The task was to determine current work status from project histories containing stale, superseded, conflicting, or missing evidence. Because human corrections were absent from those sources, only the Registry arms could report the corrected status. Within each model, direct local-file access cost 36-59% less per query, used 15-28% fewer tokens, and achieved the highest pooled accuracy with fully valid citations. Teams with comparable workloads may see savings of this order. Evaluation materials, data, and full results: github.com/markpyzhov/work-registry-eval. AI-use disclosure: Under the author's direction, AI agents assisted in drafting and editing the text, created corpus materials, ran evaluation sessions, and produced initial scores. The author developed the method, designed the evaluation and corpora, reviewed the materials, finalized the answer keys, adjudicated scoring disagreements, and is responsible for all claims and conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"Work Registry"的结构化流程，利用Git、Markdown和AI代理维护共享的工作状态。通过570个会话的评估表明，与传统RAG方法相比，该方法在降低成本（36-59%）、减少token使用（15-28%）的同时，实现了最高的准确率和完全有效的引用，且不需要牺牲上下文可移植性。
AI.research_question: 使用Git、Markdown和AI代理的结构化流程是否能在不牺牲准确性的前提下，减少团队中反复重建AI代理工作上下文的成本，同时保持工作上下文在团队成员、代理和运行时之间的可移植性？
AI.motivation: 团队使用AI代理时，项目上下文分散在聊天、文件、会议记录和任务系统中。持久化代理虽保留部分上下文，但人员和代理仍需要反复重建上下文，产生新的token成本；且代理可能将过时的工作状态误报为当前状态。现有方案（检索系统、代理记忆、AI维护的知识文件、项目简报）仅解决部分问题，且部分工具将上下文存储在应用管理的记忆或数据库中，限制了可移植性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文基于工作状态跟踪理论、检索增强生成（RAG）框架、代理记忆管理以及结构化知识维护（Git作为版本控制与可移植性基础设施）等理论框架。
AI.method: 提出Work Registry方法：在Git中维护共享的工作状态（Work State），由定时代理审查团队证据并更新带有来源链接的工作项（状态包括：开放、阻塞、已决定、已完成）。人工直接就地修正工作项，代理保留修正作为重新生成状态时的证据。通过570个会话、两个语料库和两个代理运行时的评估，与基于原始来源的RAG方法进行对比。任务是判断项目历史中（包含过时、被取代、冲突或缺失证据）的当前工作状态。
AI.findings: 在无人工修正的语料中，只有Registry方法能报告修正后的状态。在同一模型内，直接本地文件访问比RAG每查询成本低36-59%，token使用减少15-28%，并实现了最高的汇总准确率及完全有效的引用。工作量相似的团队可望获得类似规模的节省。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文在理论上贡献了一种将结构化工作状态维护与AI代理相结合的框架，为代理记忆中"人机协同纠错"机制提供了系统化方法，并对RAG与本地结构化文件访问在准确性和成本方面的权衡提供了实证比较。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一个可直接实施的Work Registry工作流，利用Git和Markdown实现工作上下文的完全可移植性（跨团队成员、代理和运行时），显著降低了AI代理使用中的token成本和延迟，同时提升了状态报告的准确性和可验证性（完全有效的引用）。

title:
Procuring Sovereignty

Public Authority under the EU Cloud and AI Act

detail.title:
Procuring Sovereignty

Public Authority under the EU Cloud and AI Act
detail.abstract: The European Commission's June 2026 proposal for a Cloud and AI Development Act (CADA) is the Union's most ambitious attempt to translate digital sovereignty into operative law. This article argues that the proposal is significant but structurally incomplete. CADA builds a sophisticated supply-side framework: cloud providers are classified against graduated Union assurance levels; higher levels depend on third-party assessment; contracting authorities must procure at the level indicated by risk assessment; and the proposal expressly addresses extraterritorial access, service disruption and vendor dependency. Yet the responsible public institution is constituted principally as a purchaser of qualified services, not as an administrator that must remain capable of discharging public-law duties through those services. The article develops this distinction between supplier assurance and retained operational control. It examines the proposal's cumulative legal basis under Articles 114 and 173(3) TFEU, its accommodation of Article 4(2) TEU, and its reliance on private assurance and adequacy mechanisms. It then shows why Articles 41 and 47 of the Charter expose a demand-side gap concerning reasons, evidence, correction, intervention, continuity and exit. The proposed complement is not a new constitutional settlement, but procurement and governance duties preserving non-delegable public responsibility throughout the lifecycle of digitally mediated public functions.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟委员会2026年6月提出的《云与人工智能发展法案》（CADA），认为该提案在构建供给侧云服务保障框架方面意义重大，但存在结构性缺陷：其将负责任公共机构主要定位为合格服务的购买者，而非必须保持通过该等服务履行公法职责能力的行政管理者。文章提出了供应商保障与保留运营控制之间的区分，并论证《欧盟基本权利宪章》第41条和第47条揭示了需求侧的缺陷，最终提出通过采购和治理义务来维护不可委托的公共责任。
AI.research_question: 欧盟CADA提案在将数字主权转化为操作性法律方面存在哪些结构性缺陷？如何在供给侧保障与保留公共机构运营控制之间实现平衡？
AI.motivation: 欧盟CADA提案是欧盟将数字主权转化为操作性法律的最雄心勃勃的尝试，但该提案过度关注供应商保障而忽视了公共机构作为行政管理者保留运营控制的需求，存在结构性不完整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字主权理论、供应商保障与保留运营控制的区分框架、欧盟条约法律基础（第114条和第173(3)条TFEU、第4(2)条TEU）、《欧盟基本权利宪章》第41条（良好行政权）和第47条（有效司法救济权）
AI.method: 法律文本分析，对CADA提案进行规范性法律审查，结合欧盟条约和《欧盟基本权利宪章》展开教义学分析。
AI.findings: CADA提案构建了完善的供给侧框架（分级云服务保障、第三方评估、采购义务、域外访问和供应商依赖的规制），但存在需求侧缺陷：公共机构被定位为购买者而非行政管理者，这导致在第41条和第47条宪章权利方面存在理由说明、证据、纠正、干预、连续性和退出等维度的缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"供应商保障与保留运营控制"的理论区分框架，论证了通过数字服务履行的公共职能中不可委托的公共责任，补充了数字主权法律化研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及成员国在采购云计算和AI服务时如何设计采购和治理义务以保障公共利益提供了具体建议，强调在数字中介的公共职能全生命周期中维护非可委托的公共责任。

title: Compliance Ahead of Capacity: Institutional Isomorphism and Cybersecurity Governance Adoption in Ghana's Business Process Outsourcing and Telecommunications Sectors

detail.title: Compliance Ahead of Capacity: Institutional Isomorphism and Cybersecurity Governance Adoption in Ghana's Business Process Outsourcing and Telecommunications Sectors
detail.abstract: Ghana built formal cybersecurity governance infrastructure with unusual speed: the Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038) established a licensing and accreditation regime, sectoral computer emergency response teams now span banking, telecommunications, and government, and the Bank of Ghana substantially revised its financial-sector cyber directive in 2026, its first major revision since 2018. Yet Kolog and Tijani's (2023) survey of Ghanaian financial institutions found that legal measures were by far the strongest driver of Cybersecurity Act implementation, while organisational measures, the internal governance capacity to sustain compliance, showed no significant effect at all. That finding is reported but not theoretically explained. This paper argues that institutional isomorphism (DiMaggio & Powell, 1983), together with the related concept of decoupling (Meyer & Rowan, 1977), accounts for the asymmetry: coercive pressure, exercised through statute, licensing, and audit, has outpaced the mimetic and normative pressures that typically convert formal compliance into embedded organisational capacity, leaving formal structure and operating practice loosely connected at best. Composite illustrative vignettes from Ghana's business process outsourcing and telecommunications sectors, drawn from operational experience, show the same pattern below the level of national survey data. The paper closes with implications for practitioners, who should not read legal compliance as a proxy for readiness, and an agenda for research testing the three isomorphic pressures directly against cybersecurity governance outcomes in Ghana.

AI.tldr: 本文利用制度同构理论与脱耦概念，解释了加纳金融机构中法律措施显著驱动网络安全法案实施而组织措施无效的悖论——强制性压力通过法规、许可和审计超越了模仿性与规范性压力，导致正式结构与运营实践脱节。
AI.research_question: 为什么加纳金融部门中法律措施是网络安全法案实施的强势驱动力，而组织内部治理能力（组织措施）却无显著影响？
AI.motivation: Kolog和Tijani（2023）的调查发现法律措施与组织措施实施效果存在不对称性，但该发现仅被报告而未被理论解释。本文旨在为这一经验发现提供理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度同构理论（DiMaggio & Powell, 1983）——包含强制性、模仿性、规范性三种同构压力；脱耦概念（Meyer & Rowan, 1977）——正式结构与实际运营实践之间的松散连接。
AI.method: 理论分析结合复合式说明性案例研究（composite illustrative vignettes），基于加纳业务流程外包和电信行业的运营经验数据。
AI.findings: 强制性压力（法规、许可、审计）在加纳网络安全治理中占据主导，超越了将正式合规转化为组织内嵌能力的模仿性与规范性压力，导致正式结构与运营实践之间仅存在松散连接；案例层面的证据与全国调查数据呈现一致模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度同构理论与脱耦概念应用于全球南方国家（加纳）的网络安全治理情境，为Kolog和Tijani（2023）的实证发现提供了理论解释，拓展了制度理论在新兴经济体网络安全政策研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示从业者不应将法律合规视为网络安全的就绪状态；提出未来研究议程，建议直接检验三种同构压力与加纳网络安全治理结果之间的关系。

title: Intraday Reaction of FX Futures to U.S. Macroeconomic Shocks

detail.title: Intraday Reaction of FX Futures to U.S. Macroeconomic Shocks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this work.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates price adjustment speed and conditional volatility dynamics in the B3 Dollar futures contract following US macroeconomic announcements (Non-Farm Payroll and Consumer Price Index-CPI). Using a high-frequency dataset comprising 134,340 1-minute intraday observations from August 2025 to August 2026, we apply an intraday event study and joint ARMA(1, 0)-GARCH(1, 1)-X modeling. Empirical results indicate that positive shocks in both indicators immediately increase the exchange rate (β Pay = 0.2005 and β CPI = 0.1953, both significant at the 1% level). Conditional volatility exhibits strong persistence (α + β = 0.9936) with immediate jumps proportional to forecast error magnitude (γ = 0.0792). The findings corroborate the semi-strong form of the Efficient Market Hypothesis and highlight the rapid transmission of exogenous shocks to the Brazilian financial market microstructure.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2025年8月至2026年8月间巴西B3美元期货合约的134,340条1分钟高频日内数据，通过日内事件研究和ARMA(1,0)-GARCH(1,1)-X联合建模，考察美国宏观经济公告（非农就业和CPI）发布后价格调整速度与条件波动率动态。结果显示，两个指标的正面冲击会立即推高汇率，条件波动率呈现强持续性且随预测误差幅度即时跳升，验证了半强式有效市场假说。
AI.research_question: 美国宏观经济公告（非农就业和CPI）发布后，巴西B3美元期货合约的价格调整速度和条件波动率动态如何变化？
AI.motivation: 探究外部宏观经济冲击如何快速传导至新兴市场（巴西）的金融微观结构，检验半强式有效市场假说在巴西市场的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有效市场假说（EMH）半强式形式；事件研究法；GARCH族条件波动率模型。
AI.method: 采用高频日内事件研究法，结合ARMA(1,0)-GARCH(1,1)-X联合模型，使用134,340条1分钟日内观测数据进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）非农就业和CPI的正面冲击均立即推高汇率（系数分别为0.2005和0.1953，均在1%水平显著）；（2）条件波动率表现出强持续性（α+β=0.9936）；（3）波动率随预测误差幅度即时跳升（γ=0.0792）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为半强式有效市场假说在巴西新兴市场情境下提供了实证支持，拓展了宏观公告冲击传导至国际市场微观结构的研究视野。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴西及新兴市场交易者提供宏观公告发布后价格快速调整和波动率跳变的量化参考，有助于交易策略制定和风险管理。

title: Efficient Simulation of Hemodynamics and Rupture Potential of an Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Using Reduced Order Geometric Modeling
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur and Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur

detail.title: Efficient Simulation of Hemodynamics and Rupture Potential of an Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Using Reduced Order Geometric Modeling

keywords: Pulsatile inflow and specified pressure outflow

detail.abstract: We investigate the consequences of simplifying the patient-specific geometry of an abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) in flow simulations with realistic time-dependent boundary conditions. In geometrically modeled arteries, we quantify important aspects of blood flow using the realistic Apostolidis-Beris viscosity model. We solve the incompressible continuity and momentum equations on a 3D unstructured mesh using a finite-volume method. Results are presented for the original and simplified geometries in terms of 3D vortical patterns and hemodynamic indicators, including wall shear stress (WSS), time-averaged wall shear stress (TAWSS), oscillatory shear index (OSI), and the endothelial cell activation potential (ECAP). We demonstrate how wall shear stresses can be reliably estimated for a realistic artery using significantly faster simulations in idealized equivalent geometries. Differences in flow patterns between the original (Level 1) and the simplified (Level 2) geometries are minor, while the reduction in CPU time is substantial. However, several essential details of the flow field are lost with further simplification of the geometry (Levels 3-4), in which surface undulations are smoothed out, and the degree of asymmetry is reduced. Each simplification helps accelerate simulation while enabling prediction of the hemodynamic indicator for the original AAA artery (Level 1). The present study is a novel attempt to simplify complex arterial geometries, which enables meaningful results from the geometrically simplified equivalents.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在具有真实时间依赖性边界条件的血流模拟中，简化腹主动脉瘤（AAA）患者特异性几何形状的后果。研究发现Level 2级别的几何简化（轻度简化）与原始几何（Level 1）的壁面剪切应力预测结果差异很小，但计算时间大幅缩短；而Level 3-4的进一步简化则会丢失重要的流动细节。该研究首次尝试简化复杂动脉几何，使得在几何简化等效模型中也能获得有意义的结果。
AI.research_question: 在腹主动脉瘤血流模拟中，简化患者特异性几何形状对血流动力学指标预测的准确性有何影响？不同简化程度（Level 1-4）如何权衡计算效率与预测精度？
AI.motivation: 真实患者特异性动脉几何的CFD模拟计算成本高昂，限制了其在临床诊断中的应用。如果能在保证血流动力学指标（如WSS、TAWSS、OSI、ECAP）预测准确性的前提下，通过几何简化大幅降低计算时间，将有助于推动CFD技术在临床实践中的广泛应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计算流体力学（CFD）理论，采用Apostolidis-Beris粘度模型描述血液的非牛顿流体行为，通过有限体积法求解不可压缩连续性方程和动量方程。
AI.method: 在3D非结构化网格上采用有限体积法求解不可压缩流动方程，对比原始AAA几何（Level 1）与三种简化几何（Levels 2-4）下的三维涡旋模式和血流动力学指标（WSS、TAWSS、OSI、ECAP），评估简化对预测精度和计算效率的影响。
AI.findings: ①Level 2简化几何与Level 1原始几何的血流模式差异较小，CPU计算时间大幅减少；②Level 3-4的进一步简化（平滑表面起伏、降低不对称度）会导致重要流动细节丢失；③壁面剪切应力可以在理想化等效几何中可靠估计；④各级简化都能加速模拟，同时保持对Level 1原始AAA动脉血流动力学指标的预测能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地研究了AAA复杂动脉几何的逐级简化策略，证明了适度简化几何（Level 2）在保持血流动力学预测精度的同时大幅提升计算效率的可行性，为动脉血流模拟的几何简化方法论提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种实用性的几何简化框架，使临床医生和研究人员能够在显著降低计算成本的情况下获得可靠的AAA血流动力学指标，有助于推动CFD模拟从研究向临床应用的转化。

title:
From Mobilised Savings to Delivered Financial Services: 
A Stochastic-Frontier Framework for Measuring the Institutional Conversion Gap in African Financial Systems

detail.title:
From Mobilised Savings to Delivered Financial Services: 
A Stochastic-Frontier Framework for Measuring the Institutional Conversion Gap in African Financial Systems
detail.abstract:
The rapid expansion of bank accounts, mobile money, digital payments, agent networks, deposit-taking institutions and domestic securities markets has enlarged the visible perimeter of finance in Africa. Yet the collection of savings and the multiplication of access instruments do not by themselves establish that financial systems transform available resources into services that households and firms can use. This article develops and tests a quantitative framework for measuring that missing transformation. The Institutional Conversion Gap (ICG) is defined as the distance between observed financial inclusion and a conditional potential frontier supported by mobilised savings, access infrastructure and prudential capacity. The empirical architecture distinguishes the realised outcome, represented by Block 1 (transformation, usage and allocation), from lagged structural inputs—Block 2 (savings and funding), Block 3 (access infrastructure) and Block 4 (prudential capacity)—and from conversion conditions represented by Block 5 (monetary environment) and Block 6 (fiscal environment). The structural frontier is estimated with a panel stochastic-frontier model whose production kernel is first specified as Cobb–Douglas and then tested against a constant-elasticity-of-substitution (CES) alternative.

The database covers 50 African countries over 2010–2024, or 750 possible country-year cells. Because no fictitious observation is introduced and incomplete lagged records are excluded, the complete estimation sample contains 464 observations from 47 countries. The selected Cobb–Douglas stochastic frontier produces an average observed-inclusion score of 26.83, an average conditional potential of 39.37, an average absolute gap of 14.82 points and average institutional conversion efficiency of 59.23 percent. Access infrastructure receives a large estimated share in the structural kernel, but this result is interpreted cautiously because Block 3 is currently built from only two sufficiently available direct annual series. Better monetary conditions are associated with a lower inefficiency scale; the fiscal coefficient is less stable and its bootstrap interval crosses zero. A CES specification yields a slightly lower Bayesian information criterion but fails the admissibility test because the optimizer does not converge and the substitution parameter reaches its upper boundary. A proposed instrument for the fiscal block is weak, the 999-replication country-cluster bootstrap converges in only 62.16 percent of replications, and the dynamic model does not outperform a last-observation benchmark in the 2022–2024 test period. The results therefore support an exploratory structural benchmark, not a validated causal ranking or superior forecasting model.

The article contributes a transparent distinction between financial presence, structural potential and realised inclusion; a reproducible mathematical chain from economic indicators to block scores, frontier potential and conversion gaps; and a governance framework for linking a multi-country econometric foundation to a subsequent country-level monitoring workbook. The findings show why savings mobilisation should be evaluated jointly with access, prudential capacity, monetary transmission and fiscal absorption, while also demonstrating that scientific validation depends as much on measurement quality, identification and stability as on a coherent theoretical model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"制度转换缺口"（ICG）这一量化框架，用以衡量非洲金融体系将动员的储蓄转化为家庭和企业可用服务的程度。基于50个非洲国家2010-2024年数据，采用面板随机前沿模型（Cobb-Douglas与CES两种生产核设定）进行估计，发现平均制度转换效率约为59%，并强调该结果应视为探索性的结构基准而非因果验证。
AI.research_question: 非洲金融体系在多大程度上能够将动员的储蓄和金融基础设施成功转化为家庭和企业可用的金融服务？如何量化这一"缺失的转化"过程？
AI.motivation: 非洲金融包容性指标（银行账户、移动货币、数字支付、代理网络等）快速增长，但储蓄动员和获取工具的增多并不必然意味着金融体系能将可用资源转化为实际可用的服务。现有研究缺乏量化这一转化缺失的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度转换缺口（Institutional Conversion Gap, ICG）理论框架；随机前沿分析方法（Stochastic Frontier Analysis）；生产函数理论（Cobb-Douglas与CES替代弹性生产函数）。
AI.method: 构建六模块实证架构（Block 1转化/使用/配置为结果变量，Block 2储蓄融资、Block 3获取基础设施、Block 4审慎能力为滞后结构输入，Block 5货币环境、Block 6财政环境为转换条件），采用面板随机前沿模型估计结构前沿，并使用国家聚类bootstrap（999次复制）进行稳健性检验，动态模型与基准预测进行样本外比较。
AI.findings: 平均观测包容得分为26.83，平均条件潜力为39.37，平均绝对缺口为14.82点，平均制度转换效率为59.23%。获取基础设施在结构生产核中占较大份额但需谨慎解读；更好的货币条件与更低的无效率水平相关，财政系数不稳定（bootstrap区间跨零）；CES设定未通过可接受性检验；动态模型未超越基准预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"制度转换缺口"（ICG）这一新的理论概念，将金融存在（presence）、结构潜力（structural potential）与实现的包容（realised inclusion）进行明确区分；建立了从经济指标到模块得分、前沿潜力和转换缺口的可复现数学链条。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了跨国外生计量基础与国别监测工作簿相连接的治理框架；提示政策制定者应将储蓄动员与获取渠道、审慎能力、货币传导和财政吸收联合评估，而非孤立推进单一维度的金融包容措施。

title: Climate stress test of an Indonesian automotive export corridor under IPCC scenarios
affiliations: Telkom University and Telkom University

detail.title: Climate stress test of an Indonesian automotive export corridor under IPCC scenarios
detail.abstract: Corridor-level climate stress testing remains scarce for emerging-market exporters. We build a Multi-Node Climate Risk Index for the Indonesian automotive export corridor, linking two plant clusters to two ports and six buyer countries under RCP 4.5 / SSP2-4.5 and RCP 8.5 / SSP5-8.5 to 2050, coupled to a network stress test and an adaptation appraisal that propagates parameter uncertainty. Heat extremes, not flooding, become the dominant hazard at the four inland nodes from 2030 and at Tanjung Priok from 2040. At 2040 under the high-emissions pathway, plant nodes contribute 70% of corridor risk on the Patimban route, while Tanjung Priok alone contributes 41% on its own. A thirty-day closure of Tanjung Priok implies losses of USD 1,215 to 2,590 million. Port elevation there clears the cost-benefit threshold in 99.5% of Monte Carlo draws; Patimban-side measures fail. Code and data are archived openly.

AI.tldr: 本文针对新兴市场出口走廊缺乏气候压力测试的问题，构建了印度尼西亚汽车出口走廊的多节点气候风险指数，将两个工厂集群、两个港口和六个买方国家连接起来，在RCP 4.5/SSP2-4.5和RCP 8.5/SSP5-8.5情景下预测至2050年，并结合网络压力测试和适应评估来传播参数不确定性。研究发现热极端（而非洪水）自2030年起成为四个内陆节点的主要灾害，2040年在高排放路径下工厂节点占Patimban路线走廊风险的70%，Tanjung Priok港口单独贡献41%。该港口关闭30天将造成12.15亿至25.9亿美元的损失，其港口抬升措施在99.5%的蒙特卡罗模拟中通过成本效益阈值，而Patimban侧的适应措施则失败。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场出口走廊如何应对气候压力？印度尼西亚汽车出口走廊在不同气候情景下的气候风险及其适应措施的可行性如何？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场出口走廊的气候压力测试研究仍然稀缺，而新兴市场的出口走廊对全球供应链和区域经济至关重要，需要系统性的气候风险评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多节点气候风险指数、网络压力测试、气候情景分析（RCP/SSP框架）
AI.method: 构建Multi-Node Climate Risk Index连接工厂集群、港口和买方国家；采用RCP 4.5/SSP2-4.5和RCP 8.5/SSP5-8.5两种气候情景预测至2050年；耦合网络压力测试评估节点关停影响；运用蒙特卡罗模拟进行适应评估并传播参数不确定性。
AI.findings: （1）热极端而非洪水成为主要灾害：2030年起影响四个内陆节点，2040年起影响Tanjung Priok；（2）2040年高排放路径下，工厂节点占Patimban路线走廊风险的70%，Tanjung Priok单独贡献41%风险；（3）Tanjung Priok关闭30天造成12.15亿至25.90亿美元损失；（4）Tanjung Priok港口抬升措施在99.5%的蒙特卡罗模拟中通过成本效益阈值，而Patimban侧的适应措施无法通过。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将多节点气候风险指数应用于新兴市场出口走廊，将气候情景、网络压力测试与适应评估相结合，填补了新兴市场出口走廊气候压力测试的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼汽车出口走廊提供差异化的气候适应投资优先序（优先投资Tanjung Priok港口抬升而非Patimban侧措施），提供开放的数据和代码供决策者和研究者使用，支持气候韧性的基础设施投资决策。

title: Distribution Matters - How Heterogeneous Expectations Shape Business-Cycle Dynamics in Japan
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Distribution Matters - How Heterogeneous Expectations Shape Business-Cycle Dynamics in Japan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses exclusively secondary, publicly available aggregate and anonymized data. The author did not recruit participants, conduct interventions, or access identifiable personal data; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper shows that the distribution of expectations contains information that its mean does not capture. Moreover, its shape provides earlier signals of subsequent business-cycle dynamics. The paper develops a framework in which the distribution of state-dependent thresholds shapes when agents act and how aggregate adjustment unfolds. Its implications are tested with five-category responses from Japan's Economy Watchers Survey, 2005-2023. Skewness predicts the direction of the next revision in the mean outlook. Combining the mean outlook with opportunity costs predicts equipment investment one quarter ahead. Dispersion adds further information: conditional on mean and skewness, wider distributions are followed by higher investment. Greater dispersion is also associated with weaker output-gap persistence. Exploratory horizon estimates link a skew towards more optimistic expectations to a cascade-consistent profile from IPP investment to equipment investment and output, even while the mean outlook remains pessimistic.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了期望分布中包含均值无法捕捉的信息，且期望分布的形状能为后续商业周期动态提供更早的信号。作者构建了一个状态依赖阈值分布的理论框架，并用日本经济观察家调查（2005-2023）的五类分类响应数据进行检验。研究发现偏度能预测平均展望下一期修正的方向；平均展望与机会成本结合可预测设备投资；离散度（分布宽度）在给定均值和偏度条件下还能额外预测投资；更大的离散度与更弱的产出缺口持续性相关。
AI.research_question: 期望的完整分布（而不仅仅是均值）是否包含预测商业周期动态的额外信息？分布的形状（偏度、离散度）能否提供比均值更早的经济周期信号？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观分析通常只关注期望的均值（如消费者/企业信心指数），忽略了期望的分布形态信息。然而，分布形状可能反映经济主体的异质性和行为阈值分布的差异，这些信息可能对预测经济转折点具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 状态依赖阈值分布框架：经济主体何时采取行动取决于其个体阈值分布，而阈值分布的形态决定了总体调整如何展开。该框架将微观异质性与宏观聚集行为联系起来。
AI.method: 利用日本经济观察家调查（Economy Watchers Survey）2005-2023年的五类分类响应数据，构建期望分布的偏度和离散度指标，通过预测回归检验其与平均展望修正、设备投资和产出缺口持续性之间的关系，并进行探索性的水平期（horizon）估计。
AI.findings: 1. 偏度能预测平均展望下一期修正的方向；2. 平均展望与机会成本结合可预测设备投资（提前一季度）；3. 在控制均值和偏度后，离散度越大则后续投资越高；4. 更大的离散度与更弱的产出缺口持续性相关；5. 偏度偏向乐观的预期与从知识产权产品投资到设备投资再到产出的级联一致的时滞模式相关，即便平均展望仍显悲观。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了期望的宏观经济分析框架，证明期望分布的形状（偏度、离散度）包含均值遗漏的预测信息，并提出了状态依赖阈值分布的理论框架来解释分布形态如何影响宏观调整的动态过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场分析师提供了利用期望分布信息（而非仅依赖均值指数）进行更早的经济周期信号判断和投资预测的方法，改进了现有信心指标的预测效能。

title: Corruption Control and Economic Performance in Bosnia and Herzegovina and Other Western Balkan Countries
affiliations: University of Tuzla, University of Tuzla and University of Tuzla - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Corruption Control and Economic Performance in Bosnia and Herzegovina and Other Western Balkan Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No.
declarations.funderStatement: No.

detail.abstract: This paper aims to contribute to a more comprehensive understanding of entrenched corruption in Bosnia and Herzegovina, through a comparative analysis with other Western Balkan countries. It is essential to determine whether corruption acts as a stimulus or deterrent to economic performance, considering empirical evidence suggesting that corruption may have a positive effect under certain conditions. The study utilizes indicators from the World Bank's Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI) database, along with gross domestic product per capita (GDP per capita) figures. The analysis employs both descriptive and regression methods applied to the aforementioned indicators over the period from 2010 to 2022. The effect of Corruption control on economic performance varies considerably across the observed countries. In Bosnia and Herzegovina, a significant negative relationship is observed. The results can help the authorities in the creation of policies and strategies that focus on the improvement of institutional quality and economic performance. This research fulfils an identified need to investigate the phenomenon of corruption in Bosnia and Herzegovina and neighbour countries in detail in recent time.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那与其他西巴尔干国家的比较分析，探讨腐败是刺激还是阻碍经济发展。利用世界银行WGI指标和人均GDP数据，采用描述性和回归方法分析2010-2022年数据，发现腐败控制在各国对经济表现的影响差异显著，在波黑呈现显著的负相关关系。
AI.research_question: 腐败是刺激还是阻碍经济发展？在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那及西巴尔干国家中，腐败对经济表现的影响方向与程度如何？
AI.motivation: 波黑及其他西巴尔干国家的腐败问题根深蒂固，且现有实证证据表明腐败在某些条件下可能对经济产生正面效应，因此需要更全面地理解这一复杂关系，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 腐败与经济增长关系的理论争议（"润滑剂"假说 vs. "绊脚石"假说），结合制度经济学的制度质量与经济发展理论。
AI.method: 利用世界银行WGI数据库中的腐败控制指标和人均GDP数据，采用描述性统计和回归分析方法，覆盖2010-2022年期间，对波黑及西巴尔干国家进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 腐败控制对经济表现的影响在不同国家间差异显著；在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那，腐败控制与经济发展之间存在显著的负相关关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为腐败与经济增长关系的理论争议提供了来自西巴尔干地区的最新实证证据，揭示了腐败影响经济表现的国别异质性，丰富了对转型国家腐败问题的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果可帮助波黑及其他西巴尔干国家当局制定旨在改善制度质量和经济表现的政策与战略，为反腐败政策的制定提供实证依据。

title: The Efficient Cross-Section is Sparse: Factor Timing and the Dimension of the SDF

detail.title: The Efficient Cross-Section is Sparse: Factor Timing and the Dimension of the SDF
detail.abstract: Out-of-sample Sharpe ratios in the cross-section of anomaly returns keep rising as principal components with negligible variance are added, an apparent violation of the near-arbitrage restriction that expected returns concentrate on a few systematic sources of risk. I argue that this pattern is a property of the payoff space empirical asset pricing studies rather than of the market it describes. Academic anomaly portfolios are held at constant weights despite predictable variation in both their premia and their risk, and are therefore unconditionally mean-variance inefficient. Applying volatility timing and mean timing to each of 212 anomalies, using only each portfolio's own return history, raises the Sharpe ratio of the large majority. In the resulting efficient cross-section, out-of-sample performance is exhausted by nine principal components, whereas the original cross-section continues to improve through 48. The discount factor built from those few components also prices the cross-section more accurately than the celebrated factor models and than its original-space counterpart, in sample and out-of-sample. Factor proliferation appears to measure unharvested timing rents rather than a large number of distinct sources of compensated risk.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，横截面异常收益的样本外夏普比率随着加入方差可忽略的主成分而持续上升，这看似违反了近似无套利约束。作者认为这一模式是实证资产定价研究中收益空间（payoff space）的属性，而非所描述市场的属性。通过对212个异常组合应用波动率择时和均值择时，绝大多数样本外夏普比率得以提升；在由此得到的高效横截面中，样本外表现仅由9个主成分即可充分解释，而原始横截面则需要48个主成分。基于少数主成分构建的贴现因子在样本内外都能比著名因子模型和原始空间对应物更准确地为横截面定价。因子扩散看起来衡量的是未收割的择时租金，而非大量不同的补偿性风险来源。
AI.research_question: 异常收益横截面中样本外夏普比率随低方差主成分加入而持续上升这一现象，究竟是市场本身的性质还是实证研究收益空间的人为构造属性？
AI.motivation: 样本外夏普比率随主成分数量增加而不断上升的现象与近似无套利约束相矛盾——该约束要求预期收益集中于少数系统性风险来源。理解这一悖论对正确解释因子扩散（factor proliferation）现象至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 近似无套利限制（near-arbitrage restriction）、均值-方差效率理论、主成分分析、因子模型定价
AI.method: 对212个异常组合分别应用仅基于各自收益历史的波动率择时和均值择时策略，比较择时前后横截面的主成分分解结构，并评估基于少数主成分构建的贴现因子的定价表现（样本内与样本外）。
AI.findings: （1）对绝大多数异常组合应用择时策略后，样本外夏普比率显著提升；（2）择时后得到的高效横截面中，样本外表现仅需9个主成分即可解释，而原始横截面需48个主成分；（3）基于少数主成分的贴现因子在样本内外定价均优于著名因子模型及原始空间对应物。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了因子扩散现象的本质：大量因子并非代表众多独立的补偿性风险来源，而是反映了未收割的择时租金。将均值-方差效率与近似无套利约束联系起来，为理解横截面资产定价提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证资产定价研究中的收益空间设计提供了方法论指导，表明常数权重组合的广泛应用可能产生人为的因子膨胀；同时为投资者提供了利用各组合自身收益历史进行择时以提升效率的可行策略。

title: Macroeconomic Stress Testing of Sovereign Debt: Assessing the Impact of Interest Rate Shocks and Currency Depreciation on South Africa's National Portfolio Stability
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Macroeconomic Stress Testing of Sovereign Debt: Assessing the Impact of Interest Rate Shocks and Currency Depreciation on South Africa's National Portfolio Stability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships with other people or organizations that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or sensitive data. Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The research was conducted independently as part of the MSc Financial Engineering program at WorldQuant University.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the transmission mechanisms of global interest rate shocks and domestic currency depreciations on South African sovereign debt stability. Utilizing an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) multiple regression framework incorporating up to two-period lags, the study evaluates how external shocks from United States Treasury yields and the USD/ZAR exchange rate ripple through emerging market sovereign debt components. The empirical findings indicate that global interest rate shocks exert an immediate and statistically significant negative impact (p<0.001), with delayed transmission effects lasting up to two trading days. Conversely, exchange rate fluctuations demonstrate mixed, statistically insignificant daily sensitivities when evaluated against broad proxies. A 10-day cumulative stress simulation modeling a +250 basis point rate hike and a 15% currency devaluation projects constrained immediate portfolio resilience, highlighting the structural vulnerabilities of emerging market sovereign portfolios to synchronized global risk-off events.

AI.tldr: 本文运用ARDL多重回归框架（含最多两期滞后），研究全球利率冲击和美国国债收益率及USD/ZAR汇率波动对南非主权债务稳定性的传导机制。实证发现全球利率冲击具有即时且统计显著的负面影响（p<0.001），延迟传导可持续两个交易日；汇率波动的日度敏感性则表现混合且不显著。10天压力模拟显示同步全球避险事件下新兴市场主权组合的结构性脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 全球利率冲击和本币贬值如何传导并影响南非主权债务的稳定性？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场主权债务对全球风险事件高度敏感，理解外部冲击（特别是美国国债收益率和汇率波动）的传导机制对评估主权债务稳定性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球利率传导机制、汇率传递效应、新兴市场主权债务稳定性理论
AI.method: 自回归分布滞后（ARDL）多重回归框架，包含最多两期滞后项，并采用10天累积压力模拟（+250基点利率上调与15%货币贬值）进行情景分析。
AI.findings: 1) 全球利率冲击对南非主权债务产生即时且统计显著的负面影响（p<0.001），延迟传导效应可持续两个交易日；2) 汇率波动（USD/ZAR）在宽口径代理变量下日度敏感性表现为混合且统计不显著；3) 10天压力模拟显示，面对同步全球避险事件，新兴市场主权组合的即时弹性受限。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了全球利率冲击与汇率冲击对新兴市场主权债务传导的非对称性特征，明确了利率冲击的即时与延迟传导路径，为理解外部冲击对主权债务稳定性的差异化影响提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场政策制定者和主权债务投资者提供了压力情景下的风险暴露评估框架，强调了在同步全球风险事件中主权组合的脆弱性，有助于优化风险管理策略。

title: Generative AI and Mutual Fund Industry Concentration
affiliations: Business School, National University of Singapore and Washington University in Saint Louis - Olin School of Business

detail.title: Generative AI and Mutual Fund Industry Concentration
detail.abstract: We examine whether generative artificial intelligence (GAI) changes investor search and competition in the mutual fund industry. We exploit the introduction of SearchGPT, an AI-based search interface that synthesizes real-time information and provides links to underlying sources. Following SearchGPT, the previously rising concentration of website traffic across fund families flattens, and the relative traffic advantage of large fund families declines. These effects are stronger for families that relied more heavily on traditional search and distribution channels before SearchGPT and are attenuated during GPT service outages, consistent with an AI-mediated search mechanism. The shift in investor search is also reflected in capital allocation: larger fund families lose relative shares of new sales and, more gradually, total net assets. Overall, our findings suggest that GAI can weaken search-based advantages enjoyed by large incumbents and have implications for how investor search and capital are distributed within the mutual fund industry.

AI.tldr: 本文利用SearchGPT的推出作为准自然实验，考察生成式人工智能（GAI）搜索引擎如何改变共同基金行业的投资者搜索行为和竞争格局。研究发现，SearchGPT推出后，基金家族间网站流量的集中趋势被逆转，大型基金家族的相对流量优势下降，并逐渐传导至资本配置（新销售份额和总净资产），表明GAI可以削弱大型在位基金家族基于搜索的优势。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能（GAI）搜索界面是否以及如何改变共同基金行业中投资者的搜索行为以及大型基金家族与小基金家族之间的竞争格局？
AI.motivation: 共同基金行业中，大型基金家族长期以来通过传统搜索引擎优化和分销渠道维持流量与资本优势。随着GAI搜索工具（如SearchGPT）的兴起，投资者获取信息的方式可能发生根本性改变，这为研究技术变革如何重塑行业竞争结构提供了独特契机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于搜索中介理论（search intermediation）与市场竞争结构理论，探讨信息搜索渠道变革如何影响企业的市场优势与竞争均衡。
AI.method: 利用SearchGPT的推出作为外生冲击（准自然实验），采用双重差分（DID）等因果推断方法，分析网站流量集中度、大型基金家族相对流量优势的变化，并利用GPT服务中断作为安慰剂检验，考察相关基金家族的事前搜索依赖度进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）SearchGPT推出后，基金家族间网站流量的集中趋势被逆转，集中度趋于平稳；（2）大型基金家族相对于小型基金家族的流量优势显著下降；（3）这一效应在事前更依赖传统搜索和分销渠道的基金家族中更强，且在GPT服务中断期间效应减弱，表明机制为AI中介搜索；（4）流量变化最终反映在资本配置上：大型基金家族的新销售相对份额下降，总净资产的相对份额也逐步下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文揭示GAI搜索工具如何通过去中介化传统搜索渠道来削弱大型在位者的搜索优势，为理解技术变革如何重塑市场结构和竞争均衡提供了新的理论视角，丰富了金融科技与市场微观结构领域的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 对共同基金行业的投资者、基金管理公司和监管机构具有重要启示：投资者可通过GAI获取更均衡的信息；中小型基金公司可能获得与新工具竞争的机会；监管者需要关注GAI搜索对资本配置和市场竞争公平性的长期影响。

title: Robust Welfare Maximization: Statistical Calibration and Full-space Policy Optimization
affiliations: , The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Systems Engineering and Engineering Management and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Systems Engineering & Engineering Management

detail.title: Robust Welfare Maximization: Statistical Calibration and Full-space Policy Optimization
detail.abstract: We study budget-constrained treatment allocation when heterogeneous treatment benefits and costs are estimated from data. We maximize worst-case welfare subject to a worst-case budget constraint over a Wasserstein ball centered at the plug-in empirical distribution of covariates and estimated policy-evaluation scores. Our first contribution is a class-calibrated statistical analysis. Because pseudo-outcome representations are not unique, we calibrate the nominal distribution to the class of score distributions with the correct covariate marginal and conditional mean benefit and cost, rather than to a fixed oracle score distribution. If the ambiguity set intersects this policy-valid class, the robust evaluations yield simultaneous causal welfare and budget certificates. For cross-fitted augmented inverse propensity weighted scores, the Wasserstein distance to this class is bounded by an empirical-measure term plus a doubly robust product of propensity-score and outcome-or cost-regression errors. Our second contribution solves the resulting infinite-dimensional functional optimization problem. Standard Wasserstein duality theory eliminates the distributional adversary but leaves optimization over all Borel-measurable policies infinite-dimensional. We show an exact sample-wise reduction: for randomized policies, a finite-dimensional linear program followed by a Shapley extension yields a globally optimal and robustly feasible full-space policy. For deterministic policies, a mixed-integer program and nearest-neighbor extension yield explicit welfare-loss and budget-excess bounds. Simulations and a JTPA case study show favorable out-of-sample welfare and budget control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究预算约束下的异质性治疗分配问题，在Wasserstein球内最大化最坏情况福利并满足最坏情况预算约束。作者提出了类别校准统计分析方法，并开发了精确的样本级降维求解方法：随机策略用有限维线性规划+Shapley扩展，确定性策略用混合整数规划+最近邻扩展，保证全局最优和稳健可行性。
AI.research_question: 当治疗收益和成本存在异质性且从数据中估计时，如何在预算约束下进行最优治疗分配，使得最坏情况下的社会福利最大化且预算约束稳健满足？
AI.motivation: 实际政策决策中，治疗收益和成本具有异质性且需要从数据中估计，但估计误差可能导致政策在真实分布上表现不佳或超预算。需要一种分布稳健（distributionally robust）的方法来保证治疗分配的因果福利和预算约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布稳健优化（Wasserstein ambiguity set）、因果推断（增广逆概率加权AIPW）、双重稳健估计、最坏情况福利最大化、半参数理论。
AI.method: 1. 构造以经验分布为中心、以Wasserstein距离度量的模糊集；2. 提出类别校准（class-calibrated）统计分析方法，将名义分布校准到具有正确协变量边际和条件均值收益/成本的策略有效分布类；3. 利用Wasserstein对偶理论消除分布对抗项；4. 对于随机策略：证明有限维线性规划+Shapley扩展可得全局最优的满空间策略；5. 对于确定性策略：使用混合整数规划+最近邻扩展，并给出福利损失和预算超支的显式界。
AI.findings: 1. 当模糊集与策略有效分布类相交时，稳健评估可同时提供因果福利和预算证书；2. 交叉拟合AIPW得分的Wasserstein距离到策略有效类的距离，可由经验测度项加双重稳健乘积项界定；3. 随机策略可通过有限维线性规划和Shapley扩展求得全局最优且稳健可行的策略；4. 确定性策略可通过混合整数规划和最近邻扩展求解，并具有显式的福利损失和预算超支界；5. 模拟和JTPA案例研究显示良好的样本外福利和预算控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将类别校准思想引入分布稳健治疗分配问题，解决了伪结果表示不唯一的问题；2. 建立了分布稳健优化与因果推断之间的桥梁，证明Wasserstein距离可由双重稳健误差项界定；3. 证明了随机策略情况下可精确降维为有限维线性规划，为分布稳健优化提供新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一种可实际计算的治疗分配方法，能够同时保证最坏情况下的福利最大化和预算约束满足；2. 为政策制定者提供了因果福利和预算的"证书"，增强决策的可信度；3. 通过JTPA案例验证了方法在实际数据上的有效性，具有较强的应用价值。

title: People are Strange: Situated Humanness in Artificially Intelligent Contexts
affiliations: and University of Stirling

detail.title: People are Strange: Situated Humanness in Artificially Intelligent Contexts
detail.abstract: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) increasingly performs capacities historically associated with humans, the assumptions about human distinctiveness and uniqueness become increasingly unstable. We argue that existing literature largely treats humanness as a stable background reference point and therefore, overlooks how humanness itself becomes questioned and reinterpreted in AI-mediated contexts. Drawing on technological mediation theory (TTM) and the concept of defamiliarization, we develop a conceptual framework of situated humanness and its reinterpretation. We theorize humanness as a relational, contextual, and temporally dynamic experience continuously reinterpreted in relation to evolving intelligent technologies across contexts and over time. We further develop a process model explaining how AI-mediated experiences destabilize taken-for-granted understandings of humanness, render them open to reflection through defamiliarization, and initiate ongoing reinterpretation. In doing so, we reposition humanness as a central theoretical concern for understanding the future of work, human-AI interaction, and the organization of AI-mediated work itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"情境化人性"（situated humanness）概念框架，认为在AI日益承担人类能力的背景下，人性本身不再是稳定的背景参照，而是在AI中介的语境中被不断质疑和重新诠释。基于技术中介理论（TTM）与陌生化（defamiliarization）概念，作者发展出解释AI如何动摇人性既有认知、促发反思并开启持续再诠释的过程模型。
AI.research_question: 在AI中介的语境中，人性本身如何被质疑和重新诠释？当AI日益承担传统上被视为人类独有的能力时，人们对"何为人类"的理解如何被动态重构？
AI.motivation: 现有文献大多将人性视为稳定的背景参照点，忽视了人性本身在AI中介语境中被质疑和重新诠释的过程。随着AI日益承担历史上与人类相关的能力，关于人类独特性的假设变得越来越不稳定，亟需一个新的理论框架来理解这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术中介理论（Technological Mediation Theory, TTM）；陌生化（defamiliarization）概念。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性研究，通过整合技术中介理论和陌生化概念，发展出情境化人性的概念框架及解释人性再诠释的过程模型。
AI.findings: 将人性理论化为一种关系性、情境性且时间动态的体验，这种体验在与不断演进的智能技术的关系中、跨情境和跨时间地被持续重新诠释；提出了解释AI中介体验如何动摇人性既定理解、通过陌生化使其开放反思、并启动持续再诠释的过程模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将人性重新定位为理解未来工作、人机交互和AI中介工作组织方式的核心理论关切；超越了将人性视为稳定背景的传统假设，为技术哲学与组织研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在设计和管理AI中介工作环境时提供理论指导，帮助理解人与AI关系中的身份认同动态，对人力资源管理、组织设计以及AI治理实践具有启示意义。

title: An Investigation on the Impact of Environment Factors As Constraints on Libyan Commercial Adoption of Islamic Financial Transactions Using the Neo-Institutional Theory
affiliations: University of Benghazi, International Islamic University of Malaysia (IIUM) - IIUM Institute of Islamic Banking and Finance, International Islamic University of Malaysia (IIUM), Students and International Islamic University of Malaysia (IIUM)

detail.title: An Investigation on the Impact of Environment Factors As Constraints on Libyan Commercial Adoption of Islamic Financial Transactions Using the Neo-Institutional Theory
detail.abstract: This paper highlights the Libyan commercial banks’ institutional environment factors, as institutional constraints on their adoption of Islamic financial transactions. Principally, in the context of formal and informal constraints, the article investigates Libyan commercial banks' external institutional environment that governs their behaviour and decisions. To achieve this end, the authors employed reports of the Libyan Central Bank, local, international reports, and the semi- structured interviews. Finally, it reviews the implications to investigate the institutional environment and the study result conducted about Libyan commercial banks. For highlighting the research gap as a future study opens up new horizons to research the effect of external environment on the commercial banks ' adoption of Islamic financial transactions. Specifically, providing a frame that includes the influence of all main actors that openly determine the commercial banks' organizational behaviour rather than only influence of bank's users.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨利比亚商业银行在采用伊斯兰金融交易时面临的制度环境约束，重点从正式和非正式制度约束两个维度，分析外部制度环境如何影响商业银行的行为与决策。研究采用利比亚中央银行报告、国内外报告及半结构化访谈作为数据来源，并提出了未来研究框架，强调应从更广泛的利益相关者视角（而非仅银行用户）来研究外部环境对商业银行采用伊斯兰金融交易的影响。
AI.research_question: 利比亚商业银行的外部制度环境（正式与非正式约束）如何影响其采用伊斯兰金融交易？
AI.motivation: 利比亚商业银行在采用伊斯兰金融交易时受到制度环境的制约，现有研究未能全面揭示外部制度环境（包括正式与非正式约束）对银行行为的影响，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论（Institutional Theory），具体涵盖正式约束（formal constraints）与非正式约束（informal constraints）两个维度。
AI.method: 采用质性研究方法，综合运用利比亚中央银行报告、本地及国际报告等二手资料，并结合半结构化访谈进行三角验证。
AI.findings: 利比亚商业银行的外部制度环境（正式与非正式约束）对其采用伊斯兰金融交易构成显著的制度性制约；研究同时揭示了未来研究的方向，即需要构建涵盖所有主要行动者影响的分析框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将制度理论应用于利比亚商业银行采用伊斯兰金融交易的场景，从正式与非正式约束双维度深化了对外部制度环境影响银行组织行为的理论理解；提出了更全面的分析框架，超越了仅聚焦银行用户的传统视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为利比亚商业银行及其他类似背景下银行机构理解制度环境对伊斯兰金融交易采纳的制约提供了实证参考，并为政策制定者和银行管理者识别制度改革方向提供了依据。

title: How Modified Adjusted Gross Income-Based Medicaid Eligibility Is Determined: Evidence from Current Population Survey and Survey of Income and Program Participation
affiliations: University of Illinois at Chicago - Department of Health Policy and Administration (HPA)

detail.title: How Modified Adjusted Gross Income-Based Medicaid Eligibility Is Determined: Evidence from Current Population Survey and Survey of Income and Program Participation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Empirical studies find Medicaid enrollment among childless adults with annual incomes well above the statutory threshold of 138 percent of the federal poverty line (FPL). Drawing on federal Medicaid regulations and CMS guidance on MAGI household and income-verification requirements, this paper shows that the discrepancy can arise from using annual income to approximate monthly eligibility and from differences in household-income construction. Using monthly data from the 2013-2016 Survey of Income and Program Participation, we construct a lowest-monthly-earnings (LME) measure and show that Medicaid enrollment declines by 5.7 percentage points at the eligibility threshold among childless adults. Applying these insights to the Current Population Survey over the same period, we construct an annual-data eligibility measure that identifies a 6-9 percentage-point decline in Medicaid enrollment across a range of specifications. Finally, we characterize the relationship between LME and annual income, showing how monthly eligibility can correspond to annual incomes above 138 percent of the FPL and thereby reconcile statutory eligibility rules with enrollment patterns documented in prior studies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用联邦医疗补助法规和CMS关于MAGI家庭及收入核查要求的指导，证明儿童无子女成年人中医疗补助参保率高于法定门槛的现象，可归因于用年收入近似月度资格以及家庭收入构成的差异。基于2013-2016年SIPP月度数据构建最低月度收入（LME）指标，发现资格门槛处参保率下降5.7个百分点；在CPS中构建年度资格指标，识别出6-9个百分点的参保下降，并刻画了LME与年收入的关系，从而调和了法定资格规则与既往研究记录的参保模式。
AI.research_question: 为什么年收入远高于法定门槛（FPL的138%）的无子女成年人仍会参加医疗补助计划？这一现象背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 实证研究一直发现许多年收入明显高于法定资格门槛的无子女成年人仍在医疗补助参保，这一现象与法定资格规则看似矛盾，需要从制度机制层面解释这一差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦医疗补助法规、CMS关于MAGI（修正调整后总收入）家庭构成和收入核查要求的相关规定。
AI.method: 使用2013-2016年调查收入与项目参与（SIPP）的月度数据构建最低月度收入（LME）指标进行实证分析；同时运用当前人口调查（CPS）构建年度数据资格指标，并进行多种规格检验。
AI.findings: （1）在月度资格门槛处，无子女成年人的医疗补助参保率下降5.7个百分点；（2）在CPS年度数据中，识别出6-9个百分点的参保率下降；（3）刻画了LME与年收入之间的关系，表明月度资格可以对应高于FPL 138%的年收入。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了医疗补助月资格评估机制与年收入统计口径之间的差异如何导致"高收入者参保"现象，调和了法定资格规则与实证参保模式之间的表面矛盾，为理解公共福利项目资格判定机制提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供了更准确的月度资格衡量方法（LME指标）和年度数据资格衡量方法，有助于更准确地评估医疗补助覆盖情况及政策效果。

title: Rolling the Dice: A Practitioner's Framework for Call Center Platform Migration in Technology M&A

detail.title: Rolling the Dice: A Practitioner's Framework for Call Center Platform Migration in Technology M&A
detail.abstract: A call center is the one part of a technology merger where the customer is on the line while the integration is happening. This paper closes out a three-part practitioner series on technology M&A: it applies the general integration sequencing proposed in prior work, and the agentic schema-convergence architecture proposed in companion research, specifically to contact center platform migration-arguably the highest-stakes, most real-time-constrained system in the entire technology integration scope. The paper works through the full sequence as practiced: architectural discovery of both the source and destination contact center platforms; a lift-and-shift versus new-platform-build decision framework; combined schema design across five distinct artifact types-tickets, image/attachment queues, forms, letters, and reports-deliberately favoring an inclusive superset design over a from-scratch canonical rebuild, because historical ticket fidelity across both merging companies is a hard requirement, not a nicety; a staged NPE → UAT → Production data migration pipeline run in parallel with new-platform feature development; a stakeholder-gated MVP definition requiring full dual-system functional parity; data-steward certification criteria specific to each artifact type; a pre-go-live validation stage where the existing agent workforce tests production-like data on the new platform before cutover; and an extension of the five-agent AASC architecture with two contact-center-specific agents. Real-world adoption data on contact center AI and CCaaS integration challenges is used throughout to ground the framework's claims. Unlike the two earlier papers in this series, which were written ahead of field validation, this paper is grounded directly in what worked in practice on an actual technology M&A call center migration-the sequencing, the schema approach, and the certification gates described here reflect real implementation experience, not a pre-execution proposal.

AI.tldr: 本文是技术并购系列论文的第三篇，基于实际呼叫中心平台迁移经验，将前期提出的集成排序理论和智能体架构（AASC）应用于呼叫中心平台迁移这一高实时性、高风险的集成场景。论文详细描述了从架构发现、迁移决策、五类工件类型的模式设计、分阶段数据迁移、干系人门控的产品定义、数据管理员认证、上线前验证，以及扩展两个呼叫中心特定智能体的完整实践流程，并以真实采用数据作为支撑。
AI.research_question: 如何将技术并购中的通用集成排序框架和智能体架构（AASC）具体应用于呼叫中心平台迁移场景，以实现高保真的历史数据保留和双系统功能对等？
AI.motivation: 呼叫中心是技术并购中唯一在集成过程中客户实时在线的部分，其平台迁移是技术集成范围中风险最高、实时性约束最强的系统。前两篇论文发表于实际验证之前，本文需要基于真实实施经验来验证和完善此前的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通用集成排序理论（前期研究）、智能体模式融合架构（AASC，五智能体架构）、呼叫中心AI与CCaaS集成实践。
AI.method: 基于真实技术并购呼叫中心迁移项目的实践研究，采用完整的操作流程：架构发现→迁移决策框架→五类工件类型（工单、图片/附件队列、表单、信函、报告）的联合模式设计→分阶段NPE→UAT→生产数据迁移管道与功能开发并行→干系人门控的MVP定义→数据管理员认证→上线前验证→扩展AASC架构。
AI.findings: 实践表明：采用包容性超集设计优先于从零开始的正则化重建方案，因为双方公司历史工单保真是硬性要求；需要干系人门控的MVP定义，要求双系统功能完全对等；数据管理员认证需针对各工件类型制定具体标准；需要扩展到七智能体架构以支持呼叫中心特有需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 将前期提出的通用集成排序框架和AASC智能体架构从理论推演推进到实际验证阶段，实现了理论在实际技术并购呼叫中心迁移中的落地检验，并验证了包容性超集模式设计在实际场景中优于正则化重建的可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为技术并购中的呼叫中心平台迁移提供了完整的操作手册，包括决策框架、数据迁移管道设计、干系人门控机制、认证标准和上线前验证流程，具有直接的实践指导价值。

title: Optimal execution by differentiable programming
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences

detail.title: Optimal execution by differentiable programming

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors report no conflicts of interest. The authors alone are responsible for the content and writing of the paper.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received.

detail.abstract: We show that optimal execution under nonlinear transient market impact can be represented as a transformer sequence model. The propagator becomes causal attention; the execution strategy's cost becomes the forward pass through a neural network. This opens up the possibility of using a neural-network-optimized stack, such as PyTorch and the Adam optimizer on Nvidia GPUs, to compute optimal trading paths in the propagator model, as well as to train model parameters from realized executions of metaorders. For power-law impact and decay, our method matches or improves on the table of optimal values reported by Curato, Gatheral, and Lillo (2017), and on signed schedules reaches those values significantly faster than the sequential quadratic programming method. A single batched descent allows us to map signed-acquisition costs together with round-trip manipulation certificates across a plane parameterized by the impact and propagator exponents. A similar batched computation locates the slippage frontier at a manipulable exponent pair, where slippage renders the signed execution problem well posed.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了非线性瞬态市场冲击下的最优执行问题可以表示为Transformer序列模型。传播子（propagator）对应因果注意力机制，执行策略的成本对应神经网络的前向传播。这一发现使得可以利用PyTorch和Adam优化器等神经网络优化技术来计算传播子模型中的最优交易路径，并可从已实现的大单（metaorder）执行数据中训练模型参数。对于幂律冲击和衰减，该方法匹配或优于Curato、Gatheral和Lillo（2017）报告的最优值表，在有符号时间表上比顺序二次规划方法更快达到这些值。单次批处理下降可在由冲击和传播子指数参数化的平面上映射有符号获取成本与来回操纵证书。类似的批处理计算可定位可操纵指数对处的滑点边界，在该处滑点使有符号执行问题变得良定。
AI.research_question: 如何利用Transformer序列模型来表示和求解非线性瞬态市场冲击下的最优执行问题？
AI.motivation: 传统的最优执行方法（如顺序二次规划）在计算效率和参数训练方面存在局限，而Transformer架构的序列建模能力与传播子模型的结构天然契合，可以借助成熟的深度学习优化工具栈来加速计算和参数学习。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非线性瞬态市场冲击模型（传播子模型）、Transformer序列模型（因果注意力机制）、最优执行理论
AI.method: 将传播子模型中的最优执行问题映射为Transformer序列模型：传播子对应因果注意力，执行成本对应前向传播；利用PyTorch和Adam优化器在Nvidia GPU上进行批量梯度下降，计算最优交易路径并训练模型参数。
AI.findings: 1) 该方法在幂律冲击和衰减下匹配或优于Curato、Gatheral和Lillo（2017）的最优值表；2) 在有符号时间表上比SQP方法更快达到最优值；3) 单次批处理下降可映射平面上的成本与操纵证书；4) 批处理计算可定位滑点边界及可操纵指数对。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了市场微观结构中的传播子模型与深度学习中的Transformer架构之间的理论联系，为最优执行问题提供了新的计算范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了比传统数值优化方法更快的计算方案，支持从真实交易数据中训练模型参数，并可批量映射参数空间中的成本结构和操纵边界，对交易执行算法的设计与风险控制具有实际应用价值。

title: Has Your Company Gone Quiet, or Just Given Up?
affiliations: , American University of Sharjah, University of New Mexico - Robert O. Anderson Schools of Management, Universidad de los Andes, Colombia and University of Oslo

detail.title: Has Your Company Gone Quiet, or Just Given Up?
detail.abstract:
Under massive political and geopolitical pressures, companies are quietly stripping the visibility from their social activities. A survey of 400 CSR and ESG executives in both Europe and the USA shows why this silence matters, and what it costs companies now and in the future.

Idea in Brief
The finding. A survey of 400 senior executives at large US and European firms operating in high-risk and crisis-affected markets finds the corporate social and environmental agenda intact, but driven underground. Firms are conserving the substance of their commitments while spending down their visibility, mostly under pressure from their own governments.

The risk. Going quiet may be strategic but it carries long-term costs. Stakeholders cannot distinguish between quiet commitment and quiet retreat, while public visibility no longer reinforces internal accountability. Over time, this low-visibility environment can encourage commitments to gradually and quietly erode.

The response. Managers should preserve social substance even when its visibility declines, but also build organizational capabilities for incorporating home-government pressures into risk assessments, capture and scale crisis management know-how, and bring younger employees into frontline decision-making as sensors for emerging social and political risks.

AI.tldr: 在巨大的政治和地缘政治压力下，企业正悄然降低其社会活动的可见度。基于对欧美400名CSR和ESG高管的调查，研究发现企业社会责任和环境议程虽得以保留，但已转入地下运作。这种"静默"策略虽具战略意义，却带来长期成本：利益相关者无法区分静默承诺与静默撤退，公共可见度的下降削弱了内部问责机制，最终可能导致承诺的悄然侵蚀。
AI.research_question: 在政治和地缘政治压力下，企业如何调整其社会和环境活动的可见度？这种"静默化"策略对企业当前及未来的成本与风险有何影响？
AI.motivation: 企业在大规模政治和地缘政治压力下正悄然剥离其社会活动的可见性，但这一现象背后的机制和代价尚未被系统研究，值得深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业社会责任（CSR）与ESG理论、利益相关者理论、内部问责机制理论
AI.method: 对美国和欧洲400名CSR及ESG高管进行问卷调查，样本聚焦于在高风险和危机影响市场中运营的大型企业。
AI.findings: 1. 企业的社会和环境议程依然完整，但已转入地下运作；2. 企业保留承诺实质的同时削减可见度，主要压力来自本国政府；3. 静默策略带来长期成本，利益相关者无法区分静默承诺与静默撤退，公共可见度的缺失削弱了内部问责机制；4. 这种低可见度环境可能促使承诺逐渐且悄然侵蚀。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"静默式CSR"这一新现象，拓展了对企业社会责任策略在政治压力下的动态理解，补充了可见度与内部问责机制之间关系的理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供应对策略：在可见度下降时保留社会实质；建立将本国政府压力纳入风险评估的组织能力；捕捉并规模化危机管理知识；让年轻员工作为新兴社会和政治风险的传感器参与一线决策。

title: Digital Transformation of R&D Project Management in Knowledge-Intensive Organizations: A Conceptual Framework
affiliations: MGIMO University

detail.title: Digital Transformation of R&D Project Management in Knowledge-Intensive Organizations: A Conceptual Framework
detail.abstract: The accelerating pace of technological change has made digital transformation a central concern for organizations managing complex, knowledgeintensive research and development (R&D) projects. This paper synthesizes findings from the author's master's research to propose a conceptual framework for the digital transformation of R&D project management in technology-intensive organizations. Drawing on a systematic review of academic literature and comparative analysis of digital tool adoption across sectors, the paper identifies three core technological pillarsintegrated data platforms, Internet of Things (IoT) sensing, and digital twin modellingand examines the organizational, financial, and human-capital barriers that constrain their effective deployment. The proposed framework conceptualizes digital transformation as an iterative managerial cycle spanning strategic goal-setting, cross-functional integration, real-time monitoring, and institutional knowledge capture, rather than as a one-time technology procurement exercise. The paper argues that sustainable digital maturity in R&D-intensive organizations depends on aligning technology adoption with organizational design, regulatory compliance, and long-term knowledge management practices.

AI.tldr: 本文基于作者硕士研究，提出一个面向技术密集型组织研发项目管理数字化转型的概念框架，识别数据平台、物联网感知和数字孪生三大技术支柱，并将数字化转型概念化为涵盖战略目标设定、跨职能整合、实时监控和制度性知识捕获的迭代管理循环。
AI.research_question: 技术密集型组织如何实现研发项目管理的数字化转型？其关键技术支柱、组织障碍和可持续实施路径是什么？
AI.motivation: 技术变革加速使数字化转型成为管理复杂知识密集型研发项目的组织的核心关注点，但现有研究缺乏整合性的概念框架来指导此类转型实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化转型迭代管理循环理论（战略目标设定、跨职能整合、实时监控、制度性知识捕获），以及技术-组织-能力整合视角。
AI.method: 系统文献综述与跨部门数字工具采纳的比较分析。
AI.findings: 识别出三大核心技术支柱：集成数据平台、物联网传感和数字孪生建模；发现组织、财务和人力资本三方面的障碍制约技术部署；数字化转型应被视为迭代管理循环而非一次性技术采购。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了研发项目管理数字化转型的概念框架，将数字化转型重新概念化为迭代管理循环，强调技术采纳需与组织设计、合规性和知识管理实践相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研发密集型组织的管理者提供了数字化转型的三大技术支柱识别和障碍分析，指导其将技术采纳与组织设计、监管合规及长期知识管理相协调以实现可持续的数字成熟度。

title: Work-related Learning and Professional Growth of Students at a Selected Open University in Zimbabwe
affiliations: Durban University of Technology (DUT),  and Durban University of Technology

detail.title: Work-related Learning and Professional Growth of Students at a Selected Open University in Zimbabwe
detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between work-related learning (WRL) and the professional development of students at Zimbabwe Open University. The purpose of the research, guided by Experiential Learning Theory, is to identify how WRL influences students' employability, problemsolving abilities, and entrepreneurial skills. Using a quantitative approach, data were collected through a structured questionnaire administered to 148 third-year Commerce students. The data were analyzed using both descriptive and inferential statistical methods. Findings suggest that WRL significantly improves students' problem-solving skills and employability. Conversely, a notable negative correlation was observed between WRL and the development of entrepreneurial skills, indicating that structured workplace environments may limit creativity. Students also reported facing challenges related to mentorship and the alignment between academic learning and industry expectations. The study concludes that while WRL is essential for preparing students for the workforce, its design should be optimized to support more comprehensive professional development. It is recommended that universities and industry partners strengthen collaboration by integrating structured mentorship programs, aligning curricula more closely with industry requirements, and intentionally promoting entrepreneurial skill development within WRL initiatives.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于体验学习理论，通过对津巴布韦开放大学148名三年级商科学生的定量调查，探讨工作相关学习（WRL）对学生专业发展的影响。研究发现WRL显著提升学生的问题解决能力和就业能力，但与创业技能发展呈负相关，且学生在导师指导和学术与行业对接方面面临挑战。
AI.research_question: 工作相关学习（WRL）如何影响津巴布韦开放大学学生的就业能力、问题解决能力和创业技能等专业发展？
AI.motivation: 探讨工作相关学习在开放大学情境下对学生专业发展的实际影响，识别其在提升就业技能方面的作用与不足，为优化WRL项目设计提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体验学习理论（Experiential Learning Theory）
AI.method: 采用定量研究方法，通过结构化问卷对148名三年级商科学生进行数据收集，运用描述性统计和推断性统计方法分析数据。
AI.findings: WRL显著提升学生的问题解决能力和就业能力；但WRL与创业技能发展呈显著负相关，结构化的工作环境可能限制创造力；学生在导师指导和学术与行业期望对接方面面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 将体验学习理论应用于开放大学情境下的WRL研究，揭示了结构化工作环境对创业技能发展的潜在抑制作用，深化了对WRL多维影响的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议大学与行业伙伴加强合作，整合结构化导师项目、使课程更贴近行业需求，并在WRL计划中有意促进创业技能的发展。

title: Watcher and Editor: Ivan Oransky, Retraction Watch, and the Unresolved Governance of an Overlapping Research-Integrity Role
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Watcher and Editor: Ivan Oransky, Retraction Watch, and the Unresolved Governance of an Overlapping Research-Integrity Role

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial competing interests. The author has an established critical research interest in the governance, methods and accountability of post-publication-comment and research-integrity organisations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This commentary analyses publicly available professional information and institutional policies and reports no research involving human participants or private correspondence.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this commentary.

detail.abstract: Springer Nature currently lists Ivan Oransky as an Editorial Board member of Research Integrity and Peer Review, with affiliations to the Center for Scientific Integrity (CSI) and New York University. CSI identifies him as its Executive Director and as co-founder of Retraction Watch, while Retraction Watch describes its work as reporting on retractions and related research-integrity events and maintains a database integrated into Crossref infrastructure. The journal's scope expressly covers competing interests, misconduct by authors, reviewers and editors, editorial decision-making and post-publication review. This is therefore not an incidental overlap between unrelated professional activities. It is a same-domain role convergence. The public record does not show that Oransky handled any manuscript, influenced any editorial decision, sought any particular retraction, disclosed an inadequate interest, or received payment tied to a case. Those allegations are not made. The governance problem is narrower and stronger: Springer Nature's public materials do not identify why he was selected, what his actual responsibilities are, whether recurrent Retraction Watch/CSI intersections are screened as non-financial competing interests, or whether recusals are recorded and auditable. Springer Nature and BMC policies require editorial-board members to declare competing interests and exclude themselves from affected manuscripts. Where the journal studies the same institutions, editorial actions and integrity actors covered by the appointee's organisation, a generic policy is not enough. The appointment should not be treated as neutral institutional validation unless Springer Nature publishes a role description, a case-screening rule, a confidentiality firewall and a meaningful recusal mechanism. If recurrent conflicts make those safeguards impracticable, role separation is the more defensible default.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Ivan Oransky同时担任《Research Integrity and Peer Review》期刊编委与Retraction Watch/科学诚信中心（CSI）执行主任所构成的同领域角色重合问题，指出斯普林格·自然（Springer Nature）未公开其委任理由、职责范围、利益冲突筛查机制及回避记录，主张该任命不应被视作中立机构背书，除非出版方公开角色说明、案件筛查规则、保密防火墙和有效的回避机制，否则角色分离是更稳妥的默认选项。
AI.research_question: 当一个在撤稿监测与科研诚信领域具有公开身份和机构隶属的人士被任命为同领域期刊的编委时，出版方应如何管理由此产生的非经济利益冲突（治理缺失问题）？
AI.motivation: Ivan Oransky的编委身份与其在Retraction Watch和CSI的运营者身份构成同一领域（科研诚信与撤稿监督）的角色重合，这并非偶然的职业重叠，而是同域角色收敛。然而公开记录显示Springer Nature未说明选任理由、职责边界、冲突筛查与回避机制，存在治理透明度缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 学术出版中的利益冲突管理理论；编辑治理与角色分离原则；机构信任与中立性理论；可审计性（auditability）与问责机制框架。
AI.method: 案例分析与公共记录审查：基于Springer Nature、CSI、Retraction Watch等公开材料，对该编委任命涉及的治理实践进行规范性分析。
AI.findings: （1）该任命属于同领域角色收敛，而非无关职业活动的偶然重叠；（2）公开记录中无证据表明Oransky曾处理稿件、影响编辑决定或谋取撤稿，但治理问题依然存在且更尖锐；（3）Springer Nature未公开选任理由、实际职责、冲突筛查机制或回避记录；（4）通用政策不足以应对期刊研究对象与编委所属机构高度重合的特殊情形；（5）若反复冲突使保障措施不可行，角色分离是更可辩护的默认方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 为学术出版治理文献提供了"同域角色收敛"（same-domain role convergence）这一分析概念，区分了操作性不当行为指控与结构性治理缺失，拓展了非经济利益冲突（NFCIs）在编辑治理层面的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Springer Nature及同类学术出版机构提供了具体的治理改进建议：发布角色描述、制定案件筛查规则、建立保密防火墙和实施可审计的回避机制；在保障措施不可行时建议采用角色分离方案。

reference: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 26/IER/31/3/3; KIET Industrial Economic Review Vol. 31, No. 3
title: China's Industrial Policy 3.0: New Tools and Broader Intervention
affiliations: University of California, San Diego - Graduate School of International Relations and Pacific Studies (IRPS), Economics

detail.title: China's Industrial Policy 3.0: New Tools and Broader Intervention

publicationDetails.detailsText: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 26/IER/31/3/3
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics & Trade Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIET Industrial Economic Review Vol. 31, No. 3

detail.abstract:
China is fully committed to industrial and technology policy. The policy motives of security and self-reliance received even greater emphasis as the US-China trade war reached its peak between April and October 2025, and a major mobilization of resources is being sustained. New policy instruments and new forms of direct government intervention have been rolled out steadily in recent months. The number of industrial sectors designated for policy support remains exceptionally high. These features define a new phenomenon I label China Industrial Policy 3.0 (China IP 3.0). The costs of this substantial industrial policy effort are likely high, particularly when we include the indirect macroeconomic and institutional costs along with direct costs. However, China shows no sign of wavering from its commitment to technological competition with the United States, and if anything, we may observe China doubling down as we enter 2026.

Barry Naughton is one of the world's premier China scholars, and has published numerous treatises on Chinese industry, trade, finance, and the country's transition to a market economy.

His recent research focuses on regional economic growth in China and its relationship to foreign trade and investment. He has addressed economic reform in Chinese cities, trade and trade disputes between China and the United States and economic interactions among China, Taiwan and Hong Kong.

Naughton is the author of The Chinese Economy: Transitions and Growth, a widely-used textbook on the Chinese economy, which has been translated into Chinese. His work Growing Out of the Plan: Chinese Economic Reform, 1978-1993 received the Ohira Memorial Prize, and he most recently translated, edited and annotated a collection of articles by the well-known Chinese economist Wu Jinglian. Naughton writes a quarterly analysis of the Chinese economy for China Leadership Monitor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"中国产业政策3.0"（China IP 3.0）这一新概念，描述中国在2025年4月至10月美中贸易战高峰期后持续加码的产业与科技政策。该政策以安全和自给自足为核心动机，通过新政策工具和直接政府干预形式大规模动员资源，覆盖行业数量异常之多。尽管成本高昂（包括直接成本以及间接宏观经济和制度成本），中国仍坚定致力于与美国的科技竞争，并可能在2026年进一步加码。
AI.research_question: 中国在美中贸易战高峰期间及之后，其产业与科技政策的特征是什么？这些政策产生了何种新的现象和成本？
AI.motivation: 中国全面致力于产业和科技政策，在美中贸易战达到高峰（2025年4月至10月）后，安全和自给自足的政策动机得到更大强调，资源动员持续进行，形成了可识别的新政策现象，值得系统归纳和分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业政策理论、国家主导发展理论、技术竞争与地缘政治经济学框架
AI.method: 概念建构与政策观察分析（基于对近期中国政策工具、政府干预形式、受支持产业部门数量的系统观察归纳）
AI.findings: （1）中国持续推出新政策工具和新型直接政府干预形式；（2）被指定为政策支持的产业部门数量异常之高；（3）这一产业政策努力的总成本（含直接成本和间接宏观经济及制度成本）可能很高；（4）中国无退缩迹象，可能在2026年进一步加大投入。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"中国产业政策3.0"（China IP 3.0）这一新概念，将中国当前产业政策的特征系统化、阶段化，为理解中国产业政策演变提供新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策分析者、国际关系研究者及商业决策者提供关于中国产业政策当前态势及其发展趋势的洞察，有助于评估中国科技竞争的政策走向和相关经济成本。

title: Improving Human-Generated Operational Data: Evidence from Pilot Competency Assessment
affiliations: , National University of Singapore (NUS) - NUS Business School, National University of Singapore (NUS) - NUS Business School and

detail.title: Improving Human-Generated Operational Data: Evidence from Pilot Competency Assessment
detail.abstract: Organizations increasingly rely on data generated through human judgment to support operational decisions, yet the behavioral processes through which such data are produced can limit their usefulness. We study this issue in the context of pilot competency assessment at an international airline, where instructors evaluate pilots using a multi-level rating scale. Combining quantitative analysis with qualitative investigation, we first document substantial rating compression: instructors disproportionately assigned the midpoint of the rating scale across competency dimensions. Semi-structured interviews with experienced instructors provide qualitative evidence on the assessment practices underlying this pattern. Instructors report heterogeneous interpretations of the rating scale, reluctance to use extreme ratings, differences in the observability of competency dimensions, and time constraints that can make fine-grained assessment difficult. In collaboration with the airline, the training unit subsequently implemented an assessor workshop that used persona-based illustrations to clarify the intended interpretation and use of the rating scale. Using a multi-period difference-in-differences design with synthetic controls, we find that workshop participation increased within-instructor grading variation by approximately 25\%, consistent with reduced rating compression and greater differentiation in competency assessments. We further find that post-workshop ratings became more closely aligned with grading patterns predicted from historical assessments and observable trainee and training characteristics, although this evidence is less robust to alternative comparison-group definitions. Together, the findings show that an organizational intervention can change how human evaluators use an existing assessment scale and, in turn, the characteristics of the operational data they generate. More differentiated competency assessments may provide managers with more useful information for identifying training needs and tailoring subsequent training decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究以某国际航空公司的飞行员能力评估为背景，发现评委在评估中存在评分压缩现象（过度使用评分量表中间值）。通过定量与定性结合的方法，识别出评分压缩的成因，并与航空公司合作设计评估工作坊干预。利用多期差分设计与合成控制法，发现工作坊参与使评分者内部评分变异性增加约25%，且评分与历史模式及可观测特征更一致，表明组织干预可以改变人类评估者的评分行为。
AI.research_question: 组织如何通过干预改变人类评估者在使用现有评分量表时的行为，从而减少评分压缩并提高运营数据的有用性？
AI.motivation: 组织越来越依赖基于人类判断生成的数据来支持运营决策，但这些数据的生成过程中的人类行为特征可能限制其有用性。评分压缩（rating compression）会降低数据的区分度和信息量，削弱组织利用这些数据进行培训和运营决策的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 评分压缩理论、人类判断与决策理论、组织干预理论（工作坊培训）、评分量表的解释与使用框架
AI.method: 混合方法：定量分析（利用航空公司飞行员能力评估数据）、定性研究（对资深教官进行半结构化访谈）、多期差分设计（multi-period difference-in-differences）与合成控制法
AI.findings: （1）存在显著的评分压缩现象，教官过度使用评分量表中间值；（2）访谈揭示四大成因：对量表解释不一致、不愿使用极端评分、能力维度可观测性差异、时间限制；（3）工作坊干预使评分者内部评分变异增加约25%；（4）干预后评分与历史评估模式及可观测特征更一致（但稳健性有限）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了组织干预如何改变人类评估者在既有评估框架下的评分行为，将评分压缩问题从描述性发现推进到干预层面，丰富了关于人类判断数据生成的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计有效的评估者培训干预提供了具体方案（基于人物角色的工作坊），帮助组织提高评估数据的区分度和有用性，从而更好地识别培训需求并定制后续培训决策。

title: The Half-Life of a Futures Contract: Technological Obsolescence and Vintage Risk in Compute Derivatives

detail.title: The Half-Life of a Futures Contract: Technological Obsolescence and Vintage Risk in Compute Derivatives
detail.abstract: A futures contract has a legal maturity, but it can lose economic relevance before that date. This paper develops the concept of contract half-life for derivatives written on rapidly evolving technological vintages. Contract half-life is the time required for a hardware-specific contract's economic relevancemeasured through commercial exposure, trading liquidity, and price-discovery importance-to fall to onehalf of its reference level. The distinction matters for compute derivatives because the announced H100 and B200 futures are tied to named GPU generations whose commercial importance can migrate faster than their rental prices disappear. A simple vintage-migration model separates rental-price depreciation from benchmark-relevance depreciation and shows how innovation intensity, maturity, and liquidity network effects jointly determine economic expiry. The model yields four testable propositions: activity should migrate to a new vintage faster than the old rental index declines; distant maturities of an oldvintage contract should lose viability first; faster innovation should shorten contract half-life; and rolling or performance-adjusted benchmarks should extend durability while increasing conversion-model and governance risk. The paper proposes observable half-life measures based on open interest, volume, information shares, and commercial benchmark adoption, and explains why a still-published settlement index is insufficient evidence that a contract remains economically alive. Because these propositions require post-launch data, the paper also uses three completed benchmark transitions-the shift of a gasoline contract to an RBOB basis, the ultra-low-sulfur respecification of heating oil, and the inclusion of WTI Midland in Dated Brent-plus unsuccessful DRAM-futures proposals as identification templates. These analogues distinguish benchmark replacement, internal respecification, constituent revision, and launch failure; they are not estimates or formal bounds on compute-contract half-life.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"合约半衰期"（contract half-life）概念，用于衡量针对快速演进的硬件技术世代（如GPU）所设计的衍生品合约的经济相关性衰减速度。通过一个简单的世代迁移模型，将租金价格折旧与基准相关性折旧分离，识别出创新强度、合约期限和流动性网络效应如何共同决定经济到期时间。文章提出四个可检验命题，并利用过往的基准转换案例作为识别模板，说明为何已发布的结算指数不足以证明合约仍具有经济活力。
AI.research_question: 对于绑定特定硬件世代（如H100、B200 GPU）的计算衍生品合约，其经济相关性（而非法律到期日）何时衰减至参考水平的一半？这由哪些因素决定，以及如何度量？
AI.motivation: 期货合约虽然具有法律到期日，但在到期之前可能失去经济相关性。对于计算衍生品这类绑定特定硬件世代的产品，硬件的商业重要性迁移速度可能快于其租赁价格消失速度，导致合约的名义存续与实际经济价值严重脱节。现有的结算指数发布不足以证明合约仍具有经济活力，因此需要新的概念框架和度量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世代迁移模型（vintage-migration model），将租金价格折旧与基准相关性折旧分离，结合创新强度、合约期限和流动性网络效应分析经济到期时间。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建世代迁移模型，推导出四个可检验命题；案例分析：利用三个完成的基准转换（汽油合约向RBOB基差转换、取暖油ULSD重定规格、WTI Midland纳入Dated Brent）以及失败的DRAM期货提案作为识别模板，区分基准替换、内部重定规格、成分修订和上市失败。
AI.findings: 模型推导出四个命题：（1）活动迁移到新世代的速度快于旧租赁指数的下降速度；（2）旧世代合约的远月合约首先丧失可行性；（3）更快的创新缩短合约半衰期；（4）滚动或表现调整基准可延长持久性，但增加转换模型和治理风险。案例表明这些命题需要上市后数据验证，历史模拟仅作为识别模板而非正式的半衰期估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出合约半衰期概念，将经济到期与法律到期区分开来；建立世代迁移模型分离两种折旧机制；提出基于公开利益、成交量、信息份额和商业基准采用率的可观测半衰期度量方法；解释了为何结算指数发布不足以证明合约经济活力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易所、监管机构和市场参与者在计算衍生品合约设计、基准管理和风险评估方面提供概念框架；通过历史基准转换案例提供识别模板，帮助区分不同类型的基准变更；为合约设计者在设定滚动基准或表现调整条款时提供关于治理风险的警示。

title: Familiarity, Trust and Diversification: Dual-Survey Evidence from Household Decision-Makers and Financial Advisors
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Familiarity, Trust and Diversification: Dual-Survey Evidence from Household Decision-Makers and Financial Advisors
detail.abstract: This study examines how familiarity, trust and perceived control are associated with household investment preferences, and whether financial advisors report comparable patterns. Two crosssectional convenience-sample surveys were analysed: 147 household respondents involved in financial decisions and 18 financial advisors or wealth professionals. Mutual funds were the most common comfortable destination for extra savings (46.2%, n = 143), while fixed deposits most often felt safest (39.3%, n = 140). Among 141 valid responses, 72.3% selected either a diversified financial mix or a combination of several assets as the ₹1 crore option that would help them sleep best. When the same ₹50 lakh was reframed as money earned slowly over many years, 28.9% said they would be more careful, compared with 6.3% who would be more willing to take risks. Tangible-asset comfort and belief that property or gold are safer were strongly associated (rs = .621, p < .001). Investment experience was associated with choosing a diversified option (χ²(2) = 17.14, p < .001). Advisors broadly corroborated the familiarity, trust and over-concentration patterns. The results suggest a familiarity-trust gap: many respondents supported diversification in principle, while willingness to act depended on credibility, family consultation and staged implementation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过两项横截面便利样本调查（147名参与家庭财务决策的受访者及18名财务顾问），考察了熟悉度、信任感与感知控制如何影响家庭投资偏好，并检验财务顾问是否观察到类似的模式。研究发现共同基金是额外储蓄最常感到舒适的去处（46.2%），定期存款最常感到安全（39.3%）；72.3%的受访者选择多元化投资组合作为"睡得最安稳"的1000万卢比选项。当同样500万卢比被重新框定为多年缓慢积累的财富时，28.9%的人表示会更加谨慎，而仅6.3%愿意承担更多风险。有形资产舒适度与"房产或黄金更安全"的信念显著相关（rs=.621）。投资经验与选择多元化选项显著相关（χ²=17.14）。顾问们基本印证了熟悉度、信任与过度集中等模式。研究揭示了"熟悉-信任差距"：许多受访者在原则上支持多元化，但实际意愿取决于可信度、家庭咨询和分阶段实施。
AI.research_question: 熟悉度、信任感与感知控制如何与家庭投资偏好相关联？财务顾问是否观察到与家庭投资者相似的模式？
AI.motivation: 家庭投资决策对个人财富积累和金融市场稳定具有重要影响，但以往研究较少系统探讨熟悉度、信任感与感知控制等心理因素如何共同塑造投资偏好，也缺乏对财务顾问与家庭投资者认知一致性的比较分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 熟悉度-信任框架、感知控制理论、风险感知理论、行为金融学中的框架效应与多元化偏好理论
AI.method: 两项横截面便利样本问卷调查：147名参与家庭财务决策的受访者及18名财务顾问/财富专业人士；采用描述性统计、Spearman相关分析（rs）和卡方检验（χ²）等方法分析数据。
AI.findings: （1）共同基金是额外储蓄最常感到舒适的去处（46.2%），定期存款最常感到安全（39.3%）；（2）72.3%受访者选择多元化组合作为最适合"安睡"的1000万卢比选项；（3）将同样金额重新框定为多年缓慢积累时，28.9%的人更谨慎，仅6.3%更愿冒险；（4）有形资产舒适度与"房产或黄金更安全"信念显著正相关（rs=.621, p<.001）；（5）投资经验与选择多元化选项显著相关（χ²(2)=17.14, p<.001）；（6）财务顾问广泛印证了熟悉度、信任与过度集中等模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"熟悉-信任差距"这一新现象：家庭投资者在原则上认同多元化的价值，但在实际行动中受制于可信度、家庭咨询和分阶段实施的信任约束，深化了对行为金融学中认知-行为分离的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为财务顾问和财富管理机构提供了实践启示：应重视建立客户信任、引入家庭协商机制、采用分阶段实施方案，以弥合投资者在多元化投资意愿与实际行为之间的差距。

title: Pricing Maritime Insecurity: Stock-Market Responses to Maritime Piracy
affiliations: University of Macedonia, , University of Macedonia - Department of Economics and Central Bank of Cyprus

detail.title: Pricing Maritime Insecurity: Stock-Market Responses to Maritime Piracy
detail.abstract: This study examines whether maritime piracy is priced at the level of the listed shipping firm connected to the affected vessel. We hand-collect incidents from the International Maritime Organization's monthly piracy and armed-robbery reports, match vessels to their owners or operators at the incident date and link the resulting exposures to daily equity returns. The rebuilt dataset contains 101 candidate event-security matches during 2014-2023; a security audit validates 97 of them. After excluding contaminated events or estimation windows and ownership links flagged for review, the primary sample comprises 55 incidents involving 29 listed firms. Event time is anchored to the first observed trading day on or after the incident. Expected returns are estimated over trading days-250 to-21 using a market model; Fama-French three-factor, Carhart four-factor and Fama-French fivefactor models provide robustness checks. Standard errors are clustered by ticker. On the common 54-event factorcalendar sample, the event-day average abnormal return ranges from-0.50% to-0.69%; it is significant under the market and Fama-French three-factor models, borderline under Carhart, and less precise under Fama-French fivefactor. In the primary market-model sample, the cumulative abnormal return over [0,+4] is-1.65% (p = 0.042). The negative response survives winsorization, pandemic-period exclusion and leave-one-firm-out checks, although precision beyond the event day is model-dependent. Exploratory regressions reveal no precisely estimated heterogeneity by vessel market, region, waters classification, reporting status or recorded loss. The evidence indicates that a localized maritime-security incident can generate a measurable firm-level valuation discount even when it need not move aggregate freight conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了海上海盗事件是否会影响关联上市航运公司的股价。作者手工收集了国际海事组织2014-2023年的海盗事件报告，将船只与其所有者/运营商匹配，并链接到日度股票收益。基于55起有效事件（涉及29家上市公司）的事件研究法分析发现，事件日平均异常收益为-0.50%至-0.69%，[0,+4]窗口的累计异常收益为-1.65%（p=0.042），表明局部海上安全事件能产生可测量的公司层面估值折价。
AI.research_question: 海上海盗事件是否会在与受影响船只关联的上市航运公司层面被定价（即引发显著的股价负面反应）？
AI.motivation: 海盗事件对航运公司的影响以往多从行业或宏观层面研究，但缺乏在公司层面验证海盗事件是否被资本市场定价的系统性证据。作者希望检验局部海事安全事件能否产生公司层面的估值影响，即使该事件不改变整体运费条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究法（Event Study Methodology），基于有效市场假说，运用市场模型估计预期收益，并以Fama-French三因子、Carhart四因子和Fama-French五因子模型进行稳健性检验。
AI.method: 手工收集IMO月度海盗与武装抢劫报告中的事件，将船只与事件日的所有者/运营商匹配，链接到日度股票收益。以事件后首个交易日为锚点，用市场模型在交易日-250至-21窗口估计预期收益，计算事件日及事件后窗口的异常收益和累计异常收益，标准误按ticker聚类。经过安全审计和排除污染事件后，主样本包含55起事件、29家上市公司。
AI.findings: 事件日平均异常收益为-0.50%至-0.69%（在市场和Fama-French三因子模型下显著，Carhart下边缘显著，五因子下精度较低）；主样本中[0,+4]窗口累计异常收益为-1.65%（p=0.042）。负面反应在缩尾处理、剔除疫情期间和逐一剔除公司后依然稳健。异质性回归未发现按船舶市场、地区、水域分类、报告状态或损失记录方面的精确估计差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将海盗事件的经济后果研究从行业/宏观层面拓展到公司层面，验证了局部安全事件即使不改变整体行业条件，也能在资本市场产生可测量的公司价值效应。为事件研究法在航运安全领域的应用提供了新的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为航运公司管理层和投资者提供了海盗事件对公司估值影响的量化参考（约1.65%的短期累计异常损失），有助于风险评估、保险定价和投资决策；同时验证了手工构建海盗事件-上市公司匹配数据集的方法可行性。

title: A Bibliometric Analysis of Research on Artificial Intelligence Capabilities, Digital Transformation, and Organizational Performance
affiliations: Amity Business School,Amity University,Madhya Pradesh, India and Amity University

detail.title: A Bibliometric Analysis of Research on Artificial Intelligence Capabilities, Digital Transformation, and Organizational Performance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known financial, professional, or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, authorship, or publication of this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study because it is based exclusively on secondary data obtained from publicly available and/or published sources. The study did not involve human participants, the collection of personal information, or any direct interaction with individuals.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Over the past century, the research linking to artificial intelligence (AI), digital transformation (DT), and organizational performance has extend rapidly.This research paper presents a bibliometric analysis of the domain, consolidating and cross-reading the findings of recently published Scopus-and Web of Science-indexed bibliometric studies which represent research space, and fixing them within the science-mapping workflow of Zupic and Cater (2015). The analysis traces publication growth, the leading journals and thematic clusters that ground the field, the dominant co-word structures linking AI capability, digital transformation, and firm performance, and the conceptual shift of AI from an operational efficiency tool toward a strategic organizational capability. The paper generalizes with a discussion of methodological limitations common to bibliometric work in these specific areas and proposes a future research agenda focus on longitudinal designs, better AI-capability measures, and underexplored contexts such as human-AI complementarity, SMEs and governance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量分析，整合并交叉解读近期Scopus和Web of Science索引的关于人工智能（AI）、数字化转型（DT）与组织绩效关联领域的文献计量研究，勾勒出该领域的研究空间，并基于Zupic和Cater（2015）的科学图谱工作流程进行梳理。分析追踪了出版物增长、主要期刊、主题聚类、AI能力—数字化转型—企业绩效的共词结构，以及AI从运营效率工具向战略组织能力的概念转变，并讨论了方法论局限与未来研究议程。
AI.research_question: 人工智能、数字化转型与组织绩效之间关联领域的研究空间是什么？该领域的知识结构、主题演化和概念转变如何？
AI.motivation: 过去一个世纪以来，AI、数字化转型与组织绩效相关研究快速扩展，文献数量庞大且分散，缺乏系统性的整合与交叉解读，需要对该领域进行文献计量分析以描绘研究版图。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Zupic和Cater（2015）的科学图谱（science mapping）工作流程，结合文献计量分析方法论。
AI.method: 文献计量分析（Bibliometric analysis）：整合并交叉读取Scopus和Web of Science索引的已有文献计量研究，采用科学图谱工作流程，包括出版物增长追踪、期刊与主题聚类分析、共词分析等。
AI.findings: （1）追踪了出版物增长趋势与主要期刊；（2）识别了支撑该领域的基础主题聚类；（3）揭示了连接AI能力、数字化转型与企业绩效的主导共词结构；（4）发现AI从运营效率工具向战略组织能力的概念转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合并交叉解读了该领域分散的文献计量研究，描绘了AI、数字化转型与组织绩效领域的整体研究版图，识别了核心知识结构与概念演变趋势，为后续理论研究提供了系统化的知识地图。
