title: Conversational AI for Frontline Educators: Evidence from a Large-Scale Deployment in India
affiliations: Rocket Learning, Rocket Learning, Rocket Learning and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Conversational AI for Frontline Educators: Evidence from a Large-Scale Deployment in India
detail.abstract: India operates nearly 1.4 million Anganwadi centerscommunity-based childcare and preschool centers providing free education, nutrition, and health services that are especially important to low-income households. Their educators combine classroom instruction with reporting and publicservice responsibilities. They often make situated decisions with limited time, incomplete observations, and delayed pedagogical guidance. We present and evaluate Shiksha Saathi, a conversational generative AI assistant designed for this setting. The Hindi-language assistant, developed and deployed by Rocket Learning, was delivered through WhatsApp to support more than 9,000 Anganwadi educators across 18 districts in Haryana and Uttar Pradesh. It was designed to address two recurring bottlenecks in frontline educational work: Guided Journalling turns brief classroom observations into weekly reports and recommendations, while Knowledge Assistance answers immediate questions using approved curricula. We follow the deployment across four versions and evaluate the mature service using longitudinal Guided Journalling records, human review of both pathways, and a survey of 152 educators. The Guided Journalling records show new reach, returning use, and recurring reporting near the intended cadence. Human review finds that the structured journalling pathway generally preserved consequential information through the persistent record. Open-ended assistance usually produced actionable responses, but its grounding and retrieval quality were less consistent. These findings show why conversational AI for frontline work must be designed as a technical and organizational service. They also suggest that specificity and persistence should increase only with information reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍并评估了Shiksha Saathi——一个为印度Anganwadi教育工作者设计的印地语对话式生成AI助手，通过WhatsApp部署，服务于9000多名教育工作者。该系统通过引导式日志记录和知识辅助两条路径解决一线教育工作中的瓶颈，研究发现其能够实现有效覆盖和持续使用，但检索与知识库的质量一致性有待提升。
AI.research_question: 对话式生成式AI助手如何有效支持一线教育工作者（Anganwadi教育工作者）在一线工作中做出情境化决策？其效果与局限是什么？
AI.motivation: 印度拥有近140万个Anganwadi中心，为低收入家庭提供免费教育、营养和健康服务。其教育工作者承担教学与行政双重职责，面临时间有限、观察不完整、教学指导滞后等挑战，亟需技术支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于一线工作情境决策理论与对话式AI人机协同框架，强调AI系统应作为技术与组织双重服务来设计。
AI.method: 纵向部署追踪（四个版本迭代）、引导式日志记录数据、人工评审两条使用路径、对152名教育工作者的问卷调查。
AI.findings: 引导式日志记录显示较好的新增覆盖、回访使用和接近预期频率的重复报告；人工评审发现结构化日志路径能较好保留关键信息，开放式辅助通常能产生可操作回应，但知识库检索质量一致性不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一线场景对话式AI应作为技术与组织结合的服务的理论观点，并提出"具体性与持续性应随信息可靠性增加"的设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中地区的生成式AI教育辅助工具提供了大规模部署与评估的实践经验，展示了WhatsApp等普及平台作为AI交付渠道的可行性，并为一线工作者AI系统的设计提供了具体指导。

title: Who may Open the Door? Access as the Key for Constitutional Jurisdictions to Defend Constitutional Justice
affiliations: and University of Hamburg - Faculty Of Law

detail.title: Who may Open the Door? Access as the Key for Constitutional Jurisdictions to Defend Constitutional Justice
detail.abstract: Access rules for constitutional review determine the institutional role constitutional actors perform within a constitutional order. This article argues that access to constitutional review is a multidimensional and gradable concept that better captures the opportunities for defense of constitutional justice recognized to constitutional jurisdictions than the classical American/European dichotomy. It proposes to replace traditional models of constitutional justice with a relational model of constitutional jurisdictions as the principal framework for comparative constitutional law.

AI.tldr: 本文认为宪法审查的准入规则是一个多维且可分级的概念，比经典的美国/欧洲二分法更能准确反映宪法法院在宪法秩序中捍卫宪法正义的机会，并提议用宪法法院的关系模型取代传统宪法正义模型，作为比较宪法学的主要分析框架。
AI.research_question: 宪法审查的准入规则如何更好地概念化？传统的美国/欧洲二分法是否足以解释宪法法院的制度角色？
AI.motivation: 传统美国/欧洲宪法审查二分法过于简化，无法充分捕捉宪法法院在宪法秩序中准入规则的多样性和复杂性，需要更精细的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多维且可分级的准入规则概念；宪法法院的关系模型（relational model of constitutional jurisdictions）
AI.method: 概念性/理论性分析（基于比较宪法学的理论论证）
AI.findings: 宪法审查准入是一个多维且可分级的概念，比美国/欧洲二分法更能捕捉宪法法院的制度角色；关系模型可作为比较宪法学的主要分析框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了宪法审查准入规则的多维、可分级概念，取代了传统的美国/欧洲二分法；建立了宪法法院的关系模型作为比较宪法学的新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为比较宪法研究和宪法制度设计提供了更准确的分析工具，有助于理解不同宪法法院在宪法秩序中的实际制度角色和权限。

title: Manufacturing Robots and their Short-term Demand for Energy: Evidence from OECD Countries

detail.title: Manufacturing Robots and their Short-term Demand for Energy: Evidence from OECD Countries
detail.abstract: The manufacturing sector is a major contributor to global energy consumption. Using a Translog Variable Cost Function approach, this study investigates the short-term energy demand effects of industrial robot adoption in manufacturing. By constructing a quality-adjusted robot stock and restricting the sample to industries with meaningful exposure to robot adoption, the analysis reduces the risk of overstating the energy-efficiency effects embedded in automation technologies. Based on a panel of 11 OECD countries, 9 manufacturing industries, and 13 years, I find a statistically significant but modest negative energy demand elasticity of-0.019%. This indicates that robots substitute for energy in the short term and reduce energy's share in variable costs. The estimated effect is substantially smaller than that of Information and Communication Technology (ICT), measured consistently within the same empirical framework and data setting. Further analysis shows that, despite their limited effect on total energy demand, robots may contribute to the greening of manufacturing by reducing the share of fossil fuels in the energy mix while leaving electricity demand unaffected. These findings have two main policy implications. First, industrial robots can contribute to less energy-intensive manufacturing and should therefore be considered in policies addressing the interaction between the digital and green transformations. At the same time, their environmental contribution should not be overstated. Second, debates on robot taxation aimed at mitigating adverse labor-market effects should also account for the potential sustainability benefits of robotization. Alternative policy responses, including worker retraining, innovation incentives, and targeted subsidies, may help address labor-market concerns while preserving the environmental benefits of automation.

AI.tldr: 本文使用超越对数可变成本函数方法，基于11个OECD国家、9个制造业行业、13年的面板数据，研究发现工业机器人采用对制造业短期能源需求产生统计显著但较小的负向弹性（-0.019%），即机器人在短期内替代能源并降低能源在可变成本中的份额。机器人虽对总能源需求影响有限，但能降低化石燃料在能源结构中的占比而不影响电力需求，有助于制造业绿色化转型。
AI.research_question: 工业机器人采用对制造业短期能源需求有何影响？其能源替代效应和绿色化效应如何？
AI.motivation: 制造业是全球能源消耗的主要贡献者，而工业机器人的快速普及可能对能源需求产生重要影响。已有文献对机器人能源效率效应的估计可能因样本选择偏差而高估，且缺乏与ICT效应的系统比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 超越对数可变成本函数（Translog Variable Cost Function）方法，基于投入要素替代理论，分析机器人与能源之间的短期替代关系。
AI.method: 构建质量调整后的机器人存量指标，限定有意义的机器人采用暴露度的行业样本，使用11个OECD国家、9个制造业行业、13年的面板数据进行计量分析。
AI.findings: （1）机器人采用对能源需求的短期弹性为-0.019%，统计显著但幅度较小；（2）机器人对能源的替代效应远小于ICT的效应；（3）机器人在总能源需求影响有限的情况下，显著降低了化石燃料在能源结构中的占比，但不影响电力需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在统一实证框架和数据环境下系统比较机器人与ICT对能源需求的替代效应，并通过质量调整的机器人存量和样本筛选降低了自动化技术能源效率效应的高估风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字与绿色双重转型的互动政策提供依据，表明工业机器人可促进低能耗制造；同时提醒政策制定者不应夸大机器人的环境贡献。关于机器人税收的争论应纳入其可持续性收益，替代性政策方案（如工人再培训、创新激励、定向补贴）可在应对劳动力市场问题的同时保留自动化的环境效益。

title: Dethroning the event: where the harm really lies — recognition, regulatory flexibility, and the social production of post-traumatic outcomes
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Dethroning the event: where the harm really lies — recognition, regulatory flexibility, and the social production of post-traumatic outcomes
detail.abstract: Why does a potentially traumatic event leave one person functionally unharmed and another with a chronic, disabling disorder? This position paper argues that the dominant, event-centred model of psychological injury—in which the magnitude of the stressor is expected to predict the severity of the harm—is empirically untenable, and that the heterogeneity of outcome is better explained by processes that lie outside the event. Drawing together five research traditions that converge on this conclusion from incompatible methodological directions—Young's genealogy of the psychiatric apparatus, Fassin and Rechtman's moral economy of victimhood, Das's phenomenology of acknowledgment, Simpson's account of idioms of distress, and Bonanno's empirical science of resilience—the paper advances the recognition–flexibility hypothesis: that regulatory flexibility is necessary but not sufficient for recovery, and that its protective effect is conditioned by the relational and institutional field that recognises or withholds the legitimacy of a person's distress. The argument is illustrated through five hypothetical cases of Australian police officers, constructed as a quasi-controlled series in which the event is held constant while the field of recognition and the individual's capacity are varied. The paper develops implications for clinical practice, mental health services, and compensation systems, and meets the principal objections to the thesis directly, including the dose-response evidence and the risk of dissolving responsibility. It closes by specifying the conditions under which the reframing must not be over-extended: dethroning the event is not abolishing it, and the account is causal and developmental, never a means of blaming the injured or exculpating those who do harm.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了以事件为中心的心理创伤模型，提出"认可-灵活性假说"：调节灵活性是康复的必要但非充分条件，其保护作用受制于承认或拒绝认同个体痛苦的关系性与制度性场域。作者整合五个研究传统，通过澳大利亚警察的准对照案例系列加以论证。
AI.research_question: 为什么潜在创伤事件对不同个体的影响差异如此之大——一个人功能完好，另一个人却发展出慢性致残障碍？事件本身的严重程度为何不能预测伤害程度？
AI.motivation: 主导性的"以事件为中心"的心理伤害模型在经验上站不住脚；结果异质性更应归因于事件之外的过程。作者希望提出一个更优的替代性解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合五个研究传统的理论框架：Young的精神病学装置谱系学、Fassin与Rechtman的受害者道德经济、Das的承认现象学、Simpson的痛苦表达习语、Bonanno的韧性经验科学。
AI.method: 概念性/立场论文（position paper），通过五个虚构的澳大利亚警察案例构建准对照系列：事件保持恒定，而变化"认可场域"与个体能力两个变量。
AI.findings: 提出"认可-灵活性假说"：调节灵活性（regulatory flexibility）是康复的必要但非充分条件；其保护效应取决于关系性与制度性场域是否承认个体痛苦的合法性。该论证直面剂量-反应证据和"消解责任"风险等主要反驳。
AI.theory_contributions: 将五个方法论方向相异的研究传统汇聚于同一结论，提出统摄性的"认可-灵活性假说"，将个体心理能力与制度/关系认可场域整合为因果性、发展性的解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对临床实践、心理健康服务及赔偿制度提出改革启示；明确指出框架的适用边界——"去事件中心化"不等于"废除事件"，且该解释是因果性、发展性的，绝非为了责怪受害者或开脱加害者。

title: Disruptive Infrastructure and Modal Shift Dynamics: A Mixed-Methods Analysis of the Standard Gauge Railway (SGR) in Kenya
affiliations: Kenya Institute of Management

detail.title: Disruptive Infrastructure and Modal Shift Dynamics: A Mixed-Methods Analysis of the Standard Gauge Railway (SGR) in Kenya

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: This study investigates the role of the Standard Gauge Railway (SGR) Kenya as a disruptive infrastructure intervention and its influence on modal shift dynamics within the country's transport system, with particular focus on the Mombasa-Nairobi corridor. The study seeks to find out the impact of the SGR on the shift of freight and passenger transport from road to rail, examine the influence of transport cost, travel time, reliability, and safety on modal choice, and assess its effects on profitability, employment, and service coverage within the road freight and bus transport sectors. It also explores the perceptions and experiences of key transport stakeholders, including truck drivers, transport investors, clearing and forwarding employees, shippers, commuters, and regulators, concerning the disruptive effects of the SGR. Accordingly, the study will use deductive reasoning, positivism and an objectivist/realist orientation primarily for the quantitative strand, while inductive reasoning, subjectivism and interpretivism will primarily guide the qualitative strand. Ontology and epistemology will underpin both strands, although their application will differ according to the type of knowledge being generated. This philosophical arrangement is consistent with the convergent mixedmethods design and its objective of integrating statistical evidence with stakeholder experiences to understand the disruptive dynamics of the SGR in Kenya. The study will make use of a convergent mixed-methods research design, that will use both quantitative and qualitative research methods. Quantitative data will be gathered through structured face-to-face questionnaires using stratified random sampling, whereas qualitative data will be gathered using semi-structured interviews with purposively selected information-rich participants. Quantitative data will be analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics, including t-tests, ANOVA, chi-square tests, correlation, confidence intervals, and multiple linear regression, while qualitative data will be analyzed thematically. Triangulation will be used to merge the qualitative and quantitative data analysed at the interpretation stage. This study is expected to provide an all-inclusive intel of the financial, management, and community consequences of SGR-induced modal shifts and generate evidence-based policy recommendations for promoting an efficient, competitive, balanced, and sustainable multimodal transport system in Kenya.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨肯尼亚标准轨距铁路（SGR）作为一种颠覆性基础设施干预对蒙巴萨-内罗毕走廊运输方式转移（从公路到铁路）的影响，采用收敛式混合研究方法，整合定量统计证据与定性利益相关者经验，评估其对货运/客运转移、成本、时间、可靠性、安全性及公路运输行业的影响。
AI.research_question: SGR肯尼亚作为颠覆性基础设施对蒙巴萨-内罗毕走廊运输方式转移动态的影响是什么？具体包括：SGR对货运和客运从公路向铁路转移的影响；运输成本、旅行时间、可靠性和安全性对方式选择的影响；SGR对公路货运和巴士运输行业的盈利能力、就业和服务覆盖的影响；以及关键运输利益相关者对SGR颠覆性效应的感知与经验。
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚SGR作为大规模颠覆性基础设施干预，深刻改变了该国运输系统的格局，但对其实际影响（尤其是对公路运输行业和运输方式选择的系统性影响）缺乏全面的实证研究。现有研究未能充分整合量化证据与利益相关者的主观经验来理解这一颠覆性转型的动态机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究采用混合哲学框架：定量部分基于演绎推理、实证主义和客观/现实主义取向；定性部分基于归纳推理、主观主义和解释主义取向。本体论和认识论为两条研究线索提供哲学基础，符合收敛式混合研究设计。
AI.method: 采用收敛式混合研究设计：定量数据通过分层随机抽样的结构化面对面问卷收集，使用描述性和推断性统计（t检验、ANOVA、卡方检验、相关分析、置信区间和多元线性回归）分析；定性数据通过对信息丰富的目的性抽样参与者进行半结构化访谈收集，采用主题分析法分析；通过三角验证法在解释阶段合并两类数据。
AI.findings: 本研究是预期性/提案性研究，预计将提供SGR引发的运输方式转移对财务、管理和社区影响的全面信息，并生成基于证据的政策建议，以促进肯尼亚高效、有竞争力、平衡和可持续的多式联运体系。具体结果有待数据收集和分析后得出。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究贡献了将颠覆性创新理论应用于发展中国家大型基础设施（交通领域）的分析框架，并通过混合研究方法整合实证主义与解释主义范式，为理解基础设施干预下运输方式转移的动态机制提供了方法论层面的理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究将为肯尼亚及类似发展中国家提供基于证据的政策建议，涉及多式联运体系的构建、公路与铁路运输的平衡发展、运输行业就业影响评估及社区影响管理等实践指导。

title: Cadet Training and Law Enforcement Human Capital: An Assessment of BNCC Cadets in Bangladesh
affiliations: University of Dhaka and University of Dhaka

detail.title: Cadet Training and Law Enforcement Human Capital: An Assessment of BNCC Cadets in Bangladesh

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Syed Hasibul Huda Nasif is a former Cadet Sergeant (SGT) of BNCC, but has no affiliation with the organization at present. Kazi Mohammad Ohi does not have any affiliation with organizations pertinent to the research. Both authors have no financial interest from the direct application of the study.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was entirely self-funded by the researchers. No outside agency has made any financial contributions towards this work.

detail.abstract: The study is concerned with the effectiveness of employing volunteer reserve defense force cadets in law enforcement. The study investigates whether the skills required for an law enforcement career are fostered by cadet training. 23 individual attributes essential for policing, grouped into five categories, were assessed among 321 cadets through two stages: a survey of 302 cadets and interviews with 19. Furthermore, 9 Ex-cadet police officers were interviewed to verify the advantages cadet training provided them compared to their non-cadet peers. Overall, the skills beneficial to law enforcement i.e. discipline, leadership, emergency response, commitment, etc. were reported significantly high among cadets. Cadets also scored high on public engagement and trust due to the nature of their duties. BNCC duties also frequently require cadets to assist law enforcement, which provides them with hands-on training of policework. The findings show that pipeline programs from BNCC to police may assist in remedying many of its recruitment issues.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了志愿预备役国防军学员（BNCC）在执法领域的有效性，通过对321名学员（302份调查+19份访谈）和9名前学员现役警官的访谈，评估了23项警务所需个人特质（分为五类）。研究发现学员在纪律、领导力、应急响应、奉献精神等执法关键技能方面表现显著较高，且在公众参与和信任方面得分高。BNCC职责还经常要求学员协助执法，提供了警务实践培训。研究表明BNCC到警察的人才输送管道计划有助于解决警务招聘难题。
AI.research_question: 预备役国防军学员（BNCC）训练是否能有效培养执法职业所需的技能，以及BNCC到警察的人才管道计划是否有助于解决警务招聘问题？
AI.motivation: 警务招聘面临诸多困难，需要探索替代性的人才来源。BNCC学员经常参与执法协助工作，但其训练是否真的能培养警务所需的关键技能，以及是否可作为有效的警务人才输送渠道，值得系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于技能培养与职业匹配理论框架，将警务职业所需的23项个人特质分为五类进行评估，通过多阶段、多方法的混合设计来验证学员训练与警务技能需求之间的匹配度。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：1）对302名学员进行问卷调查；2）对19名学员进行深入访谈；3）对9名前学员现役警官进行访谈以验证训练优势。两阶段数据收集，定量与定性结合。
AI.findings: 1）学员在执法有益的技能（如纪律、领导力、应急响应、奉献精神）方面得分显著较高；2）由于职责性质，学员在公众参与和信任方面得分高；3）BNCC职责经常要求学员协助执法，提供警务实践培训；4）BNCC到警察的人才管道计划有助于补救警务招聘的多项问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为预备役军事训练与执法职业能力培养之间的关联性提供了实证证据，拓展了人才管道理论和警务人力资本理论在志愿者预备役力量领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为警务部门提供了一个可行的人才招聘替代渠道——通过BNCC学员管道计划解决警务招聘难题；同时验证了BNCC训练的实际警务价值，对政策制定者和警务管理者具有实践指导意义。

title: Persistent Doors: Denial-Rate Stability and Structural Breaks Across Eleven of the Largest FHA Lenders, 2018-2025

detail.title: Persistent Doors: Denial-Rate Stability and Structural Breaks Across Eleven of the Largest FHA Lenders, 2018-2025
detail.abstract: A companion paper documents that in the 2025 HMDA record, lender identity accounts for 37.97 percent of all explained variation in FHA denial outcomes (Yetis, 2026). This paper asks whether that cross-sectional dispersion is durable structure or year-specific noise. Using an eight-year annual panel (2018-2025) of denial rates for eleven of the largest FHA lenders-88 lender-year cells built from the public HMDA record-I document three facts. First, the door hierarchy is nearly frozen: 80.8 percent of pooled variance in the panel is between lenders rather than within lenders over time, and the year-over-year Spearman rank correlation of lender orderings has a median of 0.918; the most lenient lender is the same institution in seven of eight years, and the runner-up is the same in seven of eight. Second, persistence is punctuated: count-based likelihood-ratio tests locate single regime shifts of at least five percentage points at four lenders-two large declines (-19.0 and-18.6 points) around 2019-2021 and two increases (+18.1 and +7.9 points) at the 2021-2022 rate-regime boundary. Third, only one lender exhibits a statistically significant monotone trend (Mann-Kendall p = 0.009; Sen slope-4.1 points per year). Because nearly any difference is statistically significant at these sample sizes, classification is by published magnitude thresholds, with test statistics reported for transparency. All estimates are associational; the series and code definitions are public under CC BY 4.0.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2018-2025年FHA最大11家贷款机构的年度面板数据（88个机构-年观测），考察FHA贷款拒绝率的跨机构差异是持久性结构还是年度噪声。研究发现：贷款机构的"门槛层级"几乎冻结（80.8%的方差来自机构间差异而非时间变化），但持久性被少数结构性突变打断（四家机构出现至少5个百分点的制度变迁），仅一家机构呈现显著的单调趋势。
AI.research_question: FHA贷款拒绝率的跨机构横截面差异是持久性结构（durable structure）还是年度特异性噪声（year-specific noise）？
AI.motivation: 前序论文（Yetis, 2026）发现2025年HMDA记录中，贷款机构身份解释了FHA拒绝结果37.97%的可解释变异。但单一年份的横截面差异可能只是偶然噪声，需要跨期面板数据检验其持久性，以判断机构间差异是否反映稳定的制度性结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于方差分解框架（组间vs组内方差）、Spearman秩相关、计数型似然比检验（count-based likelihood-ratio tests）以及Mann-Kendall趋势检验等统计方法，考察机构效应的持久性与突变性。
AI.method: 使用2018-2025年八年度面板数据，覆盖11家最大FHA贷款机构（88个机构-年单元格，数据来自公开HMDA记录）。采用三类检验：（1）方差分解计算组间（机构间）与组内（时间）方差占比；（2）年际Spearman秩相关衡量排序稳定性；（3）计数型似然比检验识别制度突变点，辅以Mann-Kendall趋势检验。因样本量下几乎任何差异都统计显著，分类依据已发布的幅度阈值。
AI.findings: （1）机构门槛层级近乎冻结：80.8%的合并方差来自机构间而非时间变化，年际Spearman秩相关中位数为0.918；最宽松机构在八年中七年相同，次宽松机构同样七年相同。（2）持久性被突变打断：四家机构出现至少5个百分点的单一制度突变——两处大幅下降（-19.0和-18.6个百分点，约在2019-2021年）和两处上升（+18.1和+7.9个百分点，位于2021-2022年利率制度边界）。（3）仅一家机构呈现统计显著的单调趋势（Mann-Kendall p=0.009；Sen斜率每年-4.1个百分点）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融机构行为持久性研究提供了FHA抵押贷款领域的实证证据，表明贷款机构的审批标准差异具有高度稳定的跨期结构，但同时识别出制度突变（regime shift）如何打破这种稳定性；丰富了关于机构效应（lender identity）持久性与动态性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供FHA贷款审批差异的长期动态图景：机构间差异主要源于稳定结构而非随机波动，但监管者应关注识别出的制度突变时点（尤其是2021-2022年利率制度边界附近的变化），以评估政策干预和利率环境变化对贷款可及性的影响。所有数据和代码在CC BY 4.0许可下公开，便于复现和持续监测。

title: Prescriptive Analytics for Data-Driven Inventory Control: Introduction and Practical Research Opportunities
affiliations: Business Administration & Economics

detail.title: Prescriptive Analytics for Data-Driven Inventory Control: Introduction and Practical Research Opportunities
detail.abstract: Prescriptive analytics offers the opportunity to complement traditional inventory control methods with data-driven optimization approaches that leverage machine learning. This work reviews current applications of prescriptive analytics to inventory control from a practitioner's perspective and synthesizes findings from existing literature reviews and relevant studies. We identify three overarching practical limitations around the reflection of real-world problem complexity, the adaptation to real-world data regimes, and the flexibility in accommodating diverse problem settings. Building on these findings, we formulate two complementary research propositions: effectively using available data through cross-learning and effectively leveraging true state-of-the-art machine learning models across problems could further advance the benefits of data-driven optimization applied to real-world inventory control. Two numerical experiments demonstrate the potential of these propositions and provide empirical evidence that motivates future research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文从实践者视角综述了预测性分析在库存控制中的应用，识别出三大实践局限（问题复杂性反映不足、现实数据适应不足、问题设置灵活性不足），并提出两个互补研究命题（跨学习有效利用数据和跨问题利用先进机器学习模型），通过两个数值实验提供实证支持。
AI.research_question: 预测性分析在库存控制中的应用存在哪些实践局限性？如何通过跨学习和先进机器学习模型进一步推动数据驱动优化在库存控制中的价值？
AI.motivation: 预测性分析为传统库存控制方法提供了数据驱动优化的机会，但从实践者角度看，现有应用仍存在多方面的局限，需要系统梳理和提出改进方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测性分析（Prescriptive Analytics）、数据驱动优化（Data-Driven Optimization）、机器学习（Machine Learning）、跨学习（Cross-Learning）
AI.method: 文献综述与综合分析方法，结合两个数值实验验证所提出的研究命题。
AI.findings: 识别出三大实践局限：（1）对现实世界问题复杂性的反映不足；（2）对现实世界数据模式的适应不足；（3）在适应多样化问题设置方面的灵活性不足。提出两个研究命题：通过跨学习有效利用数据，以及通过利用先进机器学习模型跨问题提升数据驱动优化效果，数值实验为这些命题提供了实证证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统综合了预测性分析在库存控制领域的现有文献，从实践者视角提出了三个核心局限性框架，并构建了两个互补的研究命题，为未来数据驱动库存控制研究提供了理论方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者在库存控制中应用预测性分析提供了清晰的局限认知和改进路径，跨学习和先进机器学习模型的应用建议可直接指导实际库存管理决策的优化。

title: Human, AI, and Organizational Performance (HAOP): A Safety Framework for the AI Era

detail.title: Human, AI, and Organizational Performance (HAOP): A Safety Framework for the AI Era

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author developed the HAOP framework and operates haop.ai, which provides related practitioner tools and materials. No other personal or financial relationships influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This work involved no research with human participants. Workplace incidents described are drawn from public regulatory records and published sources, or are presented anonymized at industry level.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Human, AI, and Organizational Performance (HAOP) is a safety framework that extends Human and Organizational Performance (HOP) to work systems in which AI performs consequential functions. It recognizes three performers within one work system: the human, who adapts; the AI, which optimizes within its representation and constraints; and the organization, which contains and governs, authoring the conditions under which the other two perform.

From this architecture, HAOP develops characteristic failure and contribution signatures and a five-hazard register for identifying hazards introduced or amplified by AI-enabled work. It adds five operating modes that classify how AI performs in the workflow; Accountability by Control, which keeps responsibility attached to the roles holding relevant control; and a work-design method organized by the industrial hygiene sequence of Anticipate, Recognize, Evaluate, Control, and Confirm (ARECC). The method specifies requirements for grounding; for human, automated, and hybrid Verification Gates; for Verification Capacity and Anchor Access; and for protected human pause authority and Designed AI Reassessment Pauses.

HAOP also introduces the AI Deployment Safety Data Sheet (ADSDS) as a bidirectional hazard-communication instrument, candidate leading measures for Verification Overrun as a prospective hazard condition, and the True Function Test as an initial diagnostic that organizations can apply now. The paper situates the framework alongside convergent 2026 work on delegated authority and designed oversight and examines insurance exclusions and assessment-based underwriting as emerging market demand for evidence of allocation, control, verification, and governance. HAOP and its integrated work-design method have not yet been empirically validated; the paper identifies a testing agenda for operational pilots and comparative evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HAOP（Human, AI, and Organizational Performance）安全框架，将传统的HOP（人类与组织绩效）框架扩展至AI执行关键功能的工作系统，通过定义人类、AI与组织三方表演者的角色架构，建立故障与贡献特征、五种危险源登记、五种AI工作模式、ARECC工作设计方法及AI部署安全数据表，为AI赋能工作提供系统化的安全管理方法。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个系统化的安全框架，以识别、评估和控制AI在执行关键功能的工作系统中引入或放大的危险与风险？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在关键工作职能中的广泛应用，传统的人类与组织绩效（HOP）安全框架无法涵盖AI作为工作系统参与者的角色，需要扩展以应对AI引入的新型安全风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: HAOP框架基于HOP（人类与组织绩效）理论，提出三方表演者模型（人类适应、AI优化、组织治理），并结合工业卫生学中的ARECC（预期、识别、评估、控制、确认）序列作为工作设计方法基础。
AI.method: 概念框架构建与理论推演，包括：故障与贡献特征分析、五种危险源登记、五种AI工作模式分类、ARECC工作设计方法、AI部署安全数据表（ADSDS）设计，以及验证门槛、验证容量、锚定访问、暂停权等具体机制设计。
AI.findings: HAOP框架提出了完整的AI安全管理架构，包括故障特征签名、危险源登记体系、AI工作模式分类、责任分配机制（问责控制）、ARECC工作设计方法及ADSDS双向危险沟通工具，并识别了验证超限作为前瞻性危险条件及其领先指标。但该框架尚未经过实证验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统的HOP安全框架理论扩展至AI参与的工作系统，提出了三方表演者架构模型、AI特有故障特征签名、五种AI工作模式分类，以及验证超限等新的理论概念，为AI安全工作设计提供了系统化理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的工作设计方法（ARECC序列）、AI部署安全数据表（ADSDS）、验证门槛与暂停权的具体设计要求、真功能测试等即用诊断工具，并可服务于保险承保与风险评估等市场实践需求。

title: The AI Dependency Index (IDA): Quantifying Minimum Workforce Continuity in AI-Dependent Organizations
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The AI Dependency Index (IDA): Quantifying Minimum Workforce Continuity in AI-Dependent Organizations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of All AIdeas SAS (Buenos Aires, Argentina), a consultancy working on artificial intelligence adoption, and teaches postgraduate and final-year project courses at Universidad Tecnologica Nacional, Facultad Regional Buenos Aires. The model, its source code and its test battery are released under the MIT licence and are freely available to anyone; no commercial product, service or client engagement depends on the results reported here. No other personal or financial relationship influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study involves no human participants, no animal subjects and no personal data. It develops a deterministic analytical model and evaluates it on synthetic and illustrative scenarios.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was carried out by the author and self-funded by All AIdeas SAS.

detail.abstract: Problem. Organizations adopting artificial intelligence compute how many people they can release. We did not find a published framework that quantifies how many they must retain to keep operating if the provider becomes unavailable. Two developments in 2026 make that second number urgent: the price of inference is not anchored to any verifiable cost structure, and on 12 June 2026 a United States export-control order required a frontier provider to suspend two of its most advanced models for all foreign nationals; unable to verify nationality per user, the provider disabled both models for every customer worldwide until the controls were lifted on 30 June [5]. The disruption originated in policy, not infrastructure. Gap. Governance and operational-resilience frameworks prescribe dependency mapping, criticality tiering and fallback protocols. The AI Resilience Framework [1] extends impact-tolerance constructs to AI dependencies and identifies a quantitative substitutability score as an unrealised extension, which this work develops in workforce terms. Method. The AI Dependency Index (IDA) is a deterministic model built from six operational inputs managers already hold. It returns four outputs in one accounting: a retained workforce, a risk-adjusted saving, a maximum defensible investment, and a bounded 0-100 exposure score discounted by verified external backup. Findings. Past the continuity floor, further automation raises the AI bill without releasing anyone: savings fall while exposure rises. Under fixed-cost architectures savings plateau instead of falling, yet exposure still rises, so automation then buys dependency for nothing. Both behaviours follow from the equations. Availability. The model, its formulas, an executable implementation and a battery of 24 edge cases are published under the MIT licence and deposited with a permanent identifier [2]. It runs at modelo-ida.web.app.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI依赖指数（IDA），一个确定性模型，帮助组织在采用AI时计算必须保留多少员工以维持运营（当AI供应商不可用时），超越了仅计算可裁员人数的传统做法。模型基于六个管理者已掌握的操作输入，输出四个结果：保留员工数、风险调整后的节省、最大可防御投资和0-100暴露评分。
AI.research_question: 组织在采用AI时，必须保留多少员工以在AI供应商不可用时维持运营？
AI.motivation: 2026年两项发展使这一计算变得紧迫：（1）推理价格未锚定任何可验证的成本结构；（2）2026年6月12日美国出口管制令要求前沿提供商暂停向所有外国国民提供两个最先进模型，因无法逐用户验证国籍，提供商对全球所有客户禁用了这两个模型，直至6月30日管制解除。该中断源于政策而非基础设施，凸显了AI供应链的脆弱性。现有框架缺乏量化AI依赖所需保留人力的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI韧性框架（AI Resilience Framework）将影响容忍（impact-tolerance）概念扩展至AI依赖，但识别出定量可替代性评分（quantitative substitutability score）为未实现的扩展方向，本文以人力术语予以发展。
AI.method: AI依赖指数（IDA）是一个确定性模型，基于六个管理者已掌握的操作输入构建，以统一会计方式输出四个指标：保留人力、风险调整后的节省、最大可防御投资以及经验证外部备份贴现的0-100有界暴露评分。模型配备公式、可执行实现及24个边界案例测试，以MIT许可证发布并存入永久标识符。
AI.findings: 超过连续性底线（continuity floor）后，进一步自动化会提高AI账单但不释放任何人：节省下降而暴露上升。在固定成本架构下，节省趋于平稳而非下降，但暴露仍上升，此时自动化只购买依赖却无回报。两种行为都可由方程推导得出。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了AI韧性框架中定量可替代性评分这一未实现扩展，将影响容忍概念发展为可操作的人力保留计算方法，为AI依赖治理提供了确定性建模基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供可执行的计算工具（模型及在线应用），帮助管理者在自动化决策中同时考量保留人力（风险底线）和释放人力（成本节省），避免过度自动化导致运营脆弱性。模型开源（MIT许可），可审计、可复现，并附带24个边界案例验证。

title: Engaging Stakeholders as Research Collaborators: A Modern Blueprint for Workforce Development Research and Innovation

detail.title: Engaging Stakeholders as Research Collaborators: A Modern Blueprint for Workforce Development Research and Innovation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no conflicts of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded.

detail.abstract: This working paper presents a practical blueprint for engaging stakeholders as research collaborators in workforce development research and innovation. It argues that in complex organizational environments, research is most useful when those who influence, use, or are affected by findings participate throughout the research lifecycle. Drawing on stakeholder theory, evidence-based management, organizational development, participatory research, trust research, and change-management literature, the paper reframes stakeholder engagement as a strategic capability rather than a procedural activity. It outlines methods for identifying and prioritizing stakeholders, building trust, co-creating research agendas, sustaining engagement, tailoring participation strategies, and tracking engagement levels as indicators of organizational readiness and alignment. The paper emphasizes integrating stakeholder input with external research and internal data to create a contextual mosaic of evidence that improves decision quality and strengthens implementation. For workforce development practitioners, stakeholder engagement also functions as an intervention: it surfaces system dynamics, fosters psychological ownership, supports shared sensemaking, and accelerates adoption of research findings. The paper concludes that organizations that embed engagement into routine practice are better positioned to produce rigorous, relevant, actionable research while strengthening relationships, innovation capacity, and resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一份将利益相关者作为研究合作者纳入劳动力发展研究与创新的实用蓝图，主张将利益相关者参与从程序性活动重新定义为战略性能力，通过整合利益相关者意见、外部研究与内部数据形成情境化证据拼图，以提升决策质量和实施效果。
AI.research_question: 在复杂的组织环境中，如何将利益相关者作为研究合作者有效地纳入劳动力发展研究的全生命周期，以提升研究的严谨性、相关性和可操作性？
AI.motivation: 在复杂组织环境中，研究要发挥作用需要那些影响、使用或受研究发现影响的人全程参与。然而当前利益相关者参与往往被视为程序性活动，缺乏系统性框架，因此需要重新定位并将其发展为战略性能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论、循证管理、组织发展理论、参与式研究、信任研究、变革管理文献
AI.method: 概念性/框架性工作论文，基于多学科文献综述，提出实用的利益相关者参与蓝图和方法论框架。
AI.findings: 利益相关者参与可作为组织干预手段，能够揭示系统动态、培养心理所有权、支持共同意义建构、加速研究发现的采纳；将利益相关者意见与外部研究及内部数据整合可形成"情境化证据拼图"，提升决策质量；将参与嵌入日常实践的组织更可能产出严谨、相关、可操作的研究。
AI.theory_contributions: 将利益相关者参与从程序性活动重新框定为战略性能力，整合多学科理论视角，提出了利益相关者参与水平可作为组织准备度和一致性的指标这一新观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了识别和优先排序利益相关者、建立信任、共同创建研究议程、维持参与、定制参与策略以及追踪参与水平的具体方法，为劳动力发展实践者提供了可操作的参与路线图。

title: Improving Intersection Safety Screening Through Probabilistic Severity Weighting
affiliations: Texas Tech University, Texas Tech University, Texas Tech University, Texas Tech University, Texas Tech University, Texas Tech University and Texas Tech University

detail.title: Improving Intersection Safety Screening Through Probabilistic Severity Weighting
detail.abstract: Annual intersection screening determines which locations enter safety evaluation when severe crashes are sparse and review budgets are limited. Severity weighted crash frequency gives agencies a traceable additive score, but each crash enters that score through a fixed severity class value. This study tests whether calibrated crash level probabilities of fatal or suspected serious injury can replace those fixed values without losing the audit structure of an additive site score. Crash Records Information System records from two Texas urban networks were processed through separate regional pipelines. Records were collapsed to the crash level, assigned deterministic intersection keys, screened for outcome leakage, modeled with balanced logistic regression, calibrated with sigmoid calibration using the last screening year, and aggregated to intersection scores. Scores from 2016 through 2021 crash histories were evaluated against fatal or suspected serious injury crashes observed from 2022 through 2025. At the 5% screening threshold, the probability weighted ranking captured 61 future severe crashes within the midsized network compared with 47 under fixed severity weighting, and 515 within the larger metropolitan network compared with 445. The same ordering held at the 10% and 15% thresholds. Probability weighted rankings also produced higher adjacent year Spearman rank stability in every evaluated base year. The evidence supports calibrated crash level probability as a consequence contribution for intersection network screening when calibration and leakage controls are maintained at the local data scale.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否用校准后的单次碰撞致死/重伤概率替代固定严重度等级值，用于路口网络筛查排序。基于德克萨斯两个城市网络的CRIS数据，通过平衡逻辑回归建模、sigmoid校准和碰撞级聚合，发现概率加权排序在5%-15%筛查阈值下均捕获更多未来严重碰撞，且排序稳定性更高，支持在数据泄漏控制下用校准概率作为筛查替代方案。
AI.research_question: 校准后的碰撞级致死或疑似重伤概率能否替代固定严重度类别值，用于路口网络筛查，同时不失去可加性站点评分的审计结构？
AI.motivation: 年度交叉口筛查决定在严重碰撞稀疏、审查预算有限的情况下哪些位置进入安全评估。传统的严重度加权碰撞频率使用固定严重度类别值，但这可能无法反映碰撞严重度的实际差异，需要探索更精细的碰撞级概率能否提升筛查效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 严重度加权碰撞频率的可加性评分审计结构；平衡逻辑回归建模；sigmoid校准；碰撞级概率聚合理论。
AI.method: 基于德克萨斯两个城市网络的CRIS碰撞数据，经区域管道处理：碰撞记录折叠至碰撞级、分配确定性路口键、筛查结果泄漏、平衡逻辑回归建模、使用最后筛查年进行sigmoid校准、聚合为路口评分。用2016-2021年碰撞历史评分评估2022-2025年观察到的致死/疑似重伤碰撞。
AI.findings: 在5%筛查阈值下，概率加权排序在中型网络中捕获61个未来严重碰撞（固定严重度加权为47个），在大型都市网络中捕获515个（固定加权为445个）。10%和15%阈值下排序一致。概率加权排序在每个评估基准年都产生更高的相邻年Spearman秩稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出校准碰撞级概率可作为路口网络筛查的后果贡献指标，在保持局部数据尺度的校准和泄漏控制条件下，证明概率加权方法优于固定严重度加权，为交通安全筛查方法提供了理论扩展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通管理机构提供了更有效的路口筛查方法，可提高筛查预算使用效率，在相同筛查阈值下捕获更多未来严重碰撞，同时维持原有可加性评分审计结构。

title: Data Science in Multi-Cloud Governance: Insights for Security, Scalability, and Risk Mitigation

detail.title: Data Science in Multi-Cloud Governance: Insights for Security, Scalability, and Risk Mitigation
detail.abstract: As companies search for more resilience, scalability, and flexibility in their IT systems, multi-cloud systems are becoming more and more used. Particularly with relation to security, scalability, and risk reduction, managing governance throughout several cloud platforms presents significant challenges. Conventional governance systems sometimes fall short in providing quick understanding of security concerns, compliance issues, and resource optimization. By use of advanced analytics, machine learning, and predictive modelling to translate raw multi-cloud data into actionable insights, data science offers a strong approach for addressing these challenges. Focusing especially on security, scalability, and risk management, this project aims to study how data science could help to improve governance in multi-cloud environments. Using a qualitative approach, the study incorporates secondary data drawn from reliable web databases spanning the years 2018 through 2024. Examining past studies, pointing up flaws in present governance systems, and assessing the effectiveness of data science approaches in multi-cloud governance was done by means of a comprehensive literature study. The findings showed that data-driven governance solutions greatly improve threat identification using anomaly detection models, distribute tasks optimally using predictive analytics, and lower compliance issues by automated monitoring systems. The paper emphasizes the need of robust data-driven governance systems and provides useful advice for project managers and decision-makers to improve security, scalability, and risk reducing methods in multi-cloud environments. New AI-driven governance models and the effect of automation on multi-cloud compliance management should be explored in next research projects. These results support the more general conversation on using data science for efficient cloud governance, hence promoting innovation and efficiency in multi-cloud systems.

AI.tldr: 本文采用定性研究方法，基于2018-2024年间可靠的网络数据库二手数据，通过全面文献综述探讨数据科学如何改善多云环境中的治理问题（特别是安全、可扩展性和风险管理）。研究发现数据驱动治理方案通过异常检测模型显著提升威胁识别能力，通过预测分析优化任务分配，并通过自动化监控系统降低合规问题。论文为项目经理和决策者提供了实用建议，并指出未来应探索AI驱动治理模型及自动化对多云合规管理的影响。
AI.research_question: 数据科学如何帮助改善多云环境中的治理，特别是安全、可扩展性和风险管理方面？
AI.motivation: 随着企业IT系统对弹性、可扩展性和灵活性需求的增加，多云系统被广泛采用，但跨多个云平台的治理管理面临重大挑战。传统治理系统在提供安全关切、合规问题和资源优化的快速洞察方面存在不足，亟需新的方法来解决这些问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据驱动治理理论，涵盖高级分析、机器学习、预测建模等技术在云治理中的应用框架
AI.method: 定性研究方法，通过全面文献综述分析2018-2024年间来自可靠网络数据库的二手数据，综合考察过往研究、指出现有治理系统的缺陷，并评估数据科学方法在多云治理中的有效性。
AI.findings: 数据驱动治理方案能显著改善多云环境治理：(1)通过异常检测模型大大提升威胁识别能力；(2)通过预测分析优化任务分配；(3)通过自动化监控系统降低合规问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数据科学在多云治理中的应用提供了实证支持，丰富了数据驱动治理的理论框架，将高级分析、机器学习和预测建模与多云治理实践系统地联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为项目经理和决策者提供了改善多云环境中安全性、可扩展性和风险降低方法的实用建议，支持数据驱动治理系统在实践中的建设，促进多云系统创新与效率提升。

title: Institutional Capital, PropTech, and the Spatial Dynamics of Housing Markets

detail.title: Institutional Capital, PropTech, and the Spatial Dynamics of Housing Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it involves theoretical spatial equilibrium modeling and secondary aggregate data analysis, with no human participants or animal subjects involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant or financial support from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Non-institutional private landlords frequently display home-biased investment patterns, generating spatial capital frictions that distort rental pricing, housing supply elasticity, and the spatial pass-through of place-based tax subsidies. However, traditional real estate models fail to account for how emerging property technologies (PropTech) and large-scale institutional investors alter these localized market dynamics. This paper presents an extended Quantitative Spatial Equilibrium (QSE) framework that incorporates investor heterogeneity-contrasting local retail landlords with national institutional investors-and decomposes spatial frictions into rational monitoring costs and behavioral familiarity biases. The model demonstrates that local PropTech adoption systematically flattens the distancefriction gradient by lowering rational property management costs, thereby expanding the investment radius of retail capital while leaving behavioral familiarity biases intact. Furthermore, we evaluate the spatial transmission of macroprudential credit shocks. During monetary tightening cycles or under restrictive Loan-to-Value (LTV) caps, leverageconstrained retail landlords retrench into familiar hyper-local markets. Institutional investorsfacing zero geographic distance penalties-exploit this capital contraction by deploying balance-sheet liquidity into distressed submarkets, providing a countercyclical buffer that mitigates localized housing supply shortages. Finally, the theoretical model establishes that place-based housing tax subsidies achieve significantly higher pass-through efficiency to tenants in markets characterized by high PropTech penetration or institutional investor density. By formalizing the structural interaction between digital management stacks, corporate balance sheets, and monetary shocks, this study offers new insights into modern urban spatial dynamics and housing policy design.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个扩展的定量空间均衡（QSE）框架，纳入投资者异质性（本地散户房东vs全国性机构投资者），分析PropTech采用如何通过降低理性监控成本来压缩空间摩擦梯度，并评估宏观审慎信贷冲击和基于地点的住房税收补贴在不同市场结构下的空间传导效率。
AI.research_question: 新兴房地产科技（PropTech）和大型机构投资者的进入如何改变非机构散户房东的本土偏好投资模式所导致的空间资本摩擦，以及这些变化如何影响租金定价、住房供给弹性和基于地点的税收补贴的传导效率？
AI.motivation: 传统房地产模型未能解释PropTech和机构投资者如何改变本地化市场动态。散户房东的本土偏见投资会产生空间资本摩擦，扭曲租金定价和住房供给弹性，但现有理论框架缺乏对这些新兴力量的结构性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定量空间均衡（QSE）框架；投资者异质性模型；空间摩擦分解（理性监控成本与行为熟悉度偏差）；宏观审慎信贷传导理论
AI.method: 理论建模：构建扩展的QSE框架，将空间摩擦分解为理性监控成本和行为性熟悉度偏差两类，纳入本地散户房东与全国机构投资者的差异化行为，并通过模型推导分析PropTech渗透率、机构投资者密度对价格传导和信贷冲击传播的影响。
AI.findings: 1）本地PropTech采用通过降低理性物业管理成本来系统性地拉平距离摩擦梯度，扩大散户资本投资半径，但不影响行为性熟悉度偏差；2）在货币紧缩或严格LTV限制下，杠杆受限的散户房东退缩至熟悉的高度本地化市场，而机构投资者利用其零地理距离处罚优势，将资产负债表流动性部署至受压次级市场，提供逆周期缓冲以缓解本地住房供给短缺；3）高PropTech渗透率或高机构投资者密度的市场中，基于地点的住房税收补贴对租户的传导效率显著更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将PropTech和机构投资者纳入QSE框架，形式化了数字管理技术、企业资产负债表与货币政策冲击之间的结构性互动；提出空间摩擦的二分法（理性成本vs行为偏差），拓展了空间资本流动的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为住房政策设计提供指导：税收补贴在PropTech渗透高和机构投资者密集的市场中能更有效惠及租户；提示政策制定者关注机构投资者在信贷紧缩期的逆周期稳定作用；为评估PropTech扩散对住房市场空间效率的潜在影响提供分析基础。

title: Blended Finance and Institutional Collaboration in Climate Finance Architecture: Evidence from the G77 And China

detail.title: Blended Finance and Institutional Collaboration in Climate Finance Architecture: Evidence from the G77 And China

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial or non-financial interests that are directly or indirectly related to the work submitted for publication. On behalf of all authors, the corresponding author states that there is no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study's research protocol was reviewed and approved by the School of Business and Law Research Ethics Review Panel (RERP) at London Metropolitan University, in accordance with the university's Research Ethics Policy and Procedures and the Code of Good Research Practice, and was conducted in compliance with the 1964 Helsinki Declaration and its later amendments. No reference number was issued by the committee. Participation was voluntary and anonymous, and informed written consent was obtained from all participants (interviewees and survey respondents) prior to data collection.
declarations.funderStatement: No funds, grants, or other support were received during the preparation of this manuscript.

detail.abstract: The transition to a low-carbon global economy is constrained by a persistent climate finance gap across the G77 and China. This study examines how Multilateral Climate Funds shape climate finance architecture through four determinants: institutional collaboration, blended finance deployment, policy and regulatory alignment, and transparency. Combining survey data from 103 sustainable finance specialists with eight interviews, the study finds that institutional collaboration is the only determinant with a statistically significant, independent association with architecture effectiveness; blended finance is perceived as the primary catalyst for mobilising private capital, though this effect does not hold once other constructs are controlled for. Policy and regulatory alignment remains necessary for capital absorption, and transparency sustains investor trust and limits greenwashing risk. The study introduces an Institutional Reinforcement Cycle, a recursive model of how these determinants interact, and offers policy recommendations for restructuring climate finance governance to mobilise private investment at scale.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于103份可持续金融专家调查和8次访谈，考察多边气候基金如何通过机构合作、混合融资、政策法规协调和透明度四个决定因素塑造气候金融架构。研究发现机构合作是唯一与架构有效性存在统计显著独立关联的因素；混合融资被视作动员私人资本的主要催化剂，但在控制其他变量后不显著；政策法规协调对资本吸收不可或缺，透明度维持投资者信任并限制绿色洗钱风险。论文提出"制度强化循环"递归模型，为重构气候金融治理提供政策建议。
AI.research_question: 多边气候基金如何通过四个关键决定因素（机构合作、混合融资、政策法规协调、透明度）塑造气候金融架构的有效性？尤其是在G77和中国地区面临持续性气候融资缺口的背景下。
AI.motivation: 全球向低碳经济转型受到G77和中国地区持续性气候融资缺口的制约，需要厘清多边气候基金在塑造气候金融架构中发挥的作用，以有效动员私人资本、弥合融资缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度强化循环（Institutional Reinforcement Cycle）——一个用于解释四个决定因素之间递归互动的理论模型。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：103份可持续金融专家问卷调查（定量分析）+ 8次深度访谈（定性分析）。
AI.findings: 1. 机构合作是唯一与气候金融架构有效性存在统计显著独立关联的决定因素；2. 混合融资被感知为动员私人资本的首要催化剂，但在控制其他建构后效应不显著；3. 政策法规协调对资本吸收是必要条件；4. 透明度可维持投资者信任并限制绿色洗钱风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"制度强化循环"（Institutional Reinforcement Cycle）这一递归模型，系统解释四个决定因素之间的相互作用机制，丰富了对多边气候基金治理架构的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为重构气候金融治理提供具体政策建议，重点在于通过加强机构合作来提升架构有效性，并指导混合融资、政策协调和透明度建设的优先级安排，以实现在规模上动员私人投资的目标。

title: Financial Resilience in Small Enterprises: Integrating Structural Capacity, Time-to-Constraint, and Intervention Feasibility through the SBFRF

detail.title: Financial Resilience in Small Enterprises: Integrating Structural Capacity, Time-to-Constraint, and Intervention Feasibility through the SBFRF
detail.abstract: This conceptual paper develops the Small Business Financial Resilience & Risk Framework (SBFRF), a time-constrained approach to assessing financial resilience in small enterprises. Drawing on the resource-based view, dynamic capabilities, SME resilience, financial flexibility, stress-testing, and business-continuity research, SBFRF links an eight-pillar structural diagnosis to scenario-specific cash-flow trajectories and explicit financial constraints. It distinguishes structural capacity from realized resilience by estimating Financial Resilience Duration, the earliest binding constraint, usable decision time, and time-indexed cost and financing responses. A hypothetical manufacturer illustrates how structural exposure informs scenario selection and how proposed interventions are re-tested against all materially affected constraints. The framework's contribution is integrative: resilience depends not only on resources and adaptive capabilities, but on whether sufficiently large, sustainable responses can become effective before a scenario-specific financial constraint binds. The proposed taxonomy, weights, thresholds, and dynamic measures require subsequent empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个概念性框架——小企业财务韧性与风险框架（SBFRF），通过时间约束的方法评估小企业的财务韧性。该框架将八支柱结构诊断与情景特定的现金流轨迹和明确的财务约束联系起来，区分结构能力与实际韧性，并引入财务韧性持续时间、最早约束、可用决策时间等动态指标。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个以时间为约束、能够评估小企业财务韧性的综合框架？
AI.motivation: 现有韧性研究多关注资源和适应能力，但忽略了响应是否能在情景特定的财务约束生效之前及时到位这一时间维度。小企业面临独特的资源限制，需要更贴合其情境的评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（RBV）、动态能力理论、中小企业韧性研究、财务灵活性、压力测试、业务连续性研究。
AI.method: 概念性研究方法：整合多理论构建框架，并通过假设性制造企业案例进行说明。
AI.findings: 财务韧性不仅取决于资源和适应能力，还取决于足够大规模且可持续的响应能否在情景特定的财务约束生效之前发挥作用。SBFRF通过财务韧性持续时间等动态指标区分结构能力与实际韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出整合性的时间约束财务韧性框架，将结构诊断与情景化的时间动态相结合，为韧性研究补充了"时间性"这一关键维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小企业管理者和政策制定者提供系统化的财务韧性评估工具，支持情景选择、干预措施的再测试，以及基于时间约束的财务决策。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Corporate Governance, and Systemic Risk: Legal Regulation of Algorithmic Capital Markets

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Corporate Governance, and Systemic Risk: Legal Regulation of Algorithmic Capital Markets
detail.abstract: This article examines a structural mismatch between the temporal assumptions embedded in corporate fiduciary oversight doctrine and the operational tempo of algorithmic systems now used to allocate capital, execute trades, and manage liquidity inside regulated financial institutions. Delaware's duty-of-oversight jurisprudence, together with its sectoral analogues in securities and markets regulation, presupposes that a board can discharge its monitoring function through periodic, retrospective review. Autonomous trading and capital-allocation systems operate continuously, adjust their own parameters within pre-authorized bounds, and can materially alter a firm's risk profile within intervals shorter than any realistic review cycle. Using comparative doctrinal analysis across the United States, the European Union, the United Kingdom, and Brazil, the article argues that this "supervisory desynchronization" is not addressed by existing information-systems-based oversight standards, which ask whether a board received adequate reports but not whether the interval between report and effect remains compatible with a duty that is retrospective in structure. The article operationalizes this diagnosis as an Oversight Desynchronization Ratio and grounds it in the documented enforcement record of the 2012 Knight Capital incident, where a periodic SEC-mandated self-assessment and CEO certification process was later found not to have tested the failure mode that produced roughly $460 million in losses within forty-five minutes. It further shows that the European Union's emerging model-level systemic-risk regime for general-purpose artificial intelligence operates on a supervisory track separate from sectoral market-conduct regulation, compounding the desynchronization problem. The article proposes the Temporal Oversight Continuity Standard, requiring latency-tiered disclosure, board-level audit of algorithmic drift, and periodic re-ratification of delegated authority, and states explicit falsifiability criteria and limitations for that proposal. It concludes that corporate law's capacity to internalize systemic risk depends less on the sufficiency of information reaching the board than on whether the temporal architecture of oversight duties still matches the systems it purports to supervise.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了公司信托监督义务中的时间假设与算法系统运行节奏之间的结构性错配。公司监督义务法理预设董事会可通过定期、回溯性审查履行监督职能，但自主交易和资本配置系统持续运行、自主调整参数，并能在短于任何现实审查周期的时间内改变公司风险状况。文章通过美国、欧盟、英国和巴西的比较法分析，提出"监督失同步"问题，并提出了"时间监督连续性标准"作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 公司信托监督义务内在的时间假设（周期性、回溯性审查）与算法系统持续运行的运营节奏之间存在结构性错配，这种"监督失同步"是否以及如何被现有法律框架所忽视，以及应如何解决？
AI.motivation: 自主交易和资本配置系统可以连续运行并自主调整参数，在短于任何现实审查周期的时间内实质性地改变公司风险状况。2012年Knight Capital事件中，约4.6亿美元损失在45分钟内产生，而定期SEC强制自评和CEO认证流程并未测试到导致该损失的故障模式，这凸显了现有监督框架的根本性缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特拉华州监督义务判例法（duty-of-oversight）、证券和市场监管中的部门法类比、欧盟通用人工智能模型级系统性风险制度、监督失同步比率（Oversight Desynchronization Ratio）
AI.method: 比较法分析（美国、欧盟、英国、巴西），结合Knight Capital事件的执法记录案例分析，提出定量化指标（监督失同步比率）并进行规范性制度设计。
AI.findings: 现有基于信息系统的监督标准仅询问董事会是否收到充分报告，而不问报告与效果之间的时间间隔是否与回溯性结构的监督义务兼容。欧盟的通用AI模型级系统性风险监管与部门市场行为监管分属不同监管轨道，加剧了失同步问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"监督失同步"这一新概念作为诊断框架；提出"时间监督连续性标准"（Temporal Oversight Continuity Standard）作为规范性解决方案，包括延迟分层披露、董事会层面的算法漂移审计、委托权限的定期再批准；并给出明确的证伪标准和局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公司董事会设计具体的算法监督工具（如监督失同步比率的量化应用）；为监管机构提供超越"信息充分性"范式的监管指标；为跨境监管协调提供比较法视角；提出将算法系统纳入公司监督义务时间架构的具体操作建议。

reference: Harvard Business School Technology & Operations Mgt. Unit Working Paper No. 27-017
title: Intermediary-Based Contagion: Examining Implications of Public Scrutiny in the Voluntary Carbon Market
affiliations: and Harvard Business School

detail.title: Intermediary-Based Contagion: Examining Implications of Public Scrutiny in the Voluntary Carbon Market

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Technology & Operations Mgt. Unit Working Paper No. 27-017
publicationDetails.journalName: Harvard Business School: Technology & Operations Management Unit Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In markets for credence goods, information asymmetries prevent buyers from evaluating product quality even after purchase. Market intermediaries alleviate these information asymmetries by assuring buyers that organizations and their products conform to recognized standards. Such information assurance is often provided by multiple intermediaries offering comparable services, raising the question of whether and when an organization’s intermediary affiliation matters for prospective buyers’ willingness to transact. We theorize that public scrutiny directed at an organization is associated with greater buyer uncertainty about the reliability of its intermediary’s assurances and consequently lower willingness to transact with competing organizations sharing the same intermediary affiliation (intermediary peers). We contend that this contagion effect is more pronounced for intermediary peers offering products more similar to those of organizations directly targeted by public scrutiny and weaker for those peers whose products provide alternative grounds for evaluation. We test our hypotheses in the voluntary carbon market, where registries act as intermediaries that provide assurance for carbon credit projects’ greenhouse gas emissions reduction claims. Using data on carbon credit projects across six major registries and media coverage from 2015 to 2024, we find that negative media scrutiny directed at carbon credit projects is associated with fewer credit issuances by other projects affiliated with the same registry, with stronger effects among similar projects and weaker effects for those featuring social benefits or additional third-party certification. We identify unintended consequences of intermediary affiliation and delineate strategies to mitigate intermediary-based contagion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究信任品市场中，针对某一组织的负面公众审查如何通过共同的中介机构关联传染给其他组织，降低买家与其交易的意愿。研究基于自愿碳市场（VCM）六大注册机构2015-2024年的碳信用项目数据与媒体报道，发现负面媒体审查会显著减少同一注册机构下其他项目的碳信用签发量，产品相似性加剧这一传染效应，而社会效益或额外第三方认证可减弱该效应。
AI.research_question: 在信任品市场中，组织的中间机构关联是否以及何时会影响潜在买家与其交易的意愿？具体而言，针对某一组织的公众审查如何传染给共享同一中间机构关联的同伴组织？
AI.motivation: 信任品市场中存在严重的信息不对称，买家即使在购买后也无法评估产品质量。市场中间机构通过保证组织和产品符合公认标准来缓解这种信息不对称。然而，多个中间机构提供可比服务时，中间机构关联是否重要以及何时重要成为关键问题，现有研究对此缺乏深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、中间机构信息保障理论、传染效应（contagion effect）理论、公众审查与不确定性理论
AI.method: 基于自愿碳市场中六大注册机构（中间机构）的碳信用项目数据与2015-2024年的媒体报道数据，采用实证回归分析方法检验假设。
AI.findings: 针对碳信用项目的负面媒体报道与同一注册机构下其他项目的碳信用签发量减少相关；该效应在产品相似性更高的同伴项目中更强，而在具有社会效益或额外第三方认证的项目中更弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了中间机构信息保障理论，揭示了中间机构关联可能带来的意外负面后果（传染效应），识别了传染效应的边界条件（产品相似性与替代性评估依据），拓展了对信任品市场中买家不确定性形成的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和中间机构提供策略启示：明确了缓解中间机构层面传染效应的策略（如增加社会效益、寻求额外第三方认证），帮助市场参与者理解和规避信息保障体系中的系统性风险。

title: Control, Custody and Conflict of Laws: Private International Law and the Regulation of Crypto-assets in the European Union
affiliations: Public University of Navarra (UPNA)

detail.title: Control, Custody and Conflict of Laws: Private International Law and the Regulation of Crypto-assets in the European Union
detail.abstract: The Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) is usually discussed as a matter of supervisory detail: the rules for stablecoins, the requirements for service providers, and the perimeter of decentralised finance. This paper argues that MiCA's most consequential problems are structural, and that they lie at the intersection of regulatory law and private international law. It develops a single method: control as the criterion of responsibility and entitlement, coordinated across borders through conflict-of-laws connecting factors. From that method it derives a reform agenda. It proposes an objective directed-activity test for reverse solicitation, transposed from Pammer and Hotel Alpenhof; a general antiabuse rule for MiCA; a controller-of-last-resort attribution rule for decentralised finance; a functional property rule for tokens grounded in Article 114 TFEU; a crypto-specific presumption of the centre of main interests anchored in Eurofood and Interedil; and a free-standing conflict-of-laws Regulation for the proprietary aspects of tokens, with the effective locus of control over key-management infrastructure as the connecting factor for custody. It closes with a ten-principle framework for a transnational private law of digital-asset custody. The paper's contribution is to show that the perimeter, stablecoin, DeFi and private-law questions form one problem, and that control and private international law supply their common solution.

AI.tldr: 本文认为《加密资产市场条例》（MiCA）最具后果性的问题不是监管细节，而是结构性缺陷，这些问题位于监管法与冲突法（国际私法）的交汇处。作者提出以"控制"作为责任与权利归属的统一标准，通过冲突法连接因素实现跨境协调，并由此推导出一套改革议程，涵盖逆向招揽的客观定向活动测试、一般反滥用规则、DeFi的最终控制者归责规则、代币的功能性财产规则、加密特定的主要利益中心推定，以及针对代币物权方面的独立冲突法条例。最后提出跨国数字资产托管私法的十原则框架。
AI.research_question: MiCA条例最深层的问题是什么？如何通过"控制"标准与冲突法连接因素的结合，系统性地解决MiCA在监管法律与国际私法交叉领域的结构性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 现有对MiCA的讨论多聚焦监管细节（稳定币规则、服务商要求、DeFi边界），而忽视了其结构性缺陷。这些缺陷恰恰体现在监管法与国际私法的交汇处，若不加以解决，将导致跨境监管漏洞、法律适用不确定性和责任归属不清等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制作为责任与权利归属的标准；冲突法连接因素理论；欧盟法院判例（Pammer与Hotel Alpenhof的定向活动测试、Eurofood与Interedil的主要利益中心标准）；《欧盟运行条约》第114条作为财产规则的法源基础。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析：从现行MiCA的法律架构出发，结合欧盟法院判例法与冲突法理论，提出统一的"控制"标准，并据此推导出涵盖多个具体制度层面的改革方案。
AI.findings: （1）MiCA的监管边界、稳定币、DeFi和私法问题本质上是同一问题的不同面向；（2）"控制"标准可以作为责任承担与权利归属的统一准则；（3）通过冲突法连接因素的跨境协调，可以有效回应MiCA的结构性缺陷；（4）提出了包括逆向招揽测试、反滥用规则、DeFi最终控制者归责、功能财产规则、主要利益中心推定及独立冲突法条例在内的系统性改革议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于：（1）将MiCA的监管法与私法问题整合为单一分析框架；（2）以"控制"为统一标准，弥合了监管归责与财产权利归属之间的理论断裂；（3）创新性地将冲突法连接因素作为跨境加密资产治理的制度桥梁；（4）提出了跨国数字资产托管私法的十原则框架，为后续研究提供了新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践贡献在于：（1）为欧盟立法者提供了MiCA修订的具体改革清单；（2）为加密资产服务商、托管机构和DeFi协议运营者提供了跨境合规与责任界定的操作指引；（3）为数字资产物权归属与跨域争议解决提供了明确的法律适用规则；（4）对全球其他司法管辖区设计加密资产监管框架具有参考价值。

title: Where does Title Live? Tokenised Fund Units, Control and the Conflict of Laws in the DIFC 1
affiliations: Public University of Navarra (UPNA)

detail.title: Where does Title Live? Tokenised Fund Units, Control and the Conflict of Laws in the DIFC 1

keywords: UNIDROIT Principles on Digital Assets and Private Law

detail.abstract:
In July 2026 the Dubai Financial Services Authority asked whether any regulatory barrier stands in
the way of issuing tokenised fund units in the Dubai International Financial Centre. This paper argues
that the barrier is legal rather than technological, and that the Authority has already described it
without naming it.
Section 8.7 of the Collective Investment Rules requires a fund manager to keep a register of
unitholders. It attributes no legal effect to that register. The register is not conclusive evidence of title,
or evidence of title, and no power of rectification accompanies it. The DIFC Digital Assets Law of
2024 provides that the person in control of a digital asset is presumed to hold the superior title. One
legal order therefore supplies an answer and a silence, and the answer was drafted for native crypto
assets rather than for fund units.
The paper meets the objection that this tension is illusory. The DIFC statute admits only assets that
exist independently of any person and of any legal system, and a fund unit is a right constituted by a
legal system. The objection is well founded, and it does not rescue the position. It produces what this
paper calls the constitutive paradox. Either the tokenised unit is a digital asset, and control governs
by default; or it is not, and the token carries no proprietary protection at all under the law that issued
it.
The paper then identifies a second gap, which it calls the anchoring problem. Article 129 of the DIFC
Law of Security refers the applicable law for security rights in digital assets, and in assets embodied
in digital assets, to the laws of England and Wales. That provision reaches tokenised fund units used
as collateral. It refers the question to a system that has not yet settled it. Outside the security context
nothing governs title at all.
The paper states the case for that referral before answering it and compares the DIFC with the Abu
Dhabi Global Market. It proposes anchoring by designation, modelled on Principle 5 of the
UNIDROIT Principles on Digital Assets and Private Law, and applies the same reasoning to
collateral, custody and insolvency.

AI.tldr: 本文论证迪拜国际金融中心（DIFC）发行代币化基金单位的障碍是法律而非技术问题。DIFC《集体投资规则》要求基金管理者保存持有人名册，但该名册不具有任何法律效力；而2024年《DIFC数字资产法》规定控制数字资产的人推定拥有优先所有权，两者之间存在张力。论文提出"构成性悖论"和"锚定问题"两个核心法律漏洞，并借鉴UNIDROIT原则提出"指定锚定"（anchoring by designation）的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 迪拜金融服务管理局（DFSA）在发行代币化基金单位方面是否存在监管障碍？如果是，该障碍的法律性质是什么？如何解决？
AI.motivation: 2026年7月DFSA询问在DIFC发行代币化基金单位是否存在监管障碍。本文旨在揭示该障碍的法律本质，指出其并非技术限制而是法律框架中的结构性缺陷，并寻求解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: DIFC《集体投资规则》第8.7条（基金单位持有人名册制度）、2024年《DIFC数字资产法》（数字资产控制权推定优先所有权）、DIFC《担保法》第129条（法律适用条款）、UNIDROIT《数字资产与私法原则》原则5（指定锚定模型）
AI.method: 规范性法律分析：结合DIFC法规文本的条文解释、批判性论证（通过反驳"张力是虚幻的"的反驳意见来深化论证）、比较法分析（对比阿布扎比全球市场ADGM）、以及借鉴国际私法原则提出制度设计方案。
AI.findings: 1）DIFC面临"构成性悖论"：若代币化基金单位是数字资产，则控制权默认决定所有权；若不是数字资产，则代币在该法律体系下不享有任何财产保护。2）存在"锚定问题"：《DIFC担保法》第129条将数字资产担保权益的适用法律指向英格兰和威尔士法律，但该法域尚未解决此问题；担保之外的场景则完全无法律管辖。3）提出"指定锚定"方案，借鉴UNIDROIT原则5，并适用于抵押、托管和破产场景。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出"构成性悖论"概念，揭示代币化证券在法律分类上的根本矛盾。2）提出"锚定问题"框架，识别法律适用规则在数字资产与基金单位交叉领域的真空。3）将UNIDROIT数字资产原则应用于基金单位代币化这一具体场景，拓展了该原则的适用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为DFSA提供清晰的法律障碍诊断，明确问题在"法律"而非"技术"。2）提出"指定锚定"的具体制度设计建议，可直接作为DIFC立法改革的参考。3）通过比较ADGM实践并提供跨场景（担保、托管、破产）的综合解决方案，为监管机构提供可操作的政策路径。

title: Employee Motivation as a Driver of Socially Sustainable Public Sector Performance and Service Delivery in South Africa
affiliations: , University of Limpopo and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: Employee Motivation as a Driver of Socially Sustainable Public Sector Performance and Service Delivery in South Africa
detail.abstract: Employee motivation plays an important role in improving public sector performance and supporting socially sustainable service delivery in South Africa. Social sustainability depends on public institutions providing fair, reliable, and quality services that improve people's well-being and strengthen public trust. Despite policies such as the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa (1996), the Public Service Act, and the Batho Pele Principles, many public institutions continue to face challenges such as poor performance, low employee morale, inefficiency, and service delivery failures. This article examines the relationship between employee motivation, organisational performance, service delivery, and social sustainability in South African public institutions. The article uses a qualitative narrative review of existing literature, policy documents, and empirical studies on employee motivation in the public sector. The findings show that fair pay, job security, recognition, career development opportunities, supportive leadership, and good working conditions improve employee motivation and organisational performance. The article further finds that motivated employees contribute to better service delivery, higher productivity, improved accountability, and increased public trust, which are important elements of social sustainability. In contrast, low employee motivation contributes to absenteeism, staff turnover, poor performance, and declining service quality. The article recommends strengthening human resource management practices, employee development initiatives, and supportive leadership to improve employee motivation, enhance public sector performance, and promote socially sustainable service delivery in South Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定性叙述性文献综述，探讨了南非公共机构中员工动机、组织绩效、服务提供与社会可持续性之间的关系。研究发现公平薪酬、工作保障、认可、职业发展、支持性领导和良好工作条件能提升员工动机和组织绩效，进而促进更好的服务交付和社会可持续性。
AI.research_question: 南非公共机构中员工动机、组织绩效、服务提供与社会可持续性之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 尽管南非已有多项政策（如1996年宪法、公共服务法、Batho Pele原则），许多公共机构仍面临绩效不佳、员工士气低落、效率低下和服务交付失败等挑战，亟需理解员工动机在改善公共部门绩效和促进社会可持续性中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 员工动机理论与社会可持续性理论框架，结合组织绩效和服务交付的相关理论视角。
AI.method: 采用定性叙述性综述方法，对现有文献、政策文件和公共部门员工动机的实证研究进行系统回顾与分析。
AI.findings: （1）公平薪酬、工作保障、认可、职业发展机会、支持性领导和良好工作条件能提升员工动机与组织绩效；（2）有动机的员工有助于更好的服务交付、更高生产力、更强问责制和更高公众信任；（3）低员工动机会导致缺勤、人员流失、绩效不佳和服务质量下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为员工动机与组织绩效、服务交付及社会可持续性之间的关联提供了整合性的文献证据，丰富了公共部门人力资源管理与社会可持续发展交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议加强人力资源管理实践、员工发展计划和领导力支持，以提升员工动机、改善公共部门绩效并促进南非社会可持续性服务交付。

title: All-or-nothing versus keep-it-all: Conflicting interests in reward-based crowdfunding

detail.title: All-or-nothing versus keep-it-all: Conflicting interests in reward-based crowdfunding

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest regarding this manuscript.
declarations.funderStatement: The work has been supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Number 23K12547.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a stylized model of a reward-based crowdfunding platform, endogenizing the intermediary's choice of funding rule, all-or-nothing (AON) or keep-it-all (KIA). We show that preferences over the two rules are nested: if the backers prefer KIA, so does the creator, and if the creator does, so does the intermediary. Conflict thus arises only when the intermediary chooses KIA, which it does even where total surplus is higher under AON. Scrutiny can therefore be conditioned on the funding rule itself. Moreover, a consumer-surplus standard would restrict KIA more widely than a total-surplus standard.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于奖励式众筹平台的模型，内生化了中介机构对融资规则的选择（全有或全无规则 AON 与保留所有规则 KIA）。研究发现，支持者、创作者和中介机构对两种规则的偏好是嵌套的：若支持者偏好 KIA，则创作者也偏好 KIA；若创作者偏好 KIA，则中介机构也偏好 KIA。因此冲突仅在中介机构选择 KIA 时出现，即使在全有或全无规则下总剩余更高，中介机构仍会选择 KIA。基于此，监管审查可以依据融资规则本身进行条件设定。此外，以消费者剩余为标准会比以总剩余为标准更严格地限制 KIA 规则。
AI.research_question: 在奖励式众筹平台中，中介机构如何内生地选择融资规则（AON 或 KIA）？各利益相关方（支持者、创作者、中介）对两种规则的偏好结构如何？监管应如何介入？
AI.motivation: 奖励式众筹平台中 AON 与 KIA 两种融资规则的选择虽是平台运营的核心机制，但现有文献大多将融资规则视为外生给定，缺乏对中介机构内生化选择规则及其福利影响的分析。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，并探讨何种监管标准更为恰当。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于奖励式众筹平台的三方博弈模型（支持者、创作者、中介机构），通过内生化的融资规则选择分析各方的偏好排序与福利比较。
AI.method: 构建一个风格化（stylized）的奖励式众筹平台理论模型，将中介机构对融资规则（AON 或 KIA）的选择内生化，分析三方参与者的偏好与福利结果。
AI.findings: 1) 三方对两种规则的偏好是嵌套的：支持者偏好 KIA ⇒ 创作者偏好 KIA ⇒ 中介机构偏好 KIA；2) 冲突仅在中介机构选择 KIA 时发生，即使 AON 下总剩余更高，中介仍选择 KIA；3) 监管审查可以基于融资规则本身进行条件设定；4) 以消费者剩余为标准会比以总剩余为标准更广泛地限制 KIA 规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 将融资规则从外生变量内生化，揭示了支持者、创作者与中介机构偏好之间的嵌套结构，并论证了监管审查可依据融资规则本身进行条件设定的理论依据，为众筹平台治理研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了监管标准的参考：指出以消费者剩余为标准比以总剩余为标准更能有效限制中介机构选择 KIA 规则的倾向，有助于政策制定者设计更精准的众筹平台监管框架。

title: Identifying Influential users in Online Social Networks using Heterogeneous Influence Maximizaion
affiliations: Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology

detail.title: Identifying Influential users in Online Social Networks using Heterogeneous Influence Maximizaion
detail.abstract: Social network analysis has become a fundamental tool for understanding information propagation in online platforms. This paper addresses the problem of influence maximization on social networks, namely how to identify the optimal set of seed users whose activation triggers the largest information cascade. We implement and extend the Heterogeneous Influence Maximization (HeteroIM) framework proposed by Hou et al., which bridges the gap between recommendation systems and influence maximization by jointly modeling interaction willingness and spread capability. The framework is applied to a real-world Twitter interaction network constructed from the Stanford SNAP dataset, comprising 81,306 users and 1,768,149 directed edges. In addition, we propose an activity-weighted extension of HeteroIR that incorporates historical spread behavior as an additional signal in the ranking function. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed improvement achieves a 20.2% gain in NSpread@1 and an 8.9% improvement in NSpread@3 over the baseline, while incurring only a negligible 2-3% reduction in recommendation accuracy. We further present six graph-based visualizations, illustrating power-law degree distribution, individual influence analysis using centrality measures, seed user structural positioning, and Independent Cascade (IC) model propagation dynamics. The results confirm that incorporating historical spreading activity into influence estimation significantly enhances propagation coverage on large-scale real-world social graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文实现并扩展了HeteroIM框架，提出活动加权的异质影响最大化扩展方法，在包含81,306个用户和1,768,149条有向边的真实Twitter交互网络上，实现了NSpread@1提升20.2%、NSpread@3提升8.9%的传播覆盖率改善，同时仅损失2-3%的推荐准确率。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结合用户历史传播行为来改进社交网络上的影响最大化问题，以提升信息级联的传播覆盖率？
AI.motivation: 社交网络分析是理解在线平台信息传播的基础工具，而影响最大化（如何识别最优种子用户集以触发最大的信息级联）是其中的关键问题，现有方法未充分利用用户的历史传播行为信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质影响最大化（HeteroIM）框架，该框架通过联合建模交互意愿和传播能力，桥接了推荐系统与影响最大化之间的差距；同时涉及独立级联（IC）模型、中心性度量等图论与网络科学理论。
AI.method: 实现并扩展HeteroIM框架，提出活动加权扩展（activity-weighted extension），将历史传播行为作为排序函数中的额外信号；在Stanford SNAP数据集的真实Twitter交互网络上进行实验，并生成六种基于图的可视化分析（幂律度分布、中心性个体影响力分析、种子用户结构定位、IC模型传播动态）。
AI.findings: 活动加权扩展相比基线在NSpread@1上获得20.2%的提升，在NSpread@3上获得8.9%的提升，仅以2-3%的推荐准确率下降为代价；将历史传播活动纳入影响力估计能显著增强大规模真实社交图上的传播覆盖率。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了将历史传播行为作为额外信号融入影响最大化框架的有效性，扩展了HeteroIM框架的应用范围，为推荐系统与影响最大化的跨领域整合提供了新的实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种在保持推荐准确率基本不变的前提下显著提升传播覆盖率的影响最大化改进方案，并提供了六种图可视化工具用于理解大规模社交网络中的影响力分布和传播动态，对社交媒体营销、病毒式传播策略等领域具有实际应用价值。

title: From Recognition to Justification: Narrative Legitimation in Implicit Leadership Theories
affiliations: and The COPPEAD Graduate School of Business

detail.title: From Recognition to Justification: Narrative Legitimation in Implicit Leadership Theories
detail.abstract: This study examines how individuals build accounts of leadership recognition, a level of analysis that Implicit Leadership Theories (ILTs) have left largely unexplored. Drawing on ILTs and sensemaking, we analyzed written narratives produced by nursing professionals. Three recurrent patterns of leadership legitimation emerged: relationally grounded, impact-oriented, and integrated forms. These patterns were sustained by four evaluative dimensions (affectiverelational, instrumental, inspirational and moral-normative) that rendered leadership recognition plausible and communicable. Leaders legitimized were predominantly women, a finding read as both a cognitive attenuation of gendered prototypes and a possible reproduction of gendered expectation. Exemplars were drawn from professional, familial, religious, and educational contexts, suggesting that these interpretive resources are shaped across multiple domains of life. Based on these findings, we propose the framework of justified leadership attribution, understood as the retrospective mobilization of implicit prototypes into coherent accounts of leadership recognition. The framework extends ILTs by showing that recognition involves the social and narrative work through which cognitive matching becomes communicable and extends sensemaking by showing that account-building unfolds continuously across ordinary social life.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨个体如何构建领导力认可的叙事性解释（account），这是内隐领导理论（ILTs）尚未充分探索的分析层面。通过分析护理专业人士撰写的书面叙事，识别出三种领导力合法化模式（关系型、影响导向型和整合型），并由四个评价维度（情感关系、工具、激励、道德规范）支撑。研究提出"正当化领导力归因"框架，将内隐原型的事后动员与领导力认可的社会性、叙事性工作联系起来。
AI.research_question: 个体如何构建领导力认可的叙事性解释？即人们如何将内隐的领导原型转化为连贯的、可沟通的领导力认可叙述？
AI.motivation: 内隐领导理论（ILTs）主要关注认知匹配过程，但忽略了个体如何实际构建和表达领导力认可的过程——即有意识、社会化的叙事层面。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探讨领导力认可如何从认知匹配转化为可沟通的社会性叙述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内隐领导理论（Implicit Leadership Theories, ILTs）与意义建构理论（sensemaking）
AI.method: 质性研究：分析护理专业人士撰写的书面领导力叙事文本，采用叙事分析识别领导力合法化的模式与评价维度。
AI.findings: 1) 识别出三种领导力合法化模式：关系型、影响导向型和整合型；2) 四种评价维度（情感关系、工具、激励、道德规范）支撑这些模式；3) 被认可的领导多为女性，既反映性别原型的认知弱化，也可能再生产性别期望；4) 领导原型示例源自职业、家庭、宗教和教育等多重生活领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展ILTs：表明领导力认可涉及社会性与叙事性工作，使认知匹配变得可沟通；2) 扩展sensemaking：表明叙事构建在普通社会生活中持续展开，而非仅限于重大事件或组织情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织中的领导力识别和培养提供叙事层面的洞察，帮助理解领导力认可如何在日常社会性互动中被构建和表达，对领导力评估、人才识别及性别平等议题具有实践启示。

title: Risks and Rewards: College Teams Investing During Volatile Market Conditions
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Risks and Rewards: College Teams Investing During Volatile Market Conditions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Professor Alexander Smith, Associate Professor in Economics at Worcester Polytechnic Institute (WPI), has been the reason this experiment and last year's financial literacy study were possible. His guidance and extensive background in experimental economics have paved the way for these papers.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Approval for this research was granted by WPI's IRB. Ethical standards were upheld throughout the research and distribution. Anonymity, confidentiality, and protecting participant data are maintained.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was funded by Worcester Polytechnic Institute's Social Science and Policy Studies department.

detail.abstract: The quantitative side of investing is well studied, with many recognizable phrases such as herding behavior and fear of missing out bias. Yet, few existing experiments look towards the qualitative side, digging into the why behind investing decisions. This paper puts a dent in that, describing that team-based investing is a process in which sequential and frequently subconscious checkpoints are reached before a buy or sell decision is made. Two factors make this particularly unique, (1) a period of heightened market volatility and (2) the study group consisting of college students. Under these conditions, the conclusions reached point towards teams with consistent investing principles and frequent communication resulting in higher returns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究团队投资决策的定性过程，发现团队投资是一个包含顺序且常为潜意识检查点的流程。在市场高波动时期，以大学生为研究对象，研究发现拥有一致投资原则和频繁沟通的团队能获得更高回报。
AI.research_question: 团队在做出买入或卖出决策之前，经历了哪些定性的、顺序性的（且常为潜意识的）检查点？在高度市场波动条件下，哪些团队特征（如投资原则一致性和沟通频率）与更高投资回报相关？
AI.motivation: 现有投资研究大多侧重于定量维度（如羊群行为、错失恐惧偏差等），很少从定性角度深入探究投资决策背后的"为什么"。本文旨在弥补这一空白，探索团队投资决策过程中的定性机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 涉及行为金融学中的羊群行为和错失恐惧偏差等理论，同时引入团队决策过程理论与潜意识决策机制。
AI.method: 实验研究，以大学生为研究对象，在高度市场波动时期观察团队投资决策过程，分析团队沟通模式与投资原则一致性对投资回报的影响。
AI.findings: 团队投资是一个包含顺序性且常为潜意识检查点的决策流程；在高度市场波动条件下，拥有一致投资原则和频繁沟通的团队获得了更高的投资回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 创新性地从定性视角补充了投资决策研究，提出了团队投资决策的"顺序性检查点"过程模型，将研究视角从个体定量偏差拓展到团队定性决策机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者（尤其是团队投资者）提供了实践启示：建立一致的投资原则并保持频繁沟通有助于在高波动市场中获得更好回报。

title: Macroeconomic Convergence in the SADC: A Game-Theoretic Approach Supported by Empirical Evidence
affiliations: Department of Economics, University of Antananarivo

detail.title: Macroeconomic Convergence in the SADC: A Game-Theoretic Approach Supported by Empirical Evidence
detail.abstract: This article develops a strategic interpretation of macroeconomic convergence within the Southern African Development Community (SADC). Its central argument is that convergence is not merely a technical adjustment of indicators; rather, it constitutes a coordination problem among sovereign states. Each government bears a domestic fiscal, monetary, and external adjustment cost, whereas the most visible benefits of convergence arise only when a critical mass of countries simultaneously complies with the common criteria. The formal framework combines a stag-hunt game, a sixteen-country threshold game, and a repeated game with reputation, monitoring, and transfers. The empirical application constructs a robust convergence-distance index based on seven criteria: inflation, fiscal deficit, public debt, current account, GDP growth, central-bank credit to government, and official reserves. The raw distance is retained as a diagnostic instrument for extreme crises, whereas the principal distance is bounded within [0, 1] to prevent hyperinflation or an exceptional monetary ratio from dominating the entire set of results. The findings indicate partial yet fragile regional convergence. In 2024, no country complied with all available criteria, no member reached the 7% growth threshold, and central-bank credit to government remained one of the most discriminating criteria. The descriptive β-convergence test yields a statistically significant negative slope, consistent with partial catch-up, but not with complete convergence towards all regional targets.

AI.tldr: 本文从战略视角解读南部非洲发展共同体（SADC）的宏观经济趋同，认为趋同本质上是主权国家间的协调问题，而非单纯的技术指标调整。作者构建了结合捕鹿博弈、十六国门槛博弈和重复博弈的正式框架，并基于七项标准构建趋同距离指数进行实证分析，发现区域趋同呈现"部分但脆弱"的特征。
AI.research_question: SADC成员国宏观经济趋同为何难以实现？其本质是技术问题还是战略协调问题？
AI.motivation: 传统的宏观经济趋同研究多将趋同视为技术性指标调整，忽视其作为主权国家间协调问题的战略本质。每个国家承担国内财政、货币和外部调整成本，但只有达到关键多数国家同时达标时趋同收益才显现，这构成典型的集体行动困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文整合了三种博弈论框架：捕鹿博弈（stag-hunt game）刻画协调与信任问题、十六国门槛博弈（threshold game）刻画临界多数达成机制、重复博弈（repeated game）纳入声誉、监督与转移支付机制。
AI.method: 构建基于七项标准（通胀、财政赤字、公共债务、经常账户、GDP增长、央行对政府信贷、官方储备）的稳健趋同距离指数。原始距离保留作为极端危机诊断工具，主距离限定在[0,1]区间以防止恶性通胀或异常货币比率主导结果。采用描述性β-趋同检验验证趋同假设。
AI.findings: 区域趋同呈现部分但脆弱的状态：2024年没有国家满足所有可用标准，没有成员国达到7%的增长门槛，央行对政府信贷是区分度最高的标准之一。β-趋同检验显示统计上显著的负斜率，支持部分追赶效应，但未达到向所有区域目标的完全趋同。
AI.theory_contributions: 将宏观经济趋同从技术经济分析重新概念化为战略协调问题，为理解区域一体化中集体行动困境提供了博弈论分析框架；将捕鹿博弈和门槛博弈引入区域宏观经济趋同研究，拓展了该领域理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 构建了可操作的趋同距离指数用于监测SADC成员国宏观经济表现；为区域政策制定者提供了理解趋同失败根源的战略视角，有助于设计针对性的激励机制、监督和转移支付安排；提供了极端危机的诊断工具。

title: Symbol-Level Code Locking with Semantic Conflict Detection in Multi-Agent Software Development
affiliations: and

detail.title: Symbol-Level Code Locking with Semantic Conflict Detection in Multi-Agent Software Development
detail.abstract: Modern software development increasingly relies on multiple AI agents operating concurrently on shared codebases. Traditional version control systems, designed for human-paced interaction, are shown to be inadequate for the rapid, parallel operations that characterise such environments. In this paper, a novel framework is presented that addresses these shortcomings through two coordinated mechanisms: a Logical Integrity Engine that detects semantically incompatible changes using directed semantic graphs, and a Smart Locking System that enforces symbol-level access control rather than coarse file-level locks. Together, these mechanisms are demonstrated to enable true parallel development by multiple agents within the same source files while preventing logical conflicts from being introduced into the codebase. Experimental scenarios illustrate how breaking changes are detected before merge, deadlocks are avoided through atomic lock acquisition, and long-running operations are protected through priority-aware scheduling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个新型框架，通过逻辑完整性引擎（利用有向语义图检测语义不兼容变更）和智能锁系统（实现符号级而非文件级的访问控制）两个协调机制，使多个AI代理能在共享代码库中实现真正的并行开发，同时防止逻辑冲突进入代码库。
AI.research_question: 如何克服传统版本控制系统在支持多个AI代理并行开发共享代码库时的不足，实现安全的并行协作？
AI.motivation: 现代软件开发越来越依赖多个AI代理在同一代码库上并发操作，而传统版本控制系统是为人类节奏的交互设计的，无法满足此类环境中快速、并行操作的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有向语义图的逻辑完整性检测理论，以及符号级细粒度锁定的并发控制理论。
AI.method: 提出双机制框架：(1)逻辑完整性引擎，利用有向语义图检测语义不兼容的变更；(2)智能锁系统，实施符号级访问控制而非粗粒度的文件级锁。通过实验场景验证框架效果。
AI.findings: 该框架能够使多个AI代理在同一源文件内实现真正的并行开发，同时防止逻辑冲突进入代码库。实验表明：破坏性变更在合并前即被检测到、通过原子锁获取避免死锁、通过优先级感知调度保护长期运行操作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将语义图与细粒度锁相结合的并发控制新思路，为AI代理协作场景下的版本控制理论提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多AI代理并行开发环境提供了可操作的版本控制解决方案，包括合并前冲突检测、死锁避免和长任务保护机制。

title: Dynamic Project Expediting: A Stochastic Shortest-path Approach
affiliations: University of Brescia - Department of Economics and Management, Durham Business School and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Dynamic Project Expediting: A Stochastic Shortest-path Approach
