detail.title: A Market Uncertainty Principle: The Conjugate Structure of Price, Volume, and Time
detail.abstract: Taken literally, the claim that "a stock's transaction price, volume, and time cannot be simultaneously determined" is false: every executed trade prints an exact triple (p, v, t). We show, however, that the claim is rigorously true in four non-trivial senses: operationally (no order can guarantee price, quantity, and timing at once-an execution trilemma), statistically (any estimator of the latent efficient price faces a hard localization-precision tradeoff with floor (ση) 1/2 µ-1/4 , where η is microstructure noise, σ volatility, and µ the trade arrival rate), spectrally (instantaneous volatility inherits the Gabor limit ∆t ∆ω ≥ 1/2), and in equilibrium (a Grossman-Stiglitz incentive bound keeps prices from ever being fully revealing). The unifying mathematics is classical, not quantum: Fourier/Gabor duality for (time, frequency), Legendre duality for (price, volume) via the cost functional, and Fisher information (Cramér-Rao) for all statistical bounds. We prove that the Almgren-Chriss cost-risk frontier is exactly the hyperbola E • Var ≥ ησ 2 V 4 /4, with a Cauchy-Schwarz proof word-for-word parallel to Kennard's proof of the Heisenberg inequality; equality holds for exponential schedules. A martingale identity shows that the variance of price movements equals the reduction of market uncertainty about value-learning is never silent, the market's measurement back-action. Finally, order flow acts on price by translations, so (price, cumulative signed flow) generates a Heisenberg-Weyl algebra with Kyle's λ as its structure constant, explaining precisely where the quantum analogy is exact (group theory) and where it must degenerate (no complex amplitudes).

AI.tldr: 本文从四种严格的数学意义上证明了"股票的交易价格、数量和时间无法同时确定"这一命题为真：操作性（执行不可能三角）、统计性（局部化-精度权衡）、谱性（Gabor极限）和均衡性（Grossman-Stiglitz激励约束）。其统一数学框架借用了傅里叶/Gabor对偶（时间-频率）、勒让德对偶（价格-数量）以及Fisher信息（Cramér-Rao界），并证明Almgren-Chriss成本-风险前沿恰好是双曲线E·Var ≥ ησ²V⁴/4，且与海森堡不确定性原理的证明在结构上完全平行。
AI.research_question: "股票交易的价格、数量和时间无法同时确定"这一命题在什么严格数学意义上成立？金融市场的微观结构与量子力学不确定性原理之间的类比在什么层面上是精确的，在什么层面上必须失效？
AI.motivation: 表面上看，每笔成交都会打印出精确的(p, v, t)三元组，因此"价格、数量、时间不能同时确定"的说法似乎是假命题。但作者试图证明这一命题在四种非平凡意义上严格成立，并揭示其统一数学基础，从而深化对市场微观结构的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 傅里叶/Gabor对偶（时间-频率域）；2. 勒让德对偶（价格-体积，经由成本泛函）；3. Fisher信息与Cramér-Rao不等式（统计界）；4. 海森堡-外尔代数（Heisenberg-Weyl algebra，经由Kyle模型）；5. Grossman-Stiglitz均衡理论。
AI.method: 本文是理论/数学分析论文。作者：1) 提出执行不可能三角（操作性证明）；2) 推导估计有效价格时的局部化-精度权衡下界(ση)^(1/2)μ^(-1/4)（统计证明）；3) 证明瞬时波动率满足Gabor极限Δt·Δω≥1/2（谱证明）；4) 引用Grossman-Stiglitz激励约束（均衡证明）；5) 用Cauchy-Schwarz不等式逐字平行于Kennard对海森堡不等式的证明，推导Almgren-Chriss前沿的双曲线形式；6) 通过鞅恒等式论证价格波动方差等于市场对价值学习不确定性的减少量；7) 用群论框架展示订单流对价格的作用构成平移，生成海森堡-外尔代数。
AI.findings: 1) 执行不可能三角成立：没有订单能同时保证价格、数量和时机。2) 统计估计面临硬性下界(ση)^(1/2)μ^(-1/4)，即微观结构噪声越大（或到达率越低），估值的局部化-精度权衡越严重。3) 瞬时波动率满足Gabor极限Δt·Δω≥1/2。4) Almgren-Chriss成本-风险前沿恰好为双曲线E·Var≥ησ²V⁴/4，均衡达成的充要条件为指数调度。5) 价格运动方差等于市场不确定性减小的鞅恒等式，表明"学习从不沉默"——市场存在测量反作用。6) 在群论层面（Heisenberg-Weyl代数，Kyle λ作为结构常数），金融与量子力学的类比是精确的；但由于金融市场不存在复振幅，类比在更深层次上必须退化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将"市场不确定性原理"从启发式类比提升为四种严格数学证明。2) 建立了金融微观结构与量子力学数学结构之间的精确对应关系（傅里叶对偶、勒让德对偶、Fisher信息、Heisenberg-Weyl代数），同时清晰划定了类比的边界。3) 揭示了Almgren-Chriss模型与海森堡不等式共享的数学内核（Cauchy-Schwarz不等式的同一证明结构）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为执行策略设计提供理论边界：任何算法交易都无法同时最优地满足价格、数量和时机三个维度，必须做出明确权衡。2) 为高频交易中的统计估计提供精度下界指导。3) 为理解市场流动性（Kyle λ）作为不确定性原理中的"结构常数"提供了新的理论视角。

title: Research Design as Evidence: Information and Incentives in Peer Review
affiliations: Academia Sinica - Research Center for Humanities and Social Science,  and Academia Sinica - Institute of Political Science

detail.title: Research Design as Evidence: Information and Incentives in Peer Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Science and Technology Council, Taiwan (grant nos. NSTC 114-2410-H-001-046-MY2 to W.C.C., NSTC 113-2636-H-002-001 to W.J.C., and NSTC 113-2628-H-001-015-MY3 to G.C.H.S.).

detail.abstract: The same reported result can have different implications depending on how it was produced. In peer review, preregistration reveals research plans specified before results were known. We model how this disclosure changes reviewers' interpretation of submissions and scholars' incentives. A scholar chooses design rigour before project conditions are known and later invests in quality-improving analysis or persuasion that strengthens the submission without improving quality. In our benchmark, a more rigorous design improves the composition of marginal submissions, weakly lowers the acceptance threshold and weakly increases design rigour relative to traditional review. When project conditions instead cluster into distinct possibilities, however, the same result can look worse under a more rigorous design; preregistration can then raise the threshold and discourage ambitious designs. Hidden designs can preserve methodological diversity. Thus, preregistration changes incentives not only by constraining discretion, but also through the inferences reviewers draw from disclosed designs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈论模型分析了预注册制度如何改变审稿人对投稿的解读以及学者的研究激励。研究发现，预注册通过双向机制影响学术系统：一方面更严谨的设计能改善边际投稿的质量构成并降低录用门槛；但当项目条件呈现离散聚类时，同一结果在更严谨设计下可能看起来更差，导致预注册提高录用门槛并抑制雄心勃勃的研究设计，同时模糊设计可能保留方法论的多样性。
AI.research_question: 预注册制度如何通过审稿人的推断机制影响学者的研究设计选择和学术出版的激励结构？
AI.motivation: 同一报告结果因其产生过程不同而具有不同的含义，预注册揭示了结果揭晓前的研究计划，但现有文献尚未系统模型化这种信息披露如何改变审稿人的解读和学者的激励。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学与博弈论视角下的审稿人推断模型，涉及设计严谨性、项目条件分布、投稿决策与录门槛的均衡分析。
AI.method: 理论建模（博弈论模型）：构建学者选择设计严谨度、事后投入质量改进或说服努力的决策模型，比较传统审稿与预注册制度下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1）基准情形下，更严谨的设计改善边际投稿质量构成、弱降低录用门槛并弱提高设计严谨度；2）当项目条件离散聚类时，更严谨设计下同一结果可能看起来更差，预注册提高录用门槛并抑制雄心设计；3）隐藏设计可以保持方法论多样性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示了预注册不仅通过约束学者自由裁量权改变激励，还通过审稿人对已披露设计形成的推断这一信息渠道影响学术系统均衡，拓展了对学术评审机制设计的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术期刊、资助机构设计预注册政策提供了理论依据，指出预注册政策可能产生非预期后果（如抑制大胆设计、提高门槛），需权衡其在方法多样性与研究严谨性之间的取舍。

title: Distributed Infrastructures for the Governance of Environmental Change: Physical, Epistemic and Communicative Structure in Interdependent Earth-Human Systems

detail.title: Distributed Infrastructures for the Governance of Environmental Change: Physical, Epistemic and Communicative Structure in Interdependent Earth-Human Systems
detail.abstract: Governance of environmental change addresses a field composed of many interdependent infrastructures, energy, water, food production, ecosystems, settlements, health, transport, industry, and the digital systems that instrument them, whose couplings carry consequences across sectoral and jurisdictional boundaries. Existing arrangements govern these infrastructures sector by sector, and existing proposals for improvement concentrate on integration, the assembly of distributed observations into a single coherent picture of the system. This paper argues that integration in that sense is unavailable for a field of this kind, and proposes a different architecture. The method is conceptual and architectural: the paper distinguishes three structures that are ordinarily conflated, the physical structure of dependence among infrastructures, the epistemic structure of who knows what about which dependence, and the communicative structure of who reports to whom, and treats their divergences as governance-relevant quantities in their own right. Three consequences follow. A dependence that is physically present and communicatively absent constitutes a determinate and observable governance failure, which supplies a diagnostic that requires no model of the whole. The assembly of heterogeneous observations into one state estimate presupposes a privileged common representation, which physics supplies to meteorology and which coupled social-ecological fields do not possess, so integration must proceed at a layer that does not require it. And the absent edges of the physical structure, the couplings that exist and are unrecorded, are the governance-critical objects, which inverts the usual emphasis on what is measured. The paper's contribution is to define the three structures, to state their divergences as the primary diagnostic of the architecture, to distinguish the position from interdependency analysis, polycentric governance, and Earth observation integration programmes, and to identify the open questions that estimation of these structures raises. Its role is foundational for a wider programme, and it reports no empirical estimate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出环境变化治理的架构性问题：由众多相互依赖的基础设施（能源、水、粮食、交通、数字系统等）组成的领域无法通过"整合"（将分散观测汇集成统一图景）来治理。论文区分了三种结构——物理依赖结构、认识结构（谁知道什么）、沟通结构（谁向谁汇报），并将三者之间的"分歧"作为治理相关的核心诊断量，提出治理应聚焦于未被记录的耦合（物理结构中的"缺边"）。
AI.research_question: 对于由相互依赖的基础设施构成的环境变化治理领域，现有的"整合"治理架构是否可行？如果不可以，应当采用什么样的替代架构？
AI.motivation: 现实治理中基础设施按部门分别管辖，而各设施之间的耦合影响跨越部门和管辖权边界；现有的改进建议集中在"整合"上，即把分散的观测汇总成一幅连贯的系统图景，但论文认为这种整合在此类领域中不可行，需要新的架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区分三种结构：物理依赖结构（基础设施间实际存在的依赖关系）、认识结构（谁知道关于何种依赖的知识）、沟通结构（谁向谁汇报），并将三者的分歧视为治理相关量。对照互依性分析、多中心治理和地球观测整合方案进行概念定位。
AI.method: 概念性的、架构性的方法。通过概念区分三种结构，推导其分歧的治理后果，进行理论论证与概念辨析，不涉及实证估计。
AI.findings: 三个推论：(1) 物理上存在但沟通上缺失的依赖构成一种确定且可观测的治理失败，可作为无需整体模型的诊断工具；(2) 将异质观测汇集成单一状态估计预设了特权性的共同表征（如物理学之于气象学），而耦合的社会-生态领域不具备这种表征，因此整合必须在不需要它的层面上进行；(3) 物理结构的"缺边"——存在但未被记录的耦合——才是治理的关键对象，这颠覆了通常对"已测量内容"的关注重点。
AI.theory_contributions: 定义了三种结构；将三者分歧确立为该架构的主要诊断；将其立场与互依性分析、多中心治理、地球观测整合计划相区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 为更广泛的研究计划提供基础性（foundational）架构框架，提出"无需整体模型"的治理失败诊断路径，识别了这些结构估计所引发的开放问题。

title: Business Leadership in the Construction Industry: The Role of Public-Private Interaction and Price, Investment, Labor, and Institutional Determinants of Development
affiliations: STATE UNIVERSITY OF TRADE AND ECONOMICS, Zhytomyr Polytechnic State University,  Rector of the Kherson Economic and Legal Institute,  Rector of the Kherson Economic and Legal Institute, Bratislava University of Economics and Business and Khmelnytskyi National University

detail.title: Business Leadership in the Construction Industry: The Role of Public-Private Interaction and Price, Investment, Labor, and Institutional Determinants of Development
detail.abstract: The article is devoted to analyzing the role of business leadership and public-private interaction in shaping the development trajectories of Ukraine's construction industry. The purpose of the study is to develop and test an integrated analytical framework that combines econometric modeling, a Business Leadership Index (BLI), and scenario forecasting to identify key determinants of sectoral growth. The methodological basis includes a multifactor regression model (price, investment, labor, and institutional variables), the construction of the Business Leadership Index for leading companies, regional clustering of construction activity, and scenario forecasting based on a 5D model (Demand, Development, Delivery, Digitalization, Durability). Model verification using back-testing on 2018-2021 data showed deviations within only 7-9 %, confirming its reliability, while forward-testing provided forecast estimates up to 2028. The results demonstrated that strategic companies with a high level of innovation, ESG compliance, and participation in public-private projects act as catalysts of recovery, whereas regional asymmetries require differentiated policy measures. A comparison with Central and Eastern European countries revealed Ukraine's excessive dependence on state financing (>35 % versus 12-18 % in EU countries), highlighting the need to activate private capital. The scientific novelty of the study lies in combining index-based and scenario approaches, while its practical significance is determined by the possibility of applying the findings in public policy, corporate strategies, and international reconstruction support programs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个整合计量经济学建模、商业领导力指数（BLI）和情景预测的分析框架，用于分析乌克兰建筑行业的发展轨迹。研究识别出创新水平高、ESG合规性强且参与公私合作项目的战略企业是行业复苏的催化剂，同时发现乌克兰对国家融资的过度依赖（>35%，而欧盟国家为12-18%）需要激活私人资本。模型回测偏差仅7-9%，并可预测至2028年。
AI.research_question: 商业领导力与公私互动如何塑造乌克兰建筑行业的发展轨迹？哪些关键因素决定该行业的增长？
AI.motivation: 乌克兰建筑行业面临区域不均衡和过度依赖国家融资等挑战，需要综合性的分析框架来识别行业增长的关键决定因素，为公共政策和重建支持项目提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了多元回归模型（价格、投资、劳动力和制度变量）、商业领导力指数（BLI）、区域聚类分析以及基于5D模型（需求、发展、交付、数字化、耐久性）的情景预测框架。
AI.method: 采用多因素回归模型、商业领导力指数构建、区域聚类分析以及5D模型情景预测；使用2018-2021年数据进行回测验证，并进行前瞻性预测至2028年；与中东欧国家进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 高创新水平、ESG合规且参与公私合作项目的战略企业是行业复苏的催化剂；区域不对称性需要差异化政策；乌克兰对国家融资的依赖度（>35%）远超欧盟国家（12-18%），需激活私人资本；模型回测偏差仅7-9%，预测可靠度高。
AI.theory_contributions: 将指数型方法（BLI）与情景预测方法相结合，形成综合性的分析框架，为建筑行业增长分析提供了新的方法论整合路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究成果可直接应用于公共政策制定、企业战略规划以及国际重建支持项目，为乌克兰建筑行业的复苏路径提供了可操作的政策建议。

reference: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1201; https://doi.org/10.59576/sr.1201
title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-Through into Consumer Prices
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Columbia University - Graduate School of Arts and Sciences - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Anatomy of Tariff Pass-Through into Consumer Prices

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1201
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Tariffs raise the prices of goods made at home, not just the imports they tax-an effect that standard pass-through estimates largely miss. Studying the 2025 U.S. tariffs, we find that about 26 percent of the tariff increase passes through to consumer prices. These estimates are measured relative to less-exposed goods and hold aggregate conditions fixed. The direct effect accounts for 64 percent of this increase, as tariffs raise the consumer prices of foreign varieties of a good. The remaining 36 percent arises indirectly-tariffs raise the cost of imported inputs used by U.S. producers, and domestic producers raise their markups because they face less competition from higher-priced imports. The direct effect passes through quickly, since tariffs raise import prices almost immediately, but the indirect effect takes nine to twelve months to work its way through supply chains. As a result, tariffs have a larger and more drawnout impact on consumer prices than the direct effect alone would suggest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究2025年美国关税对消费者价格的影响，发现约26%的关税增幅传导至消费者价格。其中直接效应占64%（关税提高外国商品的消费者价格），间接效应占36%（关税提高美国生产商进口投入品成本，且国内生产商因竞争减少而提高加成率）。直接效应快速传导，间接效应需9-12个月透过供应链传导，因此关税对消费者价格的影响比仅考虑直接效应更大且更持久。
AI.research_question: 关税对消费者价格的总传导率是多少？直接效应（进口品价格上升）和间接效应（国内生产商投入成本上升及加成率调整）各自贡献多少？两种效应的传导速度有何不同？
AI.motivation: 标准关税传导估计主要关注进口价格效应，忽略了关税对国内商品价格的间接影响（投入品成本上升和竞争减少导致的加成率提高），导致对关税通胀效应的严重低估。作者利用2025年美国大规模关税作为自然实验进行量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税传导理论（pass-through）、进口竞争与加成率定价理论、供应链传导理论
AI.method: 利用2025年美国关税事件，采用差异方法（相对于关税暴露程度较低的商品进行比较），控制总体宏观条件，估计关税对消费者价格的传导率，并分离直接与间接效应。
AI.findings: (1)约26%的关税增幅传导至消费者价格；(2)直接效应占64%，间接效应占36%；(3)直接效应几乎立即传导（进口价格迅速上涨），间接效应需9-12个月透过供应链传导；(4)因此关税对消费者价格的影响比直接效应单独所示更大且更持久。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了关税传导理论，首次在统一框架下分离直接效应与间接效应并量化其相对贡献；揭示了关税对国内价格的间接传导机制（投入成本与竞争效应）；阐明直接效应与间接效应在传导时间维度上的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估关税的通胀影响提供更全面的量化依据；提示仅关注直接进口价格效应会显著低估关税的政策成本；为货币政策制定者判断关税冲击的通胀持续性提供时间维度上的参考。

title: Governing Near Environmental Criticality: The Triple Bind and the Turn to Act-Regarding Restraint

detail.title: Governing Near Environmental Criticality: The Triple Bind and the Turn to Act-Regarding Restraint
detail.abstract: A governance arrangement approaching a critical threshold in the system it governs is in a situation this paper argues is structurally worse than the sum of its difficulties. Three quantities on which such an arrangement depends degrade as the threshold nears, and they are not three independent risks to be managed separately: they are monotone functions of a single approach parameter, so they degrade together and their unfavourable values coincide exactly where governance most needs them. Detection reliability falls, because the statistical signatures on which early warning depends become harder to estimate as the system's recovery slows. The margin within which an intervention is safe shrinks, because the distance to the boundary of the occupied basin is what shrinks as a threshold nears. And estimation of the system's position degrades, in a manner the paper argues is worse than mere imprecision: near-unit-root estimation of persistence is biased downward, and because the recovery rate is a logarithm of persistence, a small downward bias becomes a large overstatement of stability precisely where persistence approaches one. The paper reports a simulation confirming that the same bias which overstates stability by five per cent far from a threshold overstates it nearly threefold near one, so the error runs toward apparent safety and grows as safety diminishes. The governance consequence is the paper's central claim. The standard institutional response to uncertainty, which is to observe more closely, act more cautiously in light of what is observed, and learn from the response, has all three of its legs cut at once by the triple bind, since observing, acting, and learning degrade together and in the same direction. The paper argues that near criticality an arrangement must therefore transfer weight from inputs that describe the system to inputs that describe the proposed act, principally its reversibility, because a property of an act does not degrade as the system approaches a threshold. This is the sense in which the burden criterion of the series' first paper is not merely applicable near criticality but is the only governing input that survives it. The paper surveys the relevant statistical, dynamical, decision-theoretic and institutional literatures, states what each owns, and identifies the residue. It reports no field study.

AI.tldr: 本文论证治理安排在临近系统临界阈值时，会同时面临三种相互关联且同步恶化的困境（检测可靠性下降、干预安全边际缩小、系统位置估计偏误增大），形成"三重束缚"。作者主张在临界状态下，治理应转向以行动属性（尤其是可逆性）而非系统描述性输入为基础，因为行动属性不随阈值接近而退化。
AI.research_question: 当治理安排所治理的系统接近临界阈值时，该治理安排为何以及如何面临结构性困境？标准制度应对（更密切观察、更谨慎行动、从响应中学习）为何会同时失效？治理应如何调整？
AI.motivation: 治理安排接近系统临界阈值时，其困境并非三种独立风险的简单叠加，而是源于单一参数驱动下三者同步恶化的结构性缺陷，这比问题之和更严重。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动力系统理论（临界慢化、单位根估计）、统计推断（持续性估计偏差）、决策理论（干预安全边际）、制度理论（观察-行动-学习制度响应）
AI.method: 理论论证辅以数值模拟：模拟表明远离阈值时偏差将稳定性高估5%，而接近阈值时高估近三倍。
AI.findings: （1）接近阈值时检测可靠性、干预安全边际和位置估计三者同步退化；（2）持续性估计存在向下偏误，恢复率是持续性的对数，小偏误在接近阈值时被放大为大幅稳定性高估；（3）误差方向指向表面安全且随安全减少而增大；（4）"观察-行动-学习"三重制度响应因三者同步退化而被同时削弱；（5）应转向以行动可逆性等属性为基础的治理标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"三重束缚"（triple bind）概念，揭示临界状态治理的结构性困境并非独立风险的累加而是单一参数驱动的同步退化；论证了"负担标准"（burden criterion）在临界状态下是唯一存续的治理输入。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临界状态下的治理实践提供指引：放弃对系统描述性输入的过度依赖，转而关注行动本身的可逆性属性作为决策依据。

title: Forecasting Event Propagation in Environmental Governance: What a Fitted Excitation Kernel Estimates

detail.title: Forecasting Event Propagation in Environmental Governance: What a Fitted Excitation Kernel Estimates
detail.abstract: The event layer developed earlier in this series produces a stream of timed, typed, sourceassessed reports across the parties of an interdependent field. Such a stream invites a familiar statistical treatment, since point processes in which past events raise the intensity of future ones are well understood and their multivariate form supplies exactly a matrix of cross-excitations among sources. This paper takes up that treatment and argues that its most natural interpretation is wrong in a way that matters. The method is analytical, with one verified simulation. The paper's central claim is that an excitation kernel fitted to a governance event stream is not an estimate of the field's physical coupling structure. An observed excitation from party i to party j is generated by a chain of four things: a coupling that obtains, a threshold at which the second party's instruments register a consequence, a carriage arrangement that delivered the first party's report, and the second party's own emission decision. Two of the four are institutional settings, and both are revisable, so a fitted kernel measures the composition and cannot be decomposed into its factors without information the stream does not contain. The consequence is a division of uses. The fit is invalid for structural inference, so a coupling may not be asserted from an excitation, nor denied from its absence; and it is valid and useful for operational purposes, since what an arrangement needs in order to route reports, allocate attention, and anticipate load is precisely the reporting-conditional propagation the fit does estimate. The paper develops three further results. The branching ratio of the stream is a relational quantity computable from the stream alone and is a candidate network-level indicator of the kind the criticality paper of this series calls for, with the caveat that it measures the reporting cascade and not the physical one. As that ratio rises, the share of activity attributable to the stream's own history rises with it, so what a forecast is forecasting changes, and near unity the forecast concerns the arrangement more than the field. And valid estimation presupposes that thresholds and carriage were stable over the fitting window or that their changes are retrievable, which makes the versioned registers required elsewhere in this series a precondition of the method and not an administrative convenience. The paper surveys the point-process, seismological, network-cascade and infrastructure-modelling literatures, states what each owns, and identifies the residue.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了将激励核（excitation kernel）拟合到治理事件流上，并不能估计该领域的物理耦合结构。观测到的从i到j的激励是由四种因素链式生成的：实际存在的耦合、触发阈值、报告传递安排以及接受方的发布决策。其中两个是制度设置且可修订，因此拟合核只能测量这些因素的合成效应，无法从流数据中分解。拟合结果不适用于结构性推断，但适用于运营目的。本文还证明了分支比是仅从流数据即可计算的关系量，可作为网络级指标。
AI.research_question: 拟合到治理事件流上的激励核是否可以被解释为领域内物理耦合结构的估计？如果不能，其正确用途是什么？
AI.motivation: 事件流数据天然适合点过程模型的统计处理（过去事件提高未来事件的强度），这种多元形式恰好提供了源间交叉激励矩阵。但作者认为最自然的解释是错误的，且这种错误在实践上有重要影响，因此需要澄清拟合核的正确解释和用途。
AI.theoretical_framework: 点过程理论（point process theory）、多元自激点过程（multivariate self-exciting point processes）、分支比理论（branching ratio）、地震学模型、网络级联（network cascade）和基础设施建模文献。
AI.method: 分析方法为主，辅以一个验证性模拟。论文通过概念拆解，将观测激励分解为四个构成因素（耦合、阈值、传递安排、发布决策），并以此分析拟合核的结构含义和适用边界。
AI.findings: （1）拟合的激励核测量的是"报告条件性传播"而非物理耦合结构，不能用于结构性推断——不能从激励的存在断言耦合存在，也不能从激励缺失否认耦合；（2）该拟合对运营目的有效有用（路由报告、分配注意力、预测负荷）；（3）分支比是仅依赖流数据的可计算关系量，可作为网络级指标，但测量的是报告级联而非物理级联；（4）随着分支比上升，流自身历史可归因的活动份额增加，预测的对象从领域转向安排本身；（5）有效估计的前提是阈值和传递安排在拟合窗口内稳定或变化可恢复，这使得版本化注册成为方法的先决条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对点过程在治理研究中的应用提出了关键的概念纠正：区分了"物理耦合"与"报告条件性传播"两个层次，证明激励核无法分解为因果结构，从而划定了结构性推断与运营用途的明确边界。这一区分对多学科（点过程、地震学类比、网络级联、基础设施建模）的交叉使用具有方法论上的澄清意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为治理事件流的实际应用提供了操作指引：明确拟合结果可用于路由规划、注意力分配和负荷预测等运营决策；提出分支比作为网络级健康指标的使用建议及其注意事项；强调版本化注册制度是该方法的前提条件而非行政便利，为数据治理实践提供了制度性要求。

title: From AI Governance Commitments to Institutional Action: Organizational Decision Governance as a Regulatory Translation Architecture

detail.title: From AI Governance Commitments to Institutional Action: Organizational Decision Governance as a Regulatory Translation Architecture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author participates in professional and policy activities related to artificial intelligence governance. No institution, organization, network, initiative, advisory body, employer, or other entity with which the author is or has been affiliated or otherwise professionally associated funded, commissioned, directed, or exercised editorial control over this research. The views expressed are solely those of the author and should not be attributed to any such entity. No institutional or organizational endorsement is implied. The author declares no financial or commercial competing interests related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This theoretical and conceptual study did not involve human participants, patient data, or the collection of human-subject research data.
declarations.funderStatement: No specific funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence governance increasingly relies on laws, principles, risk frameworks, management-system standards, and voluntary codes requiring organizations to manage risk, allocate responsibility, provide human oversight, and monitor use. Yet these instruments often leave organizations to specify the concrete authority relationships through which artificial contributions become consequential organizational action. This article develops Organizational Decision Governance as a meso-level regulatory translation architecture centered on the consequential decision pathway. Drawing on management-based regulation, meta-regulation, and organizational decoupling, it treats the attachment of governance commitments to consequential decision pathways as a necessary but insufficient condition of effective organizational implementation. The architecture connects decision authority, reliance authorization, bounded delegation, verification, institutional judgment, action, monitoring, escalation, and reassessment or revocation. Five propositions specify mechanisms of translation, authority congruence, reliance-delegation separation, proportional control, and recursive recoverability. A provision-level crosswalk shows how the architecture can operationalize, without collapsing, prominent legal, policy, risk-management, management-system, and ethical governance instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"组织决策治理"（Organizational Decision Governance）作为中观层面的监管转译架构，核心围绕"后果性决策路径"（consequential decision pathway），将法律、原则、风险框架、管理标准等治理工具转化为组织内部具体的权限关系与决策流程。
AI.research_question: 如何将抽象的人工智能治理制度要求转化为组织内部具体且可操作的权力关系与决策机制？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理工具（法律、原则、风险框架、管理标准、自愿准则）要求组织管理风险、分配责任、提供人类监督和监控使用，但往往未说明组织如何具体构建使AI贡献转化为组织行动的权力关系，存在监管要求与组织实践之间的转译鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于管理型监管（management-based regulation）、元监管（meta-regulation）与组织脱耦（organizational decoupling）理论。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念框架开发，提出五条命题及条款级对照表（provision-level crosswalk）来验证架构的适用性。
AI.findings: 提出了将治理承诺附着于后果性决策路径的组织决策治理架构；识别出决策权限、依赖授权、受约束委托、验证、制度判断、行动、监控、升级、重新评估或撤销等关键要素联结；提出了五条命题：转译机制、权威一致性、依赖-委托分离、比例控制与递归可恢复性；并通过条款级对照表展示了该架构如何在不消解各制度工具的前提下操作化法律、政策、风险管理、管理体系和伦理治理工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了中观层面的"组织决策治理"这一监管转译架构，弥合宏观监管制度与微观组织实践之间的理论空隙；将治理承诺与后果性决策路径的关联界定为实现有效组织实施的必要非充分条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了将各类AI治理工具（法律、政策、风险框架、管理标准、伦理准则）转化为具体决策权限与流程设置的可操作架构和对照指南，有助于组织实际落实AI治理合规要求。

title: Stablecoins Meet the Mundell-Fleming Trilemma
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York, National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Stablecoins Meet the Mundell-Fleming Trilemma

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1202
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how stablecoins impact global capital flows by constructing a novel wallet-level dataset linking geotagged Ethereum Name Service registrations to stablecoin transactions around banking restrictions, currency crises, sanctions, and monetary disruptions. We find that crisis-country wallets experience significant increases in USD stablecoin inflows and receipt activity during crisis weeks. Motivated by this evidence, we develop a small-open-economy New Keynesian model in which household adoption of programmable stablecoins weakens the government's enforcement technology for capital controls by making capital mobility endogenous. The empirical evidence validates the model's central assumption that flight pressure increases stablecoin adoption. Stablecoins therefore tighten the Mundell-Fleming trilemma by reducing the government's ability to sustain independent monetary policy under a fixed exchange-rate regime.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建新颖的钱包级数据集（将地理标记的以太坊名称服务注册与稳定币交易关联），研究稳定币如何影响全球资本流动。研究发现危机国家的钱包在危机周经历显著的美元稳定币流入增加。基于此证据，作者开发了一个小型开放经济体新凯恩斯模型，其中家庭对可编程稳定币的采用削弱了政府资本管制的执行技术，使资本流动性内生。实证证据验证了模型的核心假设：资本外逃压力增加稳定币采用。因此，稳定币通过削弱政府在固定汇率制度下维持独立货币政策的能力，收紧了蒙代尔-弗莱明三元悖论。
AI.research_question: 稳定币如何影响全球资本流动，以及它们如何改变政府在固定汇率制度下维持独立货币政策的能力？
AI.motivation: 随着稳定币（如USDC、USDT）的快速普及，它们可能绕过传统的资本管制措施，从而对全球资本流动和货币政策产生深远影响。然而，缺乏微观层面的数据来系统研究稳定币在危机时期的资本流动作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 小型开放经济体新凯恩斯模型；蒙代尔-弗莱明三元悖论；资本管制的内生性理论
AI.method: 构建钱包级数据集（链接地理标记的Ethereum Name Service注册与稳定币交易），进行实证事件研究分析（围绕银行业限制、货币危机、制裁和货币扰动等事件）；开发理论模型模拟稳定币采用如何削弱资本管制
AI.findings: 危机国家的钱包在危机周期间经历显著的美元稳定币流入和接收活动增加；资本外逃压力增加了稳定币采用
AI.theory_contributions: 将稳定币引入蒙代尔-弗莱明三元悖论框架，表明稳定币通过使资本流动性内生来削弱政府资本管制的执行技术，从而收紧三元悖论；为稳定币如何影响货币政策独立性提供了理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和政策制定者提供了稳定币如何绕过资本管制的实证证据；有助于理解在数字资产时代资本管制的有效性及其局限

title: Minimum Effort, Maximum Efficiency: The Evolution of IJF Judo from 2009-2026

detail.title: Minimum Effort, Maximum Efficiency: The Evolution of IJF Judo from 2009-2026
detail.abstract: We assemble the population record of International Judo Federation competition-221,875 contests across seven rule regimes (2009-2026), with 328,346 athlete-attributed within-fight events-to ask what rule changes actually change. Auditing the regimes against primary rule texts and holding measurement to a fixed competitive tier, we find a pair of invariances flanking the margins policy moves. Rules reallocate scoring production dramatically between standing and ground judo, yet the technique hierarchy within each phase never reorders; each technique carries a stable conversion signature that reforms re-price but do not re-rank. A by-production technology with distinct standing (tachiwaza) and ground (newaza) goods relations and costly disposable penalty generation models the athlete level, with union meta-frontier inference via smoothed bootstrap extending the pattern to production: the ground game's share of athlete inefficiency (∼56%) is statistically indistinguishable across regimes, standing technology gaps close monotonically toward the present, and the penalty and concession-generating technologies are era-invariant. These conclusions survive re estimation on sex-specific frontiers, which additionally reveal a symmetric division of the pooled technology: men anchor the standing frontier, women the groundwork frontier. Sex-specific frontiers preserve every ordering while revealing a symmetric division of the pooled frontier: men anchor the standing technology, women the groundwork. Convexifying the meta-frontier across regimes would manufacture a quarter to half of the measured gaps from blends of rulebooks that never existed. The most recent liberalization lowered the mean penalty rate while raising its estimated feasible floor removing the offense athletes could avoid while enlarging the one they cannot. Rule reform, on this evidence, redraws the price system athletes face far more readily than it changes what athletes are able to do.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析国际柔道联合会（IJF）2009-2026年间七个规则体系下的221,875场正式比赛及328,346个运动员相关事件，考察规则改革对柔道竞技表现的实际影响。研究发现：规则改革虽大幅重新分配了站立技术（tachiwaza）与地面技术（newaza）之间的得分产出，但各技术内部的等级排序从未改变；地面技在运动员低效率中的份额（约56%）在各规则体系间统计上无差异；站立技术差距随时代单调缩小，而罚分与让步生成技术则跨时代不变。男性锚定站立技术前沿，女性锚定地面技术前沿。研究结论认为规则改革改变的是运动员面临的"价格体系"而非其能力本身。
AI.research_question: 规则改革究竟改变了什么？在柔道运动连续七个规则体系更迭（2009-2026）中，规则变化是否真正改变了运动员的技术能力、生产效率，还是仅仅重新定价了运动员的策略选择空间？
AI.motivation: 柔道赛事规则频繁变动，但此前缺乏基于大规模人口级数据（而非抽样）对规则改革实际效果的系统性评估。研究者希望超越"规则改变前后统计变化"的表面描述，深入检验规则变化是否真正重塑了运动员的生产可能性边界，或只是改变了产出价格体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生产经济学中的联合生产技术框架，区分站立（tachiwaza）与地面（newaza）两类"商品"，构建副产品（by-production）技术模型；运用随机前沿分析（SFA）与元前沿（meta-frontier）推断，结合平滑自助法（smoothed bootstrap）进行跨时代生产率比较。
AI.method: 1) 汇编IJF全部正式比赛记录（221,875场），按七个规则体系分组；2) 对照原始规则文本审计各体系差异；3) 构建副产品生产技术模型区分站立与地面博弈关系及代价高昂的可弃罚分生成；4) 使用平滑自助法的联盟元前沿推断；5) 分性别前沿再估计检验稳健性；6) 将元前沿凸化处理以判定混合规则体系测量偏差。
AI.findings: 1) 规则仅重新分配站立与地面之间的得分产出，但各阶段内部技术等级从不重排，每种技术具有稳定的"转化特征"——重新定价但从未重新排序；2) 地面技占运动员无效率的份额（约56%）跨规则体系在统计上不可区分；3) 站立技术差距呈单调缩小趋势，罚分与让步生成技术跨时代不变；4) 性别特异性前沿揭示对称分工：男性锚定站立技术前沿，女性锚定地面技术前沿；5) 将元前沿凸化会在历史上从未存在过的规则组合混合中人为制造四分之一到一半的测量差距；6) 最近的自由化降低了平均罚分率但提高了其可行下限——移除了运动员可避免的处罚，同时扩大了不可避免的处罚。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将副产品生产技术与元前沿推断方法应用于竞技体育规则改革的因果评估；2) 提出"重新定价而非重新排序"的理论洞见，区分规则变化的价格效应与能力效应；3) 揭示规则体系间技术层级的不变性（invariance）规律，可能推广至其他规则驱动的竞技领域；4) 方法上证明了凸化元前沿可能制造虚假差距的方法论警示。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为国际柔道联合会等规则制定机构提供实证依据：规则改革对运动员能力边界影响有限，主要改变策略定价；2) 揭示罚分制度改革的实际效果（可避免罚分减少但不可避免罚分扩大），为规则微调提供方向性参考；3) 性别技术分工的发现可为训练体系、教练资源配置与运动员发展路径提供指导；4) 为其他规则频繁变动的竞技项目（如体操、花样滑冰等）的规则评估提供可复制的方法论模板。

title: Cogent Social Sciences
affiliations: , Durban University of Technology (DUT), Women's University in Africa, Chinhoyi University of Technology, Ghana Communication Technology University and Great Zimbabwe University

detail.title: Cogent Social Sciences
detail.abstract: Research on the resilience of women-owned SMes has been scant. the study examines the mediating role of transformational leadership in the relationship between adaptive leadership and dynamic capabilities, and their impact on the resilience of women-owned SMes in Zimbabwe. the research was guided by the adaptive leadership theory, dynamic capabilities theory, transformational leadership theory, and organizational resilience theory. the survey involved women-owned SMes in the services sector in harare. the findings demonstrate that transformational leadership mediates the effects of adaptive leadership and dynamic capabilities on the resilience of women-owned SMes in Zimbabwe. the research recommends integrating transformational leadership, adaptive leadership, and dynamic capabilities to achieve resilience.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了变革型领导在适应性领导与动态能力对津巴布韦女性小微企业韧性影响中的中介作用，发现变革型领导确实发挥了中介效应，并建议整合三者以提升企业韧性。
AI.research_question: 变革型领导是否在适应性领导与动态能力对女性小微企业韧性的影响中起中介作用？
AI.motivation: 关于女性小微企业韧性的研究十分匮乏，本研究旨在填补这一研究空白，并聚焦于津巴布韦这一特定情境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 适应性领导理论、动态能力理论、变革型领导理论、组织韧性理论
AI.method: 问卷调查法，样本为津巴布韦哈拉雷服务业中的女性小微企业
AI.findings: 变革型领导在适应性领导与动态能力对女性小微企业韧性的影响中起中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了女性小微企业韧性研究的空白，将适应性领导、动态能力与变革型领导整合进统一框架，拓展了组织韧性理论在女性创业情境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议女性小微企业将变革型领导、适应性领导与动态能力相结合以达成企业韧性，为政策制定者和企业管理者提供了实践指导。

title: Entrepreneurial Leadership and Human Resources Development in SMEs: The Mediating Role of Learning Orientation
affiliations: , Women's University in Africa and Durban University of Technology (DUT)

detail.title: Entrepreneurial Leadership and Human Resources Development in SMEs: The Mediating Role of Learning Orientation
detail.abstract: Most developing countries rely on smes for economic growth. However, smes face challenges in human resource development. this research aimed to advance knowledge in this area by investigating the mediating role of learning orientation in the relationship between entrepreneurial leadership and human resource development. the dynamic capabilities theory guided the study. the research was done with 321 respondents from smes. Data were collected using a closed-ended questionnaire. Data analysis was done through sPss version 30.0. Regression analysis was conducted to assess causal relationships, and andrew F. Hayes' test was performed to determine mediation. the research elaborates that learning orientation mediates the relationship between entrepreneurial leadership and human resource development. the study recommends that HRD professionals and sme leadership implement entrepreneurial leadership and a learning orientation simultaneously to achieve human resources development.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了创业型领导与人力资源开发之间的关系，并考察了学习导向在此关系中的中介作用。基于动态能力理论，通过对321家中小企业的问卷调查和回归分析，发现学习导向在创业型领导与人力资源开发之间起中介作用。
AI.research_question: 学习导向是否在创业型领导与中小企业人力资源开发之间起中介作用？
AI.motivation: 大多数发展中国家依赖中小企业促进经济增长，但中小企业在人力资源开发方面面临挑战，因此需要推进该领域的知识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论（Dynamic Capabilities Theory）
AI.method: 采用封闭式问卷对321名中小企业受访者收集数据，使用SPSS 30.0进行数据分析，通过回归分析评估因果关系，并使用Andrew F. Hayes的检验来确定中介效应。
AI.findings: 学习导向在创业型领导与人力资源开发之间起中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为创业型领导、学习导向与人力资源开发之间的作用机制提供了理论解释，将动态能力理论应用于中小企业人力资源开发场景，扩展了该理论的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议人力资源开发专业人士和中小企业领导者应同时实施创业型领导和学习导向，以实现人力资源开发。

title: Is a Dollar a Dollar? How Transfer Design Shapes Household Spending
affiliations: , Georgetown University and

detail.title: Is a Dollar a Dollar? How Transfer Design Shapes Household Spending

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No author has personal or financial relationships that have influenced this study.
declarations.funderStatement: The study received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Government transfers vary along two design dimensions that standard models predict should not matter: whether benefits are paid in cash or kind, and whether they arrive as one-time or recurring payments. We test to what extent these design choices a!ect household spending using sharp changes in four pandemic-era transfers to lowincome families with children: one-time food vouchers, monthly food benefits, one-time cash payments, and monthly cash payments. Linking variation in benefit timing and amount to high-frequency household scanner data, we estimate spending responses in a harmonized di!erence-in-di!erences and event-study framework. We find that households spend more out of in-kind benefits than out of cash transfers of similar value, and more out of recurring payments than out of one-time transfers in the short-run. Our estimates produce the first internally comparable set of shortrun food-store MPCs across di!erent transfer types ranging from 0.18 (one-time) and 0.38 (monthly) for in-kind benefits, versus 0.06 (one-time) and 0.20 (monthly) for cash. The patterns suggest that the form and timing of transfers systematically shape household spending in ways that are consistent with mental accounting, labeling, and forward-looking responses. More broadly, our results imply that transfer design-not just generosity and targeting-is a first-order policy lever for both social insurance and short-run demand stabilization.

AI.tldr: 本文利用疫情期间面向低收入家庭的四项转移支付政策（一次性食品券、月度食品福利、一次性现金、月度现金）的急剧变化，结合高频家庭扫描数据，设计了统一的DID和事件研究框架，发现家庭对实物（in-kind）补贴的边际消费倾向高于现金转移，对经常性（recurring）支付的边际消费倾向高于一次性支付，从而证明转移支付的形式和时机选择本身就是影响短期消费的重要政策杠杆。
AI.research_question: 政府转移支付的设计维度（现金vs实物、一次性vs经常性）是否以及如何影响家庭短期消费支出？
AI.motivation: 标准经济学模型预测转移支付的设计形式（现金/实物、一次性/经常性）不应该影响家庭消费行为，但现实中各国政府大量采用不同的转移支付设计。利用疫情期间美国四项大规模转移支付政策的自然实验，为这一理论预测提供经验检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心理账户理论（mental accounting）、标签效应（labeling）、前瞻性行为（forward-looking responses）
AI.method: 利用疫情期四项转移支付（一次性食品券、月度食品福利、一次性现金、月度现金）的准自然实验，将受益金额和时机变动与高频家庭扫描数据相链接，采用统一的差分中的差分（DID）和事件研究（event-study）框架估计消费反应。
AI.findings: 1）家庭对实物补贴的边际消费倾向高于等值现金转移；2）短期内容易性（recurring）支付的边际消费倾向高于一次性支付；3）首次提供了不同转移类型的内部可比较的短期食品店MPC估计：实物补贴为0.18（一次性）和0.38（月度），现金为0.06（一次性）和0.20（月度）。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了标准经济模型中转移支付形式不影响消费的理论假设，为心理账户、标签效应和前瞻性行为理论提供了大规模准实验证据，系统性地证明了转移支付设计维度（形式与时机）对消费行为的显著影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了转移支付设计的实证依据，表明除慷慨程度和精准瞄准外，转移支付的设计形式（现金vs实物、一次性vs经常性）本身也是社会救助和短期需求稳定化的首要政策工具。

title: Street Spin Foam: A Preliminary Formulation

detail.title: Street Spin Foam: A Preliminary Formulation
detail.abstract: Movement through a city is usually modelled by fixing a geometry, placing agents inside it, and treating the worth of a location as a number attached to that location. This paper develops a representation in which relations carry the state instead. A street district is written as a compact lattice gauge theory of valuation on a two-complex, in the spin-foam representation of covariant loop quantum gravity. Persons, places and stores become onecells, that is, worldlines, and the two-cells become the histories of the relations among them, so that being somewhere is a relation with a history rather than a coordinate a person carries. An entity is then a constraint on how the relations meeting at it may combine, rather than a bearer of state. Two consequences follow. Supplying a group and an action makes the spins, the intertwiners and the vertex amplitude follow from a character expansion rather than from stipulation, so that a large collection of local weights reduces to a small number of global choices; the expansion is verified against an independent numerical evaluation. Pedestrians then enter as charged matter, minimally coupled, and Kolmogorov's criterion yields a prediction sharper than the statement that valuation affects movement: circulation is sourced by the topological part of the valuation field alone, so that a region of large local disagreement and zero winding carries zero net circulation. A model whose forces are gradients of potentials leaves that pattern inaccessible, which makes the difference testable rather than interpretive. A case study on the street network of Ginza, Tokyo, with constructed commercial content, illustrates what the formalism does. The gauge structure changes simulated behaviour against a flat-connection control; circulation tracks the winding number while leaving a matched non-topological predictor inert; an effective distance read off correlation decay departs from street distance; encounter order is inert under an abelian connection and becomes material as soon as the valuation axes separate; and a walk on the complex sees an effective two-dimensional geometry over about a decade and a half of scale. One prediction fails, and its diagnosis is the most transferable result: it was imported from a confining gauge theory that the model leaves uninstantiated. The cell assignment admits two orientations, with entities on edges or objects on faces, and a counting argument bears on which of them leaves a configuration space to sample. Under the second, persons enter the spin foam directly, on condition that the one-cells are occasions gathering several parties rather than pairwise relations. The contribution is a representation in which relations rather than sites carry the state, a route by which local weights follow from a group and an action, a falsifiable point of difference from gradient-based models, and a criterion for choosing the cell assignment. Estimating the couplings from observation is identified as the next stage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全新的城市运动表征框架，将街道区域建模为紧致格点规范理论（spin-foam表示），其中关系而非位置承载状态。行人作为带电物质最小耦合进入模型，通过Kolmogorov准则得出可证伪的预测：环流仅由估值场的拓扑部分产生。通过东京银座案例验证了该框架与梯度模型的本质差异。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种以关系而非位置承载状态的城市运动表征框架？这种框架能否产生不同于传统梯度模型的、可被检验的预测？
AI.motivation: 传统城市运动模型将几何固定、将位置的价值视为该位置的附属数字，这种表征方式可能遗漏关系的动态本质。作者试图发展一种关系承载状态的替代性表征，使"在某地"成为有历史的关系而非个体携带的坐标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 紧致格点规范理论（compact lattice gauge theory）、协变圈量子引力的spin-foam表示、Kolmogorov准则、特征展开（character expansion）、规范场论中物质耦合的概念。
AI.method: 将城市街道区域构建为spin-foam表示的规范理论模型；行人作为带电物质最小耦合进入；通过特征展开推导自旋、纠缠子和顶点振幅（并用数值验证）；以东京银座街道网络为案例进行模拟研究，比较规范结构模型与平坦联络对照组及梯度模型的行为差异。
AI.findings: （1）自旋、纠缠子和顶点振幅可由群与作用通过特征展开推导，而非人为指定；（2）环流仅由估值场的拓扑部分（绕数）驱动，梯度模型无法产生该模式；（3）有效距离偏离街道距离；（4）阿贝尔联络下遭遇顺序无效，估值轴分离后变得重要；（5）在约1.5个数量级的尺度上呈现有效二维几何；（6）一个预测失败，源于从禁闭规范理论导入但模型未实例化的假设；（7）胞腔分配的计数论证表明取向选择影响构型空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一种以关系而非地点承载状态的表征体系；证明了局部权重可以从群与作用的选择中涌现；给出了与梯度模型可证伪的差异点；提供了选择胞腔分配（实体在边上vs对象在面上）的判据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市模型提供了一个可测试的框架，能够生成与梯度模型不同的行为预测；通过银座案例展示了该形式主义的实际应用；失败的预测诊断具有可迁移性，提示建模者注意理论假设是否被实例化；明确了下一步应从观测数据估计耦合参数。

title: The Scope of Situated Judgment: An Ontology of the Judged Subject in a Generative Relational Framework

detail.title: The Scope of Situated Judgment: An Ontology of the Judged Subject in a Generative Relational Framework
detail.abstract: Judgments of persons are routinely formed inside one relation and used inside another. A supervisor's account of a researcher is read by an admissions committee; a clinician's formulation follows a patient into a dierent service; an electorate that has never met a candidate decides on the strength of endorsements by those who claim to know him. This paper asks what such a judgment warrants once it leaves the relation in which it was formed. On the framework used here, what a relation generates is generated within it and is available only from the positions its parties occupied, so an attribute exhibited in one relation is not thereby a property carried into others. The paper distinguishes two claims about assessment that are usually run together: that a judgment is a noisy estimate of a real underlying quality, for which the remedies are structure and de-biasing, and that there is no such quality to estimate, for which those remedies are misdirected. It argues that both hold, in dierent domains, and states where the boundary falls. A limiting case is then examined in which a referee signs an account written by its subject: no shared experience exists and the instrument functions regardless, which indicates that such instruments do not carry an account of a relation at all. What they transmit is a eld of relational conditions that recongures what the person can subsequently generate; the account is the justication oered for opening that eld rather than the thing conveyed. This explains why an empty instrument works, why such instruments are exchanged for things other than accounts, and why the same property that lets an unassessable person enter a system is what makes the instrument tradeable. Two cases are compared, political selection and academic recommendation, and the comparison is drawn not through the motives of those who judge but through the regime under which judgments are issued: who may issue one, at what weight, with what observational access, with what transferability, and under what provision for revision. The paper's positive proposal follows from the political case. Political theory did not resolve the problem of judging a candidate by making judgment more accurate; it made the mandate revisable. That remedy is institutional and temporal rather than epistemic, and it generalises. Where the paper's claims are already made by professional assessment standards, by the conferralist account of social properties, or by the selection model of representation, they are conceded rather than asserted.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人际判断在脱离其形成关系后被使用的正当性问题。论文区分了两种评估主张——判断是对真实潜在品质的噪声估计（可用结构和去偏修正）与不存在这种可估计的品质（修正方向错误），并论证两者在不同领域同时成立。论文通过"空文书"这一极限案例（推荐人签署由被推荐人自己撰写的推荐信）揭示：此类文书传递的并非关系本身的描述，而是一种关系条件场域，它重构了被评估者未来的生成能力。论文比较了政治选拔与学术推荐两种制度，提出积极方案：让判断可修订（如政治上的任期可撤销）而非让判断更准确，这是一种制度性和时间性而非认识论的补救。
AI.research_question: 当人际判断脱离其形成的具体关系情境而被转移到另一关系中使用时，这种判断具有怎样的认识论地位和正当性？
AI.motivation: 日常实践中，评估（如推荐信、临床诊断、政治背书）普遍在一个关系中形成却在另一个关系中使用（如导师评价被录取委员会阅读），但现有理论对这种情况的认识论基础缺乏清晰说明。两种常见主张（噪声估计观与无品质可估观）被混淆使用，需要厘清边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系主义的属性生成框架（属性仅在关系内部生成、仅从当事方位置可获取）；授予论（conferralist）社会属性理论；代表性选择模型（selection model of representation）
AI.method: 概念分析与哲学论证；极限案例考察（"空文书"：推荐人签署被推荐人自撰的推荐信）；比较案例研究（政治选拔vs学术推荐），从制度维度（谁可发布、权重、观察途径、可转移性、修订规定）比较
AI.findings: 1) 判断的"噪声估计"论与"无品质可估"论在不同领域分别成立，论文划定了边界；2) 空文书能够发挥功能说明评估文书传递的并非关系描述，而是一种关系条件场域，重新配置了被评估者后续的生成能力；3) 文书是开放该场域的正当性辩护而非被传递的内容本身；4) 政治选拔中的积极方案是使授权可修订（任期制），而非提高判断精确度，这一方案具有普适性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 厘清了评估中两种长期混淆的主张（噪声估计观vs无品质可估观）的领域边界；2) 提出"文书传递关系条件场域而非关系描述"的新理解，解释了空文书为何有效；3) 将政治理论中的"可修订授权"方案推广为一般性评估补救机制，从认识论补救转向制度性补救。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为推荐信、临床转诊、政治背书等实际评估制度的设计提供新的理论依据；2) 指出提高判断准确性的传统路径（结构化和去偏）在部分领域是错位的，制度性补救（如可修订性）更为有效；3) 为评估文书为何被交换为评估之外的其他事物提供解释。

title: Education as a Nutritional Redistributor: Income, Diet Quality, and the Demand for Nutrients in Brazil
affiliations: CAEN - UFC

detail.title: Education as a Nutritional Redistributor: Income, Diet Quality, and the Demand for Nutrients in Brazil
detail.abstract: We estimate a Quadratic Almost Ideal Demand System (QUAIDS) for twelve food groups plus tobacco and alcohol-included to capture substitution with addictive goods-using microdata from Brazil's 2017-18 Household Budget Survey, correcting sample-selection bias via bivariate copulas selected empirically by canonical maximum likelihood estimation. We propose a method to derive nutritional income elasticities from a nutritional content matrix-a mapping from food-group demand to nutrient demand that extends any estimated demand system to produce nutritional elasticities without requiring a separate nutrient equation system. With this structure, we specify education-income interaction effects that reveal a pattern consistent with the redistribution-rather than a uniform increase-of nutritional sensitivity to income. Protein is the only nutrient with an income elasticity above unity, while protective micronutrients-vitamin C, fiber, calcium-respond significantly less to income. The main result lies in education: the education gradient is asymmetric-tertiary-educated households exhibit lower income elasticities for protein and zinc, but higher elasticities for 1 vitamin C, fiber, and calcium-so that the same income increment is associated with distinct nutritional returns depending on household education. This asymmetry suggests that the nutritional effectiveness of income transfer programs such as Bolsa Família varies with the educational level of the beneficiary household-a pattern that points to a possible complementarity between income and education in such policies.

AI.tldr: 本文利用巴西2017-18年家庭预算调查微观数据，估计了一个包含十二个食品组加上烟草和酒精的二次几乎理想需求系统（QUAIDS），并通过双重copula修正样本选择偏差。作者提出了一种从营养含量矩阵推导营养收入弹性的方法，将食品组需求扩展到营养素需求。研究发现蛋白质是唯一收入弹性大于1的营养素，而保护性微量营养素（维生素C、纤维、钙）对收入的响应显著较低。核心发现是教育梯度呈不对称性：受过高等教育家庭对蛋白质和锌的收入弹性较低，但对维生素C、纤维和钙的弹性较高，表明收入转移项目（如Bolsa Família）的营养效果因家庭教育水平而异。
AI.research_question: 巴西家庭对不同食品组的需求如何随收入和受教育程度变化？不同教育水平的家庭在收入增加时获得的营养回报有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解收入和营养摄入之间的关系对设计有效的营养改善政策至关重要，特别是像Bolsa Família这样的收入转移项目。以往研究较少同时考虑食品需求、营养弹性和教育异质性之间的交互效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二次几乎理想需求系统（QUAIDS）；营养含量矩阵映射方法；双重copula样本选择修正；教育和收入交互效应分析。
AI.method: 使用巴西2017-18年家庭预算调查（POF）微观数据，估计QUAIDS模型（含12个食品组加烟草和酒精），通过典型极大似然估计（CMLE）经验性地选择双重copula修正样本选择偏差。提出营养含量矩阵方法，将食品组需求映射到营养素需求以推导营养收入弹性，并引入教育-收入交互效应。
AI.findings: （1）蛋白质是唯一收入弹性大于1的营养素；（2）保护性微量营养素（维生素C、纤维、钙）对收入的响应显著较低；（3）教育梯度呈不对称性：高等教育家庭对蛋白质和锌的收入弹性较低，但对维生素C、纤维和钙的弹性较高；（4）相同收入增量对不同教育水平家庭产生不同的营养回报，暗示收入转移项目的效果随教育水平变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出营养含量矩阵方法，将任意需求系统扩展为营养弹性估计框架，无需单独估计营养素方程系统，为营养经济学提供了新的方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了收入转移政策（如Bolsa Família）的营养效果依赖于家庭的教育水平，指出收入和教育之间可能存在互补性，为设计更有效的营养干预政策提供了实证依据。

title: Crossing the Nuclear Threshold: Systemic Consequences of Hypothetical Nuclear First-Use Against Iran for International Law, Norms, and the Global Political Order

detail.title: Crossing the Nuclear Threshold: Systemic Consequences of Hypothetical Nuclear First-Use Against Iran for International Law, Norms, and the Global Political Order

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any person or organization that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or primary data collection. The analysis relies exclusively on publicly available official statements, news reporting, and published think-tank commentary; no ethics approval was therefore required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or funding from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: For eighty-one years no state has used a nuclear weapon in war. This article asks what would follow if that record were broken not in a great-power exchange but in a counter-proliferation strike against a non-nuclear-weapon state — specifically, against hardened nuclear infrastructure in Iran. It develops three findings. The discrimination paradox: over a specified range, normative damage varies inversely with humanitarian magnitude, because norm reinforcement requires a moral repertoire that a discriminate strike does not supply. The relationship is non-monotonic, peaking at the minimum casualty level consistent with demonstrated utility, which locates the maximally corrosive variant at the hard-target strike rather than at a zero-casualty demonstration. Reclassification: the likely outcome is neither the norm’s death nor its renewal but its amendment into conditional permission, through a four-move sequence each step of which is observable. Institutional displacement: the load-bearing casualty is the safeguards system rather than the Security Council. Using the 2025–26 conventional campaigns as a within-case baseline, the article isolates the nuclear variable’s marginal contribution and states a falsification test against currently reported data. A two-by-two crossing perceived success against discrimination yields the central finding: the modal outcome in actual terms is the least corrosive cell and in perceived terms the most corrosive, and that divergence — sustained by verification collapse — is where the danger lies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如果核武器使用禁令在反扩散打击（针对伊朗硬化核设施）而非大国交战中首次被打破，将会发生什么。文章提出三个发现：歧视悖论（规范性损害与 humanitarian 规模呈非单调关系，在定点打击的硬目标场景中规范性腐蚀最大）、重新分类（核规范最可能的结局既非死亡也非复兴，而是通过四步可观察序列修正为有条件许可）、制度位移（承受冲击的是保障监督体系而非安理会）。作者以2025-26常规战役作为案例内基线，隔离核变量的边际贡献，并提出可证伪检验。核心发现是：实际结果是最不具腐蚀性的单元格，而感知结果是最具腐蚀性的，这种由核查崩溃维持的分离正是危险所在。
AI.research_question: 如果核武器使用禁令在针对无核武器国家的反扩散打击（具体为对伊朗硬化核基础设施的攻击）中被打破，将会产生什么后果？
AI.motivation: 八十一年来没有任何国家在战争中使用核武器，这一记录如何被打破及其后果具有重大理论和政策意义。既有研究多关注大国核交换场景，忽略了反扩散打击这一更可能的场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 核规范理论、规范生命周期理论、歧视性使用与规范强化理论、威慑与反扩散理论。
AI.method: 概念分析+理论推演，采用案例内比较设计（with-in case baseline），以2025-26常规战役为基线隔离核变量的边际贡献，提出可证伪检验，并通过2x2交叉分析（感知成功×歧视程度）得出核心发现。
AI.findings: (1) 歧视悖论：规范损害与humanitarian规模呈非单调关系，最大规范性腐蚀出现在硬目标定点打击（而非零伤亡演示）；(2) 重新分类：核规范将修正为有条件许可，经历四步可观察序列；(3) 制度位移：保障监督体系将承受主要制度冲击而非安理会；(4) 核心发现：实际结果与感知结果之间出现分离——实际是最不腐蚀的单元格，感知是最腐蚀的单元格，这种分离由核查崩溃维持。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了核规范研究中"人道主义规模越大规范损害越大"的线性假设，提出歧视悖论和非单调关系；拓展了规范生命周期理论，提出"修正为有条件许可"这一第三可能结局；将制度分析焦点从安理会转向保障监督体系，揭示了制度位移现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了核规范破裂风险的更精准评估框架；指出核查体系的崩溃而非安理会的失能是主要风险点，对核不扩散体制的维护具有直接针对性；为预测和监测核规范演变提供了可观察的四步序列指标。

title: The Wider Effects of Higher Pension Ages: Evidence on Labor Supply, Welfare Spillovers, and Savings
affiliations: Government of the Kingdom of Denmark - Danish Ministry of Finance, Copenhagen Business School - Department of Economics, Copenhagen Business School and

detail.title: The Wider Effects of Higher Pension Ages: Evidence on Labor Supply, Welfare Spillovers, and Savings
detail.abstract: We study the effects of a six-month increase in Denmark's early, incentivized, and full pension ages using a regression discontinuity design. Over 12 years, we estimate responses in employment, benefit claiming, and savings. The reform increased the average retirement age by 3.3 months, driven by strong labor-supply responses during newly restricted eligibility periods and persistent effects thereafter. Extended employment is accompanied by higher savings, with no evidence of anticipatory adjustment. Responses around early eligibility ages align with financial incentives, whereas those near the full pension age appear norm-driven. Strong labor-supply responses and limited spillovers into alternative benefits generate fiscal gains.

AI.tldr: 本文利用丹麦将早期、激励性和全额养老金领取年龄各延长六个月的改革，采用断点回归设计，追踪12年数据，估计了就业、福利领取和储蓄的反应。改革使平均退休年龄提高3.3个月，主要由新受限资格期内的强劳动力供给反应及之后持续效应驱动。延长就业伴随更高储蓄，未发现预期性调整。早期资格年龄附近的反应与财务激励一致，而全额养老金年龄附近则表现为规范驱动。强劳动力供给反应和有限的替代福利溢出带来财政收益。
AI.research_question: 提高养老金领取年龄（包括早期、激励性和全额养老金年龄各延长六个月）如何影响个体的就业、福利领取和储蓄行为？
AI.motivation: 人口老龄化背景下，各国纷纷推迟养老金领取年龄以缓解财政压力。然而，对于领取年龄调整如何影响个体的跨期行为（包括就业、福利申领和储蓄）缺乏长期和全面的因果证据，尤其是不同养老金年龄类型（早期、激励性、全额）的差异化反应机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 养老金领取年龄改革的劳动供给理论；财务激励与规范驱动的退休行为理论；跨期储蓄与消费的生命周期理论。
AI.method: 回归断点设计（Regression Discontinuity Design），基于丹麦养老金年龄改革（早期、激励性和全额养老金年龄各增加六个月），利用12年面板数据估计就业、福利领取和储蓄的反应。
AI.findings: 1) 改革使平均退休年龄提高3.3个月；2) 反应由新受限资格期内的强劳动力供给响应驱动，并具有持续效应；3) 延长就业伴随更高的储蓄，无预期性调整证据；4) 早期资格年龄附近的反应与财务激励一致，全额养老金年龄附近则表现为规范驱动；5) 强劳动力供给响应和有限的替代福利溢出产生财政收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了不同养老金年龄类型（早期vs全额）背后不同的行为驱动机制——财务激励vs社会规范；揭示了退休年龄改革对储蓄行为的溢出效应及缺乏预期性调整的特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了推迟养老金领取年龄改革效果的长期因果证据，表明此类改革能够有效延长工作年限、增加储蓄并产生财政收益，且替代福利溢出有限，为养老金制度改革提供了参考依据。

title: Multiple Reference and the Reconstruction of Co-Experience: A Generative Relational Account of Recommendation Procedure

detail.title: Multiple Reference and the Reconstruction of Co-Experience: A Generative Relational Account of Recommendation Procedure
detail.abstract: Institutions that select people by reference almost always ask for more than one. This paper takes that requirement seriously and asks what it is for. On the account developed here, the shared experience between a candidate and a referee is not an object that either party holds and one of them writes down. It is generated within their relation, and each account of it is a projection taken from one relational position. Asking for several references is therefore an attempt to reconstruct an object from its presentations, in the way that what identies an attractor is what remains invariant across trajectories. The institution is doing something structurally correct and doing it badly. Four consequences follow for the design of the procedure. What matters among sources is independence of relational position rather than the number of letters. What carries information is what survives across projections rather than their average or their maximum. Symbolic authority accrues to those whose time is scarce, so an eminent referee supplies a thin projection, and weighting by authority is accordingly the least suitable weighting for a reconstruction. And the calibration of individual referees, which no institution maintains, is a precondition for correcting the distortion each introduces. Two failures of procedure are then identied: evaluators collapse onto the single most authoritative account, which discards the reconstruction and returns the decision to one projection; and the candidate, who is one of the two producers of the experience, contributes no account at all. The paper proposes that the candidate's structured account be collected as a required source at the time references are requested. It closes with the injustice that survives every correction it proposes, including a paradox in which contesting an account may destroy the relation that generated the standing to contest it. The paper's central empirical premise, that divergence among sources carries information, is contested in the literature it draws on, and the paper argues for it rather than assuming it.

AI.tldr: 本文从制度设计的角度重新审视推荐信制度，认为推荐信的本质不是"持有并传递"的对象，而是在推荐人与候选人关系中生成的投影。多封推荐信的推荐要求，本质上是通过多个关系性投影来重构一个共同经验对象（类似吸引子从多个轨迹中重建）。文章指出制度在结构上是正确的但执行得很糟糕，并提出四项程序改进，同时识别两类程序失败，最后提出应收集候选人的结构化陈述，并讨论了即使所有修正都无法消除的不公正悖论。
AI.research_question: 为什么推薦制度要求多封推荐信？多封推荐信的制度设计在逻辑上是什么？现行制度在哪些方面失败了，应如何改进？
AI.motivation: 推荐信制度普遍要求多封推荐信，但现有文献很少严肃追问这一要求的功能与逻辑。作者认为这不是一个技术性细节，而是理解整个推荐信制度运作原理的关键入口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系性本体论（推荐信是关系生成的投影而非个体持有的对象）；吸引子理论/重建论（从多个轨迹投影中重建不变性）；权威符号学（符号权威来自时间稀缺性）。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论论证。作者基于关系性本体论和吸引子重建的类比，构建推荐信制度的理论模型，并据此推导设计原则，识别程序失败，提出改进方案。
AI.findings: （1）推荐信的信息价值在于来源关系位置的独立性而非信件数量；（2）携带信息的是跨投影不变的部分而非平均值或最大值；（3）德高望重的推荐人因时间稀缺仅能提供"薄投影"，按权威加权是最不适合的重建方式；（4）推荐人个体校准是纠正偏差的前提但没有任何机构维护。两种程序失败：评估者坍缩到最具权威的单一账户，以及候选人作为经验的生产者之一却不提供任何陈述。作者建议在请求推荐信时同时收集候选人的结构化账户。
AI.theory_contributions: 将推荐信重新概念化为关系性生成的投影而非可传递的对象，引入吸引子重建的隐喻来理解多推荐信制度的结构合理性；识别了权威加权在认识论上的不适用性；揭示了"抗辩悖论"——对该经验记账的质疑可能摧毁产生抗辩资格的关系本身。
AI.practical_contributions: 为推荐信制度设计提供了四项明确改进原则（独立性优先于数量、关注不变性而非统计聚合、避免权威加权、建立推荐人校准机制），并提出了收集候选人结构化陈述的具体制度建议。

title: Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Maximal Extractable Value Allocation under Proposer-Builder Separation
affiliations: , Beihang University (BUAA) and School of Economics and Management, Beihang University

detail.title: Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Maximal Extractable Value Allocation under Proposer-Builder Separation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (No.\ 72271013).

detail.abstract: We develop a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework for analyzing Maximal Extractable Value (MEV) allocation in decentralized exchange (DEX) markets under Proposer-Builder Separation (PBS). The model follows the PBS block-production pipeline from uninformed DEX-user transactions to searcher bundle construction, builder block assembly, proposer block selection, and on-chain execution. Multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MARL) optimizes participant policies in this shared execution environment, and average approximate best-response (ABR) regret quantifies the residual unilateral gains found by a finite evaluation procedure that holds all other agents' policies fixed and retrains one agent at a time. In a two-pool, single-token-pair experimental instantiation, we compare a configuration with two back-running searchers against a mixed configuration with one sandwich searcher and one back-running searcher. This distinction matters because a back-running transaction is appended after observed order flow and does not change the amount of output tokens received by the original uninformed trader, whereas a sandwich attack places searcher transactions around a targeted victim swap and can reduce the amount of output tokens received by that trader. The results show that MEV-related cumulative rewards are allocated differently across these configurations. Searchers convert visible order flow into bundle profits, builders aggregate these bundles through block construction, and builder competition transfers part of the resulting value to the proposer through block bids. Permitting sandwich attacks lowers uninformed traders' cumulative rewards and increases reward asymmetry among searchers.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个多智能体深度强化学习框架，用于分析去中心化交易所市场中在提议者-构建者分离（PBS）机制下的最大可提取价值（MEV）分配问题。模型遵循PBS区块生产流水线，通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）优化参与者策略，并使用平均近似最佳响应（ABR）遗憾度量化残余单边收益。在双池、单代币对的实验设置中，比较了两种配置（两个回跑搜索者vs一个三明治搜索者加一个回跑搜索者），结果显示允许三明治攻击会降低不知情交易者的累积奖励，并加剧搜索者之间的奖励不对称性。
AI.research_question: 在PBS机制下，不同搜索者策略配置（回跑vs三明治攻击）如何影响DEX市场中MEV在各参与者（搜索者、构建者、提议者、不知情交易者）之间的分配？
AI.motivation: MEV在DEX市场中是一个重要问题，而PBS机制作为最近提出的区块生产流程变革，其对各参与者之间MEV分配的影响尚未被充分理解。理解这一分配机制对设计更公平、更高效的区块链市场至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体深度强化学习（MARL）；平均近似最佳响应（ABR）遗憾度；提议者-构建者分离（PBS）机制
AI.method: 构建多智能体深度强化学习框架，模拟PBS区块生产流水线（从DEX用户交易到搜索者构建捆绑包、构建者组装区块、提议者选择区块、链上执行）。在双池、单代币对实验环境中，比较两种搜索者配置下的MEV分配结果。
AI.findings: （1）MEV相关的累积奖励在不同配置下分配方式存在差异；（2）搜索者将可见订单流转化为捆绑利润，构建者通过区块组装聚合这些捆绑包，构建者之间的竞争通过区块出价将部分价值转移给提议者；（3）允许三明治攻击会降低不知情交易者的累积奖励，并加剧搜索者之间的奖励不对称性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将多智能体深度强化学习应用于PBS机制下的MEV分配分析，提供了量化比较不同搜索者策略（回跑vs三明治）对整体生态影响的框架，并引入ABR遗憾度作为评估残余套利空间的指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为PBS机制的设计和优化提供实证依据，帮助理解三明治攻击对不知情交易者的实际损害程度，为DEX市场的监管和协议设计提供参考。

title: Space-Based Data Providers in the EU and U.S.

detail.title: Space-Based Data Providers in the EU and U.S.
detail.abstract: Can the EU Space Act streamline European space licensing without imposing broad new compliance burdens on firms outside Europe? This paper examines the March 2026 Compromise Text and its legal context to answer this question. In this version of the Act, the term "space-based data provider" maps onto no established EU legal category and has a circular definition. The result may not be a full-fledged data regime so much as regulatory uncertainty for foreign firms with respect to proportionality, anticircumvention, and the third-country equivalence provisions applied to regimes such as that of the United States. Uncertainty itself can be a compliance burden and may undercut the streamlining the legislation is meant to deliver. Because the U.S. has no single space regulator capable of granting the reciprocal recognition that the statute demands, a sector-specific agreement may be the only realistic pathway to fulfill this goal. The paper also addresses changes made between the June 2025 draft proposal which treated the cyber provisions as lex specialis, a sector-specific override of the NIS2 Directive, while the March 2026 Compromise Text reversed course and yields without prejudice to the NIS2 regime.

AI.tldr: 本文考察欧盟《太空法案》2026年3月妥协文本，发现"太空数据提供者"这一术语缺乏既有的欧盟法律类别对应，且定义存在循环性，可能导致外国企业面临监管不确定性，从而削弱该法案旨在实现的许可精简目标。由于美国缺乏统一的太空监管机构来授予互惠承认，部门特定协议可能是实现该目标的唯一现实路径。
AI.research_question: 欧盟太空法案能否在不给欧洲以外企业施加广泛新合规负担的前提下，简化欧洲太空许可程序？
AI.motivation: 欧盟太空法案旨在简化欧洲太空许可流程，但2026年3月妥协文本中"太空数据提供者"一词缺乏既有法律类别对应且定义循环，可能对外国企业造成监管不确定性，进而削弱法案的简化目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟法律体系中的法律类别映射、监管确定性理论、互惠承认与第三国等效性条款分析。
AI.method: 法律文本分析（对2026年3月妥协文本与2025年6月草案进行对比），结合欧盟既有法律框架和美国监管体制的比较分析。
AI.findings: 1)"太空数据提供者"无法映射到任何既有的欧盟法律类别，且定义循环；2)外国企业在比例原则、反规避和第三国等效性条款方面面临监管不确定性；3)美国缺乏能够授予法规所要求互惠承认的统一太空监管机构；4)2026年3月妥协文本推翻了2025年6月草案中将网络条款作为NIS2指令特别法（lex specialis）的处理方式，改为不损害NIS2制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了法律术语模糊性（循环定义）如何在跨境监管情境中制造合规负担，挑战了"简化立法自然带来更低合规成本"的假设；补充了欧盟太空治理与既有网络法律框架（NIS2）之间协调的学术讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟立法者指出法案中定义缺陷及其对外国企业的潜在影响；为美国及其他第三国企业识别合规不确定性来源；提出部门特定协议（而非全面等效性认可）作为务实的政策路径建议。

title: The Temporal Fit Evaluation Framework (TFEF): Selecting Evaluation Methods in AI-Native Projects

detail.title: The Temporal Fit Evaluation Framework (TFEF): Selecting Evaluation Methods in AI-Native Projects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: AI-native projects need evaluation, but the methods available for it are not interchangeable across a project's timeline. House's (1980) eight established evaluation approaches, as elaborated for health informatics by Friedman and Wyatt (2006) and summarized for public health AI by Wu (2026), differ in when they can be used: some set their criteria before an outcome exists, others require a system already running in real-world use. This paper proposes the Temporal Fit Evaluation Framework (TFEF), defined by exactly that property-whether a method's criteria can be set before an outcome exists or only once one does-and makes two contributions. First, TFEF sorts House's eight methods by temporal fit: four apply directly to the upfront stage of an AI-native project, before deployment; two contribute as upfront elicitation input; three require the system to be live. Second, it turns that classification into practice-a criteria-based guide for selecting which upfront method, or combination, fits a given project, and a brief illustrative case showing the guide redirect an agentic workflow's design before any code is written, not merely validate a design already chosen. This is a conceptual contribution, not an empirical one: its claims rest on definitional and logical grounds, not new data. We close by noting two further uses of the same upfront artifacts-supporting AI governance review, and, in agentic systems, becoming part of the agent's own operating context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时间适配评估框架（TFEF），根据"评估标准能否在结果出现之前设定"这一属性，对House（1980）的八种评估方法进行分类，将其映射到AI原生项目的时间线（前期、上线前、系统运行后），并提供一套标准化的方法选择指南，帮助在编写代码前评估和引导AI项目设计。
AI.research_question: 如何根据项目时间线选择恰当的AI原生项目评估方法？即：哪些评估方法适用于项目部署前期（outcome尚未产生），哪些必须等到系统上线运行后才能使用？
AI.motivation: AI原生项目需要评估，但现有评估方法并非在项目时间线上可互换使用。House（1980）的八种评估方法在适用时机上存在本质差异——有些在结果出现前就能设定标准，有些则要求系统已在真实环境中运行。缺乏统一框架来区分这些方法的时间适配性，导致实践者难以在项目前期做出正确的评估方法选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: House（1980）的八种评估方法分类体系，经Friedman和Wyatt（2006）扩展至健康信息学领域，并由Wu（2026）总结应用于公共卫生AI。本文在此基础上提出"时间适配"（Temporal Fit）这一核心定义性属性作为分类维度。
AI.method: 概念性/规范性研究：通过定义性（definitional）和逻辑性（logical）论证，对House的八种评估方法按"标准设定时机"进行分类排序，并据此构建实践指南及说明性案例。
AI.findings: （1）四种评估方法直接适用于AI原生项目的部署前期阶段；（2）两种方法可作为前期启发式输入（upfront elicitation input）；（3）三种方法要求系统已上线运行。此外，通过说明性案例证明该指南能在编写任何代码前引导agentic工作流的设计方向，而非仅验证已选定的设计。前期评估工件还可用于AI治理审查以及作为agent自身运行上下文的组成部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出TFEF（时间适配评估框架），以"标准能否在结果存在前设定"这一单一维度统一了House八种评估方法的分类逻辑，为评估方法的时间适用性提供了系统性的理论整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套基于标准的实用指南，帮助AI项目实践者选择适合项目前期阶段的前置评估方法（或方法组合）；通过说明性案例展示该指南可引导agentic工作流在编码前的设计决策；同时指出前期评估工件在AI治理审查和智能体运行上下文方面的扩展用途。

title: EcoTechnoPolitical Citizenship
affiliations: Ikerbasque Foundation UPV/EHU

detail.title: EcoTechnoPolitical Citizenship

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: European Commission, Horizon 2020, H2020-MSCA-COFUND-2020-101034228-WOLFRAM2

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is changing how citizenship is exercised. Decisions about welfare, mobility, work, knowledge and political communication increasingly depend on data and automated systems operating across territorial and legal boundaries. These systems also require energy, water, minerals, labour and land, revealing the physical limits of seemingly immaterial digitalisation. Established accounts of digital citizenship explain rights, participation, inclusion and people's capacity to act through data. They give less attention, however, to ecological costs, ownership of essential infrastructure and consequences that extend across places and generations. This chapter develops EcoTechnoPolitical Citizenship as a framework connecting these concerns. It defines citizenship as the practical capacity to claim digital rights, participate in collective decisions, shape technological infrastructure and accept ecological responsibilities according to each actor's power and contribution. The framework has four dimensions: the physical and ecological basis of digital systems; democratic control over infrastructure; meaningful citizen agency; and responsibility across territories, supply chains and generations. The chapter traces the development of digital citizenship towards automated public life and explains AI economics through data, computing capacity, finance, labour and public dependence. It then examines the digital-green transition, which seeks to align digitalisation with sustainability but often leaves technological growth outside enforceable ecological limits. Practical implications are developed for impact assessment, public digital infrastructure, data commons, territorial oversight, citizen participation and education. Particular attention is paid to unequal power among citizens, governments, firms and communities affected by infrastructure. EcoTechnoPolitical Citizenship ultimately provides an accessible conceptual map for governing AI-dependent societies democratically while respecting planetary limits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生态技术政治公民身份"（EcoTechnoPolitical Citizenship）框架，将数字公民身份的传统关注（权利、参与、包容）与生态成本、基础设施所有权及跨地域跨代际后果相结合，为在尊重地球边界的前提下民主治理AI依赖型社会提供概念地图。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个整合生态维度、基础设施所有权与跨地域跨代际后果的公民身份框架，以理解并治理AI依赖型社会中的数字公民身份？
AI.motivation: 现有数字公民身份理论主要关注权利、参与、包容和数据行动能力，但忽视了三方面问题：（1）数字系统的生态成本（能源、水、矿产、土地等）；（2）关键基础设施的所有权问题；（3）数字化的影响跨越地域和代际边界。随着AI系统在福利、流动、工作、知识和政治沟通等领域的广泛应用，需要新的理论框架来填补这些空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态技术政治公民身份（EcoTechnoPolitical Citizenship）框架：将公民身份定义为根据每个行动者的权力和贡献，主张数字权利、参与集体决策、塑造技术基础设施并承担生态责任的实际能力。框架包含四个维度：（1）数字系统的物理与生态基础；（2）对基础设施的民主控制；（3）有意义的公民能动性；（4）跨地域、供应链和代际的责任。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性分析章节，通过梳理数字公民身份向自动化公共生活的发展历程，分析AI经济学（数据、计算能力、金融、劳动力和公共依赖），并考察数字-绿色转型的局限，最终构建概念框架并提出实践启示。
AI.findings: （1）数字公民身份已从传统权利框架演进至自动化公共生活时代，但现有理论未能充分应对生态和基础设施维度；（2）AI经济学揭示了数据、算力、金融、劳动力和公共依赖的深层结构；（3）数字-绿色转型试图将数字化与可持续性对齐，但往往使技术增长规避于可执行的生态限制之外；（4）公民、政府、企业和受基础设施影响的社区之间存在不平等的权力关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"生态技术政治公民身份"这一整合性概念框架，将数字公民身份理论与生态政治、基础设施治理和跨代际正义相结合，弥补了现有数字公民身份理论在生态维度和基础设施所有权方面的理论空白，为AI治理研究提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为影响评估、公共数字基础设施、数据共享（data commons）、领土监督、公民参与和教育提供实践启示；为政策制定者和治理主体提供一个可及的概念地图，以民主方式治理AI依赖型社会，同时尊重地球生态极限。

title: An empirical study of the stress factors affecting the mental health of Australian construction workers
affiliations: University of New South Wales (UNSW) - University of New South Wales School of Built Environment, University of New South Wales (UNSW) and University of New South Wales (UNSW)

detail.title: An empirical study of the stress factors affecting the mental health of Australian construction workers
detail.abstract: The Australian construction industry records a markedly elevated suicide rate, yet the evidence on its drivers has been predominantly subjective, cross-sectional and descriptive. Drawing on administrative data for the six Australian states and two territories over 2001–2021 (N = 168), this study constructs entropy-weighted TOPSIS indices of three demand-side stressors—work-related, employment and financial stress—and links them to the construction-worker suicide rate within a panel framework. Conditional associations are estimated by two-way fixed effects and tested for robustness; endogeneity is addressed by instrumental-variable estimation using four resource-side constructs, supported by weak-instrument diagnostics, weak-instrument-robust inference and exclusion-restriction sensitivity analysis; functional-form assumptions are relaxed through an instrumental-variable double machine-learning estimator with support-vector nuisance functions (IV-DML-SVM); and the stressors are ranked by Shapley variance decomposition and permutation importance with formal tests of statistical distinguishability. Work-related stress is the foremost and most robust driver: dominated by occupational heat exposure, which a placebo test shows it is specific to construction, and ranked first on every importance criterion applied. Employment and financial stress are positive but secondary, sensitive to specification and mutually indistinguishable, with no stable order between them. The findings convert long-standing impressions about the rank order of construction-industry stressors into triangulated, policy-relevant evidence.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用澳大利亚2001-2021年六个州和两个领地的行政数据（N=168），通过熵权TOPSIS构建三种需求侧压力源（工作相关、就业和财务压力）指数，并将它们与建筑工人自杀率联系起来。研究发现工作相关压力是最主要且最稳健的驱动因素，其中以职业热暴露为主导，且经安慰剂检验证实其对建筑行业具有特异性；就业和财务压力虽然显著但为次要因素。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚建筑行业自杀率显著偏高，其驱动因素究竟是什么？三种需求侧压力源（工作相关、就业和财务压力）对建筑工人自杀率的影响程度和相对重要性如何排序？
AI.motivation: 澳大利亚建筑行业的自杀率显著高于其他行业，但现有关于其驱动因素的证据大多基于主观判断、横截面数据和描述性分析，缺乏基于客观行政数据的大样本纵向实证研究，因此需要更严谨的经验证据来厘清各压力源的相对重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求侧压力源理论框架，将工作相关压力、就业压力和财务压力三类压力源作为自杀率的核心驱动因素进行系统分类和量化检验。
AI.method: 采用熵权TOPSIS方法构建压力指数；双向固定效应面板回归估计条件关联；工具变量估计（使用四个资源侧构念）处理内生性，并辅以弱工具变量诊断、弱工具变量稳健推断和排他性约束敏感性分析；使用工具变量双重机器学习估计量（IV-DML-SVM）放宽函数形式假设；通过Shapley方差分解和排列重要性对压力源排序，并辅以统计可区分性检验；采用安慰剂检验验证热暴露对建筑行业的特异性。
AI.findings: 工作相关压力是建筑工人自杀率最主要的驱动因素，在所有重要性标准下均排名第一且最为稳健；其中职业热暴露是主导因子，安慰剂检验证实其对建筑行业具有特异性。就业压力和财务压力虽然为正向且显著的次要因素，但对模型设定敏感，且两者之间无法统计上区分，没有稳定的排序。
AI.theory_contributions: 将关于建筑行业压力源排序的长期印象转化为经过三角验证的证据，为需求侧压力源与自杀率之间的因果关系提供了更严谨的理论支持，并通过多种稳健性方法强化了因果推断的可信度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建筑行业自杀预防政策提供循证依据，明确了应优先干预工作相关压力（尤其是职业热暴露），为政策制定者在资源分配和干预优先级上提供了具体指导。

title: Forecast, Decision, and Order as Separate Objects: A Contract-Based Evaluation Architecture for Multi-Agent Market Systems

detail.title: Forecast, Decision, and Order as Separate Objects: A Contract-Based Evaluation Architecture for Multi-Agent Market Systems
detail.abstract: Multi-agent market systems often collapse prediction, action selection, and execution into a single agent output, obscuring the provenance and independent evaluation of errors. This study evaluates a contract-based architecture in which Forecast, Decision, and Order are distinct objects with separate lifecycles and evidence boundaries. Forecasts are immutable probability-bearing objects bound to explicit targets, horizons, data cutoffs, strategy/model identifiers, and replay evidence; decision utility and execution are evaluated downstream. The empirical study uses a frozen historical replay. The primary experiment contains hourly BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, and SOLUSDT data from 2024-2025 with a six-hour event target and a 2025H2 out-of-sample test. Relative to equalweight raw aggregation, calibrated weighting reduced Brier loss by 0.01639 for BTC, 0.01357 for ETH, and 0.01208 for SOL; paired 24-hour moving-block bootstrap 95% intervals were entirely below zero for all three comparisons. Additional ablations did not support general superiority for correlation penalties, disagreement shrinkage, regimespecific weighting, shadow cold-start, or a volatility-based decision veto; these negative findings are retained. An independent daily replication on SPY, QQQ, and GLD produced calibration-improvement point estimates in the same direction, but all 95% moving-block bootstrap intervals crossed zero. The evidence supports explicit probabilistic calibration and receipt-backed forecast evaluation in the frozen replay. It does not support claims of trading profitability, production readiness, universal cross-market superiority, causal superiority of the architecture, or autonomous market intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了一种基于合约架构的多智能体市场系统，将预测、决策和订单执行分离为独立对象，通过冻结历史回放实验验证了校准加权方法在加密货币市场上的预测校准改进，但未发现其他消融方法（如相关性惩罚、分歧收缩等）的普遍优势，且不声称交易盈利或生产就绪。
AI.research_question: 在合约化架构下，将预测、决策和执行分离为独立对象，能否通过显式概率校准和收据支持的预测评估来改善多智能体市场系统的预测表现？
AI.motivation: 传统多智能体市场系统将预测、动作选择和执行压缩为单一智能体输出，导致错误来源无法溯源，也难以独立评估各环节的贡献。需要一种能明确分离各环节并独立评估错误的架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合约化架构理论（预测/决策/订单分离），概率校准理论，Brier损失评估框架，移动块自助法（Moving-block Bootstrap）统计检验
AI.method: 采用冻结历史回放（frozen historical replay）的实证研究设计。主实验使用2024-2025年BTCUSDT、ETHUSDT、SOLUSDT的小时级数据，6小时事件目标，2025H2样本外测试。对比等权原始聚合与校准加权方法，采用配对24小时移动块自助法95%区间检验。额外进行SPY、QQQ、GLD的日频复制实验以及多项消融实验。
AI.findings: 校准加权相对于等权原始聚合显著降低了Brier损失（BTC降低0.01639，ETH降低0.01357，SOL降低0.01208），三个比较的95%移动块自助区间完全低于零。但相关性惩罚、分歧收缩、制度加权、影子冷启动、波动性决策否决等消融方法未显示普遍优越性。日频复制实验（SPY/QQQ/GLD）方向一致但置信区间跨越零，不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了合约化架构下显式概率校准和收据支持的预测评估在冻结回放中的有效性；为多智能体系统中预测、决策、执行分离的架构设计提供了实证支持；同时提供了多项消融方法的负面发现，有助于界定架构优势的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了多智能体市场系统的可审计架构参考；给出了校准加权方法在加密货币预测中的具体改进幅度；明确否定了交易盈利能力、生产就绪性、跨市场普遍优越性等不支持的宣称，帮助实践者合理设定预期。

title: The Long-Lasting Effects of Bombing on Environmental Management. Evidence from Kosovo
affiliations: University of Reading

detail.title: The Long-Lasting Effects of Bombing on Environmental Management. Evidence from Kosovo
detail.abstract: This paper studies how wartime destruction shapes the quality of post-conflict reconstruction and local state capacity, focusing on waste management infrastructure in Kosovo. Exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in NATO bombing intensity during the 1999 conflict and the staggered construction of post-war waste landfills, I estimate difference-in-differences and triple-difference models comparing births at varying distances from landfill sites. The results show that children born within 6 km of landfills in heavily bombed municipalities are 3.3–4.6 percentage points more likely to die before their first birthday (approximately 33–46 additional deaths per 1,000 births), corresponding to a 118–164 percent increase relative to the baseline infant mortality rate of 28 per 1,000. Consistent with weakened local oversight and governance capacity, heavily bombed municipalities that host landfills exhibit higher perceived corruption in local government. Together, these findings indicate that conflict-induced institutional degradation can compromise post-conflict infrastructure provision, generating persistent and severe health costs. The paper highlights the political economy of reconstruction as a key channel through which war imposes long-run welfare losses.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1999年科索沃战争中北约轰炸强度的外生差异以及战后垃圾填埋场分阶段建设，通过双重差分和三重差分模型估计，发现轰炸严重的城市中距填埋场6公里内的婴儿死亡率显著上升（增加3.3-4.6个百分点，相对于基线死亡率上升118-164%），且这些地区的地方政府腐败感知更高，揭示冲突导致的制度退化会损害战后基础设施质量并产生持久健康代价。
AI.research_question: 战时破坏如何影响战后重建质量与地方国家能力？具体而言，战争造成的制度退化是否通过损害基础设施供给（如垃圾填埋场）对居民健康产生持久负面影响？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注战争对直接健康和物质资本破坏的影响，但较少探讨战争通过削弱国家能力这一政治经济渠道对战后重建质量和长期福利的间接影响。科索沃战争提供了一个独特情境，可识别冲突导致的地方治理退化对基础设施供给质量的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战争冲突的长期福利成本理论；国家能力与制度质量理论；战后重建的政治经济学（基础设施供给的质量取决于地方监督和治理能力）。
AI.method: 利用1999年北约轰炸强度的外生变异作为处理变量，结合战后垃圾填埋场的分阶段建设（交错处理），采用双重差分（DID）和三重差分（DDD）模型，比较不同距离（6公里以内）填埋场的出生婴儿死亡率差异。
AI.findings: （1）轰炸严重的城市中，距填埋场6公里内的婴儿死亡率增加3.3-4.6个百分点（每千名出生增加33-46例死亡），相对基线婴儿死亡率（28/1000）上升118-164%；（2）轰炸严重且建有填埋场的城市地方政府的腐败感知更高；（3）结果一致表明冲突导致的制度退化损害了战后基础设施供给质量，产生持久健康成本。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将战后重建的政治经济学纳入了战争长期福利成本的因果分析框架；（2）识别出"冲突削弱国家能力→基础设施质量下降→健康损害"这一具体机制链条；（3）证明了制度资本（而非仅物质资本）的破坏是战争持久性代价的重要来源。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为战后重建政策提供预警：在冲突严重地区重建基础设施时需特别关注地方监督和治理能力的恢复；（2）提示国际援助机构应同时投资于制度建设和物理重建，而非仅关注基础设施本身；（3）为战后公共卫生规划提供实证依据，建议在轰炸严重地区的填埋场选址和运营中加强环境监管。

title: The Pre-BOJ Announcement Drift: Evidence from Japanese Equity Indices

detail.title: The Pre-BOJ Announcement Drift: Evidence from Japanese Equity Indices
