detail.abstract: We document a large and robust pre-announcement drift in Japanese equity indices ahead of scheduled Bank of Japan (BOJ) monetary policy decisions: prices drift up steadily in the days before a meeting, peak immediately ahead of the decision, and do not continue afterward, earning an economically large and statistically significant excess return without elevated volatility. The drift is concentrated in meetings preceded by high ex-ante implied volatility. It is the Bank-of-Japan analog of the pre-FOMC drift of Lucca and Moench (2015), with a distinctive Japanese feature-variable announcement timing-that aids identification.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了日本股票指数在日本央行（BOJ）预定货币政策决策前存在显著且稳健的"公告前漂移"现象：价格在会议前几天持续上涨，在决策前达到峰值，之后不再延续，并产生经济规模可观且统计显著的超额收益，且不伴随波动率上升。该漂移集中在事前隐含波动率高的会议期间，是Lucca和Moench（2015）所发现的FOMC前漂移在日本央行的对应版本，并具有独特的日本特征——公告时间可变——有助于识别因果效应。
AI.research_question: 日本股票指数在日本央行预定货币政策决策前是否存在类似美国FOMC前的系统性价格漂移现象？
AI.motivation: Lucca和Moench（2015）发现了美国FOMC前的漂移现象，但该现象在其他央行的普遍性尚未得到验证。日本央行具有独特的公告时间可变特征，为检验这一现象是否具有跨国普遍性以及识别其机制提供了理想的研究场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Lucca和Moench（2015）的FOMC前漂移理论框架，利用日本央行公告时间可变的独特制度特征进行识别。
AI.method: 对日本股票指数在日本央行货币政策会议前的价格走势进行事件研究分析，并利用事前隐含波动率高低分组讨论漂移的集中性。
AI.findings: （1）日本股指在央行会议前几天系统性上涨，决策前达到峰值，会后不再延续；（2）该漂移产生显著正超额收益且不伴随高波动率；（3）漂移集中在事前隐含波动率高的会议；（4）该现象是FOMC前漂移的日本版本，但日本公告时间可变的特征增强了因果识别。
AI.theory_contributions: 将FOMC前漂移的发现从美国扩展到日本央行，证明该现象可能具有跨国普遍性；利用日本公告时间可变的制度特征提供了比美国设定更强的因果识别证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了在日本央行会议前可行的交易策略，即会议前做多股指可获取显著超额收益；也为市场参与者理解央行沟通与资产价格的关系提供了实证依据。

title: Non-economic Attributes and Marriage Matching: An Analysis of China's Hukou Inheritance Reform
affiliations: Zhejiang University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Economics, Jinan University and Zhejiang University

detail.title: Non-economic Attributes and Marriage Matching: An Analysis of China's Hukou Inheritance Reform
detail.abstract: This paper studies how institutional status shapes marital matching under China's hukou system. We exploit a reform allowing children to inherit hukou status from either parent rather than only their mother. Using census data and a triple-difference design, we find that the reform increased rural women's likelihood of marrying an urban-local man by 7.4 percentage points relative to urban women. These effects were stronger in cities with greater availability of urban-local men. To quantify the reform's contribution to marriage distribution, we estimate the Choo and Siow (2006) structural model to conduct counterfactual analyses. Changes in marital gains account for substantial shares of the 1995-2005 changes in marriage rates and hukoubased matching patterns. The reform accounts for 1.79 points (22%) of the decline in rural-local women's marriage rate and 3.51 points (64%) of the rise in rural-nonlocal matching. Overall, the reform reallocated marriage opportunities from locals to nonlocals.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国户籍制度改革（允许子女随父或随母登记户籍）作为自然实验，采用三重差分设计和Choo-Siow结构模型，发现改革使农村女性嫁给城镇本地男性的概率提高了7.4个百分点，并显著改变了婚姻匹配格局，将婚姻机会从本地男性重新分配给非本地男性。
AI.research_question: 制度身份（户籍地位）如何影响中国的婚姻匹配？户籍制度改革如何改变农村女性的婚姻选择和总体婚姻分布？
AI.motivation: 中国户籍制度长期影响社会分层与婚姻匹配，但缺乏因果证据表明制度改革如何改变婚姻市场的结构性匹配。本文利用允许子女随父或随母登记户籍的改革，为制度如何重塑婚姻市场提供因果识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 婚姻匹配理论、制度身份理论、Choo和Siow（2006）转移效用婚姻市场均衡模型
AI.method: 利用人口普查数据，采用三重差分（triple-difference）设计进行因果识别；基于Choo和Siow（2006）的结构模型进行反事实分析，量化改革对婚姻分布的影响。
AI.findings: 改革使农村女性嫁给城镇本地男性的概率相对于城镇女性提高7.4个百分点；该效应在城镇本地男性供给更充足的城市更强。改革解释了1995-2005年农村本地女性婚姻率下降的22%（1.79个百分点）以及农村非本地匹配上升的64%（3.51个百分点）。总体上，改革将婚姻机会从本地男性重新分配给了非本地男性。
AI.theory_contributions: 从理论和实证上揭示制度身份（户籍）在婚姻市场中的因果作用，拓展了婚姻匹配的制度决定因素研究；将结构性婚姻市场模型与准自然实验设计相结合，为制度变迁对婚姻分布的影响提供了深层机制解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为户籍制度改革的社会经济后果提供了婚姻市场维度的证据，有助于理解制度政策如何影响人口流动、性别匹配和社会分层，对户籍政策和社会治理具有政策启示。

title: Scaling Tokenized Markets under Sponsor Governance
affiliations: University of Calgary - Haskayne School of Business, Korea Capital Market Institute (KCMI) and Department of Fintech, SKK Business School, Sungkyunkwan University

detail.title: Scaling Tokenized Markets under Sponsor Governance
detail.abstract: A central policy question for tokenized markets is whether efforts to promote adoption are matched by the organizational capabilities needed to keep shared services operating. Tokenization can improve certification and market depth, yet growth can strain custody, servicing, settlement, and liquidity capacity. We develop a model in which internal resources and precommitted facilities absorb stress before remaining need reaches a sponsor. The sponsor supplies missing resources only when continued operation is worth the cost. At the margin, resilience improves as adoption expands only when the sponsor's credible support limit keeps pace with the residual burden created by scale. Otherwise, network effects can coexist with a fragile high-adoption outcome. For a given adoption level, sponsor support rises with need up to that limit and disappears beyond it, so the largest requests may receive no support. Portability limits losses after withdrawal. When it leaves the sponsor's continuation incentive unchanged, private investment can be too low if platforms capture only part of users' continuity benefit. No general ranking follows when portability weakens the sponsor's incentive to continue. In the bank application, intermediate stress can shift losses to depositors before larger shocks induce withdrawal. The framework identifies policy targets and trade-offs rather than a single optimal instrument mix. It suggests assessing subsidies, sandboxes, and common standards together with internal capacity, ring-fenced resources, recovery arrangements, clear limits on sponsor support, and portable core services.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个理论模型，研究代币化市场中采纳扩张与组织韧性能力之间的匹配问题。模型区分了内部资源、预先承诺设施与发起人支持三层缓冲机制，揭示了网络效应与脆弱高采纳结果可以共存的边界条件，并识别了政策目标与政策权衡。
AI.research_question: 代币化市场在采纳扩张过程中，赞助方（sponsor）的组织支持能力如何影响系统的韧性与稳定性？何种条件下扩张会带来脆弱性而非韧性提升？
AI.motivation: 代币化能改善认证与市场深度，但增长可能给托管、服务、结算和流动性能力带来压力。政策制定者需要理解采纳推广努力是否与组织能力相匹配，以避免系统脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资源缓冲与退出承诺的理论框架：内部资源和预先承诺设施吸收压力；发起人在运营值得成本时才提供缺失资源；引入了发起人可信支持上限（credible support limit）和可移植性（portability）概念。
AI.method: 理论建模/分析性模型（analytical modeling）
AI.findings: （1）当赞助方的可信支持上限与规模带来的残余负担同步增长时，韧性随采纳扩张而改善；否则网络效应与脆弱高采纳结果可共存。（2）赞助方支持随需求上升至上限，超出后消失，最大请求可能得不到支持。（3）可移植性限制退出后的损失。（4）当可移植性不改变发起人继续激励时，若平台仅捕获部分连续性收益，私人投资可能过低。（5）银行应用中，中等压力可将损失转嫁给存款人，更大冲击才引发撤资。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了赞助方支持上限与残余负担匹配条件的理论，解释了网络效应与脆弱性共存的条件，刻画了赞助支持的非单调特征（先升至上限然后消失），并分析了可移植性对继续激励与私人投资水平的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了政策目标与权衡框架，建议将补贴、监管沙盒和共同标准与内部能力、圈定资源、恢复安排、赞助支持明确上限及可移植核心服务结合起来评估，而非依赖单一最优政策组合。

title: Does QDMTT Neutralize Section 10AA? A Simulation of Pillar Two, India SEZ and Belgium Holding

detail.title: Does QDMTT Neutralize Section 10AA? A Simulation of Pillar Two, India SEZ and Belgium Holding

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable - Theoretical simulation using public tax rules, no human subjects data.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding. Self-funded independent research.

detail.abstract: The OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework's Pillar Two rules impose a 15% global minimum effective tax rate (ETR) on large multinational enterprise (MNE) groups. A central open question for practitioners and policymakers is whether income-based tax incentives-such as India's Special Economic Zone (SEZ) profit-linked deduction under Section 10AA of the Income-tax Act-retain any economic value once a host or intermediary jurisdiction introduces a Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax (QDMTT). This paper develops an illustrative, transaction-level simulation of a stylised US-parented, Belgium-holding, Indiaoperating MNE structure to quantify how a prospective Indian QDMTT would interact with the Substance-Based Income Exclusion (SBIE) and with Belgium's own minimum-tax exposure. As of Union Budget 2025-26 (February 2025), India had not legislated a QDMTT, IIR or UTPR (EY India, 2024); the analysis is therefore explicitly forward-looking rather than a description of enacted law. The simulation suggests that a fully income-based incentive such as Section 10AA would retain only 10-15% of its nominal value under a prospective QDMTT once excess profit is taxed up to 15%, while the SBIE preserves a smaller, substance-linked benefit. The paper closes with a research design for a difference-indifferences extension using Prowess and Orbis firm-level data, intended as the empirical core of a doctoral dissertation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过交易层面的模拟分析，研究了OECD/G20全球最低税（Pillar Two）规则下，印度特别经济区（SEZ）的收入型税收激励（第10AA条款）在潜在QDMTT实施后的经济价值留存问题。模拟表明，完全基于收入的激励在QDMTT下仅保留约10-15%的名义价值，而基于实质的SBIE豁免则保留了较小的、与实质活动相关的利益。
AI.research_question: 一旦东道国（印度）或中介辖区（比利时）引入合格国内最低补足税（QDMTT），基于收入的税收激励（如印度第10AA条款的SEZ利润挂钩扣除）是否仍保留经济价值？其价值保留程度如何？
AI.motivation: OECD/G20包容性框架的Pillar Two规则对大型跨国企业集团征收15%的全球最低有效税率，这引发了关于收入型税收激励是否还有价值的核心开放问题。印度尚未立法QDMTT、IIR或UTPR，但该问题对政策制定者和从业者具有重要的前瞻性意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: Pillar Two全球最低税框架、合格国内最低补足税（QDMTT）、基于实质的收入排除（SBIE）、收入型税收激励的经济价值理论。
AI.method: 交易层面的说明性模拟（transaction-level simulation），构建一个由美国母公司、比利时控股公司、印度运营公司组成的典型跨国企业结构，量化潜在印度QDMTT与SBIE及比利时最低税敞口的相互作用，并设计双重差分（difference-in-differences）实证扩展方案。
AI.findings: 完全基于收入的激励（如第10AA条款）在潜在QDMTT下仅保留其名义价值的10-15%，而SBIE保留了较小的、与实质活动相关的利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 为Pillar Two规则下收入型税收激励的价值衰减提供了量化分析框架，揭示了QDMTT与SBIE对传统税收激励工具的侵蚀效应，丰富了全球最低税制对发展中国家税收激励政策有效性的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国企业税务规划提供前瞻性参考，帮助政策制定者理解QDMTT对现有税收激励政策的冲击程度，并为印度等发展中国家设计未来的税收激励政策提供数据支撑。

title: Climate-Resilient Retail Lending: A Framework for Integrating Climate Risk, Sustainable Banking, and Financial Innovation

detail.title: Climate-Resilient Retail Lending: A Framework for Integrating Climate Risk, Sustainable Banking, and Financial Innovation
detail.abstract:
Climate-related financial risks are becoming increasingly material to banking institutions, with growing evidence suggesting that physical climate hazards and transition-related economic adjustments can influence borrower resilience, collateral quality, and mortgage lending outcomes. While substantial progress has been made in climate-risk measurement, sustainable finance, and banking regulation, comparatively limited attention has been devoted to understanding how climate-risk insights can be translated into retail lending practices and lending-product design.

This study addresses this gap by investigating the relationship between climate-related risks and mortgage lending outcomes and by examining how climate-risk information can be systematically incorporated into retail lending practices to enhance banking resilience while supporting climate adaptation and the transition towards a low-carbon and climate-resilient economy. The research develops a climate-resilient retail lending framework that links climate-risk exposure, mortgage lending outcomes, and climate-responsive lending design.

The study adopts a sequential mixed-methods approach combining theoretical synthesis, quantitative analysis, and expert validation. The empirical component focuses on the U.S. mortgage market and utilizes publicly available mortgage, banking, climate, and socioeconomic datasets to examine whether climate-risk indicators provide explanatory value beyond conventional credit-risk determinants. Findings are subsequently translated into framework development and refined through engagement with banking practitioners, credit-risk specialists, climate-risk experts, and sustainable-finance professionals.

The research contributes to climate finance and sustainable banking literature by advancing a product-level perspective on climate-risk integration. It further seeks to provide empirical evidence on the influence of climate-related risks on mortgage lending outcomes and to develop an evidence-based framework through which financial institutions can incorporate climate-related considerations into retail lending practices. In doing so, the study aims to demonstrate how retail lending can contribute simultaneously to banking resilience, climate adaptation, and the transition towards a low-carbon and climate-resilient economy.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨气候相关风险与抵押贷款结果之间的关系，开发了一个气候韧性零售贷款框架，采用混合方法（理论综合、定量分析、专家验证），以美国抵押贷款市场为实证对象，证明气候风险指标超越传统信用风险决定因素的解释价值，并为金融机构将气候因素纳入零售贷款实践提供了循证框架。
AI.research_question: 气候相关风险如何影响抵押贷款结果？气候风险信息如何被系统性地纳入零售贷款实践以增强银行韧性、支持气候适应和低碳转型？
AI.motivation: 气候相关金融风险对银行机构日益重要，但在气候风险测量、可持续金融和银行监管方面已有进展，相比之下，关于如何将气候风险洞察转化为零售贷款实践和贷款产品设计的关注有限，存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候韧性零售贷款框架，该框架将气候风险暴露、抵押贷款结果和气候响应型贷款设计联系起来。
AI.method: 顺序混合方法：理论综合、定量分析（使用美国抵押贷款市场公开的抵押贷款、银行、气候和社会经济数据集，检验气候风险指标是否在传统信用风险决定因素之外提供额外解释价值）、专家验证（与银行从业者、信用风险专家、气候风险专家和可持续金融专业人士互动）。
AI.findings: 气候风险指标在传统信用风险决定因素之外提供额外的解释价值；研究结果被转化为框架开发，并通过从业者参与得到完善。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了气候金融和可持续银行文献，通过引入产品层面的气候风险整合视角；提供了气候相关风险对抵押贷款结果影响的实证证据；建立了将气候考量纳入零售贷款实践的循证框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了将气候相关考量纳入零售贷款实践的循证框架，展示零售贷款如何同时促进银行韧性、气候适应以及向低碳和气候韧性经济的转型。

title: A Strain-Resolved Genome Resource Defines Conserved Infant Gut Microbiome Assembly across Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia
affiliations: Wellcome Sanger Institute, Wellcome Sanger Institute, Wellcome Sanger Institute, Wellcome Sanger Institute, Wellcome Sanger Institute, Wellcome Sanger Institute, Wellcome Sanger Institute, Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI) - Kemri-Wellcome Trust Research Programme, Wellcome Sanger Institute, Wellcome Sanger Institute, Wellcome Sanger Institute, Wellcome Sanger Institute, Université Joseph Ki-Zerbo, Nutrition and Clinical Services Division (NCSD), Makerere University, Aga Khan University, Aga Khan University, Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital, , Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI) - Kemri-Wellcome Trust Research Programme, Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI) - Kemri-Wellcome Trust Research Programme, Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI), University of Toronto - The Hospital for Sick Children - SickKids, Amsterdam Institute for Global Health and Development, Nutrition and Clinical Services Division (NCSD), Wellcome Sanger Institute, University of Washington, Johns Hopkins University, Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI) - Kemri-Wellcome Trust Research Programme and Wellcome Sanger Institute

detail.title: A Strain-Resolved Genome Resource Defines Conserved Infant Gut Microbiome Assembly across Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia
detail.abstract: Infant gut microbiome assembly shapes growth, immunity, and neurodevelopment, yet almost all high-resolution metagenomic data derive from high-income cohorts. We assembled a deep shotgun metagenomic reference from 596 generally healthy children aged 2–23 months across nine sites in six low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) in sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. From ~5.7 Tbp we reconstructed 7,683 high-quality genomes spanning 1,941 species, including 220 uncultured and five novel core species, with strain-resolved functional annotations and harmonized metadata. Assembly followed a conserved three-stage trajectory (pioneer, transition, expansion) governed by breastfeeding and weaning and reproducible across all nine sites, and potentially host-beneficial functions were maintained despite taxonomic turnover. Against age-matched high-income cohorts, LMIC microbiomes diverged from the first months of life and carried higher species richness, with Bifidobacterium (notably B. infantis), Lactobacillus, and Prevotella depleted in high-income infants. This open-access reference anchors future LMIC cohorts and supports globally inclusive infant microbiome research.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个来自六个中低收入国家（LMICs）596名健康婴儿的深度宏基因组参考数据集，从约5.7 Tbp测序数据中重建了7,683个高质量基因组，涵盖1,941个物种（含220个未培养和5个新核心物种）。研究发现婴儿肠道菌群的组装遵循保守的三阶段轨迹（先锋、过渡、扩张），由母乳喂养和断奶驱动，且与高收入国家婴儿相比，LMIC婴儿的菌群从生命最初几个月即出现分化，物种丰富度更高。
AI.research_question: 中低收入国家婴儿肠道菌群的组装动态如何？与高收入国家婴儿相比有何差异？
AI.motivation: 婴儿肠道菌群的组装对生长、免疫和神经发育至关重要，但几乎所有高分辨率宏基因组数据都来自高收入队列，缺乏来自中低收入国家的全球代表性数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 婴儿肠道菌群组装的三阶段轨迹理论（先锋、过渡、扩张阶段），受母乳喂养和断奶等生态因素驱动。
AI.method: 对来自6个国家9个地点的596名2-23月龄健康婴儿进行深度鸟枪法宏基因组测序（约5.7 Tbp），重建高质量基因组并进行菌株分辨的功能注释和协调元数据分析，同时与年龄匹配的高收入队列进行对比。
AI.findings: （1）重建了7,683个高质量基因组，涵盖1,941个物种，包括220个未培养和5个新核心物种；（2）菌群组装遵循保守的三阶段轨迹（先锋、过渡、扩张），由母乳喂养和断奶驱动，在9个地点均可复现；（3）潜在有益宿主功能在物种更替中得以维持；（4）与高收入婴儿相比，LMIC婴儿菌群从生命早期即出现分化，物种丰富度更高，双歧杆菌（尤其是婴儿双歧杆菌）、乳杆菌和普雷沃氏菌在高收入婴儿中更为贫乏。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了婴儿肠道菌群组装的跨区域保守轨迹，证明了菌群功能在不同物种组合下的维持机制，拓展了婴儿菌群组装研究的地理和人口覆盖范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个开放获取的宏基因组参考数据集，可作为未来LMIC队列研究的锚点，支持全球包容性的婴儿微生物组研究，有助于理解不同社会经济背景下婴儿菌群发育的差异及其健康意义。

title: One Market or Many? Property-Type Heterogeneity in Regional Real Estate Price Convergence Dynamics in China
affiliations: University of Nottingham, Ningbo - University of Nottingham Ningbo China and University of Nottingham, Ningbo - University of Nottingham Ningbo China

detail.title: One Market or Many? Property-Type Heterogeneity in Regional Real Estate Price Convergence Dynamics in China
detail.abstract: This study investigates regional real estate price convergence and club formation in China using disaggregated price data for different property types across 30 major cities. We make three key contributions. First, we utilize disaggregated prices rather than aggregate price indexes, enabling a more precise assessment of market integration. Second, we test whether commercial and residential properties follow different convergence paths, whether newly-constructed and second-hand housing exhibit distinct adjustment dynamics, and whether COVID-19 had asymmetric effects across property types. Third, we analyze the determinants of club convergence using socio-economic and property-specific variables. Our results reveal significant heterogeneity across all three dimensions. Commercial property markets display strong integration across cities, whereas residential markets remain highly fragmented, forming up to four distinct convergence clubs. Newly-constructed housing becomes more integrated over time, while second-hand housing becomes more fragmented. COVID-19 had asymmetric effects, fragmenting office markets while affecting residential markets differently across segments. Regression analysis reveals that rent, construction area, air quality, and economic development play important roles in explaining price convergence across cities. Our findings suggest that policies targeting market integration must be property-type specific, as commercial and residential markets respond differently to shocks and policy interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用中国30个主要城市不同物业类型的细分价格数据，考察区域房地产价格收敛与俱乐部形成。研究发现商业地产市场呈强一体化趋势，而住宅市场高度碎片化，形成多达四个不同的收敛俱乐部。新建住房随时间趋于一体化，二手住房则更加碎片化。COVID-19对不同物业类型产生不对称影响。政策制定需针对物业类型采取差异化措施。
AI.research_question: 中国不同物业类型的房地产价格在区域间是否存在收敛？不同物业类型（商业vs住宅、新建vs二手）的收敛路径有何差异？COVID-19是否对不同物业类型产生不对称影响？哪些社会经济和物业特定因素决定了俱乐部收敛？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多使用加总价格指数考察房地产市场一体化，无法充分捕捉不同物业类型间的异质性。本研究利用细分价格数据，更精确地评估市场整合程度，并考察商业与住宅、新建与二手住房、以及COVID-19冲击对不同物业类型的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价格收敛理论（price convergence）与俱乐部趋同（club convergence）理论框架，借鉴Phillips and Sul（2007）的log t收敛检验方法，考察不同城市间房地产价格收敛俱乐部形成机制。
AI.method: 采用Phillips and Sul（2007）提出的log t俱乐部收敛检验方法（PS方法），使用中国30个主要城市的细分物业类型价格数据，进行聚类分析和收敛俱乐部识别，并运用回归分析检验社会经济与物业特定变量对俱乐部收敛的影响。
AI.findings: （1）商业地产市场在城市间呈强一体化，而住宅市场高度碎片化，形成多达四个不同收敛俱乐部；（2）新建住房随时间变得更加一体化，二手住房则变得更加碎片化；（3）COVID-19产生不对称效应，使写字楼市场碎片化，同时住宅市场不同细分领域受不同影响；（4）租金、建筑面积、空气质量和经济发展水平是解释城市间价格收敛的重要因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用细分价格数据系统考察中国不同物业类型的房地产市场一体化差异，拓展了俱乐部收敛理论在房地产领域的应用，揭示了商业与住宅市场在收敛机制上的本质差异，并识别了COVID-19冲击对市场一体化的不对称影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供差异化政策建议：市场整合政策必须针对物业类型定制，因为商业与住宅市场对冲击和政策干预的响应不同；为投资者识别不同物业类型的跨区域套利机会提供参考；为理解疫情冲击对不同房地产细分市场的影响提供实证依据。

title:
Severing the Fintech App 
The Financial Services Exclusion, the Collapsing Safe Harbour, and Unilateral Modification under the Digital Content Directive

detail.title:
Severing the Fintech App 
The Financial Services Exclusion, the Collapsing Safe Harbour, and Unilateral Modification under the Digital Content Directive
detail.abstract: Article 19 of Directive 2019/770 entitles consumers to terminate free of charge where a trader unilaterally modifies a digital service to their detriment. The Court of Justice has not interpreted it. This article asks whether it reaches the applications through which European consumers increasingly manage their money. The obstacle is Article 3(5)(e), which excludes contracts "regarding" financial services. Three arguments are advanced. First, the exclusion operates on contractual elements rather than whole contracts: a contract-level reading would deprive Article 3(6) of any operation in respect of service bundles, since Article 3(5)(a) would exclude every contract to which the bundle rule was addressed. Second, the objection from fragmentation is answered by Article 3(7), which secures the precedence of sectoral instruments. Third, the trader's safe harbour in Article 19(4) is unavailable in the financial sector, because a retained unmodified version cannot satisfy the security dimension of objective conformity under Article 8(1)(b) while operational resilience obligations bind the provider. The article then tests the justification offered for the exclusion. Article 22 of the new Payment Services Regulation carries over the deemed-consent mechanism of Article 54 PSD2 without a valid-reason requirement, a noadditional-cost requirement, or any materiality threshold. The Council's negotiating mandate contained an express Member State power to restrict unilateral changes absent a justified reason; it did not survive the trilogue, and because the successor instrument is a regulation the gap can no longer be filled nationally.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨欧盟《数字内容与数字服务指令》（2019/770）第19条消费者免费终止权是否适用于金融科技应用（如支付、银行类App）。作者论证金融服务排除条款（第3(5)(e)条）不应阻止该保护机制适用于混业数字服务，并提出三项法律论证与一项政策批判。
AI.research_question: 欧盟2019/770号指令第19条（消费者对单方面不利修改的免费终止权）是否适用于金融类应用程序？第3(5)(e)条的金融服务排除条款应如何解释？
AI.motivation: 欧洲消费者越来越多地通过应用程序管理资金，但欧盟法院尚未对第19条作出解释。金融服务的合同排除条款可能使大量消费者失去数字服务指令赋予的终止权保护，且新《支付服务条例》（PSR）的"视为同意"机制缺乏实质保护门槛，形成监管缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟消费者保护法体系，具体包括：（1）2019/770数字内容与数字服务指令（DCD）第3条适用范围规则、第19条终止权、第8条客观符合性要求；（2）《支付服务指令2》（PSD2）第54条及新《支付服务条例》（PSR）第22条的视为同意机制；（3）欧洲立法中"行业工具优先"原则（第3(7)条）。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（doctrinal legal analysis）：对指令条款进行文义与体系解释，结合立法史（理事会谈判授权、三边谈判进程）和欧盟立法结构进行论证。
AI.findings: （1）排除条款应基于合同要素而非整个合同解释；否则第3(6)条捆绑规则将失效。（2）碎片化反对意见可由第3(7)条行业工具优先原则回应。（3）第19(4)条经营者安全港在金融领域不可用，因保留未修改版本无法满足第8(1)(b)条客观符合性的安全维度。（4）新支付服务条例第22条延续了PSD2第54条的视为同意机制，但无有效理由要求、无额外成本要求、无实质性门槛；理事会的成员国限制权在trilogue中被删除，因新工具为条例而无法由国家层面填补缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）为DCD第3(5)(e)条排除条款提供了一种"合同要素而非整合同"的解释框架，解决捆绑服务中的适用难题；（2）论证了金融领域的运营韧性义务如何使第19(4)条安全港失效，将数字服务指令的"客观符合性"概念与金融监管的"运营韧性"要求相衔接；（3）揭示了立法层级选择（条例vs指令）对成员国填补消费者保护缺口能力的结构性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为欧洲金融科技App用户在遭遇单方面不利修改时主张终止权提供法律依据；（2）为欧盟立法者、成员国监管机构识别支付服务条例中的消费者保护缺口提供分析工具；（3）为数字服务指令在金融科技领域的适用提供司法解释路径建议。

title: Audit Committees and Corporate Governance under Islamic Law: Perspectives from Libya's Banking Sector
affiliations: Misurata University

detail.title: Audit Committees and Corporate Governance under Islamic Law: Perspectives from Libya's Banking Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was approved by the Ethics Committee of Misurata University (Approval No. 55857). Informed consent was obtained from all individual participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors,

detail.abstract: This paper presents a distinct examination of the impact of applying Islamic law on the effectiveness of corporate governance (CG) and audit committees (ACs) in the Libyan banking sector, to identify actions to enhance their effectiveness. A qualitative method was employed through face-to-face interviews, involving four groups of actors in the Libyan banking sector: board members, audit committee (AC) members, executive managers, and internal auditing directors. The findings indicate that applying Islamic law in the Libyan banking sector is beneficial; however, several participants noted that CG and ACs could face obstacles, and the rapid shift to Islamic law is likely to affect practice in several Libyan banks because of the weak banking environment. Our evidence highlights the pressing need for boards, AC members, and regulators, particularly the Central Bank of Libya, to pay more attention to enhancing the effectiveness of ACs and CG in the Libyan banking sector. The paper is one of a kind, examining the impact of Sharia law enforcement on CG and AC practices within Libyan banks newly embracing Islamic finance; this is a pressing issue in Libya because the Islamic financial system takes a different approach to CG from traditional financial systems, and due to the speed at which the shift to Islamic banking is occurring in Libya.

AI.tldr: 本文采用定性访谈方法，考察了在利比亚银行业实施伊斯兰法（沙里亚法）对公司治理和审计委员会有效性的影响，发现伊斯兰法的应用虽有裨益，但由于薄弱的银行业环境，快速转向伊斯兰法可能带来诸多障碍，亟需董事会、审计委员会成员及利比亚中央银行等监管机构关注并提升其有效性。
AI.research_question: 应用伊斯兰法（沙里亚法）如何影响利比亚银行业公司治理和审计委员会的有效性？应采取哪些行动来增强其有效性？
AI.motivation: 利比亚正在快速向伊斯兰金融体系转型，而伊斯兰金融系统在公司治理方面与传统金融系统存在根本差异；然而现有研究缺乏对沙里亚法执行如何影响利比亚银行公司治理和审计委员会实践的深入考察，这是一个紧迫且未被充分研究的议题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论；审计委员会有效性理论；伊斯兰金融与沙里亚法治理框架
AI.method: 定性研究方法，通过面对面访谈收集数据，访谈对象涵盖利比亚银行业四类参与者：董事会成员、审计委员会成员、执行管理层和内部审计主管。
AI.findings: （1）在利比亚银行业应用伊斯兰法具有积极效益；（2）但部分受访者指出公司治理和审计委员会可能面临障碍；（3）由于银行业环境薄弱，快速转向伊斯兰法可能对多家利比亚银行的实际运作产生负面影响；（4）董事会、审计委员会成员及监管机构（尤其是利比亚中央银行）亟需更加关注提升审计委员会和公司治理的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文是首个考察沙里亚法执行对利比亚新兴伊斯兰银行公司治理和审计委员会实践影响的研究，填补了伊斯兰金融背景下公司治理与审计委员会有效性研究领域的空白，为理解伊斯兰法与传统公司治理框架的相互作用提供了理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为利比亚银行业董事会、审计委员会成员、监管机构（特别是中央银行）提供了增强公司治理和审计委员会有效性的具体行动方向；为利比亚伊斯兰金融转型过程中的政策制定和实施提供了实证依据和实践指导。

title: Artificial Intelligence, Household Production, and the Allocation of Time
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics, Tsinghua University - Institute of Economics, Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of International Trade and Economics and

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Household Production, and the Allocation of Time
detail.abstract: Does more affordable artificial intelligence (AI) reduce the time households devote to home production? Not necessarily. We develop a static general-equilibrium model in which households and competitive final-good firms purchase a common AI service from an upstream supplier. The supplier's fixed markup is the exogenous ratio of the AI-service price to short-run marginal cost; it distributes operating surplus, including capacity quasi-rents, to households as dividends. At fixed home output, greater affordability induces substitution of AI for household effort. Holding full income in time units fixed, it also lowers the unit cost of the home-input composite relative to the wage and expands desired output. Home-production time then falls exactly when the substitution elasticity between AI and household effort exceeds one. Changes in the dividendto-wage ratio add a third margin and can overturn this condition in equilibrium. The aggregate equilibrium is unique and recursively determined by one scalar equation in the wage-to-AIprice ratio. Higher upstream AI productivity raises affordability, aggregate AI use, and welfare. Greater final-sector AI bias raises aggregate use but lowers household affordability, and its welfare effect is ambiguous. A larger fixed markup lowers affordability and aggregate use. At short-run marginal-cost pricing, a markup increase has no first-order welfare effect; once the price exceeds short-run marginal cost, a further increase strictly lowers welfare despite the dividend distribution. Thus the sign of a marginal change in aggregate AI use alone does not determine the associated changes in household AI use or home-production time.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个静态一般均衡模型，研究AI可负担性对家庭生产时间的影响。研究发现，更可负担的AI并不必然减少家庭生产时间，只有当家庭努力与AI之间的替代弹性大于1时，家庭生产时间才会下降。均衡由工资-AI价格比的一个标量方程唯一递归决定，上游AI生产率提高、最终部门AI偏向程度和固定加价的变化都会产生不同的福利和配置效应。
AI.research_question: 更可负担的人工智能（AI）是否减少家庭用于家庭生产的时间？其经济学条件和均衡效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 直觉上AI变得更便宜似乎应减少家庭生产时间，但作者认为答案"不一定"。需要一个一般均衡框架来严谨分析AI可负担性与家庭生产时间之间的复杂关系，特别是考虑上游供应商加价和股息分配机制后的均衡效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 静态一般均衡模型；家庭与最终品企业共同从上游供应商购买AI服务；固定加价定价（价格对短期边际成本的比率外生）；家庭效用与全收入约束；替代弹性分析。
AI.method: 构建静态一般均衡模型，包含家庭部门、竞争性最终品企业和具有固定加价的上游AI供应商。通过均衡条件推导出工资-AI价格比的单一标量方程，分析不同参数（替代弹性、股息-工资比、上游生产率、最终部门AI偏向、固定加价）变化对家庭生产时间、AI使用量和福利的影响。
AI.findings: （1）在固定家庭产出下，AI可负担性提高促使AI替代家庭努力；但家庭生产时间下降的充分条件是家庭努力与AI的替代弹性大于1。（2）股息-工资比变化构成第三个边际渠道，可在均衡中推翻上述条件。（3）均衡唯一且由工资-AI价格比的单一标量方程递归决定。（4）上游AI生产率提高提升可负担性、总AI使用量和福利。（5）最终部门AI偏向提高总AI使用量但降低家庭可负担性，福利效应模糊。（6）固定加价扩大降低可负担性和总使用量；在短期边际成本定价下加价增加无一级福利效应，一旦价格超过短期边际成本，进一步加价严格降低福利。（7）总AI使用量的边际变化符号不能单独决定家庭AI使用量或家庭生产时间的变化方向。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将AI服务定价（上游固定加价）内嵌于一般均衡框架，揭示股息分配的第三个边际渠道对家庭生产时间决定的影响。（2）证明AI可负担性与家庭生产时间的关系取决于替代弹性是否大于1这一精确条件，纠正了"AI更便宜必然减少家务时间"的直觉。（3）揭示总AI使用量与家庭AI使用量/家庭生产时间之间可能脱节，说明宏观AI指标不能直接推断家庭层面的福利和劳动配置效应。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供关于AI定价（加价政策）与家庭福利关系的明确指引：加价超过短期边际成本后进一步提价将严格降低福利。（2）提醒关注AI可负担性提升对不同家庭活动（生产与服务）影响的异质性，避免仅以总AI使用量作为政策评估指标。（3）有助于理解AI供应链市场结构（上游垄断加价）对家庭时间配置和福利的传导机制。

title: Interpersonally Comparable Utility
affiliations: and Sustaining Engineering Group

detail.title: Interpersonally Comparable Utility
detail.abstract: We develop a theory of measurement scales for utility functions, based on a generalization of the notion of numeraire commodity. Every sufficiently wellbehaved utility is denominated in some scale of this form, and conversely, the choice of a compatible scale unit uniquely identifies utilities up to an additive constant. We define a profile of utilities to be interpersonally comparable precisely when they are denominated in a common measurement unit. We study when profiles of comparable utilities exist, as well as how a planner ought to aggregate them, and provide applications to social choice and welfare economics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于"计价商品"（numeraire commodity）概念泛化的效用函数测量尺度理论。每个充分良好的效用都可以用某种尺度来衡量，而兼容尺度单位的选择能唯一地将效用确定到加法常数。作者定义了人际可比较的效用概况，并研究了可比效用概况的存在条件及规划者应如何聚合它们，最后应用于社会选择与福利经济学。
AI.research_question: 如何为效用函数建立一种测量尺度理论，并在此框架下定义和实现人际效用可比性？规划者应如何聚合可比效用？
AI.motivation: 传统的效用测量与人际比较缺乏严格的理论基础，人际效用可比性问题长期困扰福利经济学和社会选择理论。本文试图通过泛化"计价商品"的概念，为效用测量和人际比较提供一个统一且严谨的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以计价商品（numeraire commodity）概念泛化为核心的测量尺度理论；效用函数测量尺度（measurement scales for utility functions）理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与公理化分析：通过定义测量尺度类型、兼容尺度单位与加法常数的关系来刻画效用；在此基础上定义人际可比较的效用概况，并研究其存在性与聚合方法。
AI.findings: （1）每个充分良好的效用都可以用一种测量尺度来计价；（2）选择兼容的尺度单位能将效用唯一确定到加法常数；（3）人际可比较的效用概况被精确定义为使用共同测量单位计价的效用集合；（4）研究了可比效用概况的存在条件以及规划者聚合它们的方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 为效用测量提供了严格的数学理论基础；将人际效用可比性从模糊的概念转化为可精确检验的形式化条件；为福利经济学和社会选择理论提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策决策中的福利比较与效用聚合提供了方法论指导，帮助规划者在存在人际可比性时做出更为合理的社会选择。

title: The Treasury Signal That Lasted One Session

detail.title: The Treasury Signal That Lasted One Session
detail.abstract: On 19 August 2026, the U.S. Treasury announced an off-cycle expansion of its long-end buyback programme, increasing the per-operation maximum from $2 billion to at least $4 billion. Because seven scheduled operations fall within the affected maturity sectors from 9 September onward, the change represents at least $14 billion of incremental capacity. This paper examines whether the measure constitutes quantitative easing and evaluates its implications for Treasury liquidity support, long-end supply, and market conditions. The analysis finds that the operation is not quantitative easing on statutory, mechanical, or institutional grounds: Treasury and the Federal Reserve operate under different authorities, Treasury retires the securities it purchases, and the buybacks must be accommodated within Treasury's financing requirement. At the same time, dismissing the measure as immaterial on the basis of size is misleading. The minimum per-operation capacity exceeds the Federal Reserve's peak QE3 long-end operation size by approximately 2.3 to 3.2 times. The paper also examines the 20-year Treasury auction conducted on the announcement day and the subsequent reversal in long-end yields. The evidence suggests that the initial market response was short-lived, while the longer-term significance of the programme remains contingent on its implementation and subsequent Treasury debt-management decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2026年8月19日美国财政部宣布的长期债券回购计划扩大政策，分析其是否构成量化宽松，并评估其对国债流动性支持、长期供给和市场状况的影响。研究发现该操作在法定、机制和制度层面均不构成量化宽松，但也不能因其规模而忽视其重要性。
AI.research_question: 美国财政部扩大长期债券回购计划是否构成量化宽松？该措施对国债流动性支持、长期供给和市场状况有何影响？
AI.motivation: 美国财政部于2026年8月19日宣布非周期性地扩大长期债券回购计划，将每笔操作上限从20亿美元提升至至少40亿美元，涉及至少140亿美元的增量容量。鉴于该措施规模巨大且具有政策重要性，需要系统评估其性质（是否为量化宽松）及其市场影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量化宽松的法定定义与制度框架；财政部与美联储的职权分离原则；国债回购与债务管理理论
AI.method: 政策分析：从法定、机制和制度三个维度评估回购计划的性质；对比美联储QE3长期操作规模；分析20年期国债拍卖结果及长期收益率走势
AI.findings: 该回购操作在法定、机制和制度层面均不构成量化宽松：财政部的职权不同于美联储，财政部注销所购证券，且回购须在财政部融资需求框架内进行。但按规模低估该措施是错误的——最低单次操作容量约为美联储QE3高峰期长期操作规模的2.3至3.2倍。初始市场反应短暂，长期意义取决于后续实施和债务管理决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 厘清了财政部主导的国债回购与美联储量化宽松之间的概念边界，从法定、机制和制度层面提供了系统区分框架，丰富了关于非央行主导的流动性支持工具与货币政策界限的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者理解财政部债券回购计划的政策性质提供清晰指引；为债务管理机构评估回购计划的实施效果和后续决策提供分析框架；帮助投资者正确解读该类政策对长期利率和国债市场的实际影响。

title: Talking the ESG Tightrope: Between Greenwashing and Greenhushing
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR), University of Florida - Department of Finance, Insurance and Real Estate and Imperial College Business School

detail.title: Talking the ESG Tightrope: Between Greenwashing and Greenhushing
detail.abstract: Using a large language model (LLM), we characterize key stylized facts about the context and depth of corporate communication on climate and DEI related issues in quarterly earnings calls for firms across Europe and North America. Both climate and DEI discourse rise strongly until 2021 and decline thereafter. In general, communications on climate change issues are conducted substantively and in terms of its financial impact by firms with worse emissions profiles, and are followed by subsequent emission reductions. In contrast, DEI discussions are made tangentially and in terms of their societal impact by firms with greater board and employee diversity, and are not followed by further increases in diversity. To interpret the empirical patterns, we provide a conceptual framework featuring financial materiality and heterogeneous investor preferences, where firms choose the substance of information provided to investors under varying communication costs. Guided by this framework, we use the 2018 EU ETS reform and 2021 Texas anti-ESG legislation as quasi-natural experiments for how financial materiality and investor preferences causally affect firms' E&S communication, respectively. Our model and empirical evidence point to a chilling effect of the anti-ESG legislation on firms' willingness to provide even financially material information, implying perverse consequences for financial investors.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型（LLM）刻画了欧美企业在季度财报电话会议中有关气候和DEI（多元化、公平与包容）议题沟通的背景与深度特征。研究发现，气候和DEI话语均持续上升至2021年而后下降。气候沟通通常以实质性且关注财务影响的方式进行，且由排放记录较差的公司主导，随后伴随排放减少；而DEI讨论则多为附带性、侧重于社会影响，由董事会和员工多元化程度更高的公司进行，且未被后续多元化提升所印证。文章提出一个包含财务重要性和异质性投资者偏好的概念框架来解释这些模式，并利用2018年欧盟ETS改革和2021年德克萨斯州反ESG立法作为准自然实验，分别检验财务重要性和投资者偏好对企业E&S沟通的因果影响。模型与实证证据表明，反ESG立法对企业即使提供财务重要信息的意愿也产生寒蝉效应，对金融投资者产生适得其反的后果。
AI.research_question: 企业如何在季度财报电话会议中沟通气候和DEI议题？沟通模式背后的驱动因素是什么？财务重要性和投资者偏好如何因果性地影响企业的E&S（环境与社会）沟通决策？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对企业ESG（环境、社会与治理）沟通的研究较为有限，缺乏对企业气候与DEI沟通的深度、语境和实质性方面的系统性刻画；同时，对于财务重要性、投资者偏好等因素如何影响企业E&S信息披露的因果机制尚不清晰，尤其缺乏利用自然实验进行的因果识别研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念框架包含两个核心要素：一是财务重要性（financial materiality），即信息对企业财务表现的实质关联；二是异质性投资者偏好（heterogeneous investor preferences），即不同投资者对E&S议题存在差异化关注。企业在此框架下根据沟通成本选择向投资者提供信息的实质内容。
AI.method: 利用大语言模型（LLM）对欧美企业季度财报电话会议中的气候与DEI沟通文本进行深度和语境特征刻画；采用2018年欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）改革和2021年德克萨斯州反ESG立法作为准自然实验，进行因果推断分析；同时构建理论概念框架以解释实证模式。
AI.findings: （1）气候和DEI话语均持续上升至2021年，此后呈下降趋势；（2）气候沟通由排放记录较差的实质性企业主导，侧重于财务影响，且这类沟通伴随后续实际排放减少；（3）DEI讨论多由董事会和员工多元化程度较高的企业进行，但内容流于附带性、侧重社会影响，且未被后续多元化提升所印证；（4）反ESG立法产生寒蝉效应，抑制了企业提供即使具有财务重要性信息的意愿，对金融投资者产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将财务重要性与异质性投资者偏好整合的概念框架，用以解释企业在不同沟通成本下对E&S信息供应的选择；利用准自然实验为财务重要性和投资者偏好对企业E&S沟通的因果影响提供了实证证据，推进了对企业ESG沟通策略决定因素的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者和政策制定者提供关于反ESG立法潜在负面后果（寒蝉效应）的实证证据；为投资者评估企业E&S沟通的实质性与可信度提供方法参考（通过LLM进行文本深度刻画）；为企业管理层理解不同E&S议题沟通的有效性与策略差异提供启示。

title: What Lies Behind Investment Banking, Shadow Banking, and High-Frequency Trading? A Risky, Dangerous, Secretive, or Reputable Business?

detail.title: What Lies Behind Investment Banking, Shadow Banking, and High-Frequency Trading? A Risky, Dangerous, Secretive, or Reputable Business?
detail.abstract: Investment banking, shadow banking, and high-frequency trading are among those manifestations of modern finance that evoke fascination and mistrust in equal measure. Drawing on the academic literature and on current data from international institutions (Financial Stability Board, ESMA, SEC, LSEG), this paper examines what these lines of business actually are, how they function, who conducts them, and whose interests they serve. The analysis shows that all of the activities examined constitute legal, economically well-founded, and in large part regulated businesses whose questionable reputation stems chiefly from opacity, conflicts of interest, and isolated excesses. Investment banking is a highly concentrated business of a few large banks, with worldwide fee income of $60.5 billion in the first half of 2025 alone. Shadow banking, as recorded by the Financial Stability Board, comprises assets of $256.8 trillion and thus already 51 per cent of the global financial system. In high-frequency trading, roughly 55 per cent of US and up to 43 per cent of European equity trading volume is attributable to strategies whose reaction times are measured in millionths of a second; the costs associated with latency arbitrage amount to roughly five billion dollars per year worldwide (Aquilina, Budish, and O'Neill, 2022). For investors, a differentiated assessment follows: none of the businesses examined is disreputable per se, and none is free of risk. Those who understand how they work, who the participants are, and where the profits originate can weigh opportunities and dangers realistically — and may, in selected cases, participate in these markets themselves, whether through listed trading firms or through regulated credit funds.

AI.tldr: 本文基于学术文献和国际机构数据，系统分析了投资银行、影子银行和高频交易这三种现代金融业务的实际运作机制、参与者及其服务对象。研究发现这些业务本质上都是合法、经济上合理且大部分受到监管的，其不佳声誉主要源于不透明度、利益冲突和个别极端案例。文章为投资者提供了差异化评估框架，指出这些业务本身并无绝对优劣，关键在于理解其运作机制和风险来源。
AI.research_question: 投资银行、影子银行和高频交易这三种现代金融业务到底是什么、如何运作、由谁从事、服务于谁的利益，以及它们是否像公众所认为的那样不可信赖？
AI.motivation: 现代金融中的投资银行、影子银行和高频交易等业务既引人入胜又令人不信任，公众对这些业务的认知存在大量误解。作者希望通过学术文献和权威数据还原这些业务的真实面貌，为投资者和政策制定者提供理性、差异化的评估视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于金融中介理论、市场微观结构理论和金融监管理论，结合利益冲突理论和信息不对称理论来审视三类金融业务的本质。
AI.method: 文献综述与国际机构数据相结合的分析方法。数据来源包括金融稳定理事会（FSB）、欧洲证券和市场管理局（ESMA）、美国证券交易委员会（SEC）和伦敦证券交易所集团（LSEG），并引用了Aquilina, Budish和O'Neill (2022)的实证研究。
AI.findings: （1）投资银行业务高度集中，少数大型银行主导，2025年上半年全球费用收入达605亿美元；（2）影子银行资产达256.8万亿美元，占全球金融体系的51%；（3）高频交易占美国股票交易量的约55%、欧洲的约43%，延迟套利成本全球每年约50亿美元；（4）所有三类业务均属合法且大体受监管，声誉问题主要源于不透明性、利益冲突和个别过度行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 为现代金融中备受争议的业务提供了系统性的分析框架，澄清了公众对这些业务的常见误解，弥合了学术认知与公众认知之间的鸿沟，为理解金融中介和市场结构提供了整合性视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了差异化的投资评估指南：这些业务本身并非不名誉，但也都存在风险。理解其运作方式、参与者和利润来源后，投资者可以在选定情况下通过上市交易公司或受监管信贷基金参与这些市场。

title: From Caldeira-Leggett to Multiplicative Noise State-Dependent Coupling Channels for Heavy-Tailed Financial Returns

detail.title: From Caldeira-Leggett to Multiplicative Noise State-Dependent Coupling Channels for Heavy-Tailed Financial Returns
detail.abstract: Financial return distributions exhibit heavy power-law tails with an exponent near two, a regularity that has resisted a fully convincing physical explanation. This paper asks whether an open-system Langevin framework rooted in Caldeira-Leggett dynamics can reproduce the tail exponents observed in equity markets, and if not, what minimal extension of the framework is needed. We build a threebody model of coupled airline equities driven by empirical market noise and probe the architecture in four stages, with the goal of reproducing the empirical airline tail exponent ᾱ ≈ 2.04. A Gaussian equilibrium bath produces Gaussian outputs, confirming the internal consistency of the Caldeira-Leggett baseline. Direct measurement of the S&P 500 bath then reveals a non-Gaussian marginal with kurtosis 16 and a Hill tail exponent near 2.3, invalidating the equilibrium reservoir hypothesis. Driving the system with these empirical returns alone, in place of the thermal background, still does not preserve heavy tails. The additive Langevin dynamics average roughly thirty independent noise draws per relaxation time. The empirical market distribution has finite variance and, under iid resampling, bounded support, so it lies in the Gaussian domain of attraction and the averaging drives the output toward Gaussian behavior. It is also not Lévy-stable, so it is not a fixed point under convolution. We show separately that the finite-threshold Hill estimate rises under filtering even for non-stable inputs whose asymptotic tail index is provably preserved, so the measured attenuation is an estimator effect at moderate thresholds and not destruction of an asymptotic power law. To overcome this attenuation we make the noise coupling state-dependent, so that large market shocks are amplified when the system is in certain dynamical states. The core finding of the paper is that the timescale of the state variable through which this multiplicative coupling acts determines whether it can counteract the averaging. Position is a slow variable confined by the potential well. Coupling to it reproduces the empirical exponent only at a coupling strength more than two orders of magnitude larger than what leverage regressions measure, and it leaves the exponent untouched until the coupling is already large. Velocity and realized volatility are fast variables that fluctuate on the timescale of returns. Coupling to either of them reproduces the target exponent at a coupling roughly twenty times smaller, with the realized-volatility channel showing the cleanest timestep convergence. The shared-bath architecture additionally produces cross-stock tail clustering with co-exceedance ratios of seven to nine even at zero direct coupling, which exceeds the clustering seen in the data, while the collective mode and the mean of the individual stocks have tail exponents that are close to one another. All results are reported with multi-seed uncertainty estimates. I. INTRODUCTION The empirical distribution of financial asset returns is one of the most studied and least understood objects in quantitative finance. Since the work of Mantegna and Stanley [25] and Cont [13], it has been clear that daily returns deviate systematically from Gaussian decay. Their survival distributions follow approximate power laws P (|r| > x) ∼ x-α with exponents typically between 2 and 4. This two-sided form is the convention of the literature we are summarizing. The exponents we estimate in this paper are one-sided right-tail quantities, defined precisely in Section III. This range is consequential. For 2 < α ≤ 4, the variance is finite while the fourth moment is divergent or borderline, which means that Gaussian risk metrics such as Value-at-Risk can underestimate the probability of large moves by orders of magnitude. AI.tldr: 本文基于Caldeira-Leggett开放系统Langevin框架，探讨能否复现金融市场收益的幂律尾指数（约为2）。研究发现：高斯平衡浴产生高斯输出；直接用经验市场噪声驱动仍无法保持重尾，因为平均效应将输出推向高斯。核心发现是：通过状态依赖的乘性耦合可以克服这一衰减，且耦合所作用的状态变量的时间尺度是关键——耦合到快速变量（速度和已实现波动率）能以约为慢变量（位置）二十分之一的耦合强度复现经验尾指数。
AI.research_question: 一个基于Caldeira-Leggett动力学的开放系统Langevin框架能否复现股票市场观测到的尾指数？如果不能，需要对该框架做何种最小扩展？
AI.motivation: 金融市场收益分布的幂律尾（指数接近2）是一个长期缺乏令人信服的物理解释的规律。高斯风险度量（如VaR）会严重低估大额波动的概率，因此理解重尾的物理起源具有重要的理论和实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: Caldeira-Leggett开放系统Langevin动力学、中心极限定理/高斯吸引域、Lévy稳定分布、Hill尾指数估计、状态依赖乘性耦合
AI.method: 构建航空公司股票的三体模型，分四个阶段推进：（1）高斯平衡浴验证基线一致性；（2）直接测量S&P 500浴的非高斯边际（峰度16，Hill尾指数≈2.3）；（3）用经验收益驱动系统检验重尾保持；（4）引入状态依赖乘性耦合，分别测试位置、速度和已实现波动率三个耦合通道，并报告多种子不确定性估计。
AI.findings: （1）高斯平衡浴产生高斯输出；（2）S&P 500浴是非高斯的，峰度为16，Hill尾指数≈2.3，否决了平衡储库假设；（3）直接用经验收益驱动仍不保持重尾——经验分布有界且有限方差，属于高斯吸引域，加性平均将输出推向高斯；（4）Hill估计衰减是中等阈值下的估计效应而非渐近幂律破坏；（5）状态依赖乘性耦合可克服衰减，耦合到快速变量（速度、已实现波动率）的所需耦合强度比慢变量（位置）小约20倍；（6）共享浴架构产生跨股票尾部聚集（共超阈值比7-9），超过数据中观测到的聚集程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了加性Langevin框架中平均效应（多次噪声抽取）如何将重尾推向高斯行为；阐明了状态依赖乘性耦合中状态变量时间尺度决定其能否抵消平均的关键机制；区分了Hill估计衰减的估计器效应与真实渐近尾指数变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融风险模型提供了物理上可解释的重尾生成机制，提示风险管理中应关注已实现波动率等快速变量作为乘性耦合通道；对风险度量（如VaR）在高斯假设下的低估问题给出了物理层面的解释和改进方向。

title: Closing Without Contracting: Local Employment Adjustment to a State-Owned Nuclear Facility Suspension
affiliations: KDI School of Public Policy and Management - KDI School of Public Policy and Management, Students, University of Tennessee, Knoxville, KDI School of Public Policy and Management, European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and KDI School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Closing Without Contracting: Local Employment Adjustment to a State-Owned Nuclear Facility Suspension

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. DS26-06
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: When a large employer closes, how much of the direct loss propagates into the wider local economy depends on the regional and institutional conditions of the host community. Quasi-experimental evidence on which conditions matter has nevertheless concentrated on private manufacturing closures in Western economies, leaving state-owned operators and Asian institutional settings largely unexamined. We estimate the employment consequences of the June 2017 permanent suspension of Kori Unit 1, Korea's first commercial reactor, combining an establishment-level difference-indifferences design with a municipality-level synthetic control drawn from 245 municipalities. Neither design detects an effect on total employment. Beneath this aggregate null, the two designs recover different margins of adjustment. The difference-indifferences estimates show a significant increase in accommodation and food services and no detectable change in manufacturing, while the synthetic control additionally reflects establishment entry and exit and shows manufacturing falling below its counterfactual. We read this pattern as sectoral recomposition operating partly through the extensive margin, consistent with the joint operation of three absorption mechanisms. These are employment protection within a state-owned operator, partial withdrawal of a generation-linked host-community transfer regime, and a co-occurring tourism-development shock. The local consequences of nuclear closure depend on institutional configuration rather than the closure event alone.

AI.tldr: 本文利用双重差分和合成控制法，考察了2017年韩国古里1号核反应堆（韩国首座商业反应堆）永久停运对当地就业的影响。尽管总体就业无显著变化，但两种方法揭示了不同的调整机制：DID显示住宿餐饮业就业显著增加、制造业无变化，而合成控制法则显示制造业低于反事实水平。这反映了部门重组与广延边际调整，由国有企业就业保护、发电关联转移支付部分退出以及旅游业发展冲击三种吸收机制共同作用。
AI.research_question: 大型国有企业（核反应堆）关闭时，直接就业损失在多大程度上传导至更广泛的当地经济？何种区域与制度条件调节了这一传导过程？特别是在韩国这一亚洲制度背景下，国有企业运营商的关闭对当地就业有何影响？
AI.motivation: 以往关于大型雇主关闭的准实验证据集中于西方经济体的私营制造业关闭，忽视了国有企业运营商和亚洲制度背景。韩国古里1号核反应堆的永久停运提供了一个独特的自然实验，可考察国有企业关闭在亚洲制度环境中的就业效应，以及不同制度机制（就业保护、转移支付制度、旅游业冲击）如何共同调节这种影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于地方乘数效应理论、劳动力市场制度理论以及区域调整机制理论，提出三种吸收机制：1) 国有企业内部的就业保护机制；2) 发电关联的宿主社区转移支付制度的部分退出机制；3) 同时发生的旅游业发展冲击机制。这些机制共同作用于部门重组与广延边际（企业进入退出）调整。
AI.method: 采用两种互补的准实验识别策略：1) 企业层面的双重差分设计（DID）；2) 基于245个市郡的市级合成控制法。两种方法分别识别不同的调整边际：DID侧重集约边际（既有企业的就业变化），合成控制法则同时反映广延边际（企业进入与退出）。
AI.findings: 1) 两种识别策略均未检测到总体就业的显著效应；2) DID估计显示住宿和餐饮服务业就业显著增加，制造业无显著变化；3) 合成控制法显示制造业就业低于反事实水平；4) 该模式表明部门重组部分通过广延边际运作，与三种制度吸收机制（国有企业就业保护、转移支付部分退出、旅游业发展冲击）共同作用一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将地方乘数效应的分析扩展至国有企业关闭和亚洲制度背景，填补了现有文献集中于西方私营制造业的空白；2) 揭示核关闭的地方后果取决于制度配置而非关闭事件本身，深化了对制度条件调节地方经济冲击的理解；3) 通过DID与合成控制法的互补使用，区分了集约边际与广延边际的不同调整路径，丰富了区域调整机制的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为核电站退役决策提供就业影响评估的政策参考，表明核关闭不一定导致净就业损失；2) 提示政策制定者关注关闭企业的制度属性（国有vs私营）及配套政策（转移支付、产业扶持）对就业缓冲的作用；3) 为亚洲及其他新兴经济体的大型国有企业关闭的公共政策设计提供经验证据。

title: Dissecting Machine Forecast Disagreement: Investor Disagreement versus Model Uncertainty
affiliations: Old Dominion University

detail.title: Dissecting Machine Forecast Disagreement: Investor Disagreement versus Model Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Machine forecast disagreement (MFD) does not identify investor disagreement when investors face model uncertainty. We allow investors to entertain multiple forecasting models and use Bayesian model averaging to decompose forecast dispersion into disagreement across investors and model uncertainty within investors. Model uncertainty accounts for about 73% of total dispersion and is almost perfectly correlated with raw MFD. In cross-sectional return tests, model uncertainty strongly predicts lower returns, whereas investor disagreement does not. The negative return relation attributed to MFD therefore reflects model uncertainty rather than disagreement across investors, substantially changing its economic interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文发现机器预测分歧（MFD）在投资者面临模型不确定性时无法识别投资者分歧。通过引入贝叶斯模型平均，将预测分散度分解为投资者间分歧和投资者内模型不确定性，发现模型不确定性约占总体分散度的73%，且与原始MFD几乎完全相关。横截面收益检验表明，模型不确定性强烈预测较低收益，而投资者分歧则不然，因此MFD的负收益关系本质上反映的是模型不确定性而非投资者分歧。
AI.research_question: 当投资者面临模型不确定性时，机器预测分歧（MFD）是否能够真正识别投资者之间的分歧？MFD与股票收益之间的负相关关系究竟由何种经济力量驱动？
AI.motivation: 以往研究将机器预测分歧（MFD）视为投资者分歧的代理变量，但这一假设忽略了投资者可能面临模型不确定性的现实。如果投资者对多个预测模型的不确定性被误认为投资者间分歧，那么对MFD与收益关系的经济解释将存在严重偏误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯模型平均（Bayesian Model Averaging）；投资者分歧理论；模型不确定性理论
AI.method: 将预测分散度分解为两个维度：投资者之间的分歧（across investors）与投资者内部的模型不确定性（within investors）。使用贝叶斯模型平均方法允许投资者同时考虑多个预测模型，并据此量化两种成分在总分散度中的相对贡献。随后进行横截面收益回归检验两种成分对股票收益的预测能力。
AI.findings: （1）模型不确定性约占总分散度的73%，且与原始MFD几乎完全相关；（2）在横截面收益检验中，模型不确定性显著预测较低的股票收益，而投资者分歧对收益无显著预测力；（3）因此，MFD与收益之间的负向关系主要源于模型不确定性而非投资者间分歧，这从根本上改变了其经济含义。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将MFD分解为投资者间分歧与投资者内模型不确定性两个维度，澄清了既有文献对MFD经济含义的误解；（2）在理论上区分了"分歧"与"不确定性"在资产定价中的不同作用机制，为后续研究提供了更精确的度量框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为实证研究者提供了区分投资者分歧与模型不确定性的方法论工具；（2）对利用机器预测数据进行资产定价和投资决策的实践者具有警示意义：MFD的负收益预测力不应被简单解释为分歧效应，而应视为模型不确定性溢价；（3）对算法设计和预测模型的稳健性评估具有参考价值。
