title: Intellectual Property Law and Upcycling -Towards a Sustainable Transformativeness?
affiliations: University of Szeged, Institute of Comparative Law and Legal Theory; Vytautas Magnus University - Faculty of Law and University of Turku Faculty of Law

detail.title: Intellectual Property Law and Upcycling -Towards a Sustainable Transformativeness?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Péter Mezei - Heidi Härkönen: Intellectual Property Law and Upcycling - Towards a Sustainable Transformativeness? In: Iris Nguyen Duy - Ingvil Helland Göller - Siri-Helen Egeland (eds.): Legislation for Tomorrow. The Regulation of New Technologies and Climate Change in a Comparative Perspective, Routledge, 2026 (forthcoming)

detail.abstract: Upcycling is an increasingly important practice within the circular economy, particularly in the fashion and creative industries, where discarded or underused goods are transformed into products with a new function or added value. Yet, when the source materials embody intellectual property (IP), upcycling may conflict with the exclusive rights of copyright, trademark, and design right holders. This paper examines upcycling as a form of transformative recycling and explores whether, and to what extent, current IP frameworks can accommodate and support sustainable reuse. It identifies three interconnected challenges. First, it analyses the tension between the proprietary and exclusionary logic of IP law and the inclusive, resource-conserving objectives of the circular economy, including the emerging “commercial paradox of upcycling”, whereby sustainability-oriented downstream users may compete with established rightsholders. Second, it examines the difficulties created by overlapping IP rights in “mixed goods”, particularly fashion products that may simultaneously attract copyright, trademark, and design protection, and considers the role of exhaustion, exceptions and limitations, moral rights, and fundamental rights in resolving such conflicts. Third, it addresses the spatial dimension of upcycling, including the unequal distribution of textile waste between the Global North and Global South and the resulting risks of waste colonialism. Drawing on EU and US legal doctrines and emerging case law concerning the reuse, customization, and transformation of protected goods, the paper argues that upcycling should not be regarded as inherently infringing. Rather, it provides a valuable case study for reconsidering the relationship between IP protection and sustainability. The paper concludes that future IP policies should facilitate legitimate transformative reuse and recognise sustainability as a relevant consideration in balancing exclusive rights against the objectives of a circular and environmentally sustainable economy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了升级再造（upcycling）——将废弃或未充分利用的商品转化为具有新功能或附加值产品的循环经济实践——与知识产权制度之间的冲突。论文指出，当源材料承载知识产权时，升级再造可能与版权、商标和外观设计权利持有人的专有权相冲突。文章识别出三大挑战：知识产权专有排除逻辑与循环经济包容性目标之间的张力（包括"升级再造的商业悖论"）、"混合商品"中重叠知识产权的复杂性、以及全球南北之间纺织废料分配不均所导致的"废料殖民主义"风险。基于欧盟和美国的法律原则及新兴判例，论文主张升级再造不应被视为固有侵权，未来知识产权政策应促进合法的变革性再利用，并将可持续性视为平衡专有权与循环经济目标的重要考量因素。
AI.research_question: 升级再造实践在何种程度上能够被现有知识产权框架所容纳和支持？知识产权制度应如何调整以适应循环经济中可持续再利用的需求？
AI.motivation: 升级再造在循环经济中日益重要，但当源材料承载知识产权时，其可能与版权、商标和设计权利持有人的专有权产生冲突。论文旨在调和知识产权保护与可持续发展目标之间的紧张关系，为未来政策提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 运用欧盟和美国的知识产权法律理论，涵盖版权法、商标法、外观设计法、权利用尽原则、例外与限制、精神权利、基本权利等理论框架，并结合循环经济理论进行分析。
AI.method: 法律教义分析方法，结合欧盟和美国法律原则、新兴判例以及关于受保护商品的再利用、定制化和转化的案例研究进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 论文发现：升级再造不应被视为固有侵权行为；升级再造有助于重新审视知识产权保护与可持续性之间的关系；未来知识产权政策应促进合法的变革性再利用，并将可持续性作为平衡专有权与循环经济目标的重要考量因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将升级再造理论化为"变革性回收"的一种形式；识别并系统化"升级再造的商业悖论"；提出将可持续性作为知识产权权利平衡中的考量维度，丰富了知识产权法与循环经济交叉领域的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供知识产权政策调整建议，倡导促进合法的升级再造实践；为升级再造从业者厘清法律边界；关注全球南北废料分配不均问题，警示"废料殖民主义"风险。

title: Institutional Quality in Sub-Saharan Africa: Persistence, Convergence, and Reform Mobility
affiliations: Department of Economics, University of Antananarivo

detail.title: Institutional Quality in Sub-Saharan Africa: Persistence, Convergence, and Reform Mobility
detail.abstract: Institutional reform is often evaluated over horizons far shorter than the institutional process itself. This paper studies institutional quality in Sub-Saharan Africa as a persistent economic state rather than a contemporaneous policy covariate. Using the 2025 revision of the Worldwide Governance Indicators, a six-dimensional panel is constructed for 48 economies over 2002-2024 without interpolation of missing governance observations. The first principal component explains 84.8% of standardized institutional variation, yet the balanced-sample mean rises by only 0.75 point on the absolute 0-100 scale. Five-year convergence is statistically detectable: the coefficient on initial institutional quality equals-0.0447 with a country-clustered standard error of 0.0175. Its annualized persistence is 0.991, which implies a half-life near 76 years. Rank persistence remains high, while transition matrices reveal substantial adjacent mobility but rare large institutional jumps. A grid-searched threshold near 54.6 fails a cluster wild-bootstrap test of nonlinearity. The evidence favors a model of cumulative, path-dependent institutional change in which administrative progress can coexist with persistent weaknesses in legal credibility and corruption control.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2025年修订版的世界治理指标（WGI），构建2002-2024年48个撒哈拉以南非洲经济体的六维面板数据，研究制度质量作为持续经济状态而非同期政策协变量的表现。研究发现制度质量具有极强的持续性（年化持续性0.991，半衰期约76年），五年来收敛系数显著但幅度极小，制度变迁呈现累积性、路径依赖特征。
AI.research_question: 撒哈拉以南非洲的制度质量在长期尺度上是如何演化的？制度质量是否应被视为一种持续性经济状态而非短期政策变量？
AI.motivation: 现有制度改革的评估往往在远短于制度自身过程的时间跨度上进行，导致对制度变迁的真实动态理解不足。本文旨在用更长的时间视野和更严谨的方法论来考察非洲制度质量的演变规律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 路径依赖理论；制度经济学的累积性变迁理论；收敛理论（beta-convergence概念）
AI.method: 利用2025年修订版WGI构建48个经济体2002-2024年的六维面板数据（不插补缺失观测）；主成分分析提取综合制度质量指标；五年期的收敛回归（OLS + 国家聚类标准误）；年化持续性估计与半衰期计算；排名持续性分析；马尔可夫转移矩阵；网格搜索阈值并结合聚类wild-bootstrap检验非线性。
AI.findings: （1）第一主成分解释了84.8%的制度变异，但平衡样本均值在0-100绝对量尺上仅上升0.75点；（2）五年收敛系数为-0.0447（聚类标准误0.0175），统计上可检测到收敛；（3）年化持续性高达0.991，隐含半衰期约76年；（4）排名持续性高，转移矩阵显示相邻移动显著但大型制度跳跃罕见；（5）约54.6的阈值在聚类wild-bootstrap非线性检验中不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为制度变迁的路径依赖理论提供了基于长期面板数据的经验证据；提出制度质量应被视为持续性经济状态而非短期政策协变量的分析框架；通过半衰期估算量化了制度变迁的极端缓慢特征，深化了对制度粘性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 对国际组织和政策制定者具有重要启示：制度改革评估应采用比现行标准更长的时间视野；行政进步可以与法律可信度和腐败控制的持续弱点共存，提示政策干预需要区分不同制度维度的改革难度和时间预期。

title: A Statistical Qualification Framework for Probability-of-Default Estimators: Generalized Linear Models versus Regularized Gradient Boosting Ensembles
affiliations: , Bahir Dar University and Bahir Dar University

detail.title: A Statistical Qualification Framework for Probability-of-Default Estimators: Generalized Linear Models versus Regularized Gradient Boosting Ensembles
detail.abstract: We propose a unified theoretical framework for the statistical qualification of probability-ofdefault (PD) estimators, defined as the formal verification-existence, identifiability, consistency, asymptotic distribution, generalization bound-of every stage of a credit-scoring pipeline, without recourse to numerical simulation. We formalize PD as the conditional expectation f * (x) = P(Y = 1 | X = x) and compare two competing hypothesis classes: the generalized linear model (logistic regression) and additive tree ensembles obtained by regularized gradient boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM). For the first class, we establish existence and uniqueness of the maximum-likelihood estimator under a separation condition, together with its consistency and asymptotic normality. For the second, we show the monotone decrease of the regularized training objective and state a generalization bound based on Rademacher complexity. We then validate, through results either proved in full or rigorously cited, the standard components of a scoring pipeline: the AUC statistic as a Mann-Whitney U-statistic together with its asymptotic law, the Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic, the Information Value as a Jeffreys divergence together with its local quadratic expansion linking this heuristic criterion to a χ 2 divergence, the Murphy decomposition of the Brier score for calibration, the geometric properties of synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE), and the existence-uniqueness theorem for Shapley values used for explainability. Taken together, these results constitute a fully analytically verifiable qualification protocol, of particular relevance to microfinance portfolios where limited sample size restricts the scope of purely empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的统计理论框架，用于对信用评分中违约概率（PD）估计器的各个阶段进行严格的数学验证，包括可验证性、可辨识性、一致性、渐近分布和泛化界。该框架对比了逻辑回归和梯度提升树两类模型，并证明了评分管线各组件（AUC、KS统计量、信息价值、Brier分数分解、SMOTE和Shapley值）的理论性质，特别适用于样本量有限的微金融组合。
AI.research_question: 如何在不借助数值模拟的前提下，为信用评分管线中违约概率（PD）估计器的每一个阶段提供严格的统计资质验证（包括存在性、可辨识性、一致性、渐近分布和泛化界）？
AI.motivation: 在微金融组合中，有限的样本量限制了纯经验验证（数值模拟）的可靠性，因此需要一种无需数值模拟、完全基于解析证明的统计资质验证协议，以确保PD估计器各环节的理论有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: - 条件期望理论（PD = P(Y=1|X=x)）- 最大似然估计理论（分离条件下的存在唯一性、一致性和渐近正态性）- Rademacher复杂度与泛化界- U统计量理论（Mann-Whitney）- Jeffreys散度与χ²散度- Kolmogorov-Smirnov统计量- Brier分数Murphy分解- SMOTE的几何性质- Shapley值存在唯一性定理
AI.method: 理论分析方法：- 对逻辑回归建立MLE的存在唯一性（在分离条件下）、一致性和渐近正态性- 对梯度提升树证明正则化训练目标的单调递减性，并基于Rademacher复杂度给出泛化界- 对评分管线各组件（AUC、KS、信息价值、Brier分数、SMOTE、Shapley值）通过完整证明或严格引用确立其理论性质
AI.findings: 1. 在分离条件下，逻辑回归的MLE具有存在性、唯一性、一致性和渐近正态性。2. 正则化梯度提升（XGBoost/LightGBM）的训练目标单调递减，且具有基于Rademacher复杂度的泛化界。3. AUC统计量可表示为Mann-Whitney U统计量并具有渐近分布律。4. 信息价值可解释为Jeffreys散度，其局部二次展开与χ²散度相关联。5. Brier分数可通过Murphy分解用于校准评估。6. SMOTE具有可证明的几何性质，Shapley值的存在唯一性有定理保证。最终构成了一个完全可解析验证的资质验证协议。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提出统一的、全解析可验证的PD估计器统计资质验证框架，将评分管线各环节纳入一个完整的理论体系。2. 将信息价值这一启发式准则与Jeffreys散度和χ²散度建立了严格的数学联系。3. 将AUC、KS、Brier分数等实务常用统计量统一到严格的理论框架下，弥合了理论统计与信用评分实践之间的鸿沟。4. 为微金融等小样本场景提供了无需数值模拟的理论验证路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为微金融组合提供了在小样本条件下可执行的PD估计器资质验证协议。2. 为信用评分管线的各组件（模型选择、性能评估、校准、过采样、可解释性）提供了理论依据，增强模型监管合规性。3. 帮助实务从业者在无需大量数值模拟的情况下，对PD模型进行严格的统计验证，提升模型方法论的可信度和可审计性。

title: Landlocked Ambition: Convertibility and Value Capture in Haryana's Data Centre Policy
affiliations: and

detail.title: Landlocked Ambition: Convertibility and Value Capture in Haryana's Data Centre Policy
detail.abstract: This paper argues that sub-national competition for data centre investment rests on a developmental premise the asset does not satisfy, and that this misalignment constrains a challenger state twice over. It advances a convertibility framework and a value capture framework, and applies both to Haryana. Its convertibility remains structurally bounded.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，次国家层级对数据中心投资的竞争建立在一个发展主义前提之上，而该资产并不能满足这一前提。这种错位对挑战者国家造成了双重约束。文章提出了可兑换性框架和价值捕获框架，并将其应用于印度哈里亚纳邦，发现该邦的可兑换性在结构上受到限制。
AI.research_question: 次国家层级的竞争性投资（尤其是数据中心投资）为何以及如何对挑战者国家构成双重约束？
AI.motivation: 数据中心被视为重要的数字经济发展资产，各次国家层级政府竞相吸引此类投资，但其实际发展效益是否能够兑现需要理论化探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可兑换性框架（convertibility framework）和价值捕获框架（value capture framework）
AI.method: 案例研究，以印度哈里亚纳邦（Haryana）为分析对象
AI.findings: 数据中心投资无法满足次国家政府竞争所依赖的发展主义前提；哈里亚纳邦的可兑换性在结构上受到限制，导致挑战者国家面临双重约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可兑换性与价值捕获两个分析框架，揭示了次国家投资竞争与资产生质之间的错位，丰富了关于全球化投资与发展中国家次国家行为体的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为次国家政府（尤其是发展中国家地区）在吸引数据中心等数字基础设施投资时提供政策警示：需审慎评估此类资产能否真正转化为本地发展收益。

title: Whose Time Matters? Parents' Late Return from Work, Parent-Child Time, and Child Behavioral Problems in Japan

detail.title: Whose Time Matters? Parents' Late Return from Work, Parent-Child Time, and Child Behavioral Problems in Japan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used secondary microdata from the Longitudinal Survey of Newborns in the 21st Century (2010 cohort). The microdata were provided by the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare under Article 33 of the Statistics Act (Act No. 53 of 2007), with approval granted to the author (Hatsu-Seiōtō No. 0420-2, April 20, 2026), and were used in accordance with the terms attached to that approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant-in-Aid for Transformative Research Areas (A) JP22H05100 and Grant-in-Aid for Scientific Research (C) JP23K02295.

detail.abstract: In many economies, long working hours extend into the evening, delaying the time parents return home and compressing the hours available for their children. This study examines whether parents' late return from work is associated with children's behavioral problems through reduced parent-child time, using data from a large national birth cohort in Japan (the Longitudinal Survey of Newborns in the 21st Century; analytic sample of 9,458 dual-earner households), a setting in which prior evidence suggests that overtime, rather than shift work, is an important source of late return. Building on the nonstandard work schedules (NSWS) literature, late return is defined as typically returning home from work between 7 p.m. and 8 a.m. Causal mediation analysis decomposes the total association between parents' late return and children's behavioral problems at age 9 into direct and indirect components, with the indirect component operating through parent-child time. Results differ markedly by parent gender. Mothers' late return is associated with higher behavioral problems, and the estimated mediated share is substantially larger when weekday mother-child time is the mediator (26%) than when days-off time is the mediator (7%); these percentages come from separate single-mediator models. Fathers' late return shows no robust total association with child outcomes, despite fathers' substantially longer work hours. This pattern is consistent with mothers' primary caregiver role making maternal time less substitutable. The findings suggest that where overtime is widespread and caregiving remains gendered, time constraints on mothers can have measurable consequences for children. They underscore the need for work-hour policies that protect parent-child time and for measures that promote a more equal division of caregiving.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用日本大型全国出生队列数据（9,458个双职工家庭），通过因果中介分析检验父母晚归与孩子行为问题之间的关系。结果发现：母亲晚归与孩子行为问题显著相关，其中工作日亲子时间的间接效应占比26%，休息日仅为7%；而父亲的晚归对孩子行为问题无显著总关联。这一性别差异与母亲作为主要照护者的角色使其时间更不可替代有关。
AI.research_question: 父母晚归是否通过减少亲子时间与孩子的行为问题相关联？这种关联在不同性别的父母之间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 在许多经济体中，长时间工作延伸至晚间，压缩了父母在家陪伴孩子的时间。以往文献尚未充分厘清父母晚归影响儿童行为问题的机制路径，且缺乏对父/母性别差异的细致考察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非标准工作时间安排（NSWS）文献；主要照护者角色理论（时间可替代性理论）
AI.method: 使用日本21世纪新生儿纵向调查数据（分析样本9,458个双职工家庭），采用因果中介分析（causal mediation analysis），将父母晚归与孩子9岁时行为问题的总关联分解为直接效应和通过亲子时间起作用的间接效应。晚归定义为通常在晚上7点至早上8点之间回家。分别以工作日和休息日亲子时间为中介变量构建单一中介模型。
AI.findings: （1）母亲晚归与孩子行为问题显著正相关；（2）以工作日母亲-孩子时间为中介时，间接效应占比26%；以休息日时间为中介时，占比仅7%；（3）父亲晚归对孩子行为问题无稳健的总关联，尽管父亲的工作时间显著更长。该模式与母亲作为主要照护者、其时间更难被替代的论点一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 将因果中介分析引入非标准工作时间安排与儿童发展研究领域，实证检验了亲子时间作为机制路径的角色；揭示了父母性别在时间可替代性上的不对称性，丰富了主要照护者角色理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果强调，在加班普遍且照护责任存在性别分工的社会中，母亲的工时约束可能对儿童产生可衡量的负面影响；呼吁制定保护亲子时间的工作时长政策，并推动更平等的照护分担措施。

title: Auctions with Outside Options

detail.title: Auctions with Outside Options
detail.abstract: Consider a finite set of potential bidders for the sale of an indivisible object where every bidder has an outside option. Bidders have private information about the object's value and their outside option which are drawn from two different probability distributions. Every bidder participates in the auction if and only if their value for the object is larger than their outside option, which leads to uncertain number of participants. The seller imposes a floor on the number of participating bidders in order to conduct an auction. If the floor is not met, the auction is canceled. We show that if either the value distribution is strengthened or the outside option distribution is weakened, the bidders raise their bids. We also show that the bidders raise their bids due to the imposition of a floor.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在竞拍者具有外部选项且参与人数不确定的情况下，拍卖人设定最低参与人数门槛（floor）对竞拍行为的影响。研究发现，价值分布增强或外部选项分布减弱时，竞拍者会提高出价；设定参与人数门槛也会促使竞拍者提高出价。
AI.research_question: 在竞拍者具有私人外部选项、参与人数不确定的情况下，拍卖人设定最低参与人数门槛如何影响竞拍者的出价行为？
AI.motivation: 传统拍卖模型通常假设参与人数固定或外生决定，但现实中竞拍者会根据自身价值和外部选项决定是否参与拍卖，导致参与人数不确定。此时拍卖人可能需要设定最低参与人数门槛，以确保拍卖可行，但这一机制对竞拍行为的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拍卖理论（独立私有价值模型），参与约束与外部选项理论
AI.method: 理论建模与分析：构建有限潜在竞拍者模型，竞拍者的价值和外部选项分别服从两个不同的概率分布，参与条件为价值大于外部选项；引入最低参与人数门槛，分析均衡出价行为的变化。
AI.findings: （1）当价值分布增强（stochastically improved）或外部选项分布减弱时，竞拍者会提高出价；（2）设立最低参与人数门槛本身也会促使竞拍者提高出价。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了拍卖理论中关于不确定参与人数的研究，首次系统分析最低参与人数门槛对竞拍者均衡出价的影响，揭示了价值分布、外部选项分布与拍卖参与门槛之间的理论关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拍卖人在实践中制定最低参与人数门槛提供理论依据，帮助拍卖人理解门槛设置对竞拍者出价行为的影响，从而优化拍卖设计以提升收益。

title: Proper Scoring Rules for Correlation Matrix Forecasts on the SPD Manifold: Theory and Empirical Evidence

detail.title: Proper Scoring Rules for Correlation Matrix Forecasts on the SPD Manifold: Theory and Empirical Evidence
detail.abstract: Correlation and covariance matrix forecasts are typically evaluated with the energy score or the variogram score, both built from at (Euclidean/Frobenius) distances even though correlation matrices live on a curved space the cone of symmetric positive denite (SPD) matrices under the ane-invariant metric. We study geometry-aware extensions of both scores, built from the ane-invariant (FisherRao) geodesic distance, and place them on a rigorous footing. We prove: (i) a general theorem that any conditionally negative denite (CND) kernel yields a proper scoring rule via the classical energy-distance construction, with a complete self-contained Hilbert-space proof; (ii) that |x−y|p is CND on R exactly for p ∈(0,2], with an explicit minimal counterexample for p>2; (iii) that variogram-style scores are proper elicitors of a pairwise-moment vector for any xed measurable entrywise transform, requiring no CND condition at all; and (iv) a new exact isometric embedding showing the ane-invariant distance, restricted to any commuting family of SPD matrices, is exactly a rescaled Euclidean distance in log-eigenvalue coordinates. Together these results settle propriety unconditionally for the geometric variogram score and for a geometric generalization of the energy score restricted to single-geodesic (e.g. stress-ladder) ensembles; for the geometric energy score on generic, non-commuting ensembles, we show numerically that the sucient CND condition genuinely fails once enough points are considered, at dimension 3 5 (though not yet at higher dimension), and state this precisely as an open conjecture. We complement the theory with an honest empirical investigation on synthetic and real data (walk-forward regime-switching correlation forecasts for a ve-industry-portfolio equity panel): a controlled synthetic test shows the geometric variogram score detects boundary-proximate forecast danger invisible to its at counterpart; on real data the picture is more nuanced the geometric score's edge is present but smaller than the at score's in a full-sample comparison, and concentrates specically in market episodes wher correlations genuinely approach the singular boundary, disappearing in an unconditional average. We report this, and a further real-data test that returns a negative result, to characterize precisely when the geometric approach helps rather than claiming it always does.

AI.tldr: 本文研究协方差/相关矩阵预报的几何感知评分规则。作者开发了基于仿射不变（Fisher-Rao）测地距离的能量分数和变差图分数的几何扩展，并从理论上严格证明了其适当性（propriety）的前提条件。他们证明了CND核构造适当评分规则的一般定理、|x−y|^p在R上是CND的精确条件、变差图分数作为成对矩向量的适当elicitor等关键结果，并通过合成数据与真实数据（五行业股权面板的马尔可夫机制切换相关预报）进行了诚实的实证评估。
AI.research_question: 如何为生活在弯曲空间（SPD矩阵锥）上的相关/协方差矩阵预报构建几何感知且理论上严格的评分规则？几何评分规则何时优于传统欧氏评分？
AI.motivation: 相关矩阵本质上生活在SPD矩阵锥这一弯曲空间上，但传统的能量分数和变差图分数基于欧氏/弗罗贝尼乌斯距离构建，忽略了空间的曲率几何。这可能导致评分不恰当或无法捕捉矩阵接近奇异边界时的预报风险。因此需要发展几何感知的评分规则并奠定严格的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 适当评分规则理论（proper scoring rules）、条件负定（CND）核理论、能量距离构造、仿射不变（Fisher-Rao）测地距离、Hilbert空间嵌入理论、SPD矩阵几何
AI.method: 理论证明与数值实验相结合：(i) 证明CND核通过经典能量距离构造产生适当评分规则的一般定理；(ii) 证明|x−y|^p在R上CND的精确条件p∈(0,2]并给出反例；(iii) 证明变差图分数对任何可测逐点变换都是成对矩向量的适当elicitor；(iv) 给出仿射不变距离在可交换族上精确等距嵌入log-特征值坐标的欧氏距离的证明。此外辅以合成数据和真实数据的实证评估。
AI.findings: (1) 几何变差图分数的适当性无条件成立；(2) 限制在单测地线（如应力梯）系综上的几何能量分数适当性成立；(3) 对一般非交换系综的几何能量分数，充分CND条件在维度3-5一旦考虑足够多的点就确实失效（但在更高维度尚未失效），并作为开放猜想提出；(4) 合成实验显示几何变差图分数能检测边界邻近的预报危险而平面对应无法检测；(5) 真实数据上几何评分的优势存在但小于平面对应，且集中在相关矩阵真正接近奇异边界的市场剧集，无条件平均时优势消失。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 给出了CND核产生适当评分规则的完整自包含Hilbert空间证明；(2) 精确刻画了|x−y|^p的CND性质条件并给出p>2时的最小反例；(3) 证明变差图分数是成对矩向量的适当elicitor且无需CND条件；(4) 证明了仿射不变距离在交换族上等距嵌入log-特征值欧氏距离的精确结果，为了解几何评分的性质提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为相关/协方差矩阵预报评估提供了理论上严格的几何感知评分工具；揭示了几何评分在相关矩阵接近奇异边界时能捕捉平面对应无法检测的预报危险（如市场崩溃情景）；同时诚实地刻画了几何方法何时奏效而非声称始终优于传统方法，为实践者的方法选择提供了条件性指导。

reference: European Review of Economic History, 2026[10.1093/ereh/heag017]
title: Secular Decline in the Lower Yangzi Delta? Rural Wages, Work Patterns, and State-market Dynamics in Hydraulic Construction, 1827-1936

detail.title: Secular Decline in the Lower Yangzi Delta? Rural Wages, Work Patterns, and State-market Dynamics in Hydraulic Construction, 1827-1936

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Review of Economic History, 2026[10.1093/ereh/heag017]

detail.abstract: Scholars have long debated whether the rural sector in the Lower Yangzi Delta of China declined after the nineteenth century. Using hydraulic construction as cases, this article finds neither decline nor stagnation. State-elite collaboration intensified in public goods provision, while labor institutions increasingly adapted to changing market dynamics. While rural wage incomes dipped in the 1820s-1830s, they rose substantially after the 1860s and moved towards sustained growth in the early twentieth century. These findings highlight a far more dynamic rural economy and pre-industrial labor market, where laborers moved flexibly between farming and non-farm work, and between casual and regular employment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对中国长江三角洲下游地区水利建设的案例研究，反驳了该地区农村部门在19世纪后衰退或停滞的传统观点，发现国家与精英在公共物品供给上的合作加强，劳动力制度适应市场变化，农村工资在1860年代后显著上升并趋于持续增长。
AI.research_question: 中国长江三角洲下游地区的农村部门在19世纪之后是否发生了衰退？
AI.motivation: 学术界长期以来对19世纪后长江三角洲下游地区农村部门是否衰退存在争论，本研究旨在通过水利建设工程案例提供新的经验证据来回答这一争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农村经济动态发展理论、前工业化劳动力市场理论、国家与精英合作供给公共物品理论
AI.method: 以水利建设工程为案例的历史实证研究，分析公共物品供给、劳动力制度变迁以及农村工资水平的时间变化趋势。
AI.findings: 发现该地区农村经济既未衰退也未停滞：国家与精英在公共物品供给上的合作有所加强；劳动力制度日益适应不断变化的市场动态；农村工资收入在1820-1830年代有所下降，但在1860年代后显著上升，并在20世纪初走向持续增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"19世纪后中国农村衰退论"的传统观点，揭示了前工业化时期农村经济的动态性和劳动力市场的灵活性，丰富了关于中国农村经济长期发展的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国农村经济发展的历史连续性提供了经验依据，有助于重新评估前工业化时期中国农村经济的活力及其制度基础，对当代农村发展和劳动力市场政策具有历史参考意义。

title:
Energy Substitution, Biased Technical Change, and the Economy-wide Energy Rebound: 
A Normalized CES Estimation for Japan
affiliations: and Goethe University Frankfurt

detail.title:
Energy Substitution, Biased Technical Change, and the Economy-wide Energy Rebound: 
A Normalized CES Estimation for Japan
detail.abstract: We estimate an energy-extended Constant Elasticity of Substitution (CES) production function for Japan's aggregate economy to examine how high energy demand and low domestic energy sufficiency shaped supply-side production conditions from 1978 to 2019. Treating energy as an intermediate input and applying the "Normalized Supply-Side System Approach", we find a low elasticity of substitution for energy and a decelerating, time-varying energy-saving bias in technical progress. Our framework also quantifies an economy-wide rebound effect, an often-overlooked obstacle to the reduction of energy use that has rarely been investigated for the case of Japan: on average, 39% of energy efficiency gains over the sample period are offset by a subsequent unintended increase in energy consumption. These results are robust to extensive checks, including grid searches over initial values, alternative nesting structures, bootstrapped errors, addressing endogeneity concerns, and trend-filtering methods. Allowing for smooth technological regime shifts improves the model fit and reveals a sharp reversal toward accelerating energysaving technical progress after the Fukushima accident in 2011. Yet, the rebound estimate simultaneously increases to nearly 50% in the improved model. Further decomposition of energy inputs into clean and fossil-based components indicates low interfuel substitutability, suggesting a limited flexibility to switch toward a greener energy mix. Overall, our empirical findings indicate that Japan's supply-side structure and its technical progress are insufficient to support sustained energy-growth decoupling in the long run, leaving the economy vulnerable to external energy supply conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文基于1978-2019年日本宏观经济数据，运用能源扩展的标准化供给面系统CES生产函数方法，发现能源替代弹性低、技术进步呈现时间变化的节能偏向，并量化了约39%的能源效率收益被反弹效应抵消。福岛核事故后节能技术进步加速但反弹效应升至近50%，且清洁能源与化石能源间的低替代弹性限制了能源结构转型，总体表明日本供给侧结构难以支撑长期能源-增长脱钩。
AI.research_question: 日本高能源需求和低国内能源自给率如何塑造了1978-2019年间供给侧的生产条件？日本的能源-增长脱钩在长期是否可持续？
AI.motivation: 日本作为能源高度依赖进口的经济体，此前缺乏对其供给侧能源替代弹性和技术进步的深入研究；同时能源反弹效应（rebound effect）作为能源使用减少的阻碍因素在日本的实证研究极为罕见。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源扩展的CES生产函数（Energy-extended Constant Elasticity of Substitution）、标准化供给侧系统方法（Normalized Supply-Side System Approach）、反弹效应理论、技术偏向进步理论
AI.method: 估计能源扩展的CES生产函数，采用标准化供给侧系统方法；将能源作为中间投入处理；进行多种稳健性检验（网格搜索初始值、替代嵌套结构、自助法标准误、内生性处理、趋势滤波方法）；允许技术体制平滑转换；将能源分解为清洁和化石能源两部分。
AI.findings: (1) 能源替代弹性较低；(2) 技术进步呈现减速的时间变化节能偏向；(3) 样本期内平均39%的能源效率收益被反弹效应抵消；(4) 福岛核事故后节能技术进步加速，但反弹效应升至近50%；(5) 清洁与化石能源间替代弹性低，绿色转型灵活性有限；(6) 日本供给侧结构和技术进步不足以支撑长期能源-增长脱钩。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将能源作为中间投入纳入CES框架，扩展了标准生产函数对能源-增长关系的刻画；(2) 首次系统量化日本经济层面的反弹效应；(3) 引入时间变化的技术进步偏向和技术体制转换，丰富了技术偏向进步理论在能源经济学的应用；(4) 通过清洁/化石能源分解扩展了能源间替代弹性研究。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为日本能源政策制定提供供给侧结构调整的实证依据；(2) 揭示反弹效应对节能政策的削弱作用，提示政策制定者需重视；(3) 指出日本能源转型灵活性有限，需关注外部能源供应脆弱性；(4) 为能源-增长脱钩的可行性评估提供经验证据。

title: Restoring Size, Losing Power: Coverage Tests at Multi-Step Horizons

detail.title: Restoring Size, Losing Power: Coverage Tests at Multi-Step Horizons

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable — this study involves no human participants, patients, or personal data; all analyses use publicly available market price data and simulated data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Practitioners backtesting multi-step-ahead interval forecasts (H-day Value-at-Risk and related quantilebased risk measures) with the standard Kupiec (1995) and Christoffersen (1998) tests face a known problem: daily rolling evaluation induces (H − 1)-dependence in the violation sequence, and both tests over-reject correctly calibrated models. This size distortion, and its remedy of evaluating on non-overlapping subsamples, is documented in specialized practice — central-counterparty marginmethodology filings, Solvency II rolling-horizon VaR studies, and general multistep predictiveability testing — though it remains under-cited in the mainstream interval-forecasting literature, where daily conditional backtests of multi-week risk measures are still common. We identify and quantify a specific, previously unmeasured trade-off that this remedy does not resolve: we ask whether non-overlapping subsampling, known to restore nominal size, also restores usable power, and find that for the conditional (independence) test it does not. In a Monte Carlo study at horizon H = 90, the Christoffersen test rejects a perfectly calibrated model in 100% of daily replications and over half at a 30-day step (against a nominal 5%); size is restored only near s = 2H/3, but at that same step, against a genuinely clustered alternative — a two-state Markov volatility process with unconditionally correct 80% coverage — the test’s rejection rate falls to 4.7% (s = 60) and 2.8% (s = 90), at or below its own nominal size. Conditional coverage testing at multi-step horizons is therefore caught between near-certain false rejection at short evaluation steps and negligible power against horizon-scale clustering at the steps where size is controlled. A decomposition experiment using genuinely independent, non-overlapping blocks rules out the natural objection that this is merely a small-sample artefact: power remains near nominal even at 500 independent evaluation blocks, and instead depends on the ratio of the clustering process’s timescale to the horizon H — recovering sharply once regimes are long relative to H, but remaining negligible whenever clustering operates on a timescale comparable to or shorter than the forecast horizon itself, which is the empirically relevant case for volatility persistence evaluated at quarterly-or-longer horizons. This is, to our knowledge, a previously unquantified characterization of when conditional coverage testing at multi-step horizons is informative. We derive a closed-form analytical approximation for the mechanism, confirm the power ceiling is robust to a duration-based alternative test statistic and to a twelve-point sensitivity grid over regime persistence and severity, evaluate a constructive HAC/fixed-b correction and quantify its own limits, and reproduce the entire pattern empirically on a fully causal classical GARCH(1,1)-t system for Bitcoin, Brent crude, and EUR/USD. We close with a scope-limited protocol and a full literature positioning relative to CCP margin practice, insuranceregulatory rolling-horizon studies, and recent robust multistep testing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多步预测区间（如90天VaR）在实际回测中面临的大小失真与功效不足的两难困境。研究发现，标准Kupiec和Christoffersen检验在每日滚动评估时严重过度拒绝正确校准的模型；采用非重叠子样本可恢复名义大小，但条件（独立性）检验的功效几乎丧失——在规模被控制的时间步长（s=2H/3）上，对真实波动聚集备择假设的拒绝率仅4.7%（s=60）和2.8%（s=90），低于名义水平。作者通过蒙特卡洛实验、解析近似、HAC/fixed-b修正以及比特币、布伦特原油和EUR/USD的实际数据验证，揭示了条件覆盖检验在多步预测区间上的根本局限，并提出了范围受限的实用协议。
AI.research_question: 当采用非重叠子样本方法来恢复多步预测区间条件覆盖检验的名义大小后，该检验是否仍能保持可用的统计功效？更具体地说，条件覆盖检验在多大程度上受限于"短评估步长导致过度拒绝vs长评估步长导致功效丧失"的两难困境？
AI.motivation: 标准Kupiec和Christoffersen检验在每日滚动评估多步（H天）预测区间时会产生(H-1)阶自相关的违规序列，导致严重过度拒绝正确校准的模型。虽然从业者已知非重叠子样本可修复大小失真，但该修复是否以牺牲功效为代价尚未被量化。由于主流文献中仍常见对多周风险度量进行每日条件回测，这一问题的规模和机理需要被严格刻画和量化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Kupiec (1995)和Christoffersen (1998)的经典区间预测检验框架；非重叠子样本评估方法；马尔可夫两状态波动率过程作为备择假设；固定b（fixed-b）HAC修正；GARCH(1,1)-t模型用于实证验证。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟（H=90天，多种评估步长s）；非重叠子样本分解实验（500个独立块）；闭式解析近似推导；十二点敏感性网格分析；替代检验统计量（duration-based）验证；HAC/fixed-b修正评估；对比特币、布伦特原油、EUR/USD的GARCH(1,1)-t实证复现。
AI.findings: (1) 在H=90时，Christoffersen检验在每日滚动评估下对正确校准模型100%拒绝（名义5%）；(2) 仅在s≈2H/3时大小才恢复，但此时对真实聚集备择的拒绝率降至4.7%（s=60）和2.8%（s=90），低于名义大小；(3) 独立块实验排除了小样本伪象——即使500个独立块，功效仍接近名义水平；(4) 功效取决于聚类过程时间尺度与预测区间的比率——当制度持续时间远大于H时功效迅速恢复，但当聚类时间尺度与预测区间相当或更短时（对季频或更长预测区间上的波动持续性而言是经验相关情形），功效可忽略不计；(5) 解析近似、敏感性网格和HAC修正均确认该功效上限是稳健的。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化了非重叠子样本修复在条件覆盖检验中"恢复大小但牺牲功效"的特定权衡；识别了此前未被量化的条件——多步预测区间条件覆盖检验何时具有信息量；提供了该机制的第一个闭式解析近似；确立了功效取决于聚类时间尺度与预测区间之比这一新的理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CCP（中央对手方）保证金、Solvency II滚动期VaR和金融机构多步风险回测提供了范围受限的实践协议；明确警示在季频或更长预测区间上对波动持续性进行条件覆盖检验的局限；量化了HAC/fixed-b修正的适用边界；将分散于专业实践领域的检验方法问题系统化，为主流区间预测文献提供了清晰的文献定位。

title: Quantum Field Theory and VIX Dynamics: Implications for Establishing a VIX Microstructure Systemic Risk Management System

detail.title: Quantum Field Theory and VIX Dynamics: Implications for Establishing a VIX Microstructure Systemic Risk Management System
detail.abstract: This paper is the third in a series applying physics-inspired formalisms to VIX microstructure for systemic-risk analysis. Paper I described the microstructure's instantaneous state — entropy, enthalpy, effective temperature, and Gibbs free energy computed from a single snapshot of the term-structure curve. Paper II described how a single such state evolves, modeling the curve as a normalized “financial wave function” advancing under a Schrödinger-type equation. Both share a structural limitation of single-particle quantum mechanics: a fixed set of contracts, a conserved “particle number.” This paper instead recasts the microstructure as a field φ(T,t) with a 15 variable number of degrees of freedom — contracts are created and destroyed at listing and expiry — governed by a Euclidean action with curvature, mass, and quartic self-interaction terms. This paper completes a three-paper arc—from equilibrium thermodynamics (Paper I) to wave mechanics (Paper II)—by recasting the VIX Microstructure as a quantum field. We define the deviation field 𝜑(𝑇,𝑡) = ln 𝐹 (𝑇,𝑡) − ln 𝐹0 (𝑇,𝑡) over the maturity continuum, decompose it via the Karhunen–Loève expansion—which we prove is mathematically identical to the mode decomposition of a Gaussian free field—and construct a Fock space of occupation numbers 𝑛𝑘 (𝑡) = 𝑞𝑘 2 /𝜆𝑘 for each excitation mode. Roll events and shock repricings are interpreted as creation–annihilation events. We estimate the propagator (mode lifetimes, crossmaturity information cone with finite propagation speed), the renormalization group flow under Wilsonian coarse-graining (showing higher-order modes—curvature and beyond—are irrelevant operators, providing the first field-theoretic explanation for why three-factor term-structure models suffice), and an Onsager–Machlup effective potential whose double-well structure (contango/backwardation attractors separated by a barrier) allows a Kramers tunneling rate that quantifies—rather than merely illustrates—the “financial quantum tunneling” identified qualitatively in Paper II. All layers integrate into a five-layer systemic-risk confirmation framework.

AI.tldr: 本文是系列论文的第三篇，将VIX微结构重新表述为量子场论，通过场φ(T,t)描述具有可变数目的自由度（合约的创建与消亡），构建Fock空间、估计传播子、重整化群流和Onsager-Machlup有效势，最终整合成一个五层系统性风险确认框架。
AI.research_question: 如何将VIX微结构从单粒子量子力学（固定合约集、守恒粒子数）推广到量子场论框架，以处理合约创建与消亡的可变自由度，并量化系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 前两篇论文（热力学和波动力学）受限于单粒子量子力学的结构局限：合约集固定、"粒子数"守恒。现实中合约在上市和到期时被创建和销毁，需要场论框架来描述这一动态过程，并为"金融量子隧穿"提供定量刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子场论（Euclidean action、Fock空间、重整化群）、Karhunen–Loève展开与高斯自由场模式分解的等价性、Onsager–Machlup有效势、Kramers隧穿率理论。
AI.method: 将偏差场φ(T,t) = ln F(T,t) − ln F0(T,t)定义为成熟度连续统上的场，通过Karhunen–Loève展开进行模式分解（证明其与高斯自由场模式分解数学等价），构建Fock空间占据数，估计传播子（模式寿命、跨成熟度信息锥）、Wilsonian重整化群流、以及双阱结构的Onsager–Machlup有效势。
AI.findings: 高阶模式（曲率及以上）是无关算子，首次从场论角度解释了为何三因子期限结构模型足够；双阱有效势（期货溢价/现货溢价吸引子被势垒分隔）使Kramers隧穿率能量化"金融量子隧穿"；所有分析层整合为五层系统性风险确认框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将VIX微结构完整表述为量子场论，完成了从平衡态热力学→波动力学→量子场论的三部曲；提供三因子期限结构模型充分性的场论解释；将"金融量子隧穿"从定性描述提升为基于Kramers率的定量指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供五层系统性风险确认框架，可用于实际的系统性风险监测与预警；通过场论框架理解合约生命周期（上市/到期）对VIX微结构的影响。

title: Kramer vs. Kramer: On the Importance of Children and Divorce Filings for Understanding Divorce Rates in the U.S
affiliations: Autonomous University of Barcelona

detail.title: Kramer vs. Kramer: On the Importance of Children and Divorce Filings for Understanding Divorce Rates in the U.S

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationships

detail.abstract: U.S. divorce rates followed a hump shape from 1960 to 2015 while wife filed divorces fell from 70 to 56 percent. I use filing records to identify marital quality by gender in a model of endogenous marriage and unilateral divorce. Disciplining the model to match 1970 divorce filing moments, the hump and decline in wife filings emerge as out of sample predictions. Rising female wages drive two effects: a direct effect raising women’s divorce value in the first half and selection into better marriages thus less divorces in the second. Paternal custody explains wife filing trends. Ignoring filing moments fails to generate the hump.

AI.tldr: 本文利用离婚申请记录（filing records）来识别婚姻质量中的性别差异，构建了一个内生婚姻与单方离婚（unilateral divorce）模型。以1970年离婚申请数据校准模型后，成功预测了1960-2015年美国离婚率的驼峰形态以及妻子提出离婚比例从70%下降至56%的趋势。女性工资上升驱动两种效应：前半段直接提高女性离婚价值推高离婚率，后半段通过选择进入更优质婚姻降低离婚率。父亲监护权解释了妻子提出离婚比例的下降趋势。若忽略申请记录则无法生成离婚率的驼峰形态。
AI.research_question: 如何解释美国1960-2015年离婚率呈现先升后降的驼峰形态，以及妻子提出离婚比例从70%下降至56%这一双重现象？
AI.motivation: 现有离婚率研究通常只关注总体离婚率的时间趋势，忽视了"谁提出离婚"这一蕴含婚姻质量性别差异的重要信息。离婚申请记录（filing records）能够揭示婚姻中男性和女性各自面临的匹配质量，为解释离婚率动态变化及其性别不对称性提供新的识别来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生婚姻选择模型与单方离婚（unilateral divorce）模型，结合婚姻匹配质量理论，通过离婚申请记录识别婚姻质量的性别差异。
AI.method: 构建包含内生婚姻形成与单方离婚的定量模型，利用离婚申请记录识别婚姻质量的性别维度，以1970年离婚申请矩条件校准模型，并对1960-2015年的离婚率与妻子申请比例进行样本外预测。
AI.findings: （1）模型成功复制了离婚率的驼峰形态和妻子提出离婚比例的下降趋势；（2）女性工资上升产生两种效应：前半段提高女性离婚外部选项直接推高离婚率，后半段促使女性选择进入更高质量的婚姻从而降低离婚率；（3）父亲监护权（paternal custody）安排解释了妻子提出离婚比例的下降；（4）忽略申请记录信息则模型无法生成驼峰形态的离婚率。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次利用离婚申请记录作为婚姻质量性别差异的识别来源，丰富了婚姻经济学中对"谁提出离婚"的理论解释；（2）揭示了女性工资上升对离婚率的双重不对称效应（直接效应与选择效应），深化了对女性经济独立与婚姻稳定性关系的理论理解；（3）将父亲监护权制度纳入离婚动态的理论框架，补充了家庭法与婚姻市场互动的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者理解离婚率动态变化提供了更精确的机制解释，特别是区分了女性工资上涨与家庭制度（如监护权安排）对离婚趋势的影响；（2）提示离婚申请数据作为政策评估与家庭制度研究的统计价值；（3）对家庭法改革（如监护权制度设计）影响婚姻稳定性和两性离婚行为的政策含义提供了量化依据。

title: The Politics of Plunder From Asset Stripping under Al-Ingaz to Sabotage Capitalism -The RSF Invasion of Khartoum as Strategic Sabotage (1989-2024)
affiliations: Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Politics of Plunder From Asset Stripping under Al-Ingaz to Sabotage Capitalism -The RSF Invasion of Khartoum as Strategic Sabotage (1989-2024)
detail.abstract: This extended edition builds upon the original analysis of systematic privatization and asset stripping under Omar al-Bashir's Al-Ingaz Regime (1989–2019) and introduces a new theoretical contribution: the Theory of Sabotage Capitalism to explain the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) invasion of Khartoum in April 2023. Drawing on political theories of state capture (Hellman et al., 2000), kleptocracy (Enough Project, 2017), rentier state formation (Mahdavy, 1970; Beblawi and Luciani, 1987), the political marketplace framework (de Waal, 2016), and the regime's own doctrine of Tamkeen (empowerment), the paper argues that privatization served not as economic liberalization but as a mechanism of authoritarian consolidation. The paper documents the transfer of over 110 state assets—including sovereign territory, national infrastructure, agricultural schemes, industrial facilities, financial institutions, and public lands—to regime loyalists, security institutions, and foreign investors. It demonstrates how the Bashir regime weaponized privatization to achieve elite enrichment, patronage financing, and militarization of the economy. The central new argument is that the RSF invasion of Khartoum inflicted damage consistent with pure sabotage, not a classical coup d'état to control the state. Through systematic looting of banks, destruction of industrial zones, burning of archives and land registries, targeting of hospitals and universities, and dismantling of power and water infrastructure, the RSF campaign represents a continuity of plunder by other means: when asset stripping through legal privatization was no longer possible after 2019, the same networks shifted to direct physical plunder and infrastructural sabotage. This paper develops a formal theory of strategic sabotage as the terminal stage of Tamkeen.

AI.tldr: 本文在原有关于巴希尔"救国革命"政权（1989-2019）系统性私有化与资产剥离分析的基础上，提出"破坏资本主义"理论来解释2023年4月快速支援部队（RSF）对喀土穆的入侵。论文认为私有化并非经济自由化，而是威权巩固的工具；RSF的入侵行为符合纯粹破坏而非经典政变，是2019年后合法资产剥离不再可行时，同一网络转向直接物理掠夺和基础设施破坏的延续，即"塔姆金"（赋能）的终极阶段。
AI.research_question: 如何解释快速支援部队（RSF）2023年4月入侵喀土穆的行为性质？这一入侵与巴希尔政权的系统性私有化及资产剥离之间存在怎样的连续性关系？
AI.motivation: 现有分析将私有化视为经济自由化，但本文认为在苏丹背景下私有化是威权巩固的工具。同时，RSF入侵喀土穆的行为既有解释框架（如经典政变理论）无法充分理解其大规模破坏性，需要新的理论工具来阐明其本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文整合了多个政治理论框架，包括：国家俘获理论（Hellman等，2000）、窃贼统治理论（Enough Project, 2017）、食利国家理论（Mahdavy, 1970；Beblawi和Luciani, 1987）、政治市场框架（de Waal, 2016），以及政权自身的"塔姆金"（赋能）学说。
AI.method: 基于文献分析和案例研究，文档记录了超过110项国有资产（包括主权领土、国家基础设施、农业计划、工业设施、金融机构和公共土地）向政权忠诚者、安全机构和外国投资者的转移过程，并以此为基础进行理论建构。
AI.findings: 研究发现：第一，巴希尔政权将私有化武器化，以实现精英致富、侍从政治融资和经济军事化；第二，RSF入侵喀土穆的行为（系统抢劫银行、摧毁工业区、焚烧档案和土地登记簿、袭击医院和大学、破坏电力供水基础设施）符合纯粹破坏而非控制国家的经典政变；第三，这一入侵是掠夺的延续——当2019年后通过合法私有化进行资产剥离不再可能时，同一网络转向直接物理掠夺和基础设施破坏。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提出了原创性的"破坏资本主义"（Sabotage Capitalism）理论，将战略破坏概念化为"塔姆金"（赋能）的终极阶段，拓展了对威权政权经济策略演变的理解，弥合了合法化资产剥离与直接暴力掠夺之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文为理解和应对苏丹冲突提供了分析框架，有助于国际社会识别威权政权私有化背后的真实动机，并为理解后威权时期政治暴力的延续性、冲突预防和战后重建提供了政策启示。

title: Sovereign Clinical Compute: Capital Formation, Computational Sovereignty, and the Economics of Infrastructure Control

detail.title: Sovereign Clinical Compute: Capital Formation, Computational Sovereignty, and the Economics of Infrastructure Control

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Founder & Chief Architect of Living Cipher LLC, whose work includes semiconductor, trust, infrastructure, and architecture-to-capital analysis. This affiliation may be relevant to readers’ interpretation of the subject matter. The analysis and conclusions presented in this paper are the author’s own.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is an architectural, economic, and policy analysis. It does not report research involving human participants, patient data, clinical interventions, or identifiable health information. Institutional ethics approval was therefore not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for the preparation of this paper.

detail.abstract: Artificial-intelligence infrastructure is often discussed as a capacity problem: more connectivity, more data centers, more accelerators, more cloud access. For clinically consequential systems in capital-constrained markets, that framing is incomplete. The financing instrument, ownership structure, operating authority, key custody, portability, derivative rights, local engineering capability, and compute location jointly determine who captures the economic value created by the system. This paper extends the irreversibility framework developed in Living Cipher Analysis 001 from custom silicon to infrastructure. It asks not simply whether capital can finance compute, but what becomes difficult to reverse when a particular form of capital finances a particular architecture. The analysis separates data sovereignty, compute sovereignty, and economic sovereignty; develops a risk-adjusted comparison of infrastructure-financing structures; connects policy and capital formation to bedside, edge, regional, and accelerator architecture; and establishes decision gates for determining when external capital accelerates useful deployment without transferring disproportionate control or future economic upside. The central proposition is that capital architecture and compute architecture are the same decision viewed from opposite ends of the system. The relevant question is not merely who will finance the infrastructure. It is what the financing causes the architecture-and the future bargaining position-to become.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Living Cipher Analysis 001中提出的不可逆性框架，将分析从定制芯片扩展到人工智能基础设施。论文主张资本架构与计算架构是同一决策的两面，融资方式不仅决定谁能建造基础设施，更决定了系统架构和未来议价地位的不可逆改变，从而影响谁最终捕获经济价值。
AI.research_question: 当特定形式的资本为特定计算架构提供融资时，什么变得难以逆转？不同的基础设施融资结构如何影响数据主权、计算主权和经济主权的分配？
AI.motivation: 人工智能基础设施常被框定为容量问题（更多连接、更多数据中心、更多加速器），但在资本受限市场中具有临床意义的人工智能系统，这一框架是不完整的。融资工具、所有权结构、运营权限、托管权、可移植性、衍生权利、本地工程能力和计算位置共同决定了谁能捕获系统创造的经济价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Living Cipher Analysis 001中开发的不可逆性框架，将其从定制硅片扩展到基础设施层面；区分数据主权、计算主权和经济主权三个维度。
AI.method: 概念分析：进行风险调整的基础设施融资结构比较；将政策与资本形成连接到床头（bedside）、边缘、区域和加速器架构；建立决策门控（decision gates）用于判断外部资本何时能加速有价值的部署而不转移不成比例的控制权或未来经济上行收益。
AI.findings: 核心命题是资本架构和计算架构是系统两端看到的同一决策。关键问题不仅是谁将融资基础设施，而是融资会促使架构——以及未来议价地位——变成什么样子。
AI.theory_contributions: 将不可逆性框架从定制硅片扩展到人工智能基础设施层面；提出数据主权、计算主权和经济主权的三维区分；建立资本架构与计算架构的统一分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资本受限市场中临床人工智能系统的融资决策提供决策门控框架；帮助判断外部资本何时能加速部署而不会转移过多控制权或未来经济收益；为政策制定和资本形成提供与具体计算架构相连的分析工具。

title: The Environmental Cost of Place-Based Industrial Policy: Evidence from Industrial Zones in Vietnam
affiliations: KDI School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: The Environmental Cost of Place-Based Industrial Policy: Evidence from Industrial Zones in Vietnam

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP26-15
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the environmental impacts of industrial zones in Vietnam. Exploiting the staggered establishment of over 300 zones in the last two decades, I first show that their operation roughly doubles satellite-detected industrial combustion within 5 km of the centroids. Using wind-driven variation in downwind exposure to distinguish the zones' downwind contribution from background pollution, I then find that zone operation raises ambient PM2.5 for nearby populations by 0.70 µg/m 3 , implying a 25-day loss of life expectancy per exposed person. This effect is not fixed: it is largest in a zone's early years, attenuates with age, and is indistinguishable from zero for the most recent cohort. A scale-composition-technique decomposition attributes the variation to a shift in the sectoral mix toward lighter manufacturing, rather than to cleaner production within firms or larger scale, unlike the technique-driven emission reductions documented in advanced economies. These findings suggest that where enforcement is weak, the pollution a zone generates depends mainly on the industries it attracts.

AI.tldr: 本文利用越南过去二十年中300多个工业区交错设立的自然实验，评估其环境影响。研究发现工业园区运营使5公里内的卫星检测工业燃烧翻倍，并使附近居民PM2.5暴露增加0.70 µg/m³，相当于每人损失25天预期寿命。该效应并非恒定：在园区早期最大，随时间衰减，最新一批园区的影响与零无显著差异。通过规模-构成-技术分解，发现变化主要源于产业构成向更轻型制造业转移，而非企业内部清洁生产或规模扩大，这与发达经济体以技术驱动的减排形成对比。
AI.research_question: 越南工业园区的设立和运营对当地环境（特别是空气污染）产生多大影响？这种影响在不同时期和不同园区之间如何变化？其背后的驱动机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着新兴经济体大量设立工业园区以促进工业化，其环境代价尚不明确。与发达经济体不同，发展中国家的环境执法往往较弱，因此需要理解在这种制度背景下工业园区污染的真实规模和决定因素，以指导政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境库兹涅茨曲线与产业转型理论；规模-构成-技术（scale-composition-technique）分解框架；污染暴露与健康影响评估模型；风驱动污染扩散模型
AI.method: 利用越南300多个工业区交错设立作为准自然实验（staggered difference-in-differences）；使用卫星遥感数据检测工业燃烧；利用风向来区分工业区的下风向污染贡献与背景污染；采用规模-构成-技术分解方法分析污染变化的驱动因素。
AI.findings: （1）工业园区运营使5公里内卫星检测的工业燃烧约翻倍；（2）园区运营使附近居民PM2.5增加0.70 µg/m³，人均预期寿命损失25天；（3）污染效应在园区早期最大，随园区年龄增长而衰减，最新一批园区影响不显著；（4）污染变化的驱动因素主要是产业构成向轻型制造业倾斜，而非企业内部清洁生产技术或更大规模。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统性地评估了发展中国家工业园区设立的环境影响；（2）通过规模-构成-技术分解揭示了在弱执法环境下，产业构成而非技术升级是污染变化的主要驱动力，这不同于发达经济体的技术驱动路径；（3）将交错设立的自然实验方法应用于环境经济学中的工业园区评估。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为越南及其他新兴经济体工业园区的环境监管提供实证依据；（2）表明在执法薄弱的环境中，园区吸引的产业类型是决定污染水平的关键因素，应通过产业准入政策（而非仅依赖技术标准）来控制污染；（3）提供了园区污染导致的健康损失量化估计，有助于成本效益分析。

title: Money Demand stability: A Changepoint Exploration in Dependence Structure
affiliations: , University of Glasgow, University of Calgary - Department of Economics and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Money Demand stability: A Changepoint Exploration in Dependence Structure
detail.abstract: This study employs the copula technique to examine potential instabilities in the dependence structure of the money demand function. This approach allows for modeling overall dependence while relaxing the linearity assumption used in previous studies. Our results indicate that elliptical copulas are best suited for modeling the dependence structure of money demand function based on traditional simple-sum measures (Sum M2), whereas Archimedean copulas perform better for Divisia monetary aggregates (Divisia M2, M4). Changepoint analysis of the univariate time series of the copula parameter identifies two breakpoints in the dependence structure of the simple-sum measures, occurring in the early 1980s and around the 2000s, which correspond to the beginning and end of the Great Moderation period. For the Divisia measures, we identify three changepoints. The first two, occurring in the mid-1980s and mid-1990s, are detected consistently in both Divisia M2 and Divisia M4 and are therefore identified with high confidence. The third changepoint, however, is less conclusive, as it is identified at 2017:Q4 for Divisia M2 and at 2013:Q1 for Divisia M4. An examination of stability measures does not conclusively support the conventional view that Divisia measures exhibit superior stability properties.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用copula技术考察货币需求函数依赖结构的潜在不稳定性，该方法能够在放松线性假设的同时建模整体依赖关系。研究发现椭圆copula最适合简单加总（Sum M2）货币需求函数的依赖结构，而Archimedean copula更适合Divisia货币总量（Divisia M2, M4）。变点分析识别出简单加总度量在1980年代初和2000年前后有两个结构变点（对应大稳健时期的开始与结束），而Divisia度量则识别出三个变点，但稳定性检验并未有力支持Divisia度量稳定性更优的传统观点。
AI.research_question: 货币需求函数的依赖结构是否存在不稳定性？不同货币度量（简单加总vs Divisia）的依赖结构及其结构性变点有何差异？
AI.motivation: 以往研究通常假设货币需求函数各变量之间具有线性依赖关系，这一假设可能过于严格。此外，关于简单加总与Divisia货币度量哪个更具稳定性存在争议，需要更灵活的建模方法加以检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: Copula理论（椭圆copula和Archimedean copula）、货币需求理论、变点分析理论
AI.method: 采用copula技术对货币需求函数中各变量间的依赖结构进行建模，比较椭圆copula与Archimedean copula的拟合效果；并对copula参数的单变量时间序列进行变点分析以识别依赖结构的结构变化。
AI.findings: （1）椭圆copula最适合Sum M2的依赖结构，Archimedean copula更适合Divisia M2和M4；（2）Sum M2在1980年代初和2000年前后存在两个变点，对应大稳健时期的开始与结束；（3）Divisia度量识别出三个变点，其中两个（1980年代中期和1990年代中期）在两个Divisia指标中一致出现；（4）稳定性检验并未有力支持Divisia度量稳定性更优的传统观点。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将copula技术应用于货币需求函数依赖结构的建模，突破了以往线性依赖假设的限制，为依赖结构的不稳定性分析提供了新的方法论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策的制定提供参考：变点分析揭示的依赖结构变化时间点（与大稳健时期对应）有助于理解货币需求行为的结构性变化，对货币总量指标的选择和货币政策传导机制的评估具有实践意义。

title: NSCAT: LLM-Driven Firewall Configuration Auditing with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based NIST SP 800-53 Mapping and Automated Security Operations Centre Delivery
affiliations: , National University of Sciences and Technology, Pakistan, National University of Sciences and Technology, Pakistan, National University of Medical Sciences and National University of Sciences and Technology, Pakistan

detail.title: NSCAT: LLM-Driven Firewall Configuration Auditing with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based NIST SP 800-53 Mapping and Automated Security Operations Centre Delivery
detail.abstract: Firewall configuration auditing across enterprise environments remains manual and time-intensive. Commercial platforms are proprietary, expensive and provide pass or fail verdicts without Large Language Model (LLM)-driven reasoning or Security Operations Centre (SOC) integration. Published systems do not offer multi-vendor configuration retrieval, LLM-based auditing, NIST SP 800-53 mapping and SOC dispatch within a single automated pipeline. We propose Network Security Configuration Audit Tool (NSCAT), an LLM-driven methodology that normalises six-vendor configurations into a 34-field Canonical Data Model (CDM), audits them with 36 LLMs across six providers and maps every finding to the 1,014-control NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 catalogue. A Verified or AI-inferred tagging mechanism marks each finding by line-level match against its source configuration, surfacing unverifiable LLM outputs. Completed audits auto-dispatch severity-tagged alerts to Wazuh Security Information & Event Management (SIEM) and email network-team reports via Shuffle Security Orchestration, Automation & Response (SOAR) under auditor and operations access separation. Across 303 audits, NSCAT surfaces 2,231 unique findings with zero score-extraction failures, 99.34% PDF generation, 99.96% RAG retrieval success rate (a control returned for every finding), and 100% per-attempt SOC delivery. On a 100-finding ground truth, top-1 mapping precision (correct-control rate) is 27% strict, 39% lenient; 37.7% are Verified and 62.3% are AI-inferred (n=231, post-deployment). Median audit-to-notification latency is 21 seconds, six orders of magnitude below the 180-day PCI DSS v4.0.1 Requirement 1.2.7 Network Security Control (NSC) review cadence. NSCAT is the first to measure NIST SP 800-53 mapping precision against ground truth and compress this cadence on open-source infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NSCAT（网络安全配置审计工具），这是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化网络防火墙配置审计方法，能够跨六种厂商的配置进行标准化、审计、映射到NIST SP 800-53控制目录，并通过SIEM/SOAR自动派发告警，大幅缩短审计周期。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个集多厂商配置检索、LLM驱动审计、NIST SP 800-53映射和SOC派发于单一自动化流水线中的网络安全配置审计工具？
AI.motivation: 企业环境中的防火墙配置审计仍然依赖人工且耗时；商业平台专有、昂贵且仅提供通过/失败的判决，缺乏LLM驱动的推理和SOC集成；现有公开发表系统无法在同一自动化流水线中提供多厂商配置检索、LLM审计、NIST映射和SOC派发功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于LLM驱动的配置审计理论框架，结合NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5安全控制目录、规范数据模型（CDM）标准化方法、RAG（检索增强生成）技术、以及SIEM/SOAR安全自动化编排架构。
AI.method: NSCAT采用多阶段流水线方法：（1）将六种厂商配置规范化为34字段的规范数据模型（CDM）；（2）使用36个LLM（来自六家提供商）进行配置审计；（3）将每个发现映射到包含1014项控制的NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5目录；（4）采用验证或AI推断标签机制进行逐行匹配标记；（5）通过Wazuh SIEM和Shuffle SOAR自动派发严重性标记的告警。通过303次审计、100项发现基准测试和231项部署后数据评估系统性能。
AI.findings: 在303次审计中，NSCAT发现了2231个独特发现，零分数提取失败，PDF生成成功率99.34%，RAG检索成功率99.96%，SOC交付成功率100%。基于100项发现基准，top-1映射精确度为严格27%、宽松39%；37.7%为已验证、62.3%为AI推断。中位审计到通知延迟为21秒，比PCI DSS v4.0.1要求的180天审查周期快六个数量级。
AI.theory_contributions: NSCAT是首个在开源基础设施上衡量NIST SP 800-53映射精确度（对照基准真实值）并压缩审计审查周期的系统，为LLM驱动安全审计领域提供了实证基准和方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: NSCAT为安全运营中心（SOC）提供了开源、多厂商、LLM驱动的配置审计工具，实现了从配置检索到审计、映射、告警派发的全自动化流水线，大幅降低审计延迟（21秒vs180天），并支持验证/推断标签以提高可审计性和信任度。

title: Beyond Labour and Capital: Information as a Fundamental Factor of Production
affiliations: Queen's University Belfast - School of Biological Sciences and Queen's University Belfast - Institute for Global Food Security

detail.title: Beyond Labour and Capital: Information as a Fundamental Factor of Production

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: Here, the classical production model (labour and capital) is recast in terms of fundamental physical inputs: energy flows and the embodied information organising them to perform physical work. Information, as physically embodied pattern, i.e. organisation and structure, is essential to all human technology and even to life itself. All production is essentially the investment of material with physically embodied pattern. Information and energy flow are shown to be substitutable in economic production of all kinds, providing a physical basis for decoupling economic growth from resource consumption. Further, investment in the 'knowledge economy', maintenance sectors and human capital (education and training), can support transition to lower material and energy intensity, meeting both sustainability and human development goals. Broadly, moving from energy and material intensive, towards information intensive economic activity, promotes sustainability without necessarily compromising growth. Suggestions are made for quantifying and motivating such transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文以物理学视角重新诠释古典生产模型，将劳动和资本归结为能量流与承载信息的物质模式，论证信息与能量在各类经济生产中具有可替代性，从而为经济增长与资源消耗脱钩提供物理基础，并提出向信息密集型经济活动转型可同时促进可持续发展和人类发展。
AI.research_question: 如何以物理学视角（能量流与信息的具体体现）重新构建经济生产理论，并论证信息与能量在经济生产中的可替代性，从而为可持续发展的脱钩路径提供理论依据？
AI.motivation: 传统的古典生产模型（劳动和资本）未从根本上解释经济生产中的物理约束，也难以回答经济增长如何与资源消耗脱钩的问题。作者试图从物理学基本输入（能量与信息）出发，为可持续经济增长提供更根本的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于物理学视角的生产理论：将生产视为物质被赋予物理性模式（信息/组织/结构）的过程；信息与能量流在经济生产中具有替代性的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论推演与概念重构：以物理学概念（能量流、物质模式、信息）重新表述古典生产模型，并进行概念性论证与分析。
AI.findings: 1. 信息与能量在经济生产中可相互替代；2. 这为经济增长与资源消耗脱钩提供了物理基础；3. 投资于知识经济、维护部门和人力资本可降低物质和能源强度；4. 从能源/物质密集型向信息密集型经济活动转型可促进可持续性而不必然损害增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 以物理学视角重构古典生产理论，将信息作为基本生产投入引入经济分析，提出了信息与能量替代性的理论框架，为经济脱钩理论提供了物理学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化与激励生产转型的建议，指导投资于知识经济、维护部门和人力资本，以推动向低物质能源强度的经济模式过渡，兼顾可持续性与发展目标。

title: Generative AI and CEO Compensation
affiliations: Peking University HSBC Business School and

detail.title: Generative AI and CEO Compensation
detail.abstract: We study how generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) reshapes CEO compensation contracts. Exploiting the public release of ChatGPT and cross-sectional variation in firms' pre-shock GenAI exposure, we find that GenAI increases CEO pay, primarily through equity-based compensation. The effects are stronger with tech-savvy boards and in more competitive CEO labor markets. A shock-based instrumental variables design identifies labor cost reductions and increased firm uncertainty as two channels through which GenAI drives compensation redesign. GenAI-induced labor displacement creates surplus that raises agency concerns, while greater uncertainty increases the need for long-term risk-taking incentives. Consistent with these contracting needs, firms tie CEO pay to longer-horizon performance, reduce reliance on short-term accounting measures, and increase CEO Delta and Vega. Compensation adjustments through both channels predict higher future firm value and facilitate more efficient internal resource allocation. The results are robust to alternative specifications and tests distinguishing GenAI from broader labor-saving technologies. Overall, our findings support optimal contracting rather than managerial rent extraction and highlight compensation redesign as a governance mechanism that facilitates firms' efficient adaptation to GenAI.

AI.tldr: 本文利用ChatGPT的发布作为自然实验，研究生成式人工智能（GenAI）如何重塑CEO薪酬合约。研究发现GenAI增加了CEO薪酬，主要通过股权薪酬实现，其机制包括劳动力成本降低（引发代理问题）和不确定性增加（需要长期风险激励），最终通过重新设计薪酬合约促进企业更高效地适应GenAI。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）如何重塑CEO薪酬合约？其背后的经济机制是什么？
AI.motivation: GenAI的快速普及正在深刻改变企业运营模式，但现有研究对其如何影响高管薪酬设计缺乏系统证据。理解GenAI冲击下薪酬合约的调整方向及其效率含义，对于公司治理和薪酬监管具有重要现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优契约理论（Optimal Contracting Theory）；代理理论（Agency Theory）；劳动力替代与效率工资理论；不确定性风险激励理论
AI.method: 采用ChatGPT公开发布作为外生冲击，利用企业事前GenAI暴露度的横截面差异构建准自然实验（双重差分框架）；使用基于冲击的工具变量（IV）设计识别劳动力成本降低和企业不确定性增加两个机制渠道；并进行了多种稳健性检验以区分GenAI与更广泛的节约劳动力技术。
AI.findings: （1）GenAI显著提高CEO总薪酬，主要来自股权薪酬；（2）效应在技术娴熟的董事会和更具竞争性的CEO劳动力市场中更强；（3）劳动力成本降低和不确定性增加是两条传导渠道；（4）企业将CEO薪酬与更长业绩期限挂钩，减少短期会计指标依赖，提高Delta和Vega；（5）薪酬调整与企业未来价值和内部资源分配效率正相关，支持最优契约而非管理层寻租解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了代理理论和最优契约理论在技术冲击背景下的适用性；首次系统揭示GenAI通过劳动力替代和不确定性两条渠道影响薪酬设计的机制；为"薪酬合约作为公司治理机制促进技术适应"提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业董事会设计适应AI时代的CEO薪酬合约提供指导；为政策制定者理解GenAI劳动力冲击下的高管激励设计提供参考；为投资者评估AI技术冲击下的公司治理质量提供分析框架。

title: Research on Han Nationalism in China in the 2020s (IV): Why Chinese Scholars Rarely Discuss Han Nationalism

detail.title: Research on Han Nationalism in China in the 2020s (IV): Why Chinese Scholars Rarely Discuss Han Nationalism
detail.abstract: This article is one of a series of papers examining Han nationalist ideology in China in the 2020s. It seeks to explore the phenomenon whereby discourse related to Han nationalism has increased in Chinese online space in recent years, yet has rarely been treated as an independent object of inquiry within China's mainstream social-science research system. The article argues that this phenomenon does not simply stem from a lack of scholarly attention, but is related to the operating environment of Chinese social science. Analyzing academic tradition, research frameworks, academic norms, the functions of think tanks, and the situation of scholars, the article points out that Chinese social-science research has long been shaped by existing theoretical systems, modes of resource allocation, and traditions of policy research, making it relatively difficult for certain issues involving ethnic identity, historical memory, and identity competition to form independent research paths. The article further discusses the distance between theoretical systems and public discourse, and how this structure affects the explanatory capacity of Chinese social science with respect to social currents such as Han nationalism. The article does not attempt to provide statistical estimates of the scale or social support for Han nationalism in China; rather, it seeks to pose a question: when a social idea enters the space of public discussion, why does the existing academic system find it difficult to explain the phenomenon adequately?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了2020年代中国网络空间中汉民族主义话语增多，但主流社会科学研究体系却很少将其作为独立研究对象的现象。文章认为这并非单纯缺乏学术关注，而是与中国社会科学的运行环境有关，包括学术传统、研究框架、学术规范、智库功能和学者处境等因素，最终导致学术系统难以充分解释这类社会思潮。
AI.research_question: 当一个社会观念进入公共讨论空间时，为什么现有的学术体系难以充分解释这一现象？具体而言，为什么汉民族主义在中国网络空间日益增多，却未在中国主流社会科学研究体系中被作为独立研究对象？
AI.motivation: 近年来中国网络空间中汉民族主义话语显著增加，但这一现象在中国主流社会科学研究中很少被作为独立研究对象。作者认为这背后存在结构性原因，而非简单的学术疏忽，需要深入探究中国社会科学的运行环境对这一研究空白的塑造作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于对中国社会科学的学术传统、研究框架、学术规范、智库功能及学者处境的分析框架，探讨学术制度环境如何塑造研究议题的产生与缺失。
AI.method: 本文为理论分析/评论性文章，通过对中国社会科学的学术传统、研究框架、学术规范、智库功能及学者处境进行系统分析，而非采用实证或统计方法。
AI.findings: 中国社会科学研究长期受既有理论体系、资源配置模式和政策研究传统所塑造，使得涉及族群认同、历史记忆和认同竞争等议题难以形成独立研究路径。理论体系与公共话语之间存在距离，这一结构影响了中国社会科学对汉民族主义等社会思潮的解释能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文提出了一个关键的理论问题：学术制度环境如何制约社会科学对新兴社会思潮的研究与解释能力，为理解学术研究与公共话语之间的结构性张力提供了分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文有助于反思中国社会科学研究体系的制度性局限，对理解中国网络民族主义现象及其在学术系统中的缺席具有重要意义，为相关领域的学术讨论提供了问题意识。

title: Self-Validating Stability in Matching with Incomplete Information
affiliations: University of Zurich - Department of Economics

detail.title: Self-Validating Stability in Matching with Incomplete Information
detail.abstract: Firms may forecast prospective workers from data generated only when the current matching continues. Forecasts thus determine both which markets continue and which observations update later forecasts. A continuation event is self-validating when its induced forecasts classify exactly that event as unblocked. Recursive reassessment differs from absorbing removal because it can restore previously excluded profiles. In a network model, a positive-probability selfvalidating event exists if and only if every feedback cycle contains an attenuated link, where candidate productivity matters less than incumbent productivity. From the full type space, reassessment converges to the largest such event; under nonexpansive tail forecasts, the event is unique and convergence is global and order independent. With common firm values, existence reduces to acyclicity, convergence is finite, and-under strict rankings and universal acceptability-the admissible assignments are exactly the worker-Pareto-efficient assignments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业如何基于当前匹配持续过程中产生的数据来预测潜在工人，以及这种预测如何反过来决定哪些市场继续存在、哪些观测数据会更新后续预测。文章提出"自我验证事件"的概念，证明在满足特定条件下（每个反馈回路包含一个衰减链接），自我验证事件存在且收敛，并刻画了可行分配的帕累托效率性质。
AI.research_question: 在动态匹配市场中，当企业仅能从当前持续匹配中生成的数据来预测未来工人时，预测如何影响市场延续与后续预测更新？自我验证事件在什么条件下存在并收敛？
AI.motivation: 传统匹配模型假设市场参与者的类型信息是外生给定的，但在许多现实场景中（如平台经济、劳动力市场），企业只能从当前持续匹配中产生的数据来推断候选人的生产率。这种动态反馈循环产生了预测与市场行为相互影响的问题，需要从理论上刻画其均衡性质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态匹配理论、网络模型中的反馈循环分析、自我验证机制设计
AI.method: 构建动态网络模型，引入"自我验证事件"概念（延续事件诱导的预测恰好将该事件分类为未阻塞）；利用反馈循环的拓扑结构分析存在性（充要条件为每个反馈循环包含一个衰减链接）；通过递归重估算法分析收敛性质，并利用非扩张尾部预测建立唯一性和全局收敛结果。
AI.findings: （1）正概率自我验证事件存在的充要条件：每个反馈循环包含一个衰减链接（候选生产率的重要性低于在职者生产率）；（2）从完整类型空间出发，重估收敛到最大的自我验证事件；（3）在非扩张尾部预测下，自我验证事件唯一且全局、顺序无关收敛；（4）当企业价值共同时，存在性简化为无环性，收敛是有限的；（5）在严格排序和普遍可接受性下，可行分配恰好是工人帕累托有效分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统刻画了"预测决定市场延续、市场数据更新预测"这一双向反馈循环下的自我验证均衡；将反馈循环的图论性质与动态匹配均衡的存在性和收敛性联系起来；揭示了递归重估与吸收性移除的本质区别（重估可恢复先前被排除的配置）；建立了自我验证事件、无环性与帕累托效率之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台经济、劳动力匹配等场景中基于历史数据预测候选人的算法设计提供理论指导；帮助企业理解在数据受限的动态环境中，预测算法何时会产生自证预言式的市场结果；为政策制定者识别市场中可能存在的自我验证性排除提供分析工具。

title: factor-shrinkage: Modern Covariance-Shrinkage Estimators for Factor Risk Models in Python

detail.title: factor-shrinkage: Modern Covariance-Shrinkage Estimators for Factor Risk Models in Python
detail.abstract: Commercial factor risk models (Barra, Axioma) decompose the asset covariance matrix as Sigma = B * Omega * B^T + D, where Omega, the K x K factor covariance (K of roughly 20-150 in practice), is typically estimated as a dense, unregularized sample correlation matrix that vendor documentation itself flags as prone to ill-conditioning. cvxportfolio already ships a risk model built on exactly this decomposition, with no shrinkage of Omega applied. Two shrinkage estimators with strong theoretical guarantees - Wasserstein distributionally-robust shrinkage (Nguyen, Kuhn & Mohajerin Esfahani, 2022) and Ledoit & Wolf's nonlinear-shrinkage family (2022) - had no packaged, tested, scikit-learn-compatible implementation targeting this object. This paper introduces factor-shrinkage, which fills that gap with six such estimators behind one consistent interface, validated by 87 tests (property tests from each source paper's proven invariants, independent reference-oracle cross-checks, and full sklearn conformance certification, which itself caught two real bugs). On a real 16-factor equity model, the raw factor covariance is severely ill-conditioned - median condition number 61,406 across 125 real rolling windows, still 8,508 even at four years of daily data - driven by genuine factor collinearity (a 0.934 correlation between a technology-sector industry portfolio and the market factor), not insufficient sample size; Wasserstein shrinkage collapses this to a median of 40.8, roughly a 1,500x improvement, stable across every window length tested. We also report three implementation-level findings surfaced while building the package: a numerically safer closed-form bisection bracket for one estimator's Lagrange multiplier; a confirmed eigenvector-orthogonality bug in an existing open-source reference implementation of a second estimator; and a cross-paper sample-size normalization convention that would have silently broken had the two source papers' formulas been unified under one shared helper.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍factor-shrinkage，一个开源的、scikit-learn兼容的Python包，实现了六种因子协方差矩阵收缩估计器（包括Wasserstein分布鲁棒收缩和Ledoit-Wolf非线性收缩家族），填补了商业因子风险模型（Barra, Axioma）中因子协方差矩阵缺乏正则化估计的空白，并通过87项测试验证其正确性。
AI.research_question: 如何为商业因子风险模型中的K×K因子协方差矩阵提供经过充分测试、可打包、兼容scikit-learn的收缩估计器实现，以解决其严重的病态条件数问题？
AI.motivation: 商业因子风险模型中的因子协方差矩阵通常以稠密、无正则化的样本相关矩阵估计，文档本身也承认其易病态。尽管已有两种具有强理论保证的收缩估计器（Wasserstein分布鲁棒收缩与Ledoit-Wolf非线性收缩），但缺乏打包、测试、兼容scikit-learn的实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: Wasserstein分布鲁棒收缩（Nguyen, Kuhn & Mohajerin Esfahani, 2022）和Ledoit-Wolf非线性收缩估计族（2022）
AI.method: 开发factor-shrinkage包，提供六种收缩估计器的统一接口；通过87项测试验证（包括从源论文的不变量推导的属性测试、独立参考预言机交叉检查、完整sklearn一致性认证）。在真实16因子股权模型上，对125个滚动窗口评估条件数改善。
AI.findings: 真实16因子模型中，原始因子协方差严重病态（中位条件数61,406，即使四年日度数据仍达8,508），源于真实因子共线性（技术行业组合与市场因子相关性达0.934）而非样本量不足；Wasserstein收缩将条件数降至中位数40.8，约1,500倍改善。还发现三个实现层面的发现：更安全的拉格朗日乘子二分法括号、现有开源参考实现中的特征向量正交性bug、跨论文样本量归一化约定的潜在冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 将两种具有理论保证的收缩估计器系统化为统一实现的框架，并通过属性测试验证其理论不变性；报告了实现层面的发现（数值稳定性改进、现有实现的bug、跨论文约定冲突）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供开源的、scikit-learn兼容、经过全面测试的factor-shrinkage包，可直接用于商业因子风险模型，将因子协方差矩阵条件数从61,406降至40.8（约1,500倍改善），提升风险模型的数值稳定性和可靠性。

title: The Economics of the AI Boom
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Economics of the AI Boom
detail.abstract: This paper asks whether the financing of the 2026 artificial-intelligence buildout, measured under conventions that are declared rather than assumed, supports the bubble classification applied to it. Four separable objects travel under the one word: an equity mispricing, a capacity overbuild, a credit structure that depends on continued growth, and an episode of rational uncertainty about which firms capture a new technology’s surplus. Evidence for one is not evidence for another. The empirical base spans 70 reconciled builder firm-quarters, 41 financing structures, 37 country-sector portfolios, 149 valuation observations of 25 mature businesses, and the NBER railroad index, 1857 to 1937, tested against two pre-specified instruments, the Greenwood– Shleifer–You run-up screen and the GSADF explosiveness test, both calibrated on the railroad record before either touches 2026. Under volatility-robust inference the record contains no explosive episode: the test rejects in only 4.3 to 7.5 per cent of simulations, against roughly two-fifths under the homoskedastic alternative. The financing results do not all point one way. Coverage of capital expenditure by operating cash flow fell 64 per cent, from 2.871 times to 1.027, and the external share of builder funding rose from 4.3 to 35.6 per cent. Yet the consolidated, firm-level return on that incremental capital, 20.6 per cent against an 8 to 12 per cent illustrative benchmark, does not support an alarmed reading: the exception, Oracle at 4.5 per cent, is also the most externally financed and lowest-covered of the five, so the credit risk is concentrated, not sector-wide. At its own unit for the first time, the run-up screen flags five of thirty-seven portfolios, firing on United States semiconductors for 24 months, though most of it is too recent to score. Treating the reported equity-round valuation as comparable to enterprise value, given undisclosed net debt, the model layer requires 62.3 per cent compound growth for four years at the median mature multiple, a rate none of 71 comparator windows achieved, though the requirement enters the realised distribution at the top of the observed range, so the broader hypothesis is withdrawn. The financing–asset-life ratio, this paper’s other proposed discriminator, is more convention-dependent: the share of structures whose financing outlives the asset runs zero to two-thirds. A register of the choices that moved printed numbers here runs to forty-seven entries. What follows is a set of dated, checkable conditions under which this analysis, not the market, is wrong.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验2026年人工智能建设热潮是否构成"泡沫"，通过区分四类不同含义的泡沫（股权错误定价、产能过度建设、依赖持续增长的信用结构、以及关于新科技剩余归属的理性不确定性），利用70个公司-季度观测、41个融资结构、37个国家-部门组合、149个估值观测以及1857-1937年铁路指数数据，在预设的两项检验标准下进行严格实证分析。结果显示：在波动率稳健推断下不存在爆炸性泡沫证据（只有4.3-7.5%的模拟拒绝，远低于同方差假设下的约40%）；融资数据指向不一——现金流覆盖下降64%但资本回报率20.6%高于基准；Oracle是信用风险集中而非部门性风险的例外；模型层估值要求62.3%的四年复合增长（高于所有71个比较窗口），但总体假设被撤回。论文最后提供47项选择登记和一组有日期、可检验的条件，说明在何种条件下分析本身而非市场是错误的。
AI.research_question: 2026年人工智能建设的融资（按声明而非假设的惯例衡量）是否支持对其施加的泡沫分类？具体而言，四类可分离的泡沫对象（股权错误定价、产能过度建设、信贷结构、理性不确定性）各自是否得到证据支持？
AI.motivation: "泡沫"一词承载多种含义，而证据往往被不加区分地从一个含义迁移到另一个含义。作者旨在通过区分四种不同的泡沫对象，并采用预设（pre-specified）的检验标准，提供一个更严谨的实证判定框架，避免事后合理化（post-hoc rationalization）的常见陷阱。
AI.theoretical_framework: 泡沫分类理论（区分股权错误定价、产能过度建设、信贷结构依赖、理性不确定性四种类型）；Greenwood-Shleifer-You跑赢筛选（run-up screen）；GSADF爆炸性检验（explosiveness test）；波动率稳健推断（volatility-robust inference）；融资-资产寿命比率（financing-asset-life ratio）作为判别器。
AI.method: 多源实证分析：1) 70个调和后的建造商公司-季度观测与41个融资结构；2) 37个国家-部门组合的组合层面检验；3) 149个估值观测覆盖25家成熟企业；4) 1857-1937年NBER铁路指数用于标定两项预指定检验（Greenwood-Shleifer-You筛选和GSADF检验），在两套假设（波动率稳健与同方差）下运行模拟；5) 提出融资-资产寿命比率作为额外判别器，并附47项影响打印数字的选择登记。
AI.findings: 1) 波动率稳健推断下无爆炸性泡沫证据（拒绝率仅4.3-7.5%，远低于同方差假设的约40%）；2) 融资数据指向不一：资本支出现金流覆盖率从2.871降至1.027（降64%），外部融资占比从4.3%升至35.6%；3) 增量资本回报率20.6%高于8-12%基准，Oracle的4.5%例外同时也是外部融资最高、覆盖率最低者，表明信用风险集中而非部门性；4) run-up筛选首次在自身单位内只标记37个组合中的5个，美国半导体被标记24个月；5) 模型层估值要求62.3%的四年复合增长（中位数成熟倍数下），高于全部71个比较窗口，但该要求位于观测范围顶端，更宽泛假设被撤回；6) 融资-资产寿命比率高度依赖惯例选择，结构占比在0到三分之二间变动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 严格区分四种可分离的"泡沫"含义，论证一种证据不能作为另一种的证据，为泡沫分析提供了更精密的概念框架；2) 确立将检验程序预先在历史基准（铁路指数）上标定的方法论原则，减少事后选择偏差；3) 提出融资-资产寿命比率作为新的判别维度，同时指出其对惯例选择的敏感性；4) 展示了波动率稳健推断如何改变爆炸性检验的结论（拒绝率从约40%降至4.3-7.5%）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者提供了一个可操作的泡沫评估清单：通过区分泡沫类型、检查融资结构的时间匹配、评估回报率与融资依赖的分布（而非总量）、以及使用预设检验标准，投资者和监管者可以避免将一种泡沫证据误用于另一种泡沫判断。同时提供47项选择登记和一组有日期、可检证的反向条件，帮助读者检验论文自身的错误可能而非盲目接受结论。

title: Human-Centred AI Adoption for Sustainable SME Growth in Zimbabwe

detail.title: Human-Centred AI Adoption for Sustainable SME Growth in Zimbabwe
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly transforming how small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) create value, improve operational efficiency, engage customers and compete in digitally enabled markets. However, AI adoption in developing economies cannot be approached solely as a technological implementation challenge. In Zimbabwe, SMEs operate within a context characterised by resource constraints, uneven digital capabilities, infrastructure limitations and persistent digital divides, making a human-centred approach to AI adoption particularly important. Drawing on the human–machine collaboration perspective underpinning the 5th Zimbabwe Conference on Information Communication and Technology (ZCICT), the paper conceptualises AI adoption as a socio-technical process in which human creativity, contextual knowledge, ethical judgement and algorithmic capabilities are integrated rather than treated as competing resources. The paper proposes a conceptual framework linking humancentred AI adoption, digital capabilities, organisational readiness, responsible AI practices and SME innovation to sustainable business growth. Particular attention is given to trust, employee participation, skills development, explainability and context-sensitive implementation as mechanisms through which SMEs can derive inclusive and sustainable value from AI. The proposed framework contributes to the emerging discourse on AI-enabled digital transformation in developing economies by shifting attention from automation alone towards meaningful human– machine collaboration. It further aligns with Zimbabwe's Education 5.0 orientation by emphasising innovation, industrialisation, skills development and the translation of knowledge into practical socio-economic value. The paper argues that sustainable AI adoption among Zimbabwean SMEs requires not only access to AI technologies but also deliberate investment in human capabilities, organisational preparedness and responsible digital transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于人机协作视角，提出一个将人本AI采纳、数字能力、组织准备度、负责任AI实践与中小企业创新及可持续增长相连接的概念框架，强调津巴布韦中小企业在数字鸿沟与资源约束背景下，AI采纳应被视为社会技术过程而非纯技术实施挑战。
AI.research_question: 在发展中国家的资源约束和数字鸿沟背景下，津巴布韦中小企业应如何通过人本化方法实现可持续的AI采纳与商业增长？
AI.motivation: AI正日益改变中小企业的价值创造方式，但在发展中国家（如津巴布韦）中小企业面临资源约束、数字能力不均、基础设施不足和数字鸿沟等独特挑战，AI采纳不能仅被视为技术实施问题，需要人本化的综合视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人机协作视角（human–machine collaboration）；社会技术过程理论；津巴布韦第五届ICT会议（ZCICT）框架；教育5.0（Education 5.0）理念
AI.method: 概念性研究，提出一个连接人本AI采纳、数字能力、组织准备度、负责任AI实践与中小企业创新及可持续业务增长的概念框架。
AI.findings: 提出一个概念框架，指出信任、员工参与、技能发展、可解释性和情境敏感实施是实现AI包容性和可持续价值的关键机制；可持续AI采纳不仅需要技术获取，更需要对人能力、组织准备和负责任数字化转型的刻意投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI采纳的讨论从自动化转向有意义的人机协作；为发展中国家中小企业AI驱动的数字化转型提供了新的话语框架；将AI采纳与社会技术过程理论相结合，丰富了AI在发展中经济体采纳的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为津巴布韦及类似发展中国家的中小企业提供了人本AI采纳的实践指导框架；与津巴布韦教育5.0政策对齐，强调创新、产业化、技能发展和知识转化为社会经济价值；为政策制定者和企业管理者提供了在资源约束条件下推动可持续AI转型的路径建议。

title: Transformers Speak Base-2: Attention Training and the Existential Theory of (R, 2 x )

detail.title: Transformers Speak Base-2: Attention Training and the Existential Theory of (R, 2 x )
detail.abstract: Training ReLU networks is ∃R-complete (Abrahamsen-Kleist-Miltzow); with sigmoid activations it is polynomial-time bireducible to the existential theory of the reals with exponentiation, ∃(R exp) (Hankala-Hannula-Kontinen-Virtema). Both place activation atoms freely in a DAG; transformers refuse this: softmax is their only transcendental site, locked inside dot-product attention. We determine what this rigidity costs. First, an obstruction: query and key weights reach the network only through softmax, so every wired softmax argument carries an unexposed scale, and single-odds heads decide only a scale-quotiented exponential theory, strictly weaker than ∃(R exp). Second, a resolution: at sequence length three, one head emits two odds sharing one scale, and a rational calibration probe pins it to ln 2 by injectivity alone, minting exact base-2 atoms 2 τ. Third, a composition theorem: a polynomial-time, machine-verified, transcendence-free reduction from ∃(R, 2 x) to zero-loss training of masked transformers with fully trainable query/key vectors. With membership this yields ∃(R, 2 x) ≤ p Train ≤ p ∃(R exp); whether the endpoints coincide is a base-change question in the orbit of the Four Exponentials Conjecture; under Schanuel's conjecture the sandwich collapses: training is decidable iff Tarski's exponential problem is. A bookend-one tied parameter, one example-is unconditionally decidable, with certified decisions 10-7 from the transcendental threshold 1 + σ(2).

detail.abstract: The research intends to study the micro-level complexities of public goods provision and access mechanism in the rural Indian village. The researcher uses micro ethnographic study at a village using participatory research tools in order to study the patterns of public goods segregation, access and the factors influencing the social groups in their decision making at the local level. There was inequality prevailing in the study area. We could identify the vertical and horizontal hierarchy of three factors such as need, norms and physical attributes of the public goods interacting with each other in the process of decision making of an individual to access the public goods. Furthermore, there is evolution through interaction between the informal system like norms and the formal system of government intervention, observed. Thus, the contextual understanding of these patterns is required for a policymaker at any level to ensure that public goods reach the end beneficiary.

AI.tldr: 本文通过印度农村村庄的微观民族志研究，探讨公共物品供给与获取机制的复杂性，发现需求、规范和公共物品物理属性三个因素的垂直与水平层级相互作用，影响个体获取公共物品的决策，并观察到非正式系统（规范）与正式系统（政府干预）之间的演化互动。
AI.research_question: 印度农村村庄中，公共物品的分配与获取机制如何受到微观层面的复杂因素影响？哪些因素决定不同社会群体获取公共物品的决策？
AI.motivation: 公共物品供给与获取在微观层面存在复杂的分配不公问题，理解这些因素对政策制定以确保公共物品到达最终受益者至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共物品理论；制度互动理论（非正式制度与正式制度的互动/演化）
AI.method: 在印度农村村庄进行微观民族志研究，采用参与式研究工具
AI.findings: 1. 研究区域存在明显的公共物品不平等现象；2. 识别出需求、规范及公共物品物理属性三个因素存在垂直与水平层级，并在个体获取公共物品的决策过程中相互作用；3. 观察到非正式系统（如规范）与正式系统（政府干预）之间存在演化互动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出公共物品获取决策中需求、规范与物理属性三因素交互作用的分析框架，并揭示非正式制度与正式制度在公共物品供给中的演化互动机制，丰富了公共物品理论的微观层面理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各级政策制定者提供情境化的理解框架，帮助其确保公共物品能够到达最终受益者，减少分配不平等。

title: Basis-Dependence in Spectral Covariance Shrinkage

detail.title: Basis-Dependence in Spectral Covariance Shrinkage
detail.abstract: Six spectral covariance-shrinkage estimators - Wasserstein (Nguyen, Kuhn & Mohajerin Esfahani, 2022), three nonlinear-shrinkage variants of Ledoit & Wolf (QIS, LIS, GIS), Fisher-Rao (Yue, Rychener, Kuhn & Nguyen, 2025), and a regularized-harmonic estimator introduced here - turn out to be six named points on one continuum: each eigendecomposes the sample covariance Sigma-hat and nonlinearly reweights its eigenvalues while sharing its eigenvectors, differing only in which divergence calibrates the reweighting. We show, first empirically and then by proof, that this shared construction caps every member of the family at equivariance under rotations of the input basis and nothing more - despite one member being explicitly designed to deliver "distributional robustness." On a real 16-factor equity risk model, that estimator (Wasserstein) is in fact the worst-behaved member of its own family under a routine, non-adversarial change of factor basis (PCA-orthogonalization), and reusing its fitted shrinkage intensity across such a change costs a median 104.5% of achievable realized portfolio variance. We then derive, in closed form, exactly what any member of this family trades off: writing the precision-matrix eigenvalue map as s(lambda) and q(lambda) := lambda times s(lambda), the first-order sensitivity of the estimator to an infinitesimal non-orthogonal basis change is exactly twice the divided-difference matrix of q, evaluated at Sigma-hat's own spectrum - a no-free-lunch theorem: the sensitivity vanishes if and only if q is constant, i.e. no real shrinkage is applied at all. Minimizing that sensitivity at fixed regularization strength is a graph-Laplacian harmonic-interpolation problem; its naive solution is numerically unusable on real, eigenvalue-clustered factor spectra, but a bandwidth-regularized version - mirroring the kernel smoothing Ledoit & Wolf already use for an analogous singularity - delivers a validated, exactly matched-strength 34% median reduction in basis-sensitivity over the best existing family member across 125 real walk-forward windows, at a real but modest cost in realized performance.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示六种谱协方差收缩估计量（Wasserstein、三种非线性收缩变体、Fisher-Rao及新引入的正则化调和估计量）实际上是同一连续族上的六个命名点——它们都通过特征分解和对特征值的非线性重加权来构造，仅在用于标定重加权的散度上有所不同。该共享构造使整个家族最多只能在输入基旋转下保持等变性。在真实的16因子权益风险模型中，Wasserstein估计量在常规非对抗性的因子基变换（PCA正交化）下表现最差，敏感性分析证明其敏感度仅当q为常数（即无真实收缩）时才为零。最小化该敏感性等价于图拉普拉斯调和插值问题，带宽正则化版本在125个真实滚动窗口上实现34%的基敏感性中位数降低。
AI.research_question: 六种谱协方差收缩估计量是否共享统一的构造框架？该家族在基变换下的等变性边界是什么？成员间在基敏感性上存在何种权衡？
AI.motivation: 协方差收缩估计在金融风险管理中被广泛使用，但不同估计量（如Wasserstein、Ledoit-Wolf系列、Fisher-Rao等）看似独立发展，缺乏统一理论框架。更重要的是，尽管Wasserstein估计量被设计为具有"分布鲁棒性"，其在非正交基变换下的行为却不明确，而因子模型中的基选择（如PCA正交化）是常规操作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 谱协方差收缩理论、特征值重加权框架、等变性分析、散度/信息几何、图拉普拉斯调和插值、核平滑理论（Ledoit-Wolf的非线性收缩）
AI.method: 理论推导（证明家族共享构造及等变性上限）、敏感性分析（闭式推导精度矩阵特征值映射的一阶敏感性）、实证研究（16因子权益风险模型、125个滚动窗口、PCA正交化基变换）、数值方法（带宽正则化的图拉普拉斯调和插值）
