AI.findings: （1）六种估计量是同一连续族上的点，共享特征分解+特征值非线性重加权的构造；（2）该家族最多只能保证输入基旋转下的等变性；（3）Wasserstein估计量在PCA正交化下是家族中最差成员，重用其收缩强度导致104.5%的已实现组合方差中位数损失；（4）闭式敏感性公式：估计量对无穷小非正交基变换的敏感度等于q的差分矩阵的2倍，仅当q为常数（无收缩）时为零；（5）带宽正则化的调和插值方法在125个窗口上实现34%的基敏感性中位数降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 统一了六种看似独立的谱协方差收缩估计量于一个连续族框架下；证明了该族等变性的精确边界（仅旋转等变，而非更广义的等变）；建立了收缩强度与基敏感性之间的"无免费午餐"定理（敏感度为零当且仅当无实际收缩）。
AI.practical_contributions: 警告实践者Wasserstein估计量在常规因子基变换下可能表现最差，不应盲目依赖其"分布鲁棒性"宣称；提供了带宽正则化的调和插值方法，可在保持收缩效果的同时将基敏感性降低34%，且已实现性能损失适度。

title: Study on the Influence of Government Expenditure on Housing Supply
affiliations: University of Eldoret, Southwest University, University of Aleksander, Xhuvani and University of National and World Economy - Sofia

detail.title: Study on the Influence of Government Expenditure on Housing Supply
detail.abstract: The debate over whether government spending on housing aids or impedes residential investment and housing supply remains a significant topic of discussion. This study examines the effects of government housing expenditure on housing supply in Kenya from 1980 to 2024. Utilizing a time series data regression method, the analysis employs a fully modified ordinary least squares (FMOLS) approach, along with robustness tests, to explore the relationship between the relevant variables. The findings indicate that government housing expenditure has a negative and significant impact on housing supply in Kenya. Specifically, a 1% increase in public housing expenditure is associated with a potential reduction of 0.8 housing units supplied. These results suggest that public spending may adversely affect investment in the housing sector, hinder employment, and slow the rate of housing supply. The VECM and OLS robustness tests indicate that public spending harms housing provision, suggesting that government expenditure on housing is not being allocated effectively and should be reassessed. The study recommends that the government should harness private sector expertise and funding to facilitate the construction and maintenance of housing. This approach could potentially lower costs and enhance the efficiency of government expenditure. A balanced strategy that integrates government support with market-driven solutions is essential for addressing the housing crisis in the Kenyan construction sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用1980至2024年肯尼亚的时间序列数据，采用完全修正普通最小二乘法（FMOLS）及稳健性检验，发现政府住房支出对住房供给有显著的负向影响——公共住房支出每增加1%，住房供给单位减少约0.8个。研究建议政府应借助私营部门的专业知识和资金来建设和维护住房，采取政府支持与市场驱动相结合的策略以应对肯尼亚住房危机。
AI.research_question: 政府住房支出是促进还是阻碍了肯尼亚的住房供给？具体而言，政府住房支出对住房供给的影响方向和程度如何？
AI.motivation: 关于政府住房支出对住房投资和供给的影响一直存在争议，缺乏针对肯尼亚的实证证据。理解这一关系对于解决肯尼亚建筑业面临的住房危机至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共财政理论中关于政府支出对私人投资的影响（可能涉及挤出效应理论），以及公共支出效率理论。
AI.method: 时间序列数据回归方法，采用完全修正普通最小二乘法（FMOLS）作为主要估计方法，并使用向量误差修正模型（VECM）和普通最小二乘法（OLS）进行稳健性检验。数据范围为1980至2024年肯尼亚的时间序列数据。
AI.findings: 政府住房支出对肯尼亚住房供给具有显著负向影响：公共住房支出每增加1%，住房供给单位减少约0.8个。VECM和OLS稳健性检验均证实公共支出对住房供给产生负面影响，表明政府住房支出未得到有效配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政府住房支出对住房供给的影响提供了来自肯尼亚（撒哈拉以南非洲）的新实证证据，支持了政府支出可能对住房供给产生挤出效应的观点，挑战了政府支出促进住房供给的传统假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政府重新评估住房支出配置效率，转而利用私营部门的专业知识和资金来建设和维护住房，以降低成本和提升公共支出效率；提出政府支持与市场驱动相结合的政策策略应对肯尼亚住房危机。

title: Performance Measures for Social Security Pension Systems: A Taxonomy and Pareto Framework

detail.title: Performance Measures for Social Security Pension Systems: A Taxonomy and Pareto Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study used published and institutional sources and involved no human participants or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study reviews how the performance of social security pension systems is measured across the literature. It identifies 136 measures organized into nine performance dimensions: (1) coverage, (2) adequacy, (3) equity, (4) sustainability, (5) administrative and service performance, (6) labour market and economic efficiency, (7) resilience and security, (8) welfare impact, and (9) governance. The findings show that multidimensionality exists both across and within these dimensions, and that differences in population, denominator, analytical level, time basis, valuation assumptions and uncertainty can materially affect interpretation. The review also identifies exact transformations that provide duplicate ordering information and structural relationships among measures that remain substantively distinct. These findings support the use of focused and sufficiently comparable sets of measures. The paper further develops a multidimensional framework in which selected measures are represented as a performance vector and compared using Pareto dominance. The approach identifies unambiguously inferior configurations without assigning weights across pension objectives while preserving the trade-offs among non-dominated configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了社会保障养老金制度绩效测量的文献，识别出136项测量指标，归入九个绩效维度。研究发现绩效测量在维度内和维度间均呈现多维性，且人口、分母、分析层级、时间基础、估值假设和不确定性等差异会实质影响解读。文章还识别出提供重复排序信息的精确变换，以及结构上仍具区别的测量间关系。基于此，论文提出一个多维框架，将选定测量表示为绩效向量，并用帕累托占优进行比较，无需在养老金目标间分配权重即可识别明确劣等的配置，同时保留非占优配置间的权衡。
AI.research_question: 社会保障养老金制度绩效如何被测量？不同测量指标之间存在怎样的结构关系？如何构建一个无需跨目标赋权的多维绩效比较框架？
AI.motivation: 养老金制度绩效测量文献分散且测量指标众多，缺乏系统性整合；现有比较方法往往需要对不同目标赋权，难以反映决策者间的价值分歧；需要识别测量中的重复信息与实质性差异，以支持更聚焦和可比较的测量集合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多维绩效测量理论；帕累托占优（Pareto dominance）作为无赋权比较框架；绩效向量概念
AI.method: 系统性文献综述：识别136项测量指标并归类为九个维度；对测量指标进行结构分析，识别重复排序的精确变换与实质不同的结构关系；构建绩效向量与帕累托占优比较框架。
AI.findings: （1）识别出136项测量指标，归于九个绩效维度；（2）多维性同时存在于维度间和维度内；（3）人口、分母、分析层级、时间基础、估值假设和不确定性差异会实质影响测量解读；（4）部分测量间存在提供重复排序信息的精确变换，部分则结构上实质不同；（5）帕累托占优框架可识别明确劣等配置，无需跨目标赋权，同时保留非占优配置间的权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了分散的养老金绩效测量文献，提出九维度分类框架；厘清了测量间重复信息与实质差异的结构关系；将帕累托占优引入养老金绩效比较，为无赋权的多维绩效评估提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究者提供聚焦且可比较的测量选择指南；支持在不预设目标权重的情况下识别明确劣等的养老金制度配置；有助于养老金制度改革的循证评估与跨国比较。

title: Somatic Decision Flow (SDF v1.12.0): Master Production Package

detail.title: Somatic Decision Flow (SDF v1.12.0): Master Production Package

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none Independent
declarations.ethicsApproval: No Patients
declarations.funderStatement: none Independent

detail.abstract: Traditional economic and institutional decision-making models rely heavily on static, binary decision trees and frictionless utility-maximizing assumptions, completely ignoring the underlying physiological, thermodynamic, and metabolic constraints governing human behavior under stress. This paper introduces the Sond-Decision Flow (SDF v1.12.0) framework, a first-principles biophysical and economic architecture that bridges cellular thermodynamics, active inference, and macroeconomic critique. By operationalizing a non-linear cognitive override function ($\Phi_{\text{override}}$) tied to critical energy floors ($\Theta_{\text{survival}}$) and incorporating a damped somatic Hamiltonian operator ($H_{\text{somatic}}$) for affective state transitions, the model demonstrates how severe resource constraints and uncreated macro-debt drains force systems into metabolic lockdown. Furthermore, the framework establishes a rigorous work-energy equivalence (defining 1 Unit of Value = 1 kWh), exposing how traditional debt-based monetary structures impose hidden biological extraction costs on active labor pools. Supported by an executable Python simulation engine, SDF offers a robust foundation for analyzing human agency, systemic stress limits, and alternative thermodynamic economic governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sond-Decision Flow (SDF)框架，从生物物理第一性原理出发，将细胞热力学、主动推理与宏观经济批判相结合，通过非线性认知覆盖函数、衰减躯体哈密顿算子及功-能等价原理（1单位价值=1kWh），揭示了传统债务型货币体系对劳动力施加的隐性生物提取成本，并提供了可执行的Python仿真引擎作为分析工具。
AI.research_question: 传统经济决策模型忽略了人体在压力下的生理、热力学和新陈代谢约束，那么如何构建一个融合生物物理约束与经济决策的统一框架，以更真实地解释人类行为与系统性压力极限？
AI.motivation: 传统经济和制度决策模型依赖静态二元决策树和无摩擦效用最大化假设，完全忽视了压力下人类行为背后的生理、热力学与代谢约束，需要从第一性原理出发构建更符合现实的决策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究整合了三个理论基础：细胞热力学（cellular thermodynamics）、主动推理（active inference）以及宏观经济批判（macroeconomic critique），并通过非线性认知覆盖函数和非衰减躯体哈密顿算子加以形式化。
AI.method: 构建了一个跨学科理论模型，包含非线性认知覆盖函数（与生存能量下限挂钩）、衰减躯体哈密顿算子（用于情感状态转换），并建立了功-能等价原理；同时配套开发了可执行的Python仿真引擎进行验证。
AI.findings: 该模型展示了严重资源约束和未创造的宏观债务消耗如何迫使系统进入代谢锁定状态；揭示了传统债务型货币结构对活跃劳动力池施加的隐性生物提取成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将生物物理约束（热力学与代谢因素）纳入经济决策建模的新架构，建立了工作-能量等价原则（1单位价值=1kWh），为替代性热力学经济治理提供了理论基准。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可运行的Python仿真引擎作为分析工具，可用于分析人类能动性、系统性压力极限，并为替代性热力学经济治理提供实践支持。

title: The Polycrisis and Emerging-Market Resilience: Climate Shocks, Financial Volatility, and Geopolitical Fragmentation as Simultaneous Stressors - Building Adaptive Macroeconomic Frameworks for Compounding Risks

detail.title: The Polycrisis and Emerging-Market Resilience: Climate Shocks, Financial Volatility, and Geopolitical Fragmentation as Simultaneous Stressors - Building Adaptive Macroeconomic Frameworks for Compounding Risks
detail.abstract:
Emerging and frontier economies are entering a structural era of polycrisis, where climate disasters, global financial tightening, and geopolitical fragmentation strike simultaneously and interact through non‑linear, multiplicative transmission channels. As the report notes, “the resulting crisis is not additive but multiplicative” and traditional stabilization tools—interest‑rate hikes, fiscal austerity, and reserve drawdowns—“fail catastrophically under polycrisis conditions” .

This flagship institutional study maps how compound shocks propagate across balance‑of‑payments systems, inflation dynamics, and sovereign fiscal space, demonstrating that climate‑induced supply shocks, dollar‑cycle capital flight, and trade chokepoints jointly produce super‑additive GDP contractions, debt‑service absorption exceeding 50% of revenue, and persistent food‑energy inflation. Econometric evidence shows that synchronized shocks generate output losses up to 3.4× greater than isolated events, pushing vulnerable economies into debt‑climate traps and market lockout.

The report constructs a comprehensive Adaptive Macroeconomic Architecture—counter‑cyclical fiscal buffers, synthetic FX hedging, climate‑resilient debt clauses (CRDCs), parametric disaster insurance, and geoeconomic supply diversification—to neutralize compounding risks. Stress‑testing simulations reveal that deploying these adaptive buffers reduces cumulative GDP loss from ‑14.8% to ‑3.6%, stabilizes debt trajectories, and preserves sovereign solvency under synchronized shocks.

Ultimately, the analysis argues that resilience in the polycrisis era is an institutional achievement, not a geographic privilege. Sovereigns that build state‑contingent debt systems, domestic‑currency capital markets, strategic commodity reserves, and digital social protection rails can transform compounding vulnerabilities into durable macroeconomic stability and long‑run development convergence.

AI.tldr: 本研究聚焦新兴和前沿经济体在多重危机（气候灾害、金融紧缩、地缘政治碎片化）叠加冲击下的宏观经济脆弱性，提出"适应性宏观经济架构"（包括逆周期财政缓冲、合成外汇对冲、气候韧性债务条款、参数化灾害保险、地缘经济供应链多元化），通过压力测试证明该架构可将累计GDP损失从-14.8%降至-3.6%，帮助主权国家在多危机时代实现宏观经济稳定与发展趋同。
AI.research_question: 新兴和前沿经济体如何在多重危机（polycrisis）叠加冲击下维持宏观经济稳定和主权偿付能力？适应性宏观经济架构能否有效中和复合风险？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体正进入多重危机的结构性时代，气候灾害、全球金融紧缩和地缘政治碎片化同时冲击并通过非线性、乘数性传导渠道相互作用。传统稳定工具（加息、财政紧缩、储备消耗）在多危机条件下严重失效，亟需新的适应性政策框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多重危机（polycrisis）理论：复合冲击非线性乘数传导机制；债务-气候陷阱理论；主权债务可持续性分析框架；宏观经济韧性理论。
AI.method: 机构旗舰研究报告方法：复合冲击在收支平衡、通胀动态和主权财政空间的传导映射；计量经济学证据分析（同步冲击vs孤立冲击效应比较）；适应性宏观经济架构构建；压力测试模拟（应力测试前后GDP损失对比）。
AI.findings: （1）气候引发的供给冲击、美元周期资本外逃和贸易瓶颈共同产生超加性GDP收缩，债务服务吸收超过收入的50%，并导致持续性食品-能源通胀；（2）同步冲击产生的产出损失是孤立事件的3.4倍，将脆弱经济体推入债务-气候陷阱和市场锁定；（3）部署适应性缓冲可将累计GDP损失从-14.8%降至-3.6%，稳定债务轨迹并保持主权偿付能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"危机不是加性的而是乘性的"这一分析视角，系统阐述复合冲击在跨国经济系统中的非线性传导机制；将多重危机理论与宏观经济稳定框架整合，构建了适应性宏观经济架构的概念性框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体提供了一套可操作的政策工具组合（逆周期财政缓冲、合成FX对冲、气候韧性债务条款、参数化灾害保险、地缘经济供应链多元化），并强调国家或有债务体系、本币资本市场、战略商品储备和数字社会保护基础设施的建设路径。

title: Investigating Consumer Behaviour Regarding Stevia: An Application of the Health Belief Model in an Emerging Asian Market
affiliations: Universiti Malaysia Kelantan and Universiti Malaysia Kelantan

detail.title: Investigating Consumer Behaviour Regarding Stevia: An Application of the Health Belief Model in an Emerging Asian Market
detail.abstract: Background: The rapid growth of diet-related non-communicable diseases in emerging markets necessitates a transition toward sustainable, plant-based sugar substitutes. While Stevia rebaudiana offers a natural zero-calorie solution, mass consumer adoption is constrained by cognitive risk perception, sensory barriers, and habit inertia. Purpose: Extending the Health Belief Model (HBM) with consumer choice theories, this study evaluates the structural drivers of consumer behaviour toward stevia and designs actionable food marketing practices for emerging markets. Methodology: A quantitative cross-sectional survey was administered to 123 working adults in Terengganu, Malaysia. Data were evaluated using descriptive statistics, Pearson correlation, and Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). Findings: Consumer adoption behavior (M=4.10,SD=0.79) and perceived benefits (M=4.08) were high. PLS-SEM path analysis confirmed that Perceived Benefits exerted the dominant direct effect on adoption (β=0.513,p<0.001), followed by Perceived Susceptibility (β=0.347,p=0.002). Perceived Barriers had no direct structural significance (β=0.072,p=0.138). Practical Implications: We propose a four-pillar Future Food Marketing Strategy focusing on sensory-nudge packaging, digital front-of-pack dosage labeling, lifestyle benefit positioning, and trial-bundling pricing to overcome habit resistance and accelerate sustainable sweetener transitions.

AI.tldr: 本研究扩展健康信念模型（HBM），结合消费者选择理论，通过123名马来西亚登嘉楼上班族的定量调查，运用PLS-SEM分析消费者对甜叶菊（stevia）替代糖的采纳行为。研究发现感知利益（β=0.513）是采纳行为的最强驱动因素，其次为感知易感性（β=0.347），而感知障碍无显著直接影响。基于此提出"未来食品营销四支柱策略"以促进新兴市场可持续甜味剂转型。
AI.research_question: 在新兴市场中，哪些结构性因素驱动消费者对甜叶菊（stevia）替代糖的采纳行为？如何设计可操作的食品营销实践以促进可持续糖替代品转型？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场饮食相关非传染性疾病快速增长，亟需向可持续植物基糖替代品转型。尽管甜叶菊是天然零卡路里的解决方案，但消费者认知风险感知、感官障碍和习惯惯性制约了大规模采纳，需要系统理解其采纳驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康信念模型（HBM）扩展，融合消费者选择理论（consumer choice theories）。
AI.method: 定量横断面调查，样本为马来西亚登嘉楼123名在职成年人；数据分析采用描述性统计、皮尔逊相关分析和偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）。
AI.findings: 消费者采纳行为（M=4.10, SD=0.79）和感知利益（M=4.08）均处于较高水平。PLS-SEM路径分析证实感知利益对采纳行为具有最强的直接效应（β=0.513, p<0.001），其次是感知易感性（β=0.347, p=0.002）；感知障碍无直接结构显著影响（β=0.072, p=0.138）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将健康信念模型扩展至新兴市场可持续食品替代品采纳情境，实证验证了感知利益相对感知障碍在消费者采纳决策中的主导性地位，丰富了HBM在食品营销与消费者行为领域的理论适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"未来食品营销四支柱战略"：感官引导（sensory-nudge）包装、数字前包装剂量标签、生活方式利益定位、试用捆绑定价，旨在克服习惯惯性并加速可持续甜味剂转型，为新兴市场食品企业提供可操作的营销策略框架。

title: Apex Vien Predictor (AVP): A Real-Time Structural Telemetry Framework for Market Regime Classification

detail.title: Apex Vien Predictor (AVP): A Real-Time Structural Telemetry Framework for Market Regime Classification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the creator of the Apex Vien Predictor (AVP) and related research developed within the broader ChipShot Universe experimental research program. The author may have a financial or commercial interest in future applications of this work. No third party influenced the study design, analysis, interpretation, or preparation of this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, personal data, or animal subjects. It analyzed market data and machine-generated system telemetry; therefore, institutional ethics approval and informed consent were not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was independently funded by the author and the ChipShot Universe research program. No external institutional, corporate, or government funding was received.

detail.abstract: Financial prediction systems are commonly evaluated by whether they forecast price direction or produce profitable trades, but these objectives do not directly measure the structural environment in which a prediction is made. This paper introduces the Apex Vien Predictor (AVP), a real-time structural telemetry framework motivated by the Recursive Predictive Manifold (RPM-4D) model. AVP records multidimensional market-state measurements-including regime identity, curvature-related behavior, distortion, trajectory, uncertainty-cone, reflexive, override, and recovery variables-alongside signal evaluation, permissioning, and trade outcomes. The preserved 2026 research record includes a March 8-13 baseline of 16,512 synchronized signal and telemetry observations with 790 closed outcomes, followed by validation and replication windows. A preserved combined March 30-April 10 analysis contains 27,084 synchronized telemetry observations and 1,321 closed outcomes. The strongest retained regime-level result occurs in the April 7-10 replication window: Regime 5 exhibited an 89.9% signal permission rate, Regimes 1 and 2 exhibited 61.8% and 61.0%, respectively, and Regime 6 exhibited 14.9%, a 75.0-percentage-point separation between the highest-and lowest-permission states. These findings support the interpretation that AVP generated behaviorally differentiated operational state classifications within the implemented decision architecture. However, structural differentiation did not consistently translate into trade-level profitability, and the surviving record cannot establish that AVP contributes incremental predictive information after conventional signal and gating variables are controlled. The original row-level telemetry is no longer available, limiting full reproducibility and preventing new inferential testing. Accordingly, AVP is presented as an empirically motivated structural-measurement framework rather than as a validated profitable forecasting system. A prospective confirmatory study using immutable row-level data, frozen benchmarks, and temporal out-of-sample testing is required to determine whether AVP telemetry provides reproducible incremental information for predictive reliability, selective abstention, or regime-conditioned execution.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Apex Vien Predictor (AVP)，一种基于Recursive Predictive Manifold (RPM-4D)模型的实时结构遥测框架，用于记录市场状态的多维测量。虽然AVP在2026年保存的研究记录中展示了行为分化的运营状态分类（如Regime 5与Regime 6之间75个百分点的许可率差距），但结构分化并未持续转化为交易层面的盈利能力，且原始行级遥测数据已不可用，限制了完全可复现性。因此AVP被视为一个经验驱动的结构测量框架，而非经过验证的盈利预测系统，需要前瞻性确证研究来验证其增量预测信息。
AI.research_question: 金融预测系统能否通过结构化市场状态遥测（而非仅依赖价格方向或交易盈利指标）来提供增量预测信息，并实现行为分化的运营状态分类？
AI.motivation: 现有金融预测系统通常以价格方向预测准确性或交易盈利性作为评估标准，但这些目标并未直接测量预测所处的结构环境。本文旨在引入一种实时结构遥测框架，以捕捉市场状态的多维结构特征，弥补传统评估指标的不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: Recursive Predictive Manifold (RPM-4D)模型，该模型构成了AVP框架的理论基础，涉及制度识别、曲率相关行为、扭曲、轨迹、不确定锥、反射、覆盖和恢复等多维市场状态变量。
AI.method: 实时结构遥测框架（AVP），记录多维市场状态测量（包括制度身份、曲率相关行为、扭曲、轨迹、不确定性锥、反射、覆盖和恢复变量），同时配合信号评估、许可和交易结果。使用2026年保存的研究记录，包括3月8-13日基线（16,512个同步信号与遥测观测，790个已关闭结果）及后续验证和复制窗口，以及3月30日至4月10日的合并分析（27,084个同步遥测观测和1,321个已关闭结果）。
AI.findings: 最强的保留制度级结果出现在4月7-10日复制窗口：Regime 5表现出89.9%的信号许可率，Regime 1和2分别为61.8%和61.0%，而Regime 6仅为14.9%，最高与最低许可状态之间相差75个百分点。但结构分化并未持续转化为交易层面的盈利能力，且留存记录无法证明AVP在控制传统信号和门控变量后提供增量预测信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一个基于RPM-4D模型的实时结构遥测框架概念，将多元市场状态变量（制度身份、曲率、扭曲、轨迹等）纳入预测系统评估，为金融预测领域的结构环境测量提供了概念框架。同时，实证结果表明结构分化不等同于预测有效性的理论洞察。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可操作的结构测量框架设计示例，记录了市场状态分类与信号许可率之间的行为分化模式；同时为未来研究指明了需要进行的前瞻性确证研究要求（不可变行级数据、冻结基准、时间外样本测试），以验证遥测数据是否能为预测可靠性、选择性弃权和制度条件执行提供可复现的增量信息。

title: It Is the Economy, Stupid: Maritime Adaptation to Trade Protectionism
affiliations: University of Macedonia, , , University of Macedonia - Department of Economics and Central Bank of Cyprus

detail.title: It Is the Economy, Stupid: Maritime Adaptation to Trade Protectionism
detail.abstract: Trade protectionism changes not only trade volumes and prices but also the operational choices of firms that move international commerce. This letter uses an original survey of 84 respondents drawn from maritime and related professional networks to examine whether reported operational adaptation is associated with perceived economic consequences of tariffs or with broader attitudes toward globalization and free trade. Principalcomponent analysis identifies two dimensions-Economic Concern and Globalization Orientation-that explain 69.2% of the variation across eight perception items. In the prespecified-response sample (N = 77), robust logit estimates show that Economic Concern is positively associated with operational adaptation, whereas Globalization Orientation is not. Multinomial estimates indicate that the relationship is strongest for port substitution and near-shoring responses. The findings suggest that maritime adaptation to protectionism is better understood as a response to perceived commercial exposure than as an expression of general views about globalization.

AI.tldr: 本文基于一份对84名海事及相关专业人士的原始调查，检验企业运营适应是否与关税的经济后果感知或更广泛的全球化态度相关。主成分分析识别出两个维度——经济关切和全球化取向，解释了8个感知项目69.2%的变异。稳健Logit估计显示经济关切与运营适应正相关，而全球化取向则不然；多元估计表明该关系在港口替代和近岸外包响应中最强。
AI.research_question: 贸易保护主义下，海事企业的运营适应行为是由关税的经济后果感知驱动，还是由更广泛的全球化态度驱动？
AI.motivation: 贸易保护主义不仅改变贸易量和价格，还影响企业的运营选择。已有研究多关注宏观贸易效应，但对微观企业层面运营适应行为的驱动因素缺乏实证检验，尤其是难以区分经济理性驱动与意识形态驱动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济理性决策理论与态度-行为一致性理论的对比框架，区分经济关切（perceived commercial exposure）与全球化取向（general views about globalization）对运营适应行为的不同影响。
AI.method: 原始调查数据（84名海事专业人士），主成分分析（PCA）提取两个维度，稳健Logit回归和多元Logit（multinomial）模型进行估计。
AI.findings: （1）经济关切与运营适应正相关，全球化取向则无显著关系；（2）该关系在港口替代和近岸外包响应中最强；（3）两个维度解释了69.2%的感知变异。
AI.theory_contributions: 表明海事企业对保护主义的适应更应理解为对感知商业风险的反应，而非全球化意识形态的体现，为态度-行为关系提供情境化证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行业管理者提供洞见：经济激励比观念引导更能有效驱动企业运营调整，理解企业应对保护主义的实际行为动机。

title: Autonomous Micro-Enterprise Economics (AMEE): Reframing the Theory of the Firm under Zero-Marginal-Labor Coordination and Algorithmic Clearing

detail.title: Autonomous Micro-Enterprise Economics (AMEE): Reframing the Theory of the Firm under Zero-Marginal-Labor Coordination and Algorithmic Clearing
detail.abstract: For nearly a century, Ronald Coase's Theory of the Firm and Williamson's Transaction Cost Economics (TCE) have posited that internal managerial coordination costs impose diminishing returns to scale, constraining optimal firm size and necessitating O(N) marginal operational labor overhead. The recent empirical emergence of autonomous micro-enterprises achieving multi-billion-dollar transaction throughput with fewer than ten employees represents a departure from neoclassical organizational theory. This paper formalizes the Autonomous Micro-Enterprise Economics (AMEE) framework, establishing microeconomic foundations for algorithmic contracting, endogenous boundary contraction, and capital-labor substitution elasticity under generative multi-agent systems (σ → ∞). We formulate an augmented production function incorporating algorithmic coordination capital, derive the marginal-cost equilibrium under automated verification lattices, prove a boundedrisk proposition governing coordination failure under algorithmic governance, and present comparative empirical evidence of a 94.8% contraction in non-settlement marginal operating costs. We close by analyzing structural implications for electronic platform microstructure, market contestability, and post-labor corporate governance, and outline a doctoral research agenda extending this framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了自主微型企业经济学（AMEE）框架，以解释少数员工即可实现数十亿美元交易量的新型企业形态。通过引入算法协调资本和生成式多智能体系统，论文论证了企业组织边界的内生收缩、资本-劳动替代弹性的极限化，并提供了非结算边际运营成本下降94.8%的经验证据，对科斯企业理论与威廉姆森交易成本经济学构成理论挑战。
AI.research_question: 在生成式多智能体系统兴起的背景下，传统企业理论所预设的内部管理协调成本的规模递减效应是否仍然成立？自主微型企业如何突破传统企业规模约束，其微观经济学基础如何形式化？
AI.motivation: 科斯企业理论与威廉姆森交易成本经济学近百年来一直认为内部管理协调成本导致规模收益递减，从而约束企业最优规模并需要O(N)的边际运营劳动开销。然而，近期出现的员工不足十人却实现数十亿美元交易吞吐量的自主微型企业，在经验上偏离了新古典组织理论的预测，亟需新的理论框架加以解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自主微型企业经济学（AMEE）框架，融合算法契约理论、内生边界收缩理论、资本-劳动替代弹性理论，以及基于生成式多智能体系统（σ → ∞）的组织治理理论。
AI.method: 数理建模方法：构建包含算法协调资本的增广生产函数，推导自动化验证格下的边际成本均衡，证明算法治理下协调失败的有界风险命题，并结合比较实证证据（94.8%非结算边际运营成本收缩）加以验证。
AI.findings: 构建了AMEE框架的微观经济学基础；推导出算法契约与自动化验证条件下的边际成本均衡；证明了算法治理下协调失败的有界性；经验证据显示自主微型企业实现了94.8%的非结算边际运营成本收缩。
AI.theory_contributions: 对科斯企业理论和威廉姆森交易成本经济学构成理论突破，将企业边界理论从"协调成本约束规模"拓展为"算法资本替代协调成本"的新范式；为资本-劳动替代弹性趋于无穷大的极限情形提供形式化基础；建立了算法治理下的有界风险命题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电子平台微观结构设计、市场可竞争性与后劳动企业治理提供结构性启示，并为后续博士研究议程奠定框架基础。

title: AI-Enabled Risk Analytics for Resilient U.S. Manufacturing and Supply Chains

detail.title: AI-Enabled Risk Analytics for Resilient U.S. Manufacturing and Supply Chains

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organizations that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data. All data used in this research were obtained from publicly available datasets (BUSI - Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset). Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The U.S. manufacturing and supply-chain systems are becoming more vulnerable to a growing number of interconnected and rapidly changing disruptions, such as operational uncertainty, cybersecurity threats, supply interruptions, and shifts in market conditions, which means that traditional risk-management methods, those which usually rely on fixed assessments and reactive actions, have reached their limits. Recent research has shown that artificial intelligence (AI)-driven risk analytics can enhance the ability to identify, predict, and manage these types of risks by incorporating large-scale data, predictive models, and decision-support functions into manufacturing and supply-chain operations (Chukwu et al., 2024; Singh et al., 2024; Belhadi et al., 2024; Wong et al., 2024; Smyth et al., 2024). This study looks at the role that AI-enabled risk analytics can play in making U.S. manufacturing and supply-chain systems more resilient, with a special focus on the connection between AI, predictive analytics, risk intelligence, cybersecurity, real-time information, and organizational resilience. The combined results show that AI can help with the early detection of risks, allow for a more proactive rather than a reactive approach to risk management, improve real-time responsiveness, increase supply-chain visibility, and enable faster and more informed decision-making (Diyora, 2024; Mishu et al., 2025; Nsama, 2025; Singh et al., 2025). Yet the effectiveness of AI-enabled risk analytics cannot be judged solely on the basis of technological capability; it is also affected by the quality of the data, cybersecurity measures, organizational readiness, system integration, and proper human supervision. The study thus concludes that AI should not be seen simply as an automation technology but rather as a risk-intelligence capability that is part of a wider resilience framework combining technological intelligence, organizational capabilities, and human judgement in order to boost the ability of U.S. manufacturing and supply-chain systems to anticipate, absorb, and respond to disruptions (Beta et al., 2025; Wu et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2025; George, 2025).

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨AI驱动的风险分析在提升美国制造业与供应链韧性中的作用，认为AI不仅是自动化技术，更应被视为融入更广泛韧性框架的风险智能能力，需与技术智能、组织能力和人类判断相结合。
AI.research_question: AI赋能的風險分析在提升美国制造业与供应链系统韧性方面扮演何种角色？其有效性的关键影响因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 美国制造业与供应链系统正面临日益增多且相互关联的快速变化干扰（如运营不确定性、网络安全威胁、供应中断和市场变动），传统依赖固定评估和被动应对的风险管理方法已到达极限，亟需探索新的风险管理范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI驱动风险分析理论、组织韧性理论、供应链风险管理理论，强调AI与预测分析、风险智能、网络安全、实时信息和组织韧性的关联。
AI.method: 文献综述/综合研究（基于多项已有研究如Chukwu, Singh, Belhadi等），对AI在制造与供应链风险管理中的应用进行系统性梳理与综合分析。
AI.findings: AI能帮助早期检测风险、促进从被动到主动的风险管理转变、提升实时响应能力、增强供应链可见性、支持更快更明智的决策。但AI有效性受数据质量、网络安全措施、组织准备度、系统集成和人类监管等因素制约。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI从单纯的自动化技术重新概念化为风险智能能力，提出AI应嵌入更广泛的韧性框架，即技术智能、组织能力与人类判断的三维整合模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国制造业和供应链管理者提供了AI风险分析应用的实践指导，强调在部署AI时需关注数据质量、网络安全、组织准备和人类监督等关键因素，以提升系统预测、吸收和响应干扰的能力。

title: From Specialization to the Augmented Polymath: How Generative AI Lowers the Cost of Cognitive Integration A Historical and Philosophical Account of Knowledge Production
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: From Specialization to the Augmented Polymath: How Generative AI Lowers the Cost of Cognitive Integration A Historical and Philosophical Account of Knowledge Production

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: בשדה **Ethics approval** שבתמונה, העתק: > Not applicable. This is a theoretical paper and does not involve human participants, patient data, or the collection of empirical data requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This article is situated within the history and philosophy of knowledge production and uses generative artificial intelligence as a case through which to reconsider the historical and cognitive conditions that have shaped the organization of human knowledge. Its central argument is that specialization and sub-specialization are not fixed features of science and human knowledge, but historical responses to the cost of cognitive integration, the mental cost involved in acquiring, connecting, translating, and integrating distant bodies of knowledge, which increased as the volume of human knowledge expanded beyond the capacity of any single individual to acquire and process it. In this article, this cost functions as an explanatory theoretical variable rather than as a fully developed empirical measure. The article argues that artificial intelligence may alter the conditions underlying this cost at two complementary levels. At the level of working memory, it can reduce the cost associated with translating, contextualizing, and synthesizing knowledge across domains in real time. At the level of long-term memory, it can provide broad access to bodies of knowledge whose independent acquisition would otherwise require years of learning and specialization within each domain. This does not entail an increase in human biological capacity or the elimination of the need for expertise. Rather, it represents a change in the amount of cognitive work required of the individual to perform integration across domains.

AI.tldr: 本文从知识与生产的历史与哲学视角出发，以生成式人工智能为案例，探讨人类知识组织形态的历史条件。核心论点是：专业化与亚专业化并非科学与人类知识的固定特征，而是对认知整合成本（获取、连接、翻译和整合远距离知识所需的心智成本）的历史性回应。人工智能可能在两个层面改变这一成本的基础条件：工作记忆层面（降低跨领域实时翻译、情境化和综合的成本）和长期记忆层面（提供无需多年深度学习即可获取的广泛知识）。这并不意味着人类生物能力的提升或专业知识的消失，而是改变了个人跨领域整合所需的认知工作量。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能如何改变人类知识组织的专业化结构？具体而言，AI能否通过降低认知整合成本来改变知识与生产的历史与认识论条件？
AI.motivation: 专业化与亚专业化长期被视为科学与人类知识的固有特征，但本文试图揭示其本质上是历史性的回应——随着人类知识总量增长超出个体吸收能力，认知整合成本上升，因而催生了专业化分工。当前生成式AI的崛起可能改变这一历史条件的底层变量，因此需要从知识与生产的历史与哲学视角重新审视这一变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以知识与生产的历史哲学为理论背景，将"认知整合成本"作为核心解释性理论变量（而非经验测量），并借鉴认知科学中工作记忆与长期记忆的区分作为分析框架。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性论文：以生成式AI为案例，进行历史与哲学层面的理论分析与论证，而非实证研究。认知整合成本作为理论变量而非实证测量被使用。
AI.findings: （1）专业化是认知整合成本上升的历史产物，而非科学知识的固有属性；（2）AI在工作记忆层面可降低跨领域实时翻译、情境化与综合的认知成本；（3）AI在长期记忆层面可提供广泛知识获取渠道，替代多年深度学习与专业化积累；（4）这种变化不等于提升人类生物认知能力或消除专业知识需求，而是改变了跨领域整合所需的个体认知工作量。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解知识专业化现象提供历史与认识论的新解释框架，将"认知整合成本"确立为解释知识组织形式变迁的理论变量；同时将生成式AI的兴起置于知识生产的历史连续性中加以定位，而非视为断裂性事件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术界和知识界应对生成式AI时代的知识组织变革提供理论指导；提示机构、学科和知识体系可能需要重新思考专业化结构；为个体在AI辅助下进行跨领域整合与协作提供观念上的框架。

title: China's Autocallable Cycle: Dealer Hedging Flows, Market Impact, and Lessons for Japan's Structured-Note Market

detail.title: China's Autocallable Cycle: Dealer Hedging Flows, Market Impact, and Lessons for Japan's Structured-Note Market

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author was previously employed by a derivatives valuation and trading-system provider and its affiliated private fund manager in China, where he developed pricing, hedging and risk systems for the product class discussed in this paper. The paper uses a representative parameter set and publicly available market data only; no proprietary client, position or counterparty information is disclosed. The author has no current financial relationship with any organization mentioned in this paper, and received no compensation from any party for this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves no human participants; it uses only publicly available market data and the author's own model computations.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding from any organization. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Chinese autocallable ("snowball") notes generated predictable, state-dependent dealer hedging flows around their knock-in and knock-out barriers. This paper reconstructs the January 2024 knock-in episode from the hedging side. Using a finite-difference implementation of a representative CSI 500-linked note — validated by grid-refinement and bump-size checks, and cross-checked against a Monte Carlo implementation using common random numbers — I show that the economically relevant quantity is the hedge released across the barrier region rather than a pointwise delta at the contractual barrier, and that remaining tenor changes this release by an order of magnitude: from roughly 0.6× of notional at twelve months to maturity to about 6× at one month. Combining published estimates of barrier and maturity concentration with futures-market capacity, hypothetical one-way flows of RMB 5–10bn per 100 index points are small relative to stress-window turnover, while a concentrated near-dated cohort could generate RMB 22–43bn — microstructurally meaningful if executed in a short window. A 120-day constant-maturity basis series and family- and date-fixed-effect event-window regressions show basis widening and activity increases in the CSI 500/1000 futures families significantly exceeding the CSI 300/SSE 50 controls; these are consistency results, not causal identification. The monitoring framework — outstanding notional × barrier concentration × maturity concentration × local dealer gamma — transfers to Japan's structured-note market, but the magnitude does not: Japanese retail issuance is more single-name-oriented, barriers sit further out of the money, and only one of the four variables is currently measurable from public disclosure.

AI.tldr: 本文从对冲交易（dealer hedging）视角重建了2024年1月中国自动赎回（"雪球"）票据的敲入事件，通过有限差分和蒙特卡洛交叉验证，证明经济上关键的量是跨障碍区域释放的对冲头寸而非合约障碍处的点delta，且剩余期限将这一释放量从12个月的0.6倍名义本金放大到1个月的6倍。结合障碍与期限集中度估算，假设单向流动50–100亿元/百点为小量，但集中到期的近月组合可产生220–430亿元流量，在微观结构上具有重要意义。120天常数期限基差序列和固定效应事件窗口回归显示CSI 500/1000期货基差走阔与活动增加显著超过对照组，但仅为一致性结果而非因果识别。
AI.research_question: 中国雪球（自动赎回）票据在2024年1月敲入事件中，交易商对冲流量的规模、时变特征（随剩余期限的变化）及其对股指期货市场的微观结构影响如何？
AI.motivation: 2024年1月中国雪球票据集中敲入引发市场关注，但现有研究多从产品买方视角出发，缺乏从交易商对冲端定量刻画敲入事件的系统性分析。理解对冲释放的实际规模与变化规律，对于评估系统性风险和市场冲击至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 衍生品定价与对冲理论（有限差分/蒙特卡洛方法）；交易商delta对冲与gamma再平衡理论；市场微观结构理论（基差与期货持仓活动分析）。
AI.method: 1) 有限差分法实现代表性CSI 500联结票据定价，通过网格细化和bump-size检验验证，并用公共随机数蒙特卡洛实现交叉验证；2) 计算跨障碍区域的对冲释放量（而非点delta）在不同剩余期限下的规模；3) 构建120天常数期限基差序列，采用家族和日期固定效应的事件窗口回归分析CSI 500/1000期货族相对CSI 300/SSE 50对照组的表现。
AI.findings: 1) 经济上关键的量是跨障碍区域释放的对冲头寸，而非合约障碍处的点delta；2) 剩余期限使对冲释放量变化一个数量级：12个月剩余期限约0.6倍名义本金，1个月约6倍；3) 假设单向往返流量50–100亿元/百点相对于压力窗口成交量较小，但集中近月到期的组合可产生220–430亿元，若在短窗口执行则具有微观结构意义；4) 基差走阔和期货活动增加在CSI 500/1000族显著超过CSI 300/SSE 50对照，但这是一致性证据而非因果识别。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"跨障碍区域对冲释放量"而非点delta作为衡量敲入事件经济影响的正确指标；2) 定量揭示剩余期限对对冲释放量的数量级影响（0.6倍→6倍），深化了对自动赎回票据对冲动态的理解；3) 构建了"未偿名义本金×障碍集中度×期限集中度×本地交易商gamma"的四变量监测框架，可推广至其他结构化票据市场。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构和市场参与者提供了量化雪球敲入事件对冲流量的可操作方法，有助于评估短期市场冲击；2) 提供了将监测框架推广至日本结构化票据市场的评估，指出日本零售发行更偏单一股票、障碍更虚值、且四变量中仅一个可从公开披露中获得，为跨市场监管比较提供了参考。

title: Does Artificial Intelligence Mitigate Credit Risk? Causal Evidence from the Indian Banking Sector
affiliations: Acharya Institute of Graduate Studies, Acharya Institute of Graduate Studies and Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Open University

detail.title: Does Artificial Intelligence Mitigate Credit Risk? Causal Evidence from the Indian Banking Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest and no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses secondary, publicly available data (annual reports, financial statements, and stock market data) and does not involve human participants or patient data; therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency.

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in the financial intermediation, yet its impact on core bank fundamentals remains empirically contested. This study examines whether AI adoption generates tangible improvements in asset quality or primarily reflects technological signalling. Using staggered AI adoption across Indian commercial banks from 2011-2025, we examine the dynamic impact of AI implementation on non-performing assets (NPAs). We document a deterioration in asset quality in the years preceding adoption, consistent with technology investment responding endogenously to rising credit risk and operational stress. Following adoption, however, NPAs decline significantly and persistently, indicating that AI deployment facilitates improvement in risk monitoring and credit screening rather than merely signalling innovation. These results are robust to bank and year fixed effects, differential pre-trends, ownership heterogeneity, and macroeconomic controls. By linking AI to balance-sheet outcomes, this study provides causal evidence that technological integration stabilizes credit risk management and contributes to banking sector stability in the medium term.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2011-2025年印度商业银行分阶段采用AI的数据，考察AI采纳对不良资产（NPAs）的动态影响。研究发现，AI采纳前几年资产质量恶化（表明技术投资对信用风险内源响应），采纳后NPAs显著且持续下降，说明AI部署确实改善了风险监控和信贷筛选，而非仅作技术信号。研究提供了AI技术整合稳定信贷风险管理的因果证据。
AI.research_question: AI采用是否对银行核心财务指标（资产质量）产生实质改善，还是主要反映技术信号？（即AI采纳对不良资产的影响及其因果机制）
AI.motivation: AI在金融中介中的嵌入日益加深，但其对银行核心基本面指标的影响在实证上仍存在争议，既有文献未能明确区分AI的真实改善效应与象征性技术信号效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳的内生性理论（技术投资响应信贷风险与运营压力）、风险监控与信贷筛选理论、技术信号理论（signaling）。
AI.method: 使用2011-2025年印度商业银行的分阶段AI采纳数据，采用动态事件研究（动态处理效应）设计，控制银行和年份固定效应、差异前趋势、所有权异质性和宏观经济变量。
AI.findings: （1）AI采纳前数年内银行不良资产恶化，表明技术采纳内生于上升的信用风险和运营压力；（2）AI采纳后，不良资产显著且持续下降；（3）结果在银行/年份固定效应、前趋势检验、所有权异质性及宏观控制下均稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI技术采纳与银行资产负债表结果的因果关联提供实证证据，区分了实质改善效应与技术信号效应，回应了AI是否真正改善资产质量的争议。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理层和监管机构提供证据，表明AI整合可稳定信贷风险管理并有助于中期银行体系稳定，支持银行数字化转型的决策依据。

title: What a Backtest Overfitting Diagnostic Measures, and What Readers Take It to Mean

detail.title: What a Backtest Overfitting Diagnostic Measures, and What Readers Take It to Mean
detail.abstract: The probability of backtest overfitting measures how consistently the configuration selected in-sample continues to dominate its grid out-of-sample. Its authors state that the method assumes the grid represents the trials actually performed. Readers take a low value to mean that a backtest is not overfitted. These two readings coincide when the assumption holds and diverge when it does not, and we quantify the divergence. Simulating a researcher who explores M configurations with no edge whatsoever and reports a grid of ten containing the winner, the selection damage grows from 0.066 to 0.141 as M goes from ten to a thousand, while the reported statistic falls from 0.54 to 0.10. The direction is the difficulty: a wider hidden search produces a winner that is an extreme of the whole sample and therefore dominates its grid more consistently, which is exactly what a low value records. The effect holds under the Sharpe ratio as originally specified and under the mean outcome, under selection on the full sample and on a training subperiod, with and without a genuine edge, and at every level of correlation between configurations we tested. No statistic computed on the reported grid recovers what is missing. The diagnostic retains only the mean of the winner's out-of-sample ranks; their dispersion separates the two regimes when configurations are independent, and the separation vanishes once neighbouring configurations share sixty percent of their trades, as adjacent parameter values do. A protocol condition does restore it. When the grid is fixed before evaluation, the statistic becomes insensitive to search outside it, with a trend of-0.00 against-0.38 under free search. But an unverified pre-declaration is worth little: a researcher who declares a grid and explores elsewhere anyway finds a better candidate outside it in eighty-eight percent of cases at a thousand external trials, and the damage returns. The condition that makes the diagnostic interpretable is therefore a timestamped record of the search, which is a documentary artefact rather than a property of the returns.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了回测过拟合概率（PBO）统计量在假设违反时的偏差。当研究者实际搜索范围远大于报告的参数网格时，PBO会系统性偏低，产生"低值=未过拟合"的虚假安全感。研究发现，仅报告10个参数网格但实际探索1000个配置时，PBO从0.54降至0.10，而实际的"选择损害"从0.066升至0.141。任何基于报告网格计算的统计量都无法修复这一问题，唯有带时间戳的搜索记录（协议条件）才能恢复统计量的可解释性。
AI.research_question: 当研究者实际搜索的参数空间远大于其报告的网格时，回测过拟合概率（PBO）统计量会产生多大的偏差？能否通过报告网格上的统计量来修复这一偏差？
AI.motivation: PBO统计量的有效性依赖于"网格代表实际试验"这一假设，但实际研究中研究者常在更大的搜索空间中探索后仅报告包含最优结果的子网格，导致统计量被系统性低估，给读者带来虚假的安全感。
AI.theoretical_framework: 回测过拟合概率（Probability of Backtest Overfitting, PBO）；选择损害（Selection Damage）；样本内/样本外一致性；配置相关性；协议条件（Protocol Condition）。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟：模拟在M个配置中无优势（或无/有真实边际）的研究者，报告包含赢家的10个网格。测试夏普比率和均值结果、全样本和训练子样本选择、配置间不同相关性水平，以及固定网格（协议条件）与自由搜索两种情景。
AI.findings: （1）隐藏搜索越广，PBO越低（0.54→0.10），而实际选择损害越大（0.066→0.141）；（2）该效应在夏普比率、均值结果、有无真实优势、不同相关性水平下均稳健；（3）赢家样本外秩的离散度可在独立配置下区分两种机制，但当相邻配置共享60%交易时区分消失；（4）预先固定网格可使统计量对搜索外不敏感（趋势-0.00 vs -0.38）；（5）但不可验证的预声明价值有限——在1000次外部试验中，88%的情况下研究者能找到网格外的更好候选，损害复现。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了PBO统计量在违反"网格=实际试验"假设时的系统性方向偏差（低PBO反而对应更严重的过拟合），并指出任何基于报告网格的统计量（包括秩的离散度）在配置高度相关时都无法修复该问题；提出"带时间戳的搜索记录"作为使诊断可解释的必要协议条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用PBO的研究者和审稿人提供警示：低PBO值不能独立作为未过拟合的证据；要求研究者提供可验证的、带时间戳的完整搜索记录，而非仅报告精选网格；为期刊和监管机构制定回测报告标准提供依据。

title: The Corridor's Hidden Fragility, Applying the Reference-Class Correction to the Economic Appraisal of a West African Road

detail.title: The Corridor's Hidden Fragility, Applying the Reference-Class Correction to the Economic Appraisal of a West African Road

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interest. The study reuses only public appraisal documents of the African Development Bank and public World Bank evaluation data.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses only publicly available project appraisal and evaluation documents and involves no human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: A companion paper established, on the full record of World Bank evaluations, that the optimism bias of the economic rate of return grows with the ambition of the appraisal, and derived a reference-class deflation schedule from it. The present article tests that instrument on a named corridor, the Kankan–Kourémalé–Bamako road linking Guinea and Mali, whose appraisal we reconstruct from the African Development Bank report. We first reproduce exactly the appraisal rate of return of each of the two sections, 13.30 and 19.70 percent, from the published benefit stream, then decompose these benefits and set out the cost-benefit framework beneath them. We then apply the correction, which leaves the prudent section almost intact and heavily discounts the ambitious one. Three independent instruments, the margin after correction, the switching value and a Monte Carlo simulation, then converge on a counterintuitive result. The seemingly safest section, prudently appraised at 13.30 percent, is in fact the most fragile, with nearly a one-in-four chance of falling below the profitability hurdle, while the spectacular section, though heavily discounted, remains robust. A scenario analysis, a study of the sensitivity to traffic growth and to the discount rate, and a value-of-information reading of the verification count, sharpen the reach of the result. The lesson for appraisal practice is that a comfortable margin above the hurdle, once the bias is corrected, matters more than the announced level of the rate.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了一个基于世界银行评估记录构建的参考类校准工具（用于纠正经济回报率中的乐观偏差），并将其应用于连接几内亚和马里的Kankan–Kourémalé–Bamako公路走廊。通过精确重现非洲开发银行报告中两个路段的收益率（13.30%和19.70%），应用偏差校正后发现：表面谨慎的路段（13.30%）实际最为脆弱，有近四分之一概率跌破盈利门槛；而看似激进的路段经大幅折扣后仍然稳健。三种独立工具（校正后边际、转换值和蒙特卡洛模拟）得出一致结论。对评估实践的核心启示是：偏差校正后高于门槛的舒适边际，比公布的收益率水平更重要。
AI.research_question: 参考类校准工具（即对经济回报率乐观偏差的修正机制）在具体项目上的适用性如何？校正后哪个路段真正稳健，哪个路段真正脆弱？
AI.motivation: 已有companion paper基于世界银行全部评估记录证明了经济回报率的乐观偏差随评估雄心增长，并推导出参考类修正表。本文旨在将该工具应用于真实案例（Kankan–Kourémalé–Bamako公路）进行实证检验，并发现表面收益率水平可能误导决策判断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参考类预测（reference-class forecasting）理论；乐观偏差（optimism bias）理论；成本效益分析框架。
AI.method: 精确重现非洲开发银行报告中的两个路段收益率（13.30%和19.70%）；分解收益流并重建成本效益框架；应用参考类修正表进行偏差校正；采用三种独立工具交叉验证：校正后边际（margin after correction）、转换值（switching value）、蒙特卡洛模拟；辅以情景分析、交通增长和折现率敏感性分析、验证计数的信息价值（value-of-information）分析。
AI.findings: （1）成功精确重现了两个路段的原始收益率；（2）偏差校正对谨慎路段几乎无影响，但对激进路段大幅折扣；（3）看似安全的谨慎路段（13.30%）实际最脆弱，有近25%概率跌破盈利门槛；（4）看似激进的壮观路段虽经大幅折扣仍保持稳健；（5）三种独立工具结果收敛一致；（6）敏感性分析和信息价值分析进一步强化了上述结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 将参考类预测理论从宏观统计层面拓展到单个项目的微观验证层面；证明了乐观偏差修正后，边际安全性而非表观收益率才是项目稳健性的关键指标；为成本效益分析中"表面安全"与"实际脆弱"可能背离的现象提供了理论解释和实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估实践提供了可操作的工具验证：参考类修正表可应用于具体交通基础设施项目；指导评估者应关注修正后的边际而非公布的收益率水平；为多边开发银行的交通项目评估提供了偏差校正的实证案例和方法论示范。

title: Centerline Rumble Strip Installation and Lane-Departure Crash Rates: A Segment-Year Before-After Analysis in Iowa
affiliations: Baum Tenpers Research

detail.title: Centerline Rumble Strip Installation and Lane-Departure Crash Rates: A Segment-Year Before-After Analysis in Iowa
detail.abstract: Centerline rumble strips are one of the roadway treatments commonly used to address lane-departure crashes, especially on rural roads where those crashes can be severe (Federal Highway Administration [FHWA], 2006, 2011, 2017; Torbic et al., 2009). This study used Iowa roadway and crash data with known installation year to examine whether lane-departure crash rates were lower after centerline rumble strip installation. Crash records were linked to roadway segments and arranged into a segment-year panel so that changes before and after treatment could be examined more directly. A comparison-group before-after negative binomial model was used to evaluate post-installation changes while accounting for exposure and selected roadway characteristics which is consistent with count-data practice in crash-frequency analysis (AASHTO, 2010; Lord & Mannering, 2010). In the adjusted model without speed grouping, the post-installation incidence rate ratio (IRR) was 0.640, which corresponds to about a 36.0% reduction in lane-departure crash rate. After grouped speed limit was added, the estimate remained very similar, with an IRR of 0.632, or about a 36.8% reduction. Event-time results also showed lower crash rates from the installation year onward. At the same time the years leading up to installation were not completely flat, so the findings are better interpreted as strong evidence consistent with effectiveness rather than final causal proof. Like in other studies (Persaud & Lyon, 2007), a full Empirical Bayes before-after evaluation would still provide the stronger causal framework for estimating treatment effect.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用爱荷华州已知安装年份的道路和事故数据，通过比较组前后负二项模型评估了中心线隆声带安装对车道偏离事故率的影响，发现安装后事故率降低约36-37%，为隆声带的有效性提供了强有力证据。
AI.research_question: 中心线隆声带安装后，车道偏离事故率是否显著降低？
AI.motivation: 车道偏离事故（尤其是乡村道路上的此类事故）后果严重，中心线隆声带是常用的道路处理措施之一，但其效果需要严格的数据驱动评估来验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计数数据分析实践（如AASHTO指南及Lord & Mannering的研究），采用比较组前后负二项回归模型作为分析框架。
AI.method: 将事故记录与道路路段关联，构建路段-年度面板数据；采用带有比较组的before-after负二项模型，控制暴露量和道路特征，评估安装后的事故率变化；同时进行了事件时间分析（event-time analysis）和速度分组敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 未加速度分组时，安装后发病率比（IRR）为0.640，对应约36.0%的车道偏离事故率下降；加入分组速度限制后IRR为0.632，约36.8%下降。事件时间结果显示自安装年份起事故率持续较低，但安装前几年并非完全平稳。
AI.theory_contributions: 为基础设施安全措施的有效性评估提供了比较组前后设计的实证证据，支持了负二项模型在道路安全措施效果评估中的适用性，并指出了完全因果证明与证据一致性证据之间的区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通管理部门和道路安全政策制定者提供了中心线隆声带有效性（约36%事故率降低）的量化证据，有助于指导乡村道路安全基础设施的投入与决策。

title: Does Food Assistance Drive Spending on Sugary Foods? Evidence from the Pandemic Electronic Benefit Transfer Program
affiliations: American University and American University

detail.title: Does Food Assistance Drive Spending on Sugary Foods? Evidence from the Pandemic Electronic Benefit Transfer Program

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: All phases of this study were supported by a National Institutes of Health (NIH) grant, R01DK140192 (PI: Brandyn Churchill). The views expressed herein are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect the views of the NIH. The NIH had no role in the design or conduct of the study.

detail.abstract: Although it is unclear whether food assistance contributes to lower diet quality among recipients, policymakers are actively working to restrict SNAP-eligible purchases of items high in added sugars. We provide timely evidence on the extent to which food assistance increases spending on sugary items by studying the Pandemic Electronic Benefit Transfer (P-EBT) program, which provided food assistance benefits to families of children who lost access to free and reduced-price school meals due to COVID-19 pandemic school closures. Leveraging state-level variation in the timing of P-EBT disbursements and using a stacked difference-indifferences identification strategy with NielsenIQ Consumer Panel data, we find that P-EBT disbursement was associated with a 16-percent increase in weekly spending on sugary items among SNAP-eligible households with school-aged children. Notably, this increase exceeded the percentage increase in overall food spending for this group, suggesting that SNAP-eligible households with school-aged children allocated a disproportionately large share of their P-EBT-driven purchases toward sugary items relative to their pre-period baseline. We do not detect changes among households unlikely to have received P-EBT benefits or in placebo disbursement years.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用疫情期间P-EBT食品援助项目的州级发放时间差异，采用堆叠差分法结合NielsenIQ消费者面板数据，发现P-EBT发放与SNAP合格且有学龄儿童家庭含糖物品周支出增加16%相关，且该增幅超过总食品支出增幅，表明这些家庭将不成比例的大份额P-EBT购买额分配给了含糖物品。
AI.research_question: 食品援助是否会导致受助者购买更多含糖物品，从而降低饮食质量？具体而言，P-EBT食品援助项目的发放是否增加了SNAP合格家庭在含糖物品上的支出？
AI.motivation: 政策制定者正积极寻求限制SNAP可购买含糖物品的范围，但对食品援助是否真的导致更差的饮食质量尚不清楚。作者试图通过P-EBT这一自然实验提供及时证据，以回答食品援助对含糖食品消费影响的关键政策问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费行为理论，食品援助可能通过收入效应或替代效应改变受助家庭的食品购买结构；本文利用政策冲击的准自然实验框架，检验食品援助对含糖食品支出的因果效应。
AI.method: 利用各州P-EBT发放时间的差异，采用堆叠差分法（stacked difference-in-differences）识别策略，使用NielsenIQ消费者面板数据进行分析。
AI.findings: P-EBT发放与SNAP合格且有学龄儿童家庭含糖物品周支出增加16%相关，且该增幅超过总食品支出增幅，说明这些家庭将不成比例的大份额购买额分配给了含糖物品。对照家庭（不太可能收到P-EBT福利的家庭）及安慰剂发放年份中未检测到显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 为食品援助与饮食质量关系的争论提供了因果证据，表明食品援助（至少是P-EBT这类项目）确实会增加含糖物品支出，但也指出增幅相对于基线而言是适度的，为理解食品援助对消费行为的边际影响提供了经验基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者限制SNAP可购买含糖物品范围的讨论提供了及时、实证依据；同时暗示政策制定时需要权衡食品援助的福利效应与其可能对饮食质量的负面影响。

title: Modeling the Economic & Political Determinants of Chinese FDI in Africa

detail.title: Modeling the Economic & Political Determinants of Chinese FDI in Africa
detail.abstract: This paper contributes to the burgeoning literature regarding China’s increased engagement in the developing world, specifically in Africa, where the PRC has historically sought strong diplomatic ties. This study aims to evaluate the characteristics of African countries that dictate the distribution of Chinese Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) across the continent. To estimate the determinants of Chinese FDI across Africa, a two-way fixed effects model is used, which allows the effects of common FDI determinants like GDP, trade openness, and institutional quality to be isolated while controlling for country-specific and time-specific variation. This model contributes to the existing literature on Chinese FDI in Africa by offering an analysis of the key determinants of Chinese FDI on a continental scale, as well as addressing why heterogeneous effects of key determinants are often observed within the literature. To ensure the validity of results, a number of robustness tests are performed. This includes a Wald test for heteroskedasticity, an investigation of potential multicollinearity among independent variables using the variance inflation factor (VIF), and a series of Im-Pesaran-Shin tests for stationarity to determine whether independent variable characteristics change in the long run. The multiple models and ensuing analysis yield multiple interesting results. Primarily, it is found that Chinese FDI Stock in a given country is closely related to GDP and, therefore, market size. It is also found that China's FDI Stock is positively related to an index cataloging a given country’s political and institutional characteristics, and is negatively related to a country’s trade openness. The findings of this study provide important insights for African governments seeking to navigate the rise of China’s engagement on the continent, and also challenge the traditional narrative of exploitative Chinese investment in Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了中国对非洲直接投资的国别分布决定因素，使用双向固定效应模型分析非洲各国特征如何影响中国FDI的分布。研究发现中国FDI存量与市场规模（GDP）正相关，与政治制度质量正相关，但与贸易开放度负相关。
AI.research_question: 哪些非洲国家特征决定了中国对外直接投资（FDI）在非洲大陆的分布？
AI.motivation: 中国在发展中国家、特别是在非洲的参与度日益增加，但现有文献对中国FDI在非洲分布的国别决定因素研究不足，且已有研究中关键决定因素的异质性效应存在不一致，需要在大陆尺度上进行系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双向固定效应模型（two-way fixed effects model），基于国际直接投资决定因素理论，涵盖GDP、贸易开放度、制度质量等传统FDI决定因素。
AI.method: 采用双向固定效应模型，控制国家特定和时间特定变异，并进行了多项稳健性检验，包括异方差性的Wald检验、多重共线性的方差膨胀因子（VIF）检验，以及平稳性的Im-Pesaran-Shin检验。
AI.findings: 1）中国FDI存量与GDP（市场规模）密切相关；2）中国FDI存量与一国政治和制度特征指数正相关；3）中国FDI存量与一国贸易开放度负相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 在大陆尺度上系统分析中国FDI在非洲的决定因素，解释了为什么现有文献中关键决定因素的影响存在异质性效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲各国政府应对中国在非洲大陆日益增长的参与提供重要政策启示，同时挑战了关于中国在非洲进行剥削性投资的传统叙事。

title: AI Adoption and Stock Return Dynamics in Indian Banking: Evidence from Public and Private Sector Banks
affiliations: Acharya Institute of Graduate Studies, Acharya Institute of Graduate Studies and Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Open University

detail.title: AI Adoption and Stock Return Dynamics in Indian Banking: Evidence from Public and Private Sector Banks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest and no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses secondary, publicly available data (annual reports, financial statements, and stock market data) and does not involve human participants or patient data; therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency.

detail.abstract: While Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming financial intermediation, its impact on equity valuation, particularly within emerging economies such as India, remains opaque. This study examines the relationship between AI adoption and stock return dynamics in Indian banking using a balanced panel of ten major listed Indian banks, divided equally between public and private sector banks from fiscal year 2011-2025. Employing two-way fixed effects models, we evaluate whether AI integration, operationalized via binary indicator and a continuous intensity index, explains the variations in stock returns after controlling for bank-specific financial fundamentals and idiosyncratic risk. Under standard clustered standard errors, AI adoption shows no statistically significant effect on abnormal returns; however, under wild cluster bootstrap inference (more appropriate given the small number of cross-sectional clusters), the AI adoption coefficient is negative and economically borderline at the 5 percent level. The results remain consistent across ownership-interaction models, placebo tests, and dynamic event-time specifications. Adjacent to return-based findings, AI adoption shows no significant association with Return on Assets (ROA), a key profitability metric for Indian banking stocks. This could possibly be explained by a potential increase in operational costs associated with adoption and integration of AI technologies which offsets the productivity gains, leading to a productivity paradox. Altogether, the findings suggest that capital markets do not immediately reward, and may marginally penalize digital transformation initiatives in the Indian banking sector in the short run, consistent with investor scepticism about the near-term productivity gains or the internalization of implementation costs.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2011-2025财年10家印度主要上市银行（公营与私营各半）的平衡面板数据，采用双向固定效应模型，探讨AI采用对印度银行业股票收益的影响。在标准聚类标准误下AI采用无显著效应，但在小集群数更合适的野聚类自助法推断下，AI采用系数为负且在5%水平上经济意义上边缘显著。AI采用与ROA无显著关联，可能是AI整合带来的运营成本抵消了生产率收益，呈现"生产率悖论"。总体表明资本市场短期内不奖励甚至可能轻微惩罚印度银行业的数字化转型。
AI.research_question: AI采用如何影响印度银行业股票收益动态？资本市场是否即时奖励或惩罚银行的数字化转型举措？
AI.motivation: 虽然AI正在改变金融中介，但其对股票估值的影响，尤其是在印度等新兴经济体中的影响仍不透明，需要实证研究加以阐明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产率悖论（Productivity Paradox）、股票收益动态理论、数字化转型与资本市场定价理论
AI.method: 采用2011-2025财年10家印度上市银行的平衡面板数据，运用双向固定效应模型，AI采用通过二元指标和连续强度指数进行操作化，控制银行特定财务基本面与特质风险；使用标准聚类标准误与野聚类自助法推断，辅以所有权交互模型、安慰剂检验和动态事件时间规格进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）标准聚类标准误下AI采用对异常收益无显著影响；（2）野聚类自助法下AI采用系数为负且在5%水平经济意义上边缘显著；（3）结果在所有权交互模型、安慰剂检验和动态事件时间规格中保持一致；（4）AI采用与ROA无显著关联，可能因运营成本抵消生产率收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究为新兴经济体（印度）银行业AI采用与股票收益的关系提供了实证证据，丰富了数字化转型与资本市场定价的理论文献；揭示了AI投资中"生产率悖论"在银行业的具体表现。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度银行业及新兴市场投资者提供了关于AI投资短期市场反应的洞察，表明资本市场对数字化转型持怀疑态度，银行管理者需关注AI实施成本与短期回报的平衡。

title: In Situ Structural Transformation and Women's Autonomy: Evidence from Rural Bangladesh
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: In Situ Structural Transformation and Women's Autonomy: Evidence from Rural Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how in situ structural transformation, where men transition out of agriculture but remain in their communities, affects norm-based restrictions on women's autonomy. Using panel data from rural Bangladesh and a Double/Debiased Machine Learning approach, I isolate the effect of male occupational transitions on six indicators of female seclusion. I develop a theoretical framework modeling these restrictions as an equilibrium between the income-driven demand for patriarchal status and the rising efficiency costs of enforcement. Empirically, I find modest and statistically insignificant aggregate relaxations across most restrictions. However, these averages mask substantial heterogeneity: restrictions tighten among small landholding households but relax significantly for wealthier households, with effects also varying by household gender composition. Ultimately, male-biased economic shocks do not uniformly liberalize or tighten gender norms. Instead, changes depend on the specific enforcement costs and status-generating properties of individual restrictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了男性就地职业转型（从农业退出但留在社区）如何影响基于规范的对女性自主权的限制。利用孟加拉国农村的面板数据和双重/去偏机器学习方法，发现总体上对女性隔离指标的放松效应温和且统计上不显著，但存在显著的异质性：小土地持有家庭中限制收紧，而较富裕家庭中限制显著放松，且效果随家庭性别构成而变化。
AI.research_question: 男性就地结构转型（从农业部门退出但留在原社区）如何影响基于规范的女性自主权限制？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对就地结构转型（区别于迁移式转型）如何影响性别规范的系统性分析，需要理解男性经济角色变化对女性隔离规范（purdah）的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将女性隔离限制建模为"收入驱动的父权地位需求"与"执行成本上升"之间的均衡结果。
AI.method: 使用孟加拉国农村的面板数据，采用Double/Debiased Machine Learning方法，隔离男性职业转型对六项女性隔离指标的影响。
AI.findings: 总体上女性隔离限制的放松效应温和且统计上不显著；但异质性显著：小土地持有家庭中限制收紧，富裕家庭中限制显著放松；效果还随家庭性别构成而变化。男性偏向的经济冲击不会均匀地自由化或收紧性别规范。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将性别规范变化视为均衡结果的框架，强调执行成本与父权地位生成属性的具体限制特征决定了规范变迁方向，挑战了"经济冲击均匀影响性别规范"的简单假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据：经济结构转型对性别平等的效果取决于家庭经济状况和具体限制类型，需要针对性干预而非一刀切方案。

title: Geospatial Imagery and Machine Learning in Commercial Real Estate Valuation
affiliations: University of Central Florida, Auburn University - Department of Finance, Florida State University and University of South Florida

detail.title: Geospatial Imagery and Machine Learning in Commercial Real Estate Valuation
detail.abstract: Investors price commercial property partly on how it looks, yet visual attributes rarely appear in the data used to study transaction pricing. Using satellite and street view imagery for 6,533 U.S. single-tenant net lease transactions from 2005 to 2020, we read each property's images two ways: as scores against attributes we name in advance, and as unlabeled statistical summaries. Together they close about 6.5 percent of the cap rate variation left unexplained by conventional property, market, lease, and time controls, and the named attributes account for most of it. The gain survives county fixed effects, public controls for walkability, demographics, urban form, and flood risk, and it improves out-of-sample forecasts. Because most of what imagery contributes can be stated in words, appraisal and underwriting can use it without sacrificing transparency.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用卫星和街景图像分析了6,533笔美国单一租户净租赁交易，发现视觉属性能够解释传统控制变量未能解释的约6.5%的资本化率差异，且大部分信息可以用文字描述，保持了评估和承销过程的透明度。
AI.research_question: 房地产的视觉属性如何影响商业地产交易定价（资本化率），以及图像信息能否弥补传统定价数据中缺失的视觉维度？
AI.motivation: 投资者在定价商业地产时会部分依据其外观，但视觉属性很少出现在用于研究交易定价的数据中，导致传统模型存在信息缺失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于房地产定价理论，结合计算机视觉方法，将图像信息分为预先命名的属性评分与无标注的统计摘要两类进行资本化率解释。
AI.method: 使用2005-2020年美国6,533笔单一租户净租赁交易数据，通过卫星和街景图像，采用两种方式读取每处房产图像：(1)针对预先指定属性的评分；(2)无标签的统计摘要。结合传统属性、市场、租约和时间控制变量进行回归分析。
AI.findings: 图像信息共同解释了传统控制变量未能解释的约6.5%的资本化率变异，其中预先命名的属性贡献了大部分解释力。该增益在加入县级固定效应、步行便利性、人口统计、城市形态和洪水风险等公共控制变量后依然存在，并改善了样本外预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 将视觉维度引入商业地产定价研究，证明图像信息对资本化率具有显著且可量化的解释力，为房地产定价理论补充了视觉属性这一此前被忽视的因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 由于图像贡献的大部分信息可以用文字表述，评估和承销实践中可以在不牺牲透明度的前提下利用视觉信息，为房地产估值和贷款承销提供了可操作的改进方案。

title: Sampford Apportionment Satisfies Threshold Monotonicity
affiliations: , University of New South Wales (UNSW) and University of New South Wales (UNSW)

detail.title: Sampford Apportionment Satisfies Threshold Monotonicity

declarations.funderStatement: Haris Aziz and Simon Mackenzie are supported by the NSF-CSIRO grant on “Fair Sequential Collective Decision-Making” (RG230833). Mashbat Suzuki is supported by the ARC Laureate Project FL200100204 on “Trustworthy AI”.

detail.abstract: Apportionment distributes a fixed number of legislative seats among political parties in proportion to their vote shares. Randomization can satisfy quota in every realization and exact proportionality in expectation, but these requirements determine only the parties' marginal seat distributions. We study threshold monotonicity, which requires that when every standard quota inside a coalition weakly increases and every standard quota outside it weakly decreases, the coalition's new seat total stochastically dominates its old one. We prove that Sampford apportionment satisfies threshold monotonicity, resolving the threshold-monotonicity conjecture of Correa et al. (2024). Complementing this result, we prove that no quota-respecting, ex-ante proportional method satisfies pairwise threshold monotonicity even for disjoint coalitions when there are at least seven parties. This impossibility applies whether or not the method has full support.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机席位分配方法中的阈值单调性（threshold monotonicity）性质。作者证明了Sampford分配方法满足阈值单调性，解决了Correa等人（2024）提出的猜想；同时证明在至少有七个政党时，不存在任何满足配额约束和事前比例性的方法能满足配对阈值单调性（即使在不相交联盟的情况下）。
AI.research_question: 随机席位分配方法是否能够同时满足阈值单调性以及其他基本的分配性质（如配额约束、事前比例性）？
AI.motivation: 随机化可以同时满足实现配额约束和期望比例性，但这仅决定各政党的边际席位分布。阈值单调性是一个重要的规范性要求，它确保联盟内所有政党的标准配额增加时，联盟的席位总数在随机占优意义上不会变差。此前Correa等人（2024）提出了Sampford分配满足阈值单调性的猜想，但尚未得到证明；同时，现有文献也未系统探讨阈值单调性与其他性质之间的兼容性边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于社会选择理论与公平分配理论，核心概念包括席位分配中的配额约束（quota）、事前比例性（ex-ante proportionality）、随机占优（stochastic dominance）、阈值单调性（threshold monotonicity）以及Sampford分配方法。
AI.method: 本文采用理论证明方法：一方面通过构造性证明（positive result）证明Sampford分配满足阈值单调性；另一方面通过构造反例（negative/impossibility result）证明在至少七个政党时，不存在满足配额约束和事前比例性的方法能够满足配对阈值单调性。
AI.findings: （1）Sampford分配方法满足阈值单调性，解决了Correa等人（2024）的猜想；（2）当政党数量至少为七时，任何满足配额约束和事前比例性的分配方法都满足不了配对阈值单调性，即使仅考虑不相交联盟的情况（无论方法是否具有完全支持性质）。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）从理论上解决了随机席位分配领域一个悬而未决的猜想，明确了Sampford分配方法在阈值单调性方面的正面性质；（2）揭示了配额约束、事前比例性与配对阈值单调性之间的不可兼容性，刻画了随机席位分配方法的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为实际应用中设计随机席位分配机制提供了理论指导：Sampford分配是可用的满足阈值单调性的方法；（2）通过不可能性结果警示实践者在追求更强单调性要求（配对阈值单调性）时需付出放弃配额约束或事前比例性的代价。

title: The Substance Trap Transfer Pricing and the Global Minimum Tax After the 2026 Side by Side Package: Long Run Consequences for West Africa and for Nigeria

detail.title: The Substance Trap Transfer Pricing and the Global Minimum Tax After the 2026 Side by Side Package: Long Run Consequences for West Africa and for Nigeria
detail.abstract: The international tax settlement changed shape twice in eighteen months. In June 2025 Nigeria enacted a domestic minimum effective tax rate of fifteen percent, effective January 2026, and in January 2026 the Inclusive Framework agreed a Side by Side package that exempts United States parented groups from the two principal charging rules of the global minimum tax and introduces a Substance based Tax Incentive Safe Harbour. I argue that the second of these changes carries a distributional consequence for low wage economies that has not been priced into African policy debate. The safe harbour protects a tax incentive only up to a cap set at five and a half percent of eligible payroll costs, so the fraction of an incentive that survives is proportional to the wage bill a jurisdiction happens to carry per unit of taxable profit. I show that a full exemption is preserved intact only where payroll exceeds GloBE income by a factor of 2.73, a threshold no plausible West African configuration reaches, while an economy with an OECD style labour share sits within reach of it. The minimum tax is therefore not neutral across development levels: it is neutral in wages, which is a different and much less attractive property. Three implications follow. Regionally, tax holidays have become a transfer from West African treasuries to foreign ones, and the only reliable instrument of recapture is a qualified domestic minimum top-up tax, which no Economic Community of West African States member has yet enacted. Nationally, Nigeria's section 57 rule is close to that instrument but not identical to it, and I show that whenever GloBE income exceeds the Nigerian statutory base by a factor δ, a residual foreign claim of τ (1-1/δ) survives full domestic compliance, worth three percentage points of profit at δ = 1.25 and five at δ = 1.50. The reform priority is base alignment and qualification, not rate setting.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025-2026年国际税收制度两次重大变革对低收入经济体的分配性后果，特别是全球最低税"Side by Side"方案中基于实质的税收激励安全港规则。该安全港的税收激励保护上限设定为合格工资成本的5.5%，导致激励保护比例与该辖区每单位应税利润所对应的工资账单成正比。作者证明，只有工资支出超过GloBE收入的2.73倍时才能保留完整豁免，而西非经济体远达不到这一门槛，OECD式劳动份额的经济体则接近门槛。因此最低税并非在发展水平间保持中性，它仅在工资金额上中性，这是截然不同且吸引力弱得多的属性。
AI.research_question: 全球最低税"Side by Side"方案中基于实质的税收激励安全港规则对低收入（特别是西非）经济体产生了怎样的分配性后果？这些后果如何影响税收激励的有效性和政策应对？
AI.motivation: 国际税收结算在18个月内两次重大变革：尼日利亚于2025年6月出台15%的国内最低有效税率（2026年1月生效），2026年1月包容性框架达成"Side by Side"方案，豁免美国母公司集团的两项主要全球最低税征税规则，并引入基于实质的税收激励安全港。作者认为第二项变革对低工资经济体产生了非洲政策辩论中尚未定价的分配性后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球最低税（GloBE）税收激励安全港机制、工资成本挂钩的激励保护上限、劳动份额与税收中性理论
AI.method: 数学推导与数值分析：通过推导安全港的工资-利润比率保护条件（2.73倍阈值），比较西非经济体与OECD式经济体的劳动份额配置，分析税收激励的保护比例与辖区工资账单对单位应税利润的比例关系。
AI.findings: 1）只有工资超过GloBE收入2.73倍的辖区才能保留完整豁免，没有西非配置能达到此门槛，而OECD式劳动份额的经济体接近达到。2）最低税在工资金额而非发展水平上中性。3）区域层面，税收豁免已成为西非国库向外转移的工具，唯一可靠的回收手段是合格国内最低补足税（QDMTT），但ECOWAS成员国均未颁布。4）国家层面，尼日利亚第57条规则接近但不等同于QDMTT，当GloBE收入超过尼日利亚法定税基δ倍时，残余外国索赔为τ(1-1/δ)，在δ=1.25时值3个百分点利润，δ=1.50时值5个百分点。5）改革优先事项是税基对齐和资格认定，而非税率设定。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了全球最低税安全港规则在不同发展水平经济体间的分配性后果，证明该规则并非在发展水平上保持中性，而是在工资金额上中性，为国际税收分配正义理论提供了新的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为西非经济体（尤其尼日利亚）提供了明确的政策建议：优先实施合格国内最低补足税（QDMTT），聚焦税基对齐与资格认定而非设定税率；量化了尼日利亚第57条规则的不足及优化空间。

title: The Digital Sovereignty Trap: Fragmentation, Retaliation and the Limits of Regulatory Power

detail.title: The Digital Sovereignty Trap: Fragmentation, Retaliation and the Limits of Regulatory Power

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an official of the European Commission, representing the EU on digital policy issues in G20, G7 and trade negotiations, and teaches International Digital Policies and Regulations at Sciences-Po Paris.

contentType.other: Revised manuscript, submitted to Computer Law & Security Review — currently under peer review after first round of reviewer comments (manuscript CLSR-D-26-00799).

detail.abstract: "Digital sovereignty" is one of the most invoked yet least legally defined concepts in contemporary regulatory discourse. For example, across eight major jurisdictions (the European Union, the United States, China, the United Kingdom (UK), India, Brazil, Canada and Japan) governments are putting digital sovereignty at the top of their agenda, appointing ministers responsible for it, enacting measures justified by appeals to this objective, yet the legal content of that concept varies dramatically by actor, by layer of the digital stack targeted, and by the underlying justification advanced. This article argues that digital sovereignty is not yet a coherent legal principle, but a contested political claim translated into fragmented regulatory instruments. Through a comparative analysis of legislative design and enforcement mechanisms, the article develops, building on prior scholarship in digital policy studies, a typology of four archetypes of sovereignty claims (data sovereignty, technological sovereignty, regulatory sovereignty, and jurisdictional sovereignty) and maps how each is being operationalised. It then examines a paradox: the stronger the assertion of digital sovereignty, the more it provokes counter-assertions by others, progressively eroding the sovereignty of all. Drawing on WTO law, trade agreements, and emerging international coalitions, the article proposes possible legal avenues for distinguishing legitimate digital sovereignty claims from disguised protectionism, and concludes that, absent multilateral discipline, the current fragmentation risks producing a sovereignty trap from which no actor can escape.

AI.tldr: 本文论证"数字主权"并非一个连贯的法律原则，而是一个被转化为碎片化监管工具的政治性争议主张。通过八大司法辖区的比较分析，文章构建了四种数字主权主张的理想类型（数据主权、技术主权、监管主权和管辖权主权），并揭示了一个悖论：数字主权的强调越强烈，越会引发他者的反制主张，从而侵蚀所有人的主权。文章最后基于WTO法和贸易协定提出区分正当数字主权主张与伪装保护主义的法律途径，并警告缺乏多边纪律的碎片化可能导致"主权陷阱"。
AI.research_question: 数字主权在当代监管话语中被频繁援引却缺乏法律定义，其法律内容究竟如何？不同司法辖区的数字主权主张呈现何种形态与差异？应如何在法律上区分正当的数字主权主张与伪装的保护主义？
AI.motivation: 数字主权是当代监管话语中被引用最多但法律定义最模糊的概念之一。八大主要司法辖区（欧盟、美国、中国、英国、印度、巴西、加拿大和日本）均将数字主权置于议程顶端，任命负责部长并以此为理由制定措施，但该概念的法律内容因行为者、数字堆栈层级和背后的论证理由而存在巨大差异，亟需系统的法律分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字政策研究的既有学术成果，结合比较立法设计与执法机制的分析框架，构建数字主权主张的类型学（数据主权、技术主权、监管主权、管辖权主权四种理想类型），并借鉴WTO法、贸易协定及新兴国际联盟的法律理论。
AI.method: 比较分析方法：对欧盟、美国、中国、英国、印度、巴西、加拿大和日本八大司法辖区的数字主权相关立法设计与执法机制进行系统比较，在此基础上建构类型学框架，并运用WTO法和贸易协定进行法律分析。
AI.findings: （1）数字主权尚非连贯的法律原则，而是被转化为碎片化监管工具的政治性争议主张；（2）可归纳出四种数字主权主张的理想类型：数据主权、技术主权、监管主权和管辖权主权；（3）存在一个悖论：数字主权主张越强烈，越会引发他者的反制主张，逐渐侵蚀所有人的主权；（4）缺乏多边纪律的碎片化可能导致无人能逃脱的"主权陷阱"。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）系统揭示了"数字主权"作为法律概念的不连贯性，挑战了其作为统一法律原则的预设；（2）构建了四种数字主权理想类型的类型学框架，为数字政策研究提供了新的分析工具；（3）提出"主权悖论"概念，深化了对数字主权动态交互效应的理论理解；（4）为法律层面区分正当主权主张与保护主义提供了规范性理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者厘清数字主权的法律边界与内涵提供参考；（2）基于WTO法和贸易协定提出区分合法数字主权主张与伪装保护主义的可行法律途径；（3）警示碎片化监管的风险，为国际多边协调和数字治理合作提供政策建议。

title: On Tuberculosis Incidence, Health Expenditure and the Macroeconomy:,Insights from Cross- Country Data
affiliations: Monash University - Monash University Malaysia, University of the Philippines Diliman and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: On Tuberculosis Incidence, Health Expenditure and the Macroeconomy:,Insights from Cross- Country Data
detail.abstract: This study examines the determinants of tuberculosis (TB) incidence using a Poisson spatial autoregressive model that incorporates macroeconomic, socioeconomic, population health, and public health expenditure indicators. Spatial dependence is captured through a spatial autoregressive component based on average per capita health expenditure within income regions. Using pooled cross-country data, parameters are estimated through a backfitting algorithm combining conditional least squares and maximum likelihood estimation, while statistical significance is evaluated using the AR Sieve Bootstrap.,Results show that the inclusion of both temporal and spatial autoregressive effects improves the predictive performance of conventional Poisson regression models. TB incidence is significantly influenced by socioeconomic conditions, underscoring the role of social and economic factors in shaping disease burden. A positive and significant spatial effect is also observed, suggesting that public health expenditures within an income region influence health outcomes, including TB incidence.,The findings highlight the importance of sustained government investment in public health programs for controlling communicable diseases. Equally important is the strategic allocation of health resources toward interventions that address disease transmission and socioeconomic vulnerabilities. Targeted, pro-poor health policies that promote equitable access to healthcare can reduce the financial burden on affected households and improve population health outcomes. Overall, the results support prioritizing health expenditures that simultaneously address the social determinants of health and communicable disease control.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用泊松空间自回归模型分析结核病发病率的决定因素，纳入宏观经济、社会经济、人口健康和公共卫生支出指标。研究发现时空自回归效应的加入提高了传统泊松回归模型的预测性能，结核病发病率显著受社会经济条件影响，且存在显著的正向空间效应，说明某收入区域内公共卫生支出会影响包括结核病在内的健康结果。研究强调了持续政府公共卫生投资和战略性资源配置对控制传染病的重要性。
AI.research_question: 结核病发病率的决定因素是什么？空间自回归效应如何影响结核病发病率的预测和解释？
AI.motivation: 结核病是全球重大传染病负担，传统泊松回归模型未充分考虑空间依赖性和时间效应，可能导致估计偏差。作者希望通过纳入空间自回归成分来更准确地识别结核病发病率的影响因素，特别是公共卫生支出的空间溢出效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 泊松空间自回归模型（Poisson spatial autoregressive model）；空间依赖理论；社会决定因素理论（social determinants of health）
AI.method: 采用泊松空间自回归模型，结合条件最小二乘与极大似然估计的backfitting算法进行参数估计，使用AR Sieve Bootstrap评估统计显著性，基于跨国面板数据进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）同时纳入时间与空间自回归效应可提升传统泊松回归模型的预测性能；（2）社会经济条件显著影响结核病发病率；（3）存在显著的正向空间效应，表明收入区域内公共卫生支出影响包括结核病在内的健康结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将空间自回归机制引入传染病流行病学建模，为理解公共卫生支出的空间溢出效应提供了方法学贡献；拓展了社会决定因素理论在传染病负担研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调政府持续投资公共卫生项目对控制传染病的重要性；建议战略性分配卫生资源以应对疾病传播和社会经济脆弱性；倡导面向贫困群体的健康政策以促进医疗公平、减轻家庭经济负担并改善人口健康结果。

title: The Value of Tax Transparency
affiliations: University of Iowa - Henry B. Tippie College of Business, University of Iowa - Henry B. Tippie College of Business and

detail.title: The Value of Tax Transparency
detail.abstract: We examine investor responses to the first jurisdiction-level income tax disclosures required under new accounting standards (ASU 2023-09). Using firms' first ASU 2023-09 compliant Form 10-K filings, we find that firms experience significantly more favorable filing window abnormal returns, ranging from 1.4 to 1.6 percentage points, when the expanded effective tax rate reconciliation reveals that any foreign jurisdiction materially lowers the firm's effective tax rate. This reaction is concentrated among tax havens. A complementary intensive-margin test, using the number of haven jurisdictions a firm discloses rather than a binary indicator, corroborates this concentration: the market reaction rises significantly with each additional haven jurisdiction disclosed. Overall, our findings provide initial evidence that investors value the enhanced transparency introduced by new tax disclosure requirements, particularly information conveyed through the expanded effective tax rate reconciliation, and that this value is concentrated in disclosures identifying economically significant tax-haven activity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用ASU 2023-09新会计准则下公司首次提交的Form 10-K文件，研究发现当扩展的有效税率调节表显示外国司法管辖区显著降低了公司有效税率时，公司经历了显著更有利的申报窗口异常回报（约1.4至1.6个百分点），且这一反应集中在避税天堂。市场反应随披露的避税天堂辖区数量增加而显著上升，表明投资者重视新税收披露要求带来的增强透明度。
AI.research_question: 投资者如何响应首次司法管辖区级所得税披露（ASU 2023-09），特别是扩展有效税率调节表中外国司法管辖区信息的影响？
AI.motivation: 新会计准则ASU 2023-09首次要求企业在司法管辖区层面披露所得税信息，这为研究者提供了检验投资者是否重视税收透明度的天然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息披露理论、有效资本市场假说；基于税收透明度与投资者估值视角分析市场对新增披露信息的反应。
AI.method: 事件研究法，利用公司首次符合ASU 2023-09的Form 10-K申报窗口异常回报衡量市场反应；采用二元变量和连续变量（避税天堂辖区数量）的密集边际检验。
AI.findings: 当扩展有效税率调节表显示外国辖区实质降低公司有效税率时，申报窗口异常回报显著更有利（1.4-1.6个百分点）；该反应集中于避税天堂；市场反应随披露的避税天堂辖区数量增加而显著上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供投资者重视税收披露透明度增强的初步证据，拓展了信息披露价值相关性的理论理解；表明扩展有效税率调节表所传达的信息具有增量价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估ASU 2023-09披露要求的有效性提供实证证据；帮助企业理解投资者如何解读司法管辖区级税收披露，对税务策略和披露实践具有参考意义。

title: The Singleton Effect: Isolated Digits Overturn the Presumed Hierarchy of Cultural Number Preferences

detail.title: The Singleton Effect: Isolated Digits Overturn the Presumed Hierarchy of Cultural Number Preferences

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available, non-human-subject archival data (lottery draw and payout records) and does not require ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: A substantial literature documents that culturally lucky numbers shape economic behavior, from stock listing codes to housing prices to trading decisions, with the digit 8-associated with wealth in Chinese culture-consistently identified as the dominant cultural anchor. We show this consensus reflects a measurement artifact: prior studies measure preference through multi-digit identifiers (stock tickers, addresses, license plates), conflating positional salience with the strength of a digit's underlying cultural meaning. Using 24 years of data from the Hong Kong Mark Six lottery-3,277 draws and over US$20 billion in turnover-we exploit a discontinuity between prize tiers that isolates a single digit from combinatorial noise. First, contrary to the presumed hierarchy, digit 9 is selected 37% more often than chance, exceeding 8's 27% premium. Second, the "Singleton Effect" explains why: digit 9's pull collapses nearly 90% once embedded in a compound identifier, versus only 38% for 8, explaining why decades of compound-identifier-based studies converged on the wrong anchor. Third, we quantify the economic cost of this preference at the singleton level, free of the compound-identifier contamination affecting many prior premium estimates: digit 9 commands an "Auspiciousness Premium" of 18.6%, versus 16.3% for digit 8, while the culturally shunned 40s range earns a "Tetraphobia Discount" of up to 23.3%. Together, our findings offer a template for isolating the true magnitude of willingness to pay for cultural preferences wherever compound identifiers may dilute existing estimates.

AI.tldr: 本研究质疑了现有文献中"数字8是中华文化中最具吉利含义的数字"这一共识，认为此前的结论是测量假象：以往研究通过多位数标识符（股票代码、地址、车牌）测量偏好，混淆了位置显著性（如首位数字）与数字本身的文化含义强度。作者利用香港六合彩24年数据（3277期、超过200亿美元投注额），利用奖级之间的不连续性将单个数字从组合噪声中分离出来。研究发现：数字9的选择频率（高出随机37%）超过数字8（27%）；数字9的偏好被称为"单例效应"，当嵌入复合标识符时其拉动力下降近90%，而数字8只下降38%，这解释了为何数十年基于复合标识符的研究得出了错误的锚点；在单例层面，数字9享有18.6%的"吉祥溢价"，数字8为16.3%，而文化上避讳的40区间享有高达23.3%的"四忌折价"。
AI.research_question: 文化吉利数字（尤其是"8"）对经济行为的影响是否如现有文献所示？此前研究中"8"的主导地位是否源于测量方法缺陷？
AI.motivation: 现有文献一致认为数字8是中华文化中最具经济影响力的吉利数字，但这种共识可能源于一个系统性测量问题：以往研究都是通过多位数标识符（股票代码、地址、车牌号）来测量偏好，这些标识符混淆了位置显著性（如首位效应、末位效应）与数字本身文化含义的强度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化偏好理论、数字吉祥信仰（数字命理学）、测量方法论（位置显著性与文化含义强度的区分）、"单例效应"（Singleton Effect）
AI.method: 利用香港六合彩24年数据（3277期、超过200亿美元投注额），利用奖级之间的不连续性（discontinuity between prize tiers）来隔离单个数字的文化偏好，将单数字选择与复合标识符嵌入场景分离，从而消除组合噪声和位置混淆。
AI.findings: （1）数字9的选择频率比随机高37%，超过数字8的27%溢价；（2）"单例效应"：数字9嵌入复合标识符后其偏好拉力下降近90%，而数字8仅下降38%，解释了此前研究为何一致得出"8主导"的错误结论；（3）单例层面，数字9享有18.6%的"吉祥溢价"，数字8为16.3%，而避讳的40区间享有高达23.3%的"四忌折价"。
